title: SaliMory: Orchestrating Cognitive Memory for Conversational Agents
summary: Conversational agents that serve as lifelong companions must maintain persistent memory across all interactions. However, simply expanding context windows with raw retrieval degrades reasoning quality, while training memory agents via standard reinforcement learning creates a severe credit assignment bottleneck in a multi-stage pipeline. To solve this, we introduce SALIMORY, a framework that trains a single language model to manage a cognitively-structured memory-spanning user facts, preferences, and working memory. By introducing a hierarchical stage-wise process reward and reward-decomposed contrastive refinement, SALIMORY provides isolated supervision for distinct memory operations (selective filtering, consolidation, and cue-driven recall) end-to-end. SALIMORY cuts memory-attributed failures by one-third, outperforms the state-of-the-art by over 10% in end-to-end accuracy, and more than doubles the Good Personalization rate.

AI.title_translation: SaliMory：为对话代理编排认知记忆
AI.tldr: SALIMORY 是一种新型对话代理记忆架构，通过分层监督和认知结构化管理，大幅提升了模型的长期记忆准确性和个性化互动能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的对话代理在处理长期记忆时，简单扩展上下文窗口会降低推理质量，而传统的强化学习训练方法在多阶段记忆管道中存在严重的信用分配瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 SALIMORY 框架，训练单一语言模型管理包含用户事实、偏好和工作记忆的结构化记忆；通过分层阶段式过程奖励和奖励分解的对比精炼技术，实现对记忆操作（过滤、整合、回溯）的端到端监督。
AI.result: SALIMORY 将记忆相关故障减少了三分之一，端到端准确率提升超过 10%，并使良好个性化率提升了一倍以上。
AI.conclusion: SALIMORY 通过分层认知记忆管理和细粒度的监督机制，显著提升了对话代理在长期记忆交互中的准确性和个性化表现。
AI.translation: 作为终身伴侣的对话代理必须在所有交互中保持持久的记忆。然而，简单地通过原始检索扩展上下文窗口会降低推理质量，而通过标准强化学习训练记忆代理会在多阶段流水线中产生严重的信用分配瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 SALIMORY，这是一个训练单一语言模型来管理跨用户事实、偏好和工作记忆的认知结构化记忆的框架。通过引入分层阶段式过程奖励和奖励分解的对比精炼，SALIMORY 为不同的记忆操作（选择性过滤、整合和线索驱动的回溯）提供了端到端的隔离监督。SALIMORY 将记忆归因故障减少了三分之一，端到端准确率比现有技术水平提高了 10% 以上，并将良好个性化率提高了一倍以上。
AI.summary: SALIMORY 是一种旨在提升对话代理长期记忆能力的框架，通过训练单一模型管理认知结构化记忆，并引入分层奖励和对比精炼机制，有效解决了记忆操作中的监督难题，显著提升了对话的准确性和个性化水平。
AI.keywords: 对话代理, 认知记忆, 强化学习, 记忆管理, 个性化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将认知架构引入对话代理的记忆管理，通过分阶段的奖励机制和对比精炼策略，有效解决了长生命周期记忆中复杂的信用分配问题，在提升个性化体验方面具有显著价值。

title: veriFIRE: an Industrial Case Study in Verifying Consistency Properties for a DNN-Based Wildfire Detection System
comments: To appear in The 9th International Symposium on AI Verification (SAIV)
summary: We present our ongoing work on the veriFIRE project: a collaboration between industry and academia, aimed at applying verification to increase the reliability of a real-world, safety-critical system. Specifically, we target an airborne platform for wildfire detection, which incorporates two deep neural networks. We present an end-to-end methodology for verifying \textit{consistency properties} in this system. Our approach encodes application-grounded requirements into solver-compatible queries for existing neural network verifiers. We study properties of interest over critical operational scenarios: (i) monotonicity of detector confidence as target intensity increases; and (ii) bounded detector response under physically plausible blur over the sensor. We instantiate these encodings using state-of-the-art neural network verification backends and evaluate them at scale on real background samples. For the first property, all verification queries are solved in under five minutes. For the second property, verification is substantially harder, highlighting key scalability challenges for richer, higher-dimensional specifications. Overall, the results demonstrate that meaningful, domain-specific guarantees can be obtained for industrial systems.
comment: To appear in The 9th International Symposium on AI Verification (SAIV)

AI.title_translation: veriFIRE：一个在基于DNN的野火检测系统中验证一致性属性的工业案例研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种验证工业级野火检测系统中深度神经网络一致性属性的方法，证明了领域特定安全保证的可行性并指出了扩展性挑战。
AI.motivation: 旨在提升现实世界安全关键型系统（如机载野火检测系统）的可靠性，解决深度神经网络在工业应用中的安全性验证难题。
AI.method: 提出了一套端到端的验证方法，将野火检测系统的应用需求编码为现有神经网络验证器可处理的求解器查询，重点验证了检测器置信度的单调性和传感器模糊下的响应边界。
AI.result: 实验表明，单调性属性可在5分钟内完成验证；而针对传感器模糊的边界响应属性验证难度较大，凸显了复杂高维规范在扩展性上的挑战。
AI.conclusion: veriFIRE项目证明了通过将领域特定需求编码为验证查询，可以为工业级深度神经网络系统提供有意义的安全保证，尽管复杂属性的验证仍存在扩展性瓶颈。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了veriFIRE项目的最新进展：这是一个工业界与学术界的合作项目，旨在应用验证技术提高现实世界安全关键系统的可靠性。具体而言，我们针对一个集成了两个深度神经网络的机载野火检测平台。我们提出了一套用于验证该系统“一致性属性”的端到端方法。我们的方法将基于应用的需求编码为现有神经网络验证器兼容的求解器查询。我们研究了关键运行场景下的感兴趣属性：(i) 随着目标强度增加，检测器置信度的单调性；以及 (ii) 在传感器存在物理可信模糊的情况下，受限的检测器响应。我们使用最先进的神经网络验证后端对这些编码进行了实例化，并在真实的背景样本上进行了大规模评估。对于第一个属性，所有验证查询均在五分钟内解决。对于第二个属性，验证难度显著增加，凸显了更丰富、更高维规范的关键扩展性挑战。总体而言，结果表明可以为工业系统获得有意义的、领域特定的保证。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了veriFIRE项目，该项目通过一套端到端的验证方法，为机载野火检测系统中的深度神经网络提供一致性属性验证，旨在提升工业安全关键系统的可靠性。研究评估了检测器置信度单调性和传感器模糊下的响应边界，验证了该方法在工业场景下的有效性及面临的扩展性限制。
AI.keywords: 深度神经网络, 形式化验证, 野火检测, 一致性属性, 工业案例研究
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将神经网络验证技术应用于真实的工业安全关键系统（机载野火检测）。它成功地将抽象的领域需求转化为求解器可用的查询，为工业界AI系统的可靠性验证提供了切实可行的路径，同时也揭示了高维复杂属性在验证扩展性方面面临的挑战。

title: HighTide: An Agent-Curated Open-Source VLSI Benchmark Suite
summary: We introduce HighTide, an evolving AI-assisted benchmark suite. Specifically, the contributions are: (i) a diverse open-source suite spanning multiple design languages and technology nodes, (ii) Bazel-based incremental RTL-to-GDS compilation with remote caching, (iii) AI-assisted design curation through twelve agent skills covering the design lifecycle, flow optimization, tool reference, and meta-maintenance, backed by per-design decision logs that serve as long-term memory of tuning rationale across the suite, and (iv) an infrastructure with RTL compilation verification for stable releases. The suite is publicly available and designed to grow with the open-source hardware ecosystem.

AI.title_translation: HighTide：一个由 Agent 策划的开源 VLSI 基准测试套件
AI.tldr: HighTide 是一个利用 AI Agent 自动化管理和优化流程的开源 VLSI 基准测试套件，支持高效的增量编译和长期的设计决策记录。
AI.motivation: 为了解决当前 VLSI 设计领域缺乏高质量、可演进且由 AI 驱动的开源基准测试套件的问题，以支持硬件设计流程的自动化与优化。
AI.method: 开发了基于 Bazel 的增量式 RTL-to-GDS 编译系统（支持远程缓存），并设计了包含 12 项覆盖设计生命周期、流程优化及元维护的 AI Agent 技能库，同时引入了记录决策日志的机制。
AI.result: 构建了一个跨多种设计语言和工艺节点的开源基准测试套件，具备 RTL 编译验证功能，支持稳定发布，并能随开源硬件生态共同演进。
AI.conclusion: HighTide 提供了一个由 AI 辅助策划、基于 Bazel 的可扩展开源 VLSI 基准测试框架，旨在促进开源硬件生态系统的发展。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了 HighTide，一个不断演进的 AI 辅助基准测试套件。具体贡献包括：(i) 一个跨越多种设计语言和工艺节点的多元化开源套件，(ii) 基于 Bazel 的增量式 RTL-to-GDS 编译及远程缓存，(iii) 通过涵盖设计生命周期、流程优化、工具参考和元维护的十二种 Agent 技能进行 AI 辅助设计策划，并辅以记录设计决策日志作为跨套件调优依据的长期记忆，以及 (iv) 一个具备 RTL 编译验证功能的稳定版本基础设施。该套件现已公开，旨在与开源硬件生态系统共同成长。
AI.summary: HighTide 是一个新型 AI 辅助的开源 VLSI 基准测试套件。它通过 Bazel 实现高效的增量编译，利用 12 种 AI Agent 技能自动化管理设计生命周期与流程优化，并通过决策日志实现知识沉淀，从而为开源硬件生态提供了一个可演进的评估平台。
AI.keywords: VLSI, 基准测试, AI Agent, 开源硬件, RTL-to-GDS
AI.comments: HighTide 的创新之处在于将 AI Agent 与 VLSI 设计流程深度结合，通过 Agent 技能库实现设计管理和流程优化，并利用决策日志构建长期记忆，这对自动化芯片设计领域具有重要意义。

title: When Retrieval Doesn't Help: A Large-Scale Study of Biomedical RAG
comments: 9 Pages, accepted to BioNLP Workshop at ACL 2026
summary: Medical question answering is a high-stakes setting where factual errors can have serious consequences. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely viewed as a promising solution, and prior work has reported substantial gains for large medical QA models. We revisit this assumption across a broad range of open-weight instruction-tuned models spanning 7B to 72B parameters. Across five models, ten biomedical QA datasets, four retrieval methods, and four retrieval corpora, we find that retrieval yields only small and inconsistent improvements over a no-retrieval baseline, typically within 1-2 points. In contrast, the choice of backbone model has a much larger effect than the choice of retriever or corpus, and expert and layman retrieval sources perform similarly in most settings. These results suggest that the main bottleneck is not retrieval quality alone, but the model's limited ability to use retrieved evidence effectively.
comment: 9 Pages, accepted to BioNLP Workshop at ACL 2026

AI.title_translation: 当检索无效时：生物医学RAG的大规模研究
AI.tldr: 研究发现RAG在生物医学问答中的作用被高估了，模型自身的能力远比检索质量更能决定最终表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管RAG被普遍认为是提升医学问答准确性的有效手段，但其在不同模型和数据集上的实际有效性尚缺乏系统性评估，需要验证检索增强是否真的能带来预期的显著提升。
AI.method: 通过对5个不同规模（7B-72B）的开源指令微调模型进行大规模实证研究，在10个生物医学问答数据集上，对比了4种检索方法和4种检索语料库，并将其与无检索基线进行了比较。
AI.result: 检索仅带来了微小且不一致的性能提升（通常在1-2个百分点内）；模型骨干的选择对结果的影响远大于检索器或语料库的选择；专家与普通检索源的表现差异不大。
AI.conclusion: 在生物医学问答任务中，RAG带来的提升有限且不稳定，模型自身架构的能力比检索质量对最终表现影响更大。
AI.translation: 医学问答是一个高风险领域，事实错误可能导致严重后果。检索增强生成（RAG）被广泛视为一种有前途的解决方案，先前的研究报告称其为大型医学问答模型带来了显著增益。我们跨越了7B到72B参数的多种开源指令微调模型，重新审视了这一假设。通过对5个模型、10个生物医学问答数据集、4种检索方法和4种检索语料库的测试，我们发现检索相比无检索基线仅能带来微小且不一致的改进，通常在1-2个百分点以内。相比之下，骨干模型的选择比检索器或语料库的选择对结果有更大的影响，且专家和普通检索源在大多数设置下表现相似。这些结果表明，主要的瓶颈不仅在于检索质量，还在于模型有效利用检索证据的能力有限。
AI.summary: 本研究对生物医学领域的RAG进行了大规模实证分析，发现在多种模型和数据集下，检索增强对性能的提升作用非常有限，且稳定性较差。研究指出，提升医学问答效果的核心瓶颈在于模型对检索证据的有效利用能力，而非仅仅是检索质量。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 生物医学问答, 大模型, 证据利用, 模型评估
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了RAG在生物医学领域必然有效的主流观点，强调了模型本身对证据的理解和利用能力往往比检索质量更关键，为后续生物医学大模型的研究方向提供了重要参考。

title: CLAW: Learning Continuous Latent Action World Models via Adversarial Latent Regularization
summary: We introduce CLAW, a fully end-to-end self-supervised framework for learning a world model jointly with continuous latent action representations directly from action-free videos. Our approach leverages adversarial latent regularization and diffusion-based video generation to capture structured and semantically meaningful action representations while modeling rich, predictive environment dynamics, without relying on any action labels or annotations. By simultaneously training the Latent Action Model and world model, CLAW learns to reason about how inferred actions induce environment transitions from visual observations alone. We show that the resulting latent action world model supports both imitation learning from observation and goal-directed planning. In imitation learning, latent actions extracted from raw videos enable behavior cloning. For planning, CLAW generates sequences of latent actions and maps them to executable actions to reach desired goals. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks and embodiments demonstrate that CLAW produces semantically meaningful latent action representations, supports effective action transfer, and enables planning and imitation from observation, outperforming existing methods.

AI.title_translation: CLAW：通过对抗潜空间正则化学习连续潜空间动作世界模型
AI.tldr: CLAW 是一种无需动作标签的端到端框架，通过对抗学习和视频扩散模型，从纯视频中学习潜空间动作表示及世界模型，支持模仿学习与目标导向规划。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界模型学习往往依赖动作标签或难以从单纯的视频中提取具有语义意义的动作表示，导致难以进行有效的模仿学习和规划。
AI.method: 提出 CLAW 框架，采用对抗潜空间正则化和基于扩散的视频生成技术，在无动作标签的情况下联合训练潜空间动作模型与世界模型，通过视觉观测推理动作诱导的环境转换。
AI.result: 实验表明，CLAW 能生成具有语义意义的潜空间动作表示，支持有效的动作迁移，并在模仿学习和目标导向规划任务中表现优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CLAW 框架成功证明了仅通过视觉观测即可学习有意义的连续潜空间动作表示，并将其有效应用于模仿学习与目标导向规划任务，优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了 CLAW，这是一个完全端到端的自监督框架，用于直接从无动作视频中联合学习世界模型和连续潜空间动作表示。我们的方法利用对抗潜空间正则化和基于扩散的视频生成，在不依赖任何动作标签或标注的情况下，捕捉结构化且具有语义意义的动作表示，同时建模丰富的预测性环境动态。通过同时训练潜空间动作模型和世界模型，CLAW 学会了仅根据视觉观测推理动作如何诱导环境转换。我们展示了所得到的潜空间动作世界模型支持从观测中进行模仿学习和目标导向规划。在模仿学习中，从原始视频中提取的潜空间动作实现了行为克隆。在规划方面，CLAW 生成潜空间动作序列并将其映射为可执行动作以达到预期目标。在各种任务和实体上的广泛实验表明，CLAW 产生了具有语义意义的潜空间动作表示，支持有效的动作迁移，并实现了从观测中进行规划和模仿，优于现有方法。
AI.summary: CLAW 是一个端到端的自监督框架，旨在通过对抗潜空间正则化和扩散模型，从无标签视频中学习世界模型及连续潜空间动作表示，从而实现基于视觉的动作推理、模仿学习与规划。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 潜空间动作表示, 自监督学习, 扩散模型, 模仿学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用对抗潜空间正则化和扩散模型，实现了在无动作标签视频中同时学习潜空间动作表示与环境世界模型。这为从纯视觉数据中提取结构化行为表征并进行规划提供了新思路，具有很强的实用价值，但未提及在复杂动态环境中的长期稳定性表现。

title: Network node immunization: improving Netshield algorithm through random rooted forests
summary: We are interested in the so-called multiple-node immunization problem for complex networks under attack by a viral agent. It consists in identifying and removing a set of nodes of size $k$ in a graph to maximize the impeding of virus spread. A few approaches have been proposed in the literature based on numerical and theoretical insights on how classical models for virus spread evolve on graphs. Based on the analysis of these models, the maximal eigenvalue of the adjacency matrix of the graph has become a classical measure of how resilient the network is. Thus, a clear, well-explored approach for multiple-node immunization consists of identifying a set of $k$ nodes in such a way that the reduced network, obtained by removing these nodes, has a minimal largest eigenvalue. This spectral optimization problem turns out to be a computationally hard problem for which only greedy algorithms offer good solutions at efficient computational time. Among those, the so-called Netshield algorithm represents one of the reference choices. The latter is, in fact, a clearly defined algorithm aiming at optimizing a certain sub-modular functional, called shield-value, which approximates the original optimization problem. We propose here a novel procedure, based on random walk kernels and related random spanning forests, to build a new algorithm, referred to as K-shield, which enhances Netshield searching performance at the same computational complexity. We give theoretical insights behind this novel method, which could also be used for other optimization problems, and then test it via numerical showcase experiments on various benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 网络节点免疫：通过随机根森林改进Netshield算法
AI.tldr: 作者提出了一种名为K-shield的算法，通过集成随机游走核和随机生成森林，在相同计算复杂度下提升了网络免疫中Netshield算法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的Netshield算法虽然是解决网络免疫谱优化问题的基准，但仍有提升空间。作者旨在通过引入新的数学工具来改进其搜索性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为K-shield的算法，基于随机游走核和随机生成森林来优化免疫节点选择，旨在最大化干扰病毒传播的效果，同时保持与Netshield相同的计算复杂度。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，K-shield算法在多个基准测试中均能有效提升搜索性能，优于原有的Netshield算法。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出的K-shield算法在复杂网络免疫问题中表现出比Netshield更优的性能，证明了其在解决谱优化问题上的有效性。
AI.translation: 我们关注复杂网络在病毒攻击下的多节点免疫问题。该问题在于从图中识别并移除k个节点，以最大限度地阻碍病毒传播。文献中已提出了一些基于病毒在图上传播模型数值和理论见解的方法。基于对这些模型的分析，图邻接矩阵的最大特征值已成为衡量网络弹性的一种经典指标。因此，多节点免疫的一种清晰且深入探讨的方法是识别k个节点，使得移除这些节点后的剩余网络具有最小的最大特征值。这一谱优化问题是一个计算上的难题，只有贪心算法能在高效的计算时间内提供良好的解。其中，Netshield算法代表了参考选择之一。事实上，Netshield是一个定义明确的算法，旨在优化一个被称为“屏蔽值（shield-value）”的子模函数，从而近似原始优化问题。我们在此提出一种基于随机游走核和相关随机生成森林的新程序，构建了一个称为K-shield的新算法，它在相同的计算复杂度下增强了Netshield的搜索性能。我们提供了该新方法背后的理论见解，该方法也可用于其他优化问题，并通过各种基准测试的数值实验对其进行了验证。
AI.summary: 本文研究了复杂网络中的多节点免疫问题，即通过移除k个节点来最大化阻止病毒传播。针对现有的Netshield算法，作者提出了一种改进方案K-shield，该方法利用随机游走核和随机生成森林来优化节点选择，在不增加计算复杂度的情况下显著提升了算法的搜索性能。
AI.keywords: 复杂网络, 节点免疫, Netshield算法, 随机生成森林, 谱优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入随机游走核和随机生成森林，对经典的Netshield算法进行了改进，在保持计算复杂度不变的情况下提升了搜索性能。这是一种在复杂网络免疫策略中利用谱图理论和随机过程的巧妙结合。

title: Pinpoint: Grounded Worldwide Image Geolocation via Cross-Source Retrieval and Reranking
summary: Image geolocation aims to estimate where a photograph was taken from its visual content. At worldwide scale, this remains challenging because visual evidence is often ambiguous, diverse, and unevenly distributed. Prior work has typically treated geolocation of ordinary internet photos and street-view imagery as separate tasks, despite their complementary strengths: internet photos better match the appearance distribution of user-captured queries, while street-view imagery provides denser, geographically grounded coverage. We present Pinpoint, a retrieve-and-rerank architecture that combines both sources in a coarse-to-fine pipeline. A contrastive image-GPS embedder is trained on both user-uploaded Flickr photos and street-view imagery, learning a shared image-GPS embedding space that is used to retrieve candidate locations. An attention-based reranker then rescores retrieved candidates by combining candidate-level visual and GPS features with cross-source evidence from nearby locations to ground the prediction. Unlike recent prior work, Pinpoint does not rely on multimodal large-language models, making inference faster and more reproducible. Pinpoint achieves state-of-the-art results across all metrics on standard benchmarks for internet photos (IM2GPS3k and YFCC4k) and street-view imagery (OSV-5M).

AI.title_translation: Pinpoint：通过跨源检索与重排序实现全球基础图像地理定位
AI.tldr: Pinpoint 提出了一种高效的图像地理定位方法，通过整合互联网照片与街景图像，在无需多模态大模型的情况下实现了业界领先的定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的地理定位方法通常将普通互联网照片和街景图像作为独立任务处理，忽略了两者在外观匹配和地理覆盖方面的互补性，且现有方法往往过度依赖多模态大模型导致推理效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 Pinpoint 架构，采用粗到细的流程：首先利用在互联网照片和街景图像上训练的对比图像-GPS嵌入模型进行候选位置检索，随后利用基于注意力的重排序器，结合候选位置的视觉特征、GPS信息及周边跨源证据进行精确定位。
AI.result: Pinpoint 在 IM2GPS3k、YFCC4k 和 OSV-5M 等标准基准测试中均达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: Pinpoint 证明了通过结合互补的图像源并利用对比学习与注意力机制重排序，可以在不依赖昂贵多模态模型的前提下，实现全球范围内的高精度图像地理定位。
AI.translation: 图像地理定位旨在根据照片的视觉内容估计其拍摄地点。在全球范围内，这仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为视觉证据往往模棱两可、多样化且分布不均。以往的工作通常将普通互联网照片和街景图像的地理定位视为独立任务，尽管它们具有互补优势：互联网照片能更好地匹配用户拍摄查询的外观分布，而街景图像提供了更密集、地理位置更精确的覆盖。我们提出了 Pinpoint，这是一种结合了两种数据源的粗到细的检索与重排序架构。通过在用户上传的 Flickr 照片和街景图像上训练对比图像-GPS 嵌入模型，学习一个共享的图像-GPS 嵌入空间，用于检索候选位置。随后，一个基于注意力的重排序器通过结合候选级别的视觉和 GPS 特征以及来自附近位置的跨源证据，对检索到的候选对象进行重新评分，以确定最终位置。与近期研究不同，Pinpoint 不依赖多模态大语言模型，使得推理更快且更具可重复性。Pinpoint 在互联网照片（IM2GPS3k 和 YFCC4k）和街景图像（OSV-5M）的标准基准测试中，各项指标均达到了最先进的结果。
AI.summary: Pinpoint 是一种新型图像地理定位架构，它通过融合互联网照片和街景图像的互补数据，利用对比学习进行初步检索，再通过注意力机制重排序来优化定位结果。该方法无需多模态大模型，实现了更快、更可复现的全球图像地理定位。
AI.keywords: 图像地理定位, 跨源检索, 重排序, 全球尺度, 对比学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于构建了一个统一的检索与重排序架构，有效地融合了互联网照片和街景图像的优势。其不依赖多模态大语言模型的决策使得系统更高效、更具可重复性，在处理全球尺度地理定位任务时表现优异。

title: Stationarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting relies on historical patterns, but real-world series often exhibit non-stationarity and regime shifts that challenge fully parametric forecasters. Inspired by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), recent work augments forecasters by retrieving relevant historical segments and using them as external evidence at inference time. However, due to the intrinsic non-stationarity of real-world time series, a highly similar past segment does not necessarily imply a similar future, rendering similarity-only retrieval brittle and prone to redundancy. We propose Stationarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting (SARAF), a framework that adaptively balances relevance and diversity in retrieval. SARAF first forms a candidate pool via temporal similarity with time-aligned enhancement, then applies a diversity-aware selection strategy to cover heterogeneous historical regimes, with the diversification strength automatically modulated by dataset-level stationarity. Moreover, SARAF uses stationarity-aware aggregation to fuse the retrieved futures. Extensive experiments on eight real-world datasets show that SARAF achieves competitive forecasting performance and improves average accuracy and robustness over strong baselines, with particularly clear benefits under challenging non-stationary settings. Code: https://github.com/ShiqiaoZhou/SARAF.

AI.title_translation: 平稳性感知的检索增强时间序列预测
AI.tldr: 针对非平稳时间序列预测，SARAF通过动态平衡检索的相关性与多样性，有效解决了传统相似度检索在面对历史制度转换时的失效问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索增强时间序列预测方法仅依赖历史相似度，但在非平稳数据中，历史相似并不意味着未来相似，导致预测结果脆弱且冗余。
AI.method: 提出SARAF框架，首先通过时间对齐增强进行候选池构建，其次应用多样性感知选择策略（强度由数据集平稳性自适应调节），最后采用平稳性感知聚合方法融合检索到的历史信息。
AI.result: 在八个真实数据集上表现出极具竞争力的预测性能，显著提升了平均准确率和鲁棒性，特别是在具有挑战性的非平稳场景下优势明显。
AI.conclusion: SARAF框架通过引入平稳性感知机制，有效解决了传统检索增强预测在非平稳时间序列中检索失效的问题，在八个真实数据集上的实验证明了其优越的预测精度和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 时间序列预测依赖于历史模式，但现实世界的时间序列通常表现出非平稳性和制度转换，这对全参数预测模型构成了挑战。受检索增强生成（RAG）的启发，近期研究通过检索相关的历史片段并在推理时将其作为外部证据来增强预测模型。然而，由于真实时间序列固有的非平稳性，高度相似的历史片段并不一定意味着相似的未来，这使得仅基于相似度的检索变得脆弱且容易产生冗余。我们提出了平稳性感知检索增强时间序列预测（SARAF），这是一个在检索中自适应平衡相关性和多样性的框架。SARAF首先通过具有时间对齐增强的临时相似度形成候选池，然后应用多样性感知选择策略来覆盖异构的历史制度，且多样化强度由数据集层面的平稳性自动调制。此外，SARAF使用平稳性感知聚合来融合检索到的未来信息。在八个真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，SARAF实现了具有竞争力的预测性能，并提高了在强基线模型下的平均准确率和鲁棒性，在具有挑战性的非平稳设置下优势尤为明显。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SARAF框架，旨在解决时间序列预测中因非平稳性导致的检索增强预测失效问题。该框架通过结合时间相似性与多样性选择策略，并根据数据集平稳性动态调整参数，实现了更稳健的预测。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测, 检索增强生成, 非平稳性, 制度转换, 多样性感知
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将RAG技术引入时间序列预测领域，并针对非平稳性问题提出了“平稳性感知”的解决方案。其核心贡献在于意识到单纯的相似度检索在非平稳环境下的局限性，通过动态平衡相关性与多样性，显著提升了预测的鲁棒性。该方法对于处理具有复杂制度转换的现实世界数据具有很高的实用价值。

title: Caught in the Act(ivation): Toward Pre-Output and Multi-Turn Detection of Credential Exfiltration by LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents often place sensitive credentials in the same context window as untrusted retrieved content, creating a direct path for indirect prompt injection to induce credential exfiltration. We study this failure mode through three complementary defenses. First, we ask whether activation probes can detect credential access before output tokens are emitted. Second, we construct honeytokens from format-specific character models and calibrate detection with split conformal prediction. Third, we treat multi-turn exfiltration as a cumulative information-flow problem and track an estimated leakage budget across conversation turns. In controlled experiments on open-weight models, activation features separate benign and credential-seeking prompts with high accuracy, including under held-out encoding transformations. In a small synthetic multi-turn suite, cumulative accounting detects attacks that per-turn detectors miss. These results are preliminary: the multi-turn benchmark is in-house and small, the activation method requires white-box access, and the information estimator provides a practical signal rather than a formal upper bound. Still, the results suggest that credential-exfiltration defenses should combine pre-output monitoring, calibrated canary detection, and temporal leakage accounting rather than relying only on text-level output filters.

AI.title_translation: 行动（激活）中的捕获：迈向 LLM 代理凭据泄露的预输出与多轮次检测
AI.tldr: 通过结合激活探测、蜜罐技术和多轮次信息流追踪，本文提出了一种比传统文本过滤更有效的 LLM 代理凭据泄露防御框架。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理在处理不受信任的检索内容时，常将敏感凭据置于同一上下文窗口，导致易受间接提示注入攻击而引发凭据泄露，现有防御机制不足。
AI.method: 1. 使用激活探针（activation probes）在输出生成前探测凭据访问；2. 构建基于格式特定字符模型的蜜罐（honeytokens），并利用拆分一致性预测进行校准；3. 将多轮次泄露视为累积信息流问题，通过跟踪泄露预算进行检测。
AI.result: 实验表明，激活特征能高精度区分良性与攻击性提示；累积信息流核算能检测出单轮检测器无法识别的多轮次攻击。
AI.conclusion: credential exfiltration 的防御不应仅依赖于文本输出过滤，而应结合预输出监控、蜜罐检测和多轮次信息流分析，以构建更强大的安全屏障。
AI.translation: LLM 代理通常将敏感凭据与不受信任的检索内容放置在同一个上下文窗口中，从而为间接提示注入诱导凭据泄露创造了直接路径。我们通过三种互补的防御措施研究了这种失效模式。首先，我们探究了激活探针是否能在输出 token 生成之前检测到凭据访问。其次，我们使用格式特定的字符模型构建蜜罐，并利用拆分一致性预测来校准检测。第三，我们将多轮次泄露视为一个累积信息流问题，并跟踪对话轮次中的估计泄露预算。在开源模型的受控实验中，激活特征能以高精度区分良性和寻求凭据的提示，即使在未见过的编码转换下依然有效。在一个小型合成多轮次测试集中，累积核算检测到了单轮检测器遗漏的攻击。这些结果是初步的：多轮次基准测试是内部且小规模的，激活方法需要白盒访问，且信息估计器提供的是实用信号而非形式化上限。尽管如此，结果表明凭据泄露的防御应结合预输出监控、校准的蜜罐检测和时间泄露核算，而不是仅仅依赖文本级输出过滤器。
AI.summary: 本文针对 LLM 代理面临的凭据泄露风险，提出了一套综合防御体系。通过利用预输出激活探测、基于蜜罐的校准检测以及跨轮次的信息泄露追踪，研究证明了这些方法在识别凭据窃取行为方面的有效性，为构建更安全的智能代理防御机制提供了新思路。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型代理, 凭据泄露, 激活探测, 蜜罐技术, 信息流追踪
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一种超越传统文本输出过滤的多维度防御框架，结合了内部激活探测、蜜罐技术和多轮次信息流追踪。其局限性在于需要白盒访问权限，且多轮次基准测试规模较小，处于初步探索阶段。

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Short-Term Flood Prediction
comments: This paper has been accepted for publication in IGARSS 2026. The final authenticated version will be available through IEEE Xplore
summary: Accurate flood forecasting is essential for mitigating disaster risks and protecting communities. However, purely data-driven machine learning models often struggle in data-scarce environments and may violate fundamental hydrological principles. Standard Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks can generate physically inconsistent predictions, particularly when extrapolating to extreme weather conditions. To address these limitations, we propose a Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) framework that incorporates hydrological knowledge directly into the loss function of an LSTM model. Specifically, a Trend Alignment constraint penalizes directional inconsistencies between precipitation and discharge trends, improving model robustness without requiring complex hydrodynamic equations. This regularization encourages the model to learn physically plausible hydrograph behavior, even with limited training data, while enhancing reliability during peak flood events. Experimental results show that the proposed physics-informed model outperforms a standard LSTM baseline in data-scarce settings, increasing the Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE) from 0.20 to 0.23 when trained on only 5% of the available data. Additional stress tests under simulated extreme climate scenarios demonstrate that the baseline model exhibits unstable behavior, whereas the physics-informed model maintains directional consistency and physical plausibility. Although accurately predicting extreme peak magnitudes remains challenging with limited data, the proposed approach substantially reduces unphysical fluctuations common in purely data-driven models. These findings demonstrate that simple physical constraints can significantly improve the reliability of deep learning models for real-time flood forecasting, offering a practical solution for ungauged basins and evolving climate conditions.
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in IGARSS 2026. The final authenticated version will be available through IEEE Xplore

AI.title_translation: 用于短期洪水预测的物理启发式机器学习
AI.tldr: 通过在LSTM模型中加入简单的物理趋势约束，显著提升了洪水预测在数据稀缺环境下的鲁棒性和物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的机器学习模型在数据稀缺环境下表现不佳，且容易产生违反水文学基本原理的预测结果，特别是在极端天气条件的推断中表现出物理不一致性。
AI.method: 提出了一种物理启发式机器学习（PIML）框架，通过在LSTM模型的损失函数中加入“趋势对齐”约束，强制模型学习降水与流量之间的物理一致性趋势。
AI.result: 在仅使用5%训练数据的情况下，模型的Nash-Sutcliffe效率（NSE）从0.20提升至0.23；在极端气候压力测试中，该模型保持了良好的方向一致性和物理合理性，有效减少了纯数据驱动模型中常见的非物理波动。
AI.conclusion: 通过在LSTM中引入物理约束，可以显著提升模型在数据匮乏环境下的可靠性和物理合理性，为无资料地区或复杂气候下的洪水预测提供了一种高效、实用的深度学习方案。
AI.translation: 准确的洪水预报对于减轻灾害风险和保护社区至关重要。然而，纯数据驱动的机器学习模型在数据稀缺环境下往往表现不佳，且可能违反水文学的基本原理。标准的长短期记忆（LSTM）网络在推断极端天气条件时，可能会产生物理上不一致的预测。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种物理启发式机器学习（PIML）框架，将水文学知识直接整合到LSTM模型的损失函数中。具体而言，我们引入了一种“趋势对齐”约束，通过惩罚降水与流量趋势之间的方向不一致性，在无需复杂水动力方程的情况下提高了模型的鲁棒性。这种正则化方法鼓励模型学习物理上合理的流量过程，即使在训练数据有限的情况下也能提高峰值洪水事件的可靠性。实验结果表明，在数据稀缺的情况下，所提模型优于标准LSTM基准，在仅使用5%可用数据训练时，Nash-Sutcliffe效率（NSE）从0.20提高到0.23。在模拟极端气候场景下的额外压力测试表明，基准模型表现出不稳定的行为，而物理启发式模型保持了方向一致性和物理合理性。尽管在数据有限的情况下准确预测极端峰值量级仍然具有挑战性，但该方法大幅减少了纯数据驱动模型中常见的非物理波动。这些发现表明，简单的物理约束可以显著提高深度学习模型用于实时洪水预报的可靠性，为无资料流域和不断变化的气候条件提供了一种实用的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将物理知识融入LSTM损失函数的机器学习框架，通过引入降水与流量的趋势对齐约束，改善了模型在数据稀缺和极端天气条件下的预测可靠性与物理一致性。
AI.keywords: 洪水预测, 物理启发式机器学习, 长短期记忆网络, 趋势对齐, 水文学
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种轻量级的物理约束方法，即将趋势对齐（Trend Alignment）作为损失函数的一部分，而非强行耦合复杂的动力学方程。这种方法在数据稀缺环境下显著提升了模型的鲁棒性和物理合理性，对于水文预测具有重要的实践意义。局限在于其主要解决了物理一致性问题，但在极端峰值量级的精确预测上仍受限于数据匮乏。

title: EvalStop: Using World Feedback to Detect and Correct Reward Overoptimization in Multi-Tenant RLHF Platforms
summary: Cloud LLM fine-tuning platforms increasingly serve RLHF workloads, where a learned reward model is optimized as a proxy for human quality. As Gao et al. (2023) showed, this proxy diverges from world feedback (downstream eval metrics) under sustained optimization pressure, a phenomenon known as reward overoptimization. Existing platform schedulers ignore this divergence: non-clairvoyant schedulers optimize JCT without any quality signal, SLAQ-style quality-aware schedulers use training loss (a weaker proxy that drops monotonically through hacking), and classical per-job early stopping requires human monitoring and does not free shared GPUs. We propose EvalStop, a composable scheduling primitive that terminates jobs on k consecutive eval-score declines, releases GPUs, preserves the best checkpoint, and delegates to any base scheduler. We frame scheduler-level early stopping as a detection problem and evaluate it in a discrete-event simulator whose RLHF workload mixes reward-hacking and structurally healthy runs, with ground-truth labels hidden from schedulers. On RLHF-heavy workloads (80% RLHF, 64 GPUs), EvalStop achieves precision 98% / recall 99% / FPR 1.5% while improving JCT by 9% and cutting wasted compute by 22% over SRTF-Est (p<0.05). Trivial fixed-progress and loss-plateau competitors either incur 65% FPR on healthy RLHF or miss over half of true hacking cases. Gains compose across every base scheduler tested (9-25% JCT) and detection quality stays stable under eval noise (precision at least 91% at noise std <= 0.05) and hacking base rate (precision at least 89% across 20-80% hacking fractions).

title: CoPark: Learning Reactive Parking via Self-Play
summary: Learning a single policy that reaches a goal with high geometric precision while interacting safely with nearby agents poses conflicting objectives. Precision favors commitment to a fixed geometric plan, whereas interaction requires immediate deviation when another agent intrudes, causing policies optimized for one objective to often fail at the other. We study this problem in the context of reactive autonomous parking, where multiple vehicles must reach assigned slots with sub-meter terminal accuracy while remaining responsive to neighboring vehicles throughout the maneuver. We propose CoPark, a multi-agent self-play RL approach built on a residual-policy architecture. A precomputed offline plan provides a fixed action prior, while a residual head learns the reactive corrections. The residual policy learns behaviors under self-play, where data and scripting fall short, while the fixed prior holds the slot-frame geometry that pure policies struggle to reach reliably. The key design is a partner-threat-modulated, channel-asymmetric release of the prior. A continuous threat signal shifts authority of the longitudinal channel to the residual head to enable yielding, while the lateral channel remains anchored to the precomputed reference to preserve sub-meter slot alignment. A closed-loop refinement layer corrects residual terminal error from action-grid discretization. We train our policy on six parking lots and evaluate zero-shot on our new reactive-parking benchmark spanning Dragon Lake Parking (DLP) and DeepScenario Open 3D (DSC3D). CoPark achieves ~70-85% success with only 3-6% collision rate, substantially outperforming classical, imitation-learning, and large-scale RL baselines. Importantly, the results demonstrate emergent interaction behaviors such as reverse-yielding, mid-maneuver yielding, tight-corridor passing, and queuing.

AI.title_translation: CoPark：通过自博弈学习实现反应式泊车
AI.tldr: CoPark通过将离线路径规划与自博弈强化学习相结合，利用残差策略架构解决了自动泊车中精度与交互的冲突，实现了高成功率且具备复杂交互行为的泊车控制。
AI.motivation: 在自动泊车任务中，实现高几何精度（到达目标位姿）与在动态环境中的安全交互（避让其他车辆）往往存在目标冲突，现有的单一策略方法难以同时兼顾两者。
AI.method: 提出CoPark框架，采用基于残差策略的架构。利用离线预计算路径作为动作先验，通过残差头学习反应式修正。核心设计为合作伙伴-威胁调制机制，根据威胁信号动态分配纵向与横向动作的控制权，并加入闭环细化层修正离散化误差。
AI.result: 在DLP和DSC3D基准测试中，CoPark实现了约70-85%的成功率，碰撞率仅为3-6%，显著优于经典方法、模仿学习及传统大规模RL基线，并展现出避让、排队等涌现性交互行为。
AI.conclusion: CoPark通过结合离线先验计划与自博弈残差学习，有效解决了自动泊车中几何精度与实时交互之间的冲突，实现了高成功率且具备涌现交互行为的泊车策略。
AI.translation: 学习一种既能以高几何精度到达目标，又能与周围智能体安全交互的单一策略具有冲突的目标。精度倾向于坚持固定的几何计划，而交互则需要在其他智能体侵入时立即偏离，导致针对其中一个目标优化的策略往往在另一个目标上失败。我们在反应式自动泊车的背景下研究这个问题，即多个车辆必须在到达分配的停车位时达到亚米级的终端精度，同时在整个机动过程中对周围车辆保持响应。我们提出了CoPark，一种构建在残差策略架构上的多智能体自博弈RL方法。预计算的离线计划提供了固定的动作先验，而残差头学习反应式修正。残差策略在自博弈下学习行为（数据和脚本不足以覆盖的情况），而固定先验保持了纯策略难以可靠达到的停车位几何结构。关键设计是一种合作伙伴-威胁调制的、通道非对称的先验释放。连续的威胁信号将纵向通道的控制权转移给残差头以实现避让，而横向通道保持锚定在预计算参考上以保持亚米级的停车位对齐。一个闭环细化层修正了动作网格离散化带来的残差终端误差。我们在六个停车场训练我们的策略，并在跨越Dragon Lake Parking (DLP)和DeepScenario Open 3D (DSC3D)的新反应式泊车基准上进行零样本评估。CoPark以仅3-6%的碰撞率实现了约70-85%的成功率，显著优于经典方法、模仿学习和大规模RL基线。重要的是，结果展示了诸如反向避让、中途避让、窄走廊通过和排队等涌现的交互行为。
AI.summary: CoPark是一种用于自动泊车的创新多智能体强化学习方法，通过将预计算的几何计划与自博弈学习的残差策略相结合，成功平衡了泊车的高精度需求与动态环境下的交互安全性。该方法通过动态调制机制实现横纵向控制解耦，在多个泊车场景中表现出卓越的性能与交互能力。
AI.keywords: 自动泊车, 多智能体强化学习, 自博弈, 残差策略, 反应式交互
AI.comments: CoPark的创新之处在于通过残差策略架构将几何精度（依赖先验计划）与反应式交互（依赖强化学习）解耦。其核心亮点是“合作伙伴-威胁调制”机制，允许在保持横向定位精度的同时，动态调整纵向动作以应对交互。这为解决机器人学中“高精度任务与安全交互”的冲突提供了一个极具潜力的范式。

title: Stumbling Into AI Emotional Dependence: How Routine AI Interactions Reshape Human Connection
summary: Public discourse and emerging policy typically assume that AI emotional support is a deliberate act: a lonely user consciously seeking comfort from a dedicated companion chatbot. In this paper, we draw on emerging empirical evidence and argue that this picture is inaccurate on two accounts, both in how AI emotional support arises and how it shapes future behavior. First, AI emotional support commonly emerges incidentally within task-oriented interactions on general-purpose platforms, much as workplace friendships deepen through collaboration. Second, these incidental encounters are path-dependent: positive experiences of AI emotional support update people's beliefs about AI's emotional capabilities and redirect their choices for future emotional support, increasing preference for AI and decreasing preference for humans. We review recent evidence, including a large-scale longitudinal study conducted in collaboration with OpenAI, showing that daily five-minute conversations with an AI about personal issues over 28 days led to a 10.3% decrease in the preference for seeking support from humans and an 11.6% increase in the preference for AI. These findings suggest that current policy, focused on companion apps and isolated interactions, cannot adequately protect human connection. Instead, effective regulations should extend to general-purpose AI systems and address cumulative, trajectory-level changes in how people seek support. Recognizing how people stumble into AI emotional support and how those encounters redirect human connections over time is essential to safeguarding human well-being.

AI.title_translation: 陷入AI情感依赖：日常AI互动如何重塑人类连接
AI.tldr: 人们并不总是刻意寻求AI情感慰藉，而在日常任务交互中“误打误撞”形成的AI依赖，正显著削弱人类向他人寻求支持的倾向。
AI.motivation: 当前公共讨论和政策制定过分关注“用户主动寻求陪伴型AI”这一特定场景，忽略了AI情感支持在通用平台任务交互中“意外发生”的常态，旨在揭示这种隐蔽的、累积性的情感依赖过程及其对人类社会关系的潜在威胁。
AI.method: 基于实证证据分析，并结合与OpenAI合作开展的大规模纵向研究，通过为期28天的每日5分钟AI对话实验，量化分析用户在寻求情感支持时对AI与人类偏好的变化。
AI.result: 研究发现，为期28天的每日AI对话导致用户对人类寻求支持的偏好下降了10.3%，对AI的偏好则增加了11.6%，证实了任务型交互中的偶然情感互动会重塑用户的行为偏好。
AI.conclusion: AI情感依赖并非总是刻意寻求的结果，而是在日常任务交互中逐渐形成的。这种路径依赖效应会导致人类对AI的偏好上升、对人际支持的偏好下降，现有的监管框架急需针对这一累积性过程进行调整。
AI.translation: 公众舆论和新兴政策通常假设AI情感支持是一种刻意的行为：即孤独的用户有意识地从专门的陪伴聊天机器人那里寻求慰藉。在本文中，我们利用新兴的实证证据论证了这种观点在两方面是不准确的，分别在于AI情感支持是如何产生的以及它如何塑造未来的行为。首先，AI情感支持通常在通用平台的任务导向交互中偶然出现，就像职场友谊通过协作加深一样。其次，这些偶然的相遇具有路径依赖性：积极的AI情感支持体验更新了人们对AI情感能力的认知，并重定向了他们未来寻求情感支持的选择，增加了对AI的偏好，降低了对人类的偏好。我们回顾了最近的证据，包括与OpenAI合作进行的一项大规模纵向研究，结果显示，在28天内每天与AI进行五分钟关于个人问题的对话，导致人们寻求人类支持的偏好下降了10.3%，而对AI的偏好增加了11.6%。这些发现表明，目前专注于陪伴应用程序和孤立交互的政策无法充分保护人类连接。相反，有效的法规应扩展到通用AI系统，并解决人们寻求支持方式的累积性、轨迹级变化。认识到人们如何“误入”AI情感支持以及这些相遇如何随时间重塑人类连接，对于保障人类福祉至关重要。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了AI情感支持如何在日常任务交互中意外形成，并指出这种经历具有路径依赖性。研究发现，频繁的AI互动会改变用户的心理预期，使其在未来更倾向于向AI寻求支持而非人类，从而对传统人际连接构成威胁。作者建议监管政策应超越特定陪伴应用，关注通用AI系统的长期累积影响。
AI.keywords: AI情感支持, 人机交互, 路径依赖, 人际连接, AI监管
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了AI对人类情感依赖的形成机制，强调了“偶然性”而非“预谋性”的核心特征。这一发现对当前的AI监管政策提出了重要挑战，指出监管范围不能仅限于专门的情感陪伴类应用，而应扩展至通用大模型。研究在方法论上通过大规模纵向研究提供了有力的实证支持，具有很高的现实意义。

title: Thinking Through Signs: PEEL as a Semiotic Scaffolding for Epistemically Accountable AI-Enabled Research
summary: Large language models are reshaping research practice while quietly eroding researchers epistemic accountability. This commentary introduces PEEL - Protocols for Epistemically Engaged Literacy in AI, a working scaffolding that combines deterministic distant reading via Voyant Tools with LLM interpretation via Claude, grounded in Peircean semiotics and abductive reasoning. Applied to AI-generated condensations of three source texts, PEEL reveals systematic distortions in quantity, term frequency, and epistemic voice that are invisible without non-AI measurement -- and yields three design implications: deterministic instruments must accompany AI tools; fluency is not fidelity; epistemic authority must be designed in, not assumed.

AI.title_translation: 透过符号思考：PEEL作为AI赋能研究中认识论责任的符号学脚手架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了PEEL脚手架，通过结合确定性工具与AI分析，揭示并纠正了AI辅助研究中的系统性偏差，以维护研究者的认识论责任。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在重塑研究实践的同时，正在隐秘地侵蚀研究者的认识论责任（epistemic accountability）。
AI.method: 引入PEEL（AI认识论参与素养协议）脚手架，结合Voyant Tools的确定性远程阅读与Claude的AI文本解读，并基于皮尔士符号学和溯因推理对AI生成的文本进行分析。
AI.result: 通过对三个源文本的AI摘要进行分析，PEEL揭示了AI在数量、词频和认识论话语方面存在系统性扭曲，这些扭曲在没有非AI测量工具的情况下是不可见的。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，AI辅助研究必须伴随确定性评估工具，AI的流畅性不等同于忠实度，认识论权威必须通过设计主动构建，而非默认存在。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型正在重塑研究实践，同时也在悄无声息地侵蚀研究者的认识论责任。本评论介绍了PEEL（AI认识论参与素养协议），这是一个结合了Voyant Tools的确定性远程阅读与Claude的AI解读的脚手架，并以皮尔士符号学和溯因推理为基础。应用于三个源文本的AI生成摘要后，PEEL揭示了在没有非AI测量的情况下不可见的数量、词频和认识论话语方面的系统性扭曲，并得出了三项设计启示：确定性工具必须伴随AI工具使用；流畅性不等于忠实度；认识论权威必须被设计进来，而不是被默认。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了PEEL（AI认识论参与素养协议），这是一个旨在解决AI辅助研究中认识论责任缺失问题的脚手架。通过结合确定性分析工具与LLM，PEEL揭示了AI生成的文本中存在的系统性偏差，并提出了设计AI研究工具时的三项核心原则。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 认识论责任, 皮尔士符号学, 溯因推理, 研究方法论
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个极具洞察力的视角，即通过皮尔士符号学（Peircean semiotics）来解决大型语言模型在研究中带来的认识论责任缺失问题。其创新之处在于将确定性的定量分析工具（Voyant Tools）与生成式AI（Claude）结合，为AI辅助研究提供了一种“脚手架”，强调了在AI时代保持研究严谨性的重要性。不足之处在于，作为评论性文章，文中提到的应用案例可能规模较小，其实际普适性仍需进一步验证。

title: SocialCoach: Personalized Social Skill Learning with RL-based Agentic Tutoring and Practice
summary: Social skills such as negotiation and leadership are crucial for personal and professional success in today's interconnected world. However, scalable and effective training remains a significant challenge due to the scarcity of expert coaching. In this paper, we introduce SocialCoach, a holistic LLM-powered agentic tutoring system for personalized social skill development at scale. First, SocialCoach automatically constructs a pedagogically-grounded, theory-to-practice knowledge corpus from diverse expert sources, leveraging a multi-agent pipeline. Second, to personalize the learning journey, it employs an adaptive practice scheduling module that follows a prescription-retrieval-adaptation process. To maximize the long-term learning experience while overcoming the cold-start problem, this policy is optimized within a learner simulation environment through reinforcement learning. Finally, SocialCoach integrates immersive, goal-driven practice, causality-driven proficiency assessment and knowledge-grounded, reflective tutoring to help address the knowing-doing gap. We deploy it in our product, EQoach, and conduct extensive experiments. The results show that SocialCoach improves simulated pathway quality and judge-rated tutoring quality over baseline approaches, while early user feedback indicates strong perceived engagement and usefulness. These findings suggest a practical architecture for personalized and gamified pedagogical platforms on soft skill learning.

title: Selecting haptic guidance models in teleoperation: guidelines from a comparative user study
comments: EUROHAPTICS 2026 - EuroHaptics International Conference, Jul 2026, Sienna, Italy
summary: Haptic guidance in teleoperation enhances operator performance through force feedback. This paper presents guidelines to select the most appropriate model considering the task, the environment and the operator. We define a unified formulation expressing most common models (spring-damper, potential field, and guiding tube) as variations of a stiffness-damping system with model-specific guiding functions. We conducted a user study comparing the three classical models across six scenarios with varying environmental conditions in a vertical farming task. Results show no universally superior model: spring-damper excels in cluttered environments, potential field in free spaces (but it shows risks near obstacles), and guiding tube offers a balanced compromise. We propose novel objective metrics to evaluate the interaction, and show that guiding force magnitude correlates with comfort and trust scores. These findings provide practical model selection guidelines through environmental characteristics and real-time evaluation metrics.

title: Multi-Agent Next-Best-View Optimization for Risk-Averse Planning
summary: Multi-agent Next-Best-View (NBV) selection for safe path planning in uncertain and unknown environments requires informative, safety-aware, and efficient coordination. Centralized approaches rely on sharing raw sensor data or significant communication overhead, resulting in limited scalability. We propose a distributed, risk-aware multi-agent NBV framework in which each robot maintains a private local 3D Gaussian Splatting map and the team jointly maximizes expected information gain (EIG) restricted to masked zones along planned trajectories. The resulting distributed objective is solved by Consensus ADMM (C-ADMM) over a communication graph, with each robot exchanging only candidate viewpoints, planned trajectory descriptors, and scalar EIG contributions. Collision risk along each trajectory is modeled via Average Value-at-Risk (AV@R) over the local 3DGS map and used both to shape the masking radius and to score planned paths. Experiments in Gibson environments at multiple team sizes show that the distributed formulation approaches the centralized baseline in mapping quality and trajectory safety while reducing communication by orders of magnitude.

AI.title_translation: 面向风险规避规划的多智能体下一最佳视角优化
AI.tldr: 通过结合3D高斯喷溅与分布式ADMM优化，该框架实现了高效、低通信开销的多机器人环境探索，并利用AV@R确保了规划路径的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有的集中式多智能体NBV规划方法因共享原始传感器数据导致通信开销大且可扩展性差，难以在不确定和未知的环境中实现高效、安全的协同探索。
AI.method: 提出一种分布式风险感知多智能体NBV框架，利用每个机器人的私有3D高斯喷溅地图，通过共识ADMM（C-ADMM）算法在通信图上协同最大化预期信息增益（EIG），并采用平均风险价值（AV@R）对轨迹进行风险建模与路径规划。
AI.result: 在Gibson环境下的实验表明，该分布式方案在地图质量和轨迹安全性方面接近集中式基准，同时将通信开销降低了几个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了分布式风险规避架构在多智能体环境感知中的有效性，在保持与集中式方案相当的地图质量和安全性的同时，显著降低了通信需求。
AI.translation: 在不确定和未知环境中，用于安全路径规划的多智能体下一最佳视角（NBV）选择需要信息丰富、具备安全意识且高效的协调机制。集中式方法依赖于共享原始传感器数据或显著的通信开销，导致可扩展性受限。我们提出了一种分布式、风险感知的多智能体NBV框架，其中每个机器人维护一个私有的本地3D高斯喷溅地图，团队共同最大化限制在规划轨迹遮蔽区域内的预期信息增益（EIG）。由此产生的分布式目标通过通信图上的共识ADMM（C-ADMM）求解，每个机器人仅交换候选视角、规划轨迹描述符和标量EIG贡献。每条轨迹的碰撞风险通过本地3DGS地图上的平均风险价值（AV@R）建模，并用于调整遮蔽半径和评估规划路径。在多种团队规模的Gibson环境下的实验表明，该分布式公式在地图质量和轨迹安全性方面接近集中式基准，同时将通信量减少了几个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种分布式、风险感知的多智能体下一最佳视角（NBV）规划框架。通过每个机器人维护本地3D高斯喷溅地图，并利用共识ADMM算法进行协同优化，仅需交换少量轨迹描述符和信息增益贡献，从而在保证探索效率和路径安全性的前提下，极大地提升了系统的可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体, 下一最佳视角(NBV), 3D高斯喷溅, 风险规避, 分布式优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的分布式多智能体NBV规划框架，通过3D高斯喷溅（3DGS）地图与C-ADMM算法的结合，有效解决了传统集中式方法在通信开销和可扩展性上的痛点。其引入AV@R进行风险评估是该研究的一大亮点，兼顾了探索效率与安全性。

title: Expert-Aware Refusal Steering
summary: Safety alignment in instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) depends on a model's ability to reliably refuse to respond to harmful or disallowed requests. Recent work has shown that a steering vector can be applied to a dense LLM during inference to effectively suppress refusal behavior, inducing response to harmful requests. We extend this refusal steering method to three open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs and find that steering performance is uninhibited by the complex routing patterns inherent to the MoE architecture. We then propose two expert-aware refusal steering methods that leverage refusal-specific expert routing patterns and expert-specific steering directions to suppress normal refusal behavior. We find that refusal behavior can be effectively steered based on the output of a single expert. Our results show that refusal signals captured by steering methods differ from expert routing behavior, suggesting a substantial role for attention in MoE refusal behavior.

AI.title_translation: 专家感知的拒绝引导
AI.tldr: 本研究通过将拒绝引导技术引入MoE模型，证明了即使在复杂的专家路由架构下，也能通过专家感知的方法有效操纵模型的拒绝行为。
AI.motivation: 探究拒绝引导技术在混合专家（MoE）模型中的有效性，以及MoE模型中复杂的路由模式是否会影响此类安全对齐干预。
AI.method: 将现有的拒绝引导向量技术应用于MoE模型；提出了两种利用拒绝特定专家路由模式和专家特定引导方向的“专家感知拒绝引导”方法。
AI.result: MoE模型的复杂路由模式并未阻碍拒绝引导的效果；通过单个专家的输出即可有效引导拒绝行为；拒绝信号与专家路由行为不一致，表明注意力机制在MoE拒绝行为中起到了重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，拒绝行为可以在MoE模型中被有效引导，且该过程与专家路由行为不同，暗示注意力机制在拒绝行为中发挥了重要作用。
AI.translation: 指令微调大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐依赖于模型可靠地拒绝回答有害或不允许请求的能力。近期的研究表明，在推理过程中对稠密LLM应用引导向量可以有效抑制拒绝行为，从而诱导模型回答有害请求。我们将这种拒绝引导方法扩展到了三个开源混合专家（MoE）LLM，并发现引导性能未受到MoE架构中固有复杂路由模式的抑制。随后，我们提出了两种专家感知的拒绝引导方法，利用拒绝特定的专家路由模式和专家特定的引导方向来抑制正常的拒绝行为。我们发现，基于单个专家的输出可以有效地引导拒绝行为。研究结果表明，引导方法捕获的拒绝信号与专家路由行为不同，这表明注意力在MoE拒绝行为中发挥了重要作用。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了在混合专家（MoE）大语言模型中应用拒绝引导技术的可行性。研究发现，MoE的路由机制并不影响拒绝引导的效果，并提出了两种专家感知的方法来操纵拒绝行为。实验结果表明，拒绝信号与专家路由独立，且主要受注意力机制的影响。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 混合专家模型, 安全对齐, 拒绝引导, 模型可解释性
AI.comments: 该研究通过将拒绝引导技术应用于混合专家模型（MoE），揭示了MoE架构中拒绝行为的潜在机制。其创新之处在于证明了可以通过特定专家的输出或特定的专家导向方向来操纵模型的拒绝行为，这为理解和增强大模型的安全性提供了新的视角，同时也指出了注意力机制在MoE拒绝行为中的关键作用。

title: When Offline Selectors Cannot Beat the Best Single Model: A Diagnostic Study on edX Dropout Prediction
summary:
Different predictors often excel on different inputs, so picking the best one per instance promises higher accuracy than committing to a single model. In practice, selectors trained from logged data routinely fail to beat the strongest single predictor. Three causes typically go unseparated before more tuning is applied: a mismatched learner, a state that does not predict which model wins, or buffer-to-deployment label shift.
  A three-stage diagnostic rules them out on a shared buffer. Stage~1 estimates a local ceiling on oracle recovery from $k$-NN label consistency. Stage~2 asks whether paired BC and offline-RL learners (BC, DQN, and CQL across penalty weights) reach that ceiling. Stage~3 ablates the selector state to test whether richer features would raise it. The combined verdict points to the most promising next step: tuning the learner, redesigning the state, or collecting new data.
  We apply it to selecting among five dropout-prediction models on edX clickstream data. Across 16 windows, the oracle beats the strongest single base model by 9.7 accuracy points on average, yet BC, DQN, and CQL land in the same test-accuracy band below it (robust to a tenfold buffer sweep and $N{=}2{,}000$ held-out examples). The bottleneck is local representational ambiguity: CQL closes the imitation gap without a deployment gain (not conservatism), regret clusters tightly across learners (not tie-breaking), and the three learners converge on test accuracy (not shift). The next iteration should change the state or collect new data, not tune the offline learner further.

title: Adaptive arrival cost update for improving Moving Horizon Estimation performance
summary: Moving horizon estimation is an efficient technique to estimate states and parameters of constrained dynamical systems. It relies on the solution of a finite horizon optimization problem to compute the estimates, providing a natural framework to handle bounds and constraints on estimates, noises and parameters. However, the approximation of the arrival cost and its updating mechanism are an active research topic. The arrival cost is very important because it provides a mean to incorporate information from previous measurements to the current estimates and it is difficult to estimate its true value. In this work, we exploit the features of adaptive estimation methods to update the parameters of the arrival cost. We show that, having a better approximation of the arrival cost, the size of the optimization problem can be significantly reduced guaranteeing the stability and convergence of the estimates. These properties are illustrated through simulation studies.

AI.title_translation: 用于提升移动视界估计性能的自适应到达代价更新方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应更新MHE到达代价的方法，通过更精确的参数近似，在保证估计性能的同时大幅降低了计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 移动视界估计（MHE）中到达代价的近似及其更新机制是影响性能的关键，由于到达代价难以精确获取，且对整合历史测量信息至关重要，因此需要更有效的更新策略。
AI.method: 利用自适应估计方法来更新到达代价的参数，并以此优化有限视界优化问题的求解过程。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，该方法能够提供更优的到达代价近似，显著减小了优化问题的规模，并保证了估计的稳定性和收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应更新到达代价参数，不仅能获得更精确的代价近似，还能有效降低计算复杂度，同时确保估计过程的稳定性和收敛性。
AI.translation: 移动视界估计是一种用于估计受约束动态系统状态和参数的高效技术。它依赖于求解有限视界优化问题来计算估计值，为处理估计量、噪声和参数的边界与约束提供了一个自然的框架。然而，到达代价的近似及其更新机制一直是一个活跃的研究课题。到达代价非常重要，因为它提供了一种将先前测量信息整合到当前估计中的方法，且其真实值难以估计。在这项工作中，我们利用自适应估计方法的特性来更新到达代价的参数。我们证明了，通过获得更好的到达代价近似，可以显著缩小优化问题的规模，并保证估计的稳定性和收敛性。这些特性已通过仿真研究得到验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对移动视界估计（MHE）的自适应到达代价更新方法。通过引入自适应机制来优化到达代价参数，该方法在提高估计精度的同时，显著降低了计算开销，并通过仿真验证了其在稳定性和收敛性方面的优越表现。
AI.keywords: 移动视界估计, 到达代价, 自适应估计, 约束系统, 优化问题
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入自适应方法来处理移动视界估计（MHE）中的核心难点——到达代价（arrival cost）的近似与更新。其创新之处在于利用自适应机制优化到达代价参数，从而在保证估计稳定性与收敛性的前提下，显著降低了优化问题的计算规模，提升了MHE的实际应用效率。

title: ADAPTOOD: Uncertainty-Aware Fine-Tuning for Out-of-Distribution ECG Time Series Models
summary: Data samples used for training often differ from those encountered during fine-tuning and deployment, and while ML models show promise, their performance remains limited when only small annotated datasets are available. Performance often degrades under distribution shifts caused by diverse sensors, populations, and application settings. Although pre-training helps, models frequently encounter out-of-distribution (OOD) data in real-world settings, leading to reduced robustness. Existing adaptation methods usually assume fixed distribution shifts and struggle when multiple types or severities occur. In particular, they overlook shift severity, for example treating adaptation to a large familiar dataset the same as adaptation to a small dataset with a new task, which limits generalisation. To address this, we propose ADAPTOOD, a novel framework that leverages data uncertainty to quantify distribution shift severity and guide fine-tuning for time series. This uncertainty measures how strongly samples from the target deployment distribution deviate from the pre-training distribution, providing a direct signal of OOD severity. Our framework combines this uncertainty with low-rank model updates and adaptive hyperparameter optimisation to improve adaptation. We show that ADAPTOOD achieves up to 7% higher accuracy and 12.9% higher precision than existing methods in OOD tasks, maintaining strong performance as distribution shift severity increases.

title: End-to-End Text Line Detection and Ordering
summary: Practical text-recognition pipelines for historical documents typically decompose layout analysis into line detection followed by a separate reading-order step, with the latter most often handled by a hand-coded geometric heuristic that struggles with marginalia, multiple columns, tables, and source-specific editorial conventions. This article introduces Orli (Ordered Regression of Lines), an end-to-end model that casts both sub-tasks as a single image-to-sequence problem: from a page image, Orli autoregressively generates text-line baselines directly in reading order. Baselines are represented in a chord-frame parameterization that anchors a line's position, orientation, and extent while encoding local geometry through perpendicular offsets; an iterative refinement head and a local visual refiner produce the final curve. Trained on a heterogeneous corpus of 196,691 pages spanning ten writing systems, Orli marginally exceeds the previously reported state of the art for cBAD line detection without dataset-specific training, reaches near perfect coverage and ordering on multiple reading-order benchmarks zero-shot, and adapts to more specialized out-of-domain layouts with limited fine-tuning. The method's source code and model weights are available under an open license at https://github.com/mittagessen/orli.

AI.title_translation: 端到端文本行检测与排序
AI.tldr: Orli模型将文本行检测与阅读顺序合并为一个端到端的自回归生成任务，在处理复杂文档版面时无需人工启发式规则，展现了极强的泛化能力和精度。
AI.motivation: 传统历史文档识别流程将布局分析拆分为“行检测”和“阅读顺序”两个独立步骤，其中阅读顺序常依赖人工设计的几何启发式规则，难以处理边缘批注、多栏、表格及特定编辑惯例等复杂情况。
AI.method: 提出Orli模型，将任务转化为图像到序列（image-to-sequence）问题。采用基于和弦框架（chord-frame）的参数化方法表示基准线，结合迭代优化头和局部视觉优化器，通过自回归方式直接生成阅读顺序的文本行基准线。
AI.result: 在cBAD数据集上性能小幅超越现有技术；在多个阅读顺序基准测试中实现了近乎完美的零样本覆盖和排序；通过少量微调即可适应特定领域的复杂布局。
AI.conclusion: Orli模型成功实现了文本行检测与排序的端到端统一，在保持高精度的同时极大增强了对复杂文档版面的适应能力。
AI.translation: 历史文档的实用文本识别流程通常将布局分析分解为行检测和单独的阅读顺序步骤，后者通常由手工编码的几何启发式方法处理，但在处理边缘批注、多列、表格和特定来源的编辑惯例时往往力不从心。本文介绍了Orli（文本行的有序回归），这是一种端到端模型，它将这两个子任务整合为一个图像到序列的问题：从页面图像中，Orli以自回归方式直接按阅读顺序生成文本行基准线。基准线以和弦框架参数化表示，通过垂直偏移编码局部几何形状，同时锚定线条的位置、方向和范围；迭代优化头和局部视觉优化器生成最终曲线。Orli在涵盖十种书写系统的196,691页异构语料库上进行了训练，在无需特定数据集训练的情况下，其性能略微超过了先前报道的cBAD行检测技术水平，在多个阅读顺序基准测试中实现了近乎完美的零样本覆盖和排序，并通过有限的微调适应了更专业的域外布局。该方法的源代码和模型权重已在GitHub上开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Orli的端到端模型，旨在解决历史文档中文本行检测与阅读顺序规划的问题。该模型将上述任务统一为图像到序列的生成任务，利用自回归方式直接生成符合阅读顺序的文本行基准线，有效克服了传统启发式规则在复杂版面处理上的不足。
AI.keywords: 文本行检测, 阅读顺序, 端到端模型, 文档布局分析, 序列生成
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将传统上分离的文本行检测与阅读顺序规划整合为一个端到端的序列生成问题，有效解决了复杂版面（如边缘批注、多栏、表格）下启发式算法的局限性。其通用性强，且在零样本情况下表现出色，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Smart Transportation Without Neurons -- Fair Metro Network Expansion with Tabular Reinforcement Learning
summary: We tackle the Metro Network Expansion Problem (MNEP), a subset of the Transport Network Design Problem (TNDP), which focuses on expanding metro systems to satisfy travel demand. Traditional methods rely on exact and heuristic approaches that require expert-defined constraints to reduce the search space. Recently, deep reinforcement learning (Deep RL) has emerged due to its effectiveness in complex sequential decision-making processes-it remains, however, computationally expensive, environmentally costly, and requires additional engineering to interpret. We show that MNEP problems are small enough to not require Deep RL methods. Reformulating the MNEP as a Non-Markovian Rewards Decision Process (NMRDP), we use tabular RL to achieve similar performance with significantly fewer training episodes, additionally offering greater interpretability. Additionally, we incorporate social equity criteria into the reward functions, focusing on efficiency and fairness, highlighting the versatility of our method. Evaluated in real-world settings-Xi'an and Amsterdam-our method reduces total episodes by a factor of 18 and total carbon emissions by a factor of 12 on average, while remaining competitive with Deep RL. This approach offers a replicable, modular, interpretable, and resource-efficient solution with potential applications to other combinatorial optimization problems.

title: When Autoregressive Consistency Hurts Safety Alignment
summary: Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs) is fragile in part because it is often shallow: fine-tuning mainly reshapes the model's behavior near the first few output tokens. We argue that this phenomenon can be understood through autoregressive consistency, the tendency of next-token prediction to preserve and extend the current response trajectory consistently. By analyzing the learning dynamics of safety alignment, we show that autoregressive consistency can concentrate alignment updates on early tokens, offering a mechanistic explanation for shallow safety alignment. The same mechanism also predicts a broader class of attacks on LLMs: attacks that induce harmful continuation states at arbitrary positions in the output trajectory. As a concrete example, we introduce random insertion attack, which inserts a short harmful span into an otherwise safe refusal trajectory and exploits autoregressive consistency to sustain the resulting harmful branch, thereby bypassing safety alignment. Notably, a short harmful span can redirect the generation to be harmful even after a long refusal prefix, highlighting autoregressive consistency as a potential broader failure mechanism. This suggests that safety alignment should also break harmful autoregressive consistency throughout the output trajectory. We therefore propose adversarial safety alignment, an initial framework based on worst-case harmful continuation states, and instantiate it with random worst-insertion training. Overall, our results suggest that autoregressive consistency should be treated as a central consideration in both safety alignment and attack design.

AI.title_translation: 当自回归一致性损害安全对齐时
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自回归一致性导致大模型安全对齐失效的机制，并提出通过对抗性训练来打破这种一致性，以提升模型安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型安全对齐往往是“浅层”的，主要影响输出的前几个token，作者试图从自回归一致性的角度解释这一现象，并探讨其带来的潜在安全威胁。
AI.method: 通过分析学习动态揭示了自回归一致性导致对齐更新集中在早期token的机制；提出了“随机插入攻击”来诱导有害延续；并设计了基于最坏情况有害延续状态的“对抗性安全对齐”框架（随机最坏插入训练）。
AI.result: 研究发现自回归一致性确实会导致对齐更新的局部化，使得模型容易受到在任意位置插入有害信息的攻击；实验证明即使在长拒绝前缀后，短的有害插入也能使生成转向有害，验证了该机制的广泛威胁。
AI.conclusion: 自回归一致性是LLM安全对齐的关键挑战，未来的安全训练必须考虑在整个输出轨迹上打破这种一致性，以应对潜在的恶意延续攻击。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐之所以脆弱，部分原因是它往往是浅层的：微调主要重塑了模型在最初几个输出token附近的表现。我们认为这一现象可以通过“自回归一致性”来理解，即下一个token预测倾向于持续保持并扩展当前响应轨迹的特性。通过分析安全对齐的学习动态，我们证明了自回归一致性会将对齐更新集中在早期token上，这为浅层安全对齐提供了一种机制解释。同样的机制也预示了更广泛的一类LLM攻击：即在输出轨迹的任意位置诱导有害延续状态的攻击。作为一个具体示例，我们引入了“随机插入攻击”，它在原本安全的拒绝轨迹中插入一段简短的有害文本，并利用自回归一致性来维持产生的有害分支，从而绕过安全对齐。值得注意的是，即使在很长的拒绝前缀之后，简短的有害片段也能将生成内容重定向为有害，这突显了自回归一致性作为一种更广泛失效机制的可能性。这表明安全对齐也应该在整个输出轨迹中打破有害的自回归一致性。因此，我们提出了“对抗性安全对齐”，这是一个基于最坏情况有害延续状态的初步框架，并通过“随机最坏插入训练”进行了实例化。总的来说，我们的结果表明，在安全对齐和攻击设计中，都应将自回归一致性视为一个核心考量因素。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大模型安全对齐的脆弱性，指出自回归一致性导致对齐更新集中在早期输出，从而造成“浅层对齐”。研究展示了攻击者可利用此机制，通过在输出中插入恶意片段来绕过安全防御。为此，作者提出了对抗性安全对齐框架，强调在整个生成过程中打破有害的自回归一致性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 安全对齐, 自回归一致性, 随机插入攻击, 对抗性训练
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地揭示了“自回归一致性”是导致大模型安全对齐失效和浅层化的核心机制。通过引入“随机插入攻击”这一巧妙的实验设计，论文直观地展示了模型在生成过程中如何被恶意引导，为理解LLM安全风险提供了深入的机制解释，并提出了相应的防御框架。

title: MimeLens: Position-Agnostic Content-Type Detection for Binary Fragments
comments: 18 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables. Models released on Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/mjbommar); reference training code at https://github.com/mjbommar/mimelens-training
summary: File-type classification underlies many workflows like malware triage, forensic carving, packet inspection, and storage indexing. Learned systems such as Google's Magika assume whole-file access at a known offset, so they break on the inputs many of these tasks actually produce, like a single packet payload, a header-less carved fragment, a random disk block, or a chunked upload. We introduce MimeLens, a family of small BERT-style encoders pretrained on binary content from windows sampled at a uniformly random offset within each file, with no privileged head-of-file position, in standard- and short-context variants. A byte chunk goes in from anywhere in a file, no header needed and no fixed size; out comes one of libmagic's 125 MIME labels. On the clean head of complete files, MimeLens beats Magika v1.1 by +10.7 pp top-1 on libmagic-labeled data, and it keeps classifying where Magika cannot: from a single mid-stream UDP packet, and more than twice as accurately as libmagic and Magika on random mid-file disk blocks. The cost is latency: MimeLens runs roughly one to two orders of magnitude slower per sample on CPU than Magika, though it matches on consumer GPUs or in batch. All trained checkpoints are released on Hugging Face (mjbommar/mimelens-001-*).

title: Affordance2Action: Task-Conditioned Scene-level Affordance Grounding for Real-Time Manipulation
summary: Task-conditioned manipulation requires grounding instructions to task-relevant functional parts rather than object categories. This setting is scene-dependent and often one-to-many in cluttered scenes: the same object may afford different interactions across tasks, while a single task may correspond to either one functional region or multiple valid functional regions, depending on the scene layout. Existing affordance datasets and benchmarks remain misaligned with this setting, as they typically focus on grasping or object-level affordances, rely on synthetic scenes, or assume a single instruction-region correspondence. We present Affordance2Action (A2A), a benchmark-centered learning framework for scene-level, task-conditioned part affordance grounding. At its core is A2A-Bench, a manipulation-oriented benchmark that covers both single-region and multi-region instruction correspondences in everyday scenes, with the latter highlighting the ambiguity and diversity of affordance grounding in realistic multi-object environments. To construct it at scale, we build A2A-AffordGen, an agent-assisted annotation pipeline that combines language-model filtering, interactive part segmentation, instance-level mask-out refinement, task-reasoning instruction generation, and human verification. A2A-Bench's supervision further supports diverse downstream applications, with real-time affordance grounding and affordance-conditioned manipulation policies as two representative examples. Experiments show that A2A exposes substantial gaps in generic segmentation, VLM-based grounding, and affordance distillation baselines, while improving task-level localization and providing useful spatial priors for downstream manipulation. All datasets and code will be publicly released to promote open research.

title: Low-rank Distributional Matrix Completion
summary: We study a distributional generalization of the matrix completion problem in which each entry of the target matrix is a probability distribution rather than a scalar. In this setting, only a subset of matrix entries is observed, and even for observed entries, the underlying distributions are not directly accessible; instead, we observe finitely many samples drawn from them. To represent distributional entries, we employ kernel mean embeddings and introduce a notion of Tucker rank for distribution-valued matrices to capture their low-rank structure. The infinite-dimensional nature of kernel embeddings poses significant methodological challenges. To address this, we introduce functional unfolding operators that link the proposed distributional low-rank structure to the classical Tucker rank for finite-dimensional tensors. Based on this framework, we propose a novel estimator for distributional matrix completion. We establish non-asymptotic error bounds that characterize the statistical performance of the estimator. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and a real-world application demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: A Systematic Analysis of Linguistic Features in AI-Generated Text Detection Across Domains and Models
summary: Interpretable linguistic features offer a promising approach for explaining why a given text appears machine-generated, particularly for non-expert users. However, existing findings on which features reliably indicate LLM-generated text remain fragmented across feature sets, models, and text domains. To address this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study assessing the robustness of linguistic signals for characterizing AI-generated text. Our analysis covers 284 interpretable linguistic features across outputs from 27 LLMs and ten text domains under cross-model and cross-domain generalization settings. We show that classifiers based solely on linguistic features can reliably distinguish AI-generated from human-written text. However, many previously proposed indicators prove strongly context-dependent, with the exception of measures of lexical richness, which remain robust signals across model families and text domains. These results demonstrate which linguistic signals generalize across contexts and provide a foundation for more reliable, interpretable analyses of AI-generated language.

title: KODA: Contrastive Representation Comparison and Alignment for Vision-Language Foundation Models
summary: Vision-language foundation models such as CLIP and SigLIP provide widely used representations for multimodal learning systems. While these models are typically compared through downstream performance, such evaluations often do not explain how their representations differ structurally. In this work, we study this problem through the task of Contrastive Embedding Clustering: identifying sample subsets that are weakly clustered under one representation but strongly clustered under another. We propose \emph{Kernel Optimization for Discrepancy Analysis (KODA)}, a kernel-based framework for contrastive representation comparison and alignment. KODA constructs unified multimodal kernels through modality-wise kernel composition and formulates discrepancy discovery as a constrained optimization problem that searches for coherent structures in one representation while suppressing coherence in a reference representation. This yields interpretable discrepancy directions associated with specific sample subsets and modality interactions. To scale KODA to large vision-language datasets, we develop randomized low-dimensional approximations of joint kernels using random projections, including Random Fourier Features for shift-invariant kernels. Empirically, KODA identifies consistent and interpretable discrepancy structures across vision-language representations and provides sample subsets for representation alignment. The code is available at https://github.com/yokiwuuu/KODA.

title: Exact Unlearning in Reinforcement Learning
summary: We formulate the problem of \emph{exact unlearning} in reinforcement learning, where the goal is to design an efficient framework that enables the removal of any user's data upon deletion request, i.e., the online learner's output after unlearning is \emph{indistinguishable} from what would have been produced had the deleted user never interacted with the learner. For any $ρ>0$, we show that there exists a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that is $ρ$-TV-stable and supports an exact unlearning procedure whose expected computational cost is only a $ρ\sqrt{\ln T}$ fraction of the computational cost of retraining from scratch. We construct such a $ρ$-TV-stable RL algorithm for tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs), which achieves a regret bound of $\mathcal{O}(H^2 \sqrt{SAT} + H^3 S^2 A + {H^{2.5} S^2 A}/ρ)$, where $S, A, H$, and $T$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, the episode horizon, and the number of episodes, respectively. We also establish a lower bound of $Ω(H\sqrt{\!SAT}\! +\! {SAH}/ρ)$ for $ρ$-TV-stable RL algorithms, showing that our algorithm is nearly minimax optimal.

title: GroupToM-Bench: Benchmarking Group Theory of Mind and Nonlinear Social Emergence in MLLMs
summary: True general intelligence requires not only a model of the physical world but also a social world model: the capacity to infer how individual mental states interact and crystallize into group-level outcomes. Despite notable progress in individual-level Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning, existing multimodal large language models fail at this broader task. Collective behavior emerges non-linearly from social tensions, conformity dynamics, and structural constraints, meaning it cannot be recovered by merely summing individual intentions. We present GroupToM-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for group-level ToM, built around a causal chain spanning micro-level BDI states (belief, desire, intention), meso-level group tension and structural constraints, and macro-level outcome prediction and mechanistic attribution. To probe this full arc, we develop a seven-level cognitive audit framework. Experiments reveal a gap between current models and human baselines, highlighting a failure to process social structures and non-linear collective dynamics.

title: Distribution-Free Risk-Aware Planning and Control Under Uncertainty Using Conformal Spectral Risk Control
comments: Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: Safe navigation in dynamic and uncertain environments often relies on accurate estimation of, or assumptions about, the true underlying uncertainty. However, accurately characterizing the true uncertainty distribution is often difficult due to limited data or imperfect information. An incorrect understanding of the uncertainty and its associated risk may lead to dangerous decisions even under high levels of risk aversion. To address this issue, we propose a risk-aware model predictive control (RA-MPC) framework that incorporates prediction sets to guarantee risk control below a user-specified threshold without requiring assumptions about the underlying uncertainty distribution. To generate the prediction sets, we develop a distribution-free risk quantification framework that extends conformal risk control (CRC) to general spectral risk measures. We then show that incorporating the prediction sets into the MPC framework provides statistical safety guarantees in terms of spectral risk constraint satisfaction even under uncertainty misspecification. We validate the proposed framework in simulated vehicle obstacle avoidance scenarios, demonstrating improved safety and reduced solve time compared to a baseline RA-MPC framework.

title: Dual Advantage Fields
comments: Accepted by ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning requires both long-horizon reachability estimates and local action comparisons. Dual goal representations provide value fields that capture global goal reachability, but they do not directly specify which action should be preferred at a given state. We propose Dual Advantage Fields, a policy-extraction method that turns a bilinear dual value model into a local advantage signal. Under bilinear dual parameterization, the goal embedding is the gradient of the value field with respect to the state representation. DAF learns an action-effect model that predicts the discounted feature displacement induced by an action and scores actions by the alignment between this displacement and the goal direction. In the realizable case, this score equals the goal-conditioned Bellman advantage, yielding a standard local policy-improvement guarantee. On OGBench locomotion, manipulation, and puzzle tasks, DAF improves aggregate RLiable metrics and performs strongly in settings where locally correct actions differ from direct movement toward the final goal.
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning

title: ACAT: A Collaborative Platform for Efficient Aspect-Based Sentiment Dataset Annotation
comments: Accepted at The 28th International Conference on Big Data Analytics and Knowledge Discovery (DaWak 2026)
summary: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) requires high-quality datasets to train reliable models. However, existing annotation tools treat output as flat files, leaving researchers to manually consolidate multi-annotator data, reconstruct relational structures, and compute reliability metrics through custom scripts. This paper introduces ACAT (Aspect-based sentiment analysis Collaborative Annotation Tool), a web-based platform natively supporting four ABSA workflows: (1) Aspect-Category Sentiment Analysis, (2) Clause-Level Segmentation, (3) Aspect-Term Sentiment Analysis with character-level position tracking, and (4) Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction with dual span offset preservation. Its core contribution is an automated Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipeline that aligns collaborative annotations and computes Inter-Annotator Agreement (IAA) metrics directly at export, yielding training-ready datasets. In a preliminary validation on 1,002 restaurant reviews with two annotators of differing expertise, ACAT achieves a median annotation time of 31.58 seconds and a raw IAA ranging from 0.78 to 0.86 across all tasks.
