AI.title_translation: 折叠传输 MCMC：对称贝叶斯模型的可认证商后验计算
AI.tldr: FolT-MCMC 是一种通过在商空间采样来消除对称模型中冗余多模态干扰的新算法，有效提升了 MCMC 的收敛认证能力。
AI.motivation: 具有有限对称性的贝叶斯模型（如混合模型）会产生标签置换等冗余的多模态，导致 MCMC 收敛诊断性能下降。
AI.method: 提出 Folded Transport MCMC (FolT-MCMC)，通过在对称群的基本域上构建独立采样器，直接在商后验上进行推断，并利用对称化后的归一化流构建商建议分布，同时引入了针对商度量的认证框架。
AI.result: 在 Gaussian 混合模型、标签切换目标及实际加速度计数据实验中，FolT-MCMC 展现了 2 倍至 145 倍的认证下界提升，且在传统方法失效的情况下依然能提供有效的认证。
AI.conclusion: FolT-MCMC 成功通过在商空间上进行采样，解决了贝叶斯模型中因对称性产生的冗余多峰问题，并提供了比传统方法更强、更稳定的收敛性认证。
AI.translation: 具有有限对称性的贝叶斯模型（如具有可交换分量的混合模型、具有紧密模式的结构识别模型）定义的后验在标签置换群下是不变的，这产生了降低 MCMC 收敛诊断性能的冗余多模态。我们引入了折叠传输 MCMC (FolT-MCMC)，它通过在对称群的基本域上构建独立采样器，直接在商后验上进行推断。商建议分布是通过在群轨道上对称化一个学习到的归一化流形成的。我们证明了基于 LCNF 振荡的认证框架可以转移到具有稳定子校正球质量界和改进覆盖半径的商度量中，并且当展开流表现出跨模式建议缺陷时，分位数核心认证下界会得到改善。在高斯混合（d = 2 - 20）、标签切换目标（多达 24 个等效模式）和标准的贝叶斯三组分混合后验上，分位数核心认证改进比率范围从 2 倍到 145 倍，且折叠证书在经验上几乎是维度无关的。在台风“山竹”期间超高层建筑的实际加速度计数据上，FolT-MCMC 产生了非空的分位数核心证书，而展开证书则是空的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 FolT-MCMC 的新型 MCMC 方法，旨在解决贝叶斯模型中因对称性导致的冗余多模态问题。通过在商空间直接进行推断，并结合对称化归一化流与改进的认证框架，该方法显著提升了采样效率与收敛认证的准确性。
AI.keywords: MCMC, 对称性, 商后验, 归一化流, 贝叶斯推断
AI.comments: 该研究通过处理对称性导致的后验多峰冗余问题，在理论保证和实际计算效率上都取得了显著突破。特别是其提出的商空间推断方法，为高维复杂模型提供了一种可认证的采样策略。

title: Creative Reading: Scaffolding Reading for Transformation
summary: Reading augmentation systems increasingly help readers process text at scale. While these tools address real constraints of time and cognitive load, they often implicitly frame reading as information transmission, or "reading to discard," delegating interpretation and effort to the machine. Yet this delegation changes the outcome of reading. For example, in scholarly reading, deciding what a research text implies and why it matters is central to the work of scholarly production. We propose creative reading as an alternative goal: reading augmentation that supports readers in creating both readings and themselves as readers. By putting literary and narrative theories into conversation with scholarly sensemaking and creativity support, we present a provocation-oriented design space for valuing the process of reading as a way of preserving a plurality of readings and transforming readers over time.

AI.title_translation: 创造性阅读：为转化而搭建的阅读支架
AI.tldr: 本文呼吁改变阅读辅助工具仅追求效率的现状，转而支持“创造性阅读”，即通过设计促进读者的深度思考、多元解读与自我成长。
AI.motivation: 现有的阅读辅助工具过度侧重于提高信息处理效率，将阅读简化为“信息传输”或“阅后即焚”，忽视了阅读作为学术生产和个人成长过程中的核心解释与转化价值。
AI.method: 作者通过将文学与叙事理论与学术意义构建及创造力支持相结合，构建了一个以“引发思考（provocation-oriented）”为导向的阅读辅助设计空间。
AI.result: 提出了一种新的设计框架，旨在保留阅读的多样性解释，并通过阅读过程促进读者的持续转化。
AI.conclusion: 创造性阅读通过设计支持读者的意义构建过程，能够有效抵抗阅读的机械化趋势，实现阅读对读者的深层转化。
AI.translation: 阅读辅助系统正日益帮助读者大规模地处理文本。虽然这些工具解决了时间与认知负荷的现实约束，但它们往往隐含地将阅读定义为信息传输或“阅后即焚”，将解释和努力的工作委托给了机器。然而，这种委托改变了阅读的结果。例如，在学术阅读中，决定研究文本的含义及其重要性是学术生产工作的核心。我们提出“创造性阅读”作为一种替代目标：即支持读者在阅读过程中创造出对文本的解读以及重塑读者自身角色的阅读辅助方式。通过将文学和叙事理论与学术意义构建及创造力支持相结合，我们提出了一个以激发思考为导向的设计空间，旨在珍视阅读过程，以保留解读的多样性并实现读者的持续转化。
AI.summary: 本文针对当前阅读辅助工具将阅读简化为信息处理的现状，提出了“创造性阅读”概念。该方法通过整合文学理论与学术意义构建，旨在设计能够支持读者在阅读中进行个性化解读并实现自我转化的辅助系统。
AI.keywords: 创造性阅读, 阅读辅助系统, 意义构建, 读者转化, 设计空间
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于挑战了当前阅读辅助系统将阅读视为“信息获取”的范式，提出了“创造性阅读”这一新视角。它强调阅读过程本身的重要性，不仅仅是工具性的信息处理，更是读者自我构建和意义生成的深层过程。局限性在于该研究目前主要处于设计空间探讨阶段，缺乏具体的系统实现细节或大规模用户评估。

title: Latent Anchor-Driven Test Generation for Deep Neural Networks
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are increasingly being deployed in security-critical and safety-sensitive applications, which makes rigorous testing essential to identify and mitigate model weaknesses. Existing DNN testing approaches explore either the input space or a learned latent space. While latent-space generation can better maintain plausibility than direct input-space mutation, current methods still face a trade-off among exploration controllability, failure diversity, and seed-relative semantic drift. To overcome these limitations, we propose Latte, a black-box testing framework that generates semantically proximate, diverse, and fault-revealing test cases by leveraging the latent space. Specifically, Latte encodes each input seed with a pre-trained VQ-VAE and performs a seed-centered, one-step latent mutation along directions defined by anchors sampled from alternative classes, followed by quantization and decoding back to the input space. This explores local neighborhoods around each seed within the learned latent manifold, resulting in a larger number and broader diversity of oracle-triggering prediction discrepancies under the same budget. We evaluated Latte on 5 datasets and 10 DNN models in single-model and multi-model testing scenarios. Across the evaluated datasets and models, Latte improves fault exposure and behavioral diversity under matched testing budgets. Under the single-model setting, it also maintains low seed-relative semantic drift with respect to the source seeds.

AI.title_translation: 面向深度神经网络的潜在锚点驱动测试生成
AI.tldr: Latte是一种利用潜在空间锚点进行变异的DNN黑盒测试框架，能在保持语义一致性的同时，高效生成多样化的故障触发测试用例。
AI.motivation: 现有的DNN测试方法在输入空间或潜在空间探索上存在局限，难以同时兼顾测试的可控性、故障的多样性以及保持原始语义（避免语义漂移）。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Latte的黑盒测试框架。首先利用预训练的VQ-VAE将输入种子编码至潜在空间；然后执行以种子为中心的单步潜在变异，变异方向由从其他类别采样得到的“锚点”定义；最后通过量化和解码将变异后的向量还原为输入空间。
AI.result: 在5个数据集和10个DNN模型上的实验表明，Latte在同等预算下能比现有方法发现更多的故障，生成更多样化的测试用例，并保持较低的语义漂移。
AI.conclusion: Latte通过在潜在空间进行以种子为中心的受控变异，显著提升了DNN在黑盒测试中的漏洞发现能力和生成的多样性，同时保持了良好的语义一致性。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络（DNN）正越来越多地被部署在安全关键和敏感的应用中，这使得严格的测试对于识别和缓解模型弱点至关重要。现有的DNN测试方法要么探索输入空间，要么探索学习到的潜在空间。虽然潜在空间生成比直接的输入空间变异能更好地保持合理性，但当前方法在探索可控性、故障多样性和种子相关语义漂移之间仍面临权衡。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Latte，一个黑盒测试框架，通过利用潜在空间生成语义相近、多样化且能揭示故障的测试用例。具体而言，Latte使用预训练的VQ-VAE对每个输入种子进行编码，并沿着由从替代类别中采样的锚点定义的方向执行以种子为中心的、一步式潜在变异，随后进行量化并解码回输入空间。这探索了学习到的潜在流形中每个种子周围的局部邻域，从而在相同的预算下产生了更多数量和更广泛多样性的触发预言机预测差异。我们在5个数据集和10个DNN模型上的单模型和多模型测试场景中评估了Latte。在所有评估的数据集和模型中，Latte在匹配的测试预算下提高了故障暴露率和行为多样性。在单模型设置下，它还保持了相对于源种子的低语义漂移。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Latte的黑盒测试框架，用于深度神经网络的漏洞检测。该方法通过VQ-VAE在潜在空间中对输入种子进行受控变异，利用类别锚点引导生成具有多样性且语义合理的测试用例，有效提升了故障暴露率。
AI.keywords: 深度神经网络测试, 潜在空间, VQ-VAE, 黑盒测试, 漏洞发现
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于潜在空间锚点的测试生成方法（Latte），有效平衡了测试的可控性、多样性和语义一致性。其核心创新在于利用VQ-VAE编码和锚点引导的潜在空间变异，为DNN黑盒测试提供了一种高效的漏洞发现方案。局限性在于测试效果可能受限于预训练VQ-VAE的重构质量。

title: Formal verification of the S-two AIR
summary: StarkWare's S-two prover provides an efficient means for establishing, on blockchain, that a program written in the Cairo virtual machine language runs to completion. The latter claim is encoded by an algebraic intermediate representation (AIR) that captures the semantics of the Cairo language. The AIR asserts the existence of tables of values from a finite field satisfying certain algebraic constraints. A cryptographic interactive proof system, circle STARK, provides an efficiently-checked certificate that the AIR is satisfied. We describe our verification, using the Lean 4 proof assistant, that the AIR encoding is sound, which is to say, the satisfiability of the AIR implies the computational claim.

AI.title_translation: S-two AIR的形式化验证
AI.tldr: 使用Lean 4证明助手验证了S-two AIR编码的正确性，确保了Cairo程序执行证明的逻辑可靠性。
AI.motivation: 为了确保StarkWare的S-two证明器在区块链上证明Cairo程序执行正确性时的逻辑严密性与安全性。
AI.method: 利用Lean 4证明助手对S-two AIR编码进行形式化建模与验证，确立AIR的可满足性与Cairo程序执行正确性之间的逻辑蕴含关系。
AI.result: 验证了S-two AIR编码的可靠性（Soundness），证明了AIR满足条件即代表计算任务已按要求完成。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功使用Lean 4证明了S-two AIR编码的完备性，即AIR的可满足性确实蕴含了Cairo程序执行的正确性。
AI.translation: StarkWare的S-two证明器提供了一种在区块链上高效确立Cairo虚拟机语言程序执行完成的方法。这一主张由捕捉Cairo语言语义的代数中间表示（AIR）进行编码。AIR断言了满足特定代数约束的有限域值表的存在。加密交互式证明系统Circle STARK提供了一种可高效检查的AIR满足性证书。我们描述了使用Lean 4证明助手进行的验证，证明了AIR编码是可靠的，即AIR的可满足性蕴含了计算主张。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了使用Lean 4证明助手对StarkWare的S-two AIR编码进行的可靠性验证，确保了该代数中间表示能准确反映Cairo虚拟机的执行语义。
AI.keywords: S-two, Cairo, AIR, 形式化验证, Lean 4
AI.comments: 该论文通过形式化验证手段提升了区块链加密证明系统的可信度，将Lean 4证明助手应用于复杂的代数中间表示（AIR）验证，是密码学实现与形式化方法结合的典型范例。

title: Testing Neural Networks via Bayesian-Guided Exploration of Decision Landscapes
summary: As neural networks are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, testing is essential to evaluate and improve their reliability. Existing testing methods, whether black-box or white-box, primarily use global mutation or coverage-guided strategies, both of which struggle to efficiently uncover diverse model failures while remaining proximate to the original data distribution and semantics. We propose BayesWarp, a testing framework that addresses this limitation by mutating decision-critical input regions identified via interpretable saliency techniques and adaptively guiding the testing process using an uncertainty-aware Bayesian Optimization strategy, enabling the discovery of diverse failures while preserving distributional and semantic proximity to the original data. Evaluation on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet across six neural network models shows that BayesWarp improves failure discovery, failure diversity, test case quality, and critical neuron coverage under a fixed mutation budget. These results demonstrate that BayesWarp improves testing effectiveness. Moreover, fine-tuning with the generated failure cases leads to improvements in model performance.

AI.title_translation: 通过贝叶斯导向的决策景观探索来测试神经网络
AI.tldr: BayesWarp利用贝叶斯优化和显著性分析，在保持输入数据语义的同时，高效地发现神经网络的多样化故障并提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络测试方法在揭示多样化故障的同时，难以保持与原始数据分布及语义的接近性，这限制了其在安全关键领域的应用效果。
AI.method: 提出BayesWarp框架：首先利用可解释的显著性技术识别决策关键输入区域，随后采用具备不确定性感知能力的贝叶斯优化策略进行自适应突变，以生成多样化的故障用例。
AI.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，BayesWarp在相同的突变预算下，显著提升了故障发现率、故障多样性、测试用例质量及关键神经元覆盖率，且利用生成的故障用例微调模型能有效改善模型性能。
AI.conclusion: BayesWarp通过贝叶斯导向的探索策略，显著提升了神经网络测试的效率、故障发现的多样性以及测试用例的质量，并验证了通过故障样本微调模型可增强模型性能。
AI.translation: 随着神经网络越来越多地被部署在安全关键领域，测试对于评估和提高其可靠性至关重要。现有的测试方法，无论是黑盒还是白盒，主要使用全局变异或覆盖引导策略，这两者在高效揭示多样化模型故障的同时，难以保持与原始数据分布和语义的接近性。我们提出了BayesWarp，一个通过变异由可解释显著性技术识别出的决策关键输入区域，并使用不确定性感知贝叶斯优化策略自适应引导测试过程的框架，从而在保持与原始数据分布和语义接近的同时，实现了多样化故障的发现。在MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet上针对六个神经网络模型的评估表明，BayesWarp在固定的变异预算下，提高了故障发现、故障多样性、测试用例质量和关键神经元覆盖率。这些结果证明BayesWarp提高了测试的有效性。此外，使用生成的故障案例进行微调可以提高模型性能。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了BayesWarp，这是一个旨在提升神经网络可靠性的测试框架。它通过结合显著性分析与贝叶斯优化，能够在保持数据语义一致性的前提下，高效探索决策空间并发现多样化的模型故障。实验证明，该方法不仅提高了测试的有效性，还能通过故障样本训练提升模型的整体性能。
AI.keywords: 神经网络测试, 贝叶斯优化, 决策边界, 故障发现, 鲁棒性提升
AI.comments: 该论文提出的BayesWarp框架创新性地结合了可解释性显著性技术与贝叶斯优化，有效地平衡了故障发现的效率与测试用例的语义一致性。其局限性在于可能对计算资源有一定要求，且对不同类型神经网络的通用性仍需进一步验证。该研究对于提升安全关键领域神经网络的鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Exploring Cross-Scenario Generality of Agentic Memory Systems: Diagnostics and a Strong Baseline
summary: LLM agents accumulate histories that outgrow their context windows, motivating a growing literature on memory systems. Yet most existing designs are tuned to a single scenario (multi-session chat or a single trajectory format), and there is little evidence that they generalize across the heterogeneous trajectories agents encounter in deployment. We revisit eight memory systems plus an agentic harness for search problems, on five scenarios: single-turn QA, multi-session chat, agentic-trajectory QA, memory stress tests, and long-horizon agentic tasks. The harness, which self-manages flat text-file storage via tool calls, achieves the best cross-task ranking, suggesting that memory performance hinges on giving the agent active control over storage and retrieval rather than on a passive store behind a fixed pipeline. We instantiate this insight in AutoMEM, an agentic memory harness with a self-managed tool interface that achieves the best cross-scenario generality among the systems we evaluate.

AI.title_translation: 探索智能体记忆系统的跨场景通用性：诊断与强基准模型
AI.tldr: 研究发现智能体通过工具调用主动管理记忆（AutoMEM）比被动存储系统更能适应多变的跨场景任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型智能体记忆系统大多针对单一场景设计，缺乏在复杂多变部署环境下的跨场景通用性验证。
AI.method: 评估了八种现有的记忆系统，并开发了一个名为 AutoMEM 的智能体记忆工具，该工具通过工具调用实现对扁平文本文件存储的自我管理。
AI.result: AutoMEM 在五种不同场景（单轮QA、多轮对话、智能体轨迹QA、内存压力测试及长程任务）的测试中，展现了最佳的跨场景通用性。
AI.conclusion: 内存性能的关键在于赋予智能体对存储和检索的主动控制权，而非依赖于固定流水线后的被动存储机制。AutoMEM 在跨场景通用性方面表现最优。
AI.translation: 大模型智能体积累的历史记录往往会超出其上下文窗口，这推动了关于记忆系统文献的增长。然而，大多数现有设计仅针对单一场景（多轮对话或单一轨迹格式）进行了调优，且几乎没有证据表明它们能够在智能体部署时遇到的异构轨迹中实现通用。我们重新审视了八种记忆系统以及一种用于搜索问题的智能体工具，涵盖了五种场景：单轮问答、多轮对话、智能体轨迹问答、记忆压力测试和长程智能体任务。该工具通过工具调用自我管理扁平文本文件存储，实现了最佳的跨任务排名，这表明记忆性能的关键在于赋予智能体对存储和检索的主动控制，而不是固定流水线后的被动存储。我们将这一见解实例化在 AutoMEM 中，这是一个具有自我管理工具接口的智能体记忆工具，在评估的所有系统中实现了最佳的跨场景通用性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大模型智能体记忆系统的跨场景通用性问题。通过在五种不同任务类型中对八种记忆系统进行诊断，研究发现，赋予智能体对存储和检索的主动控制权（而非被动存储）是提升性能的关键。基于此，作者提出了 AutoMEM 系统，该系统通过自我管理的工具接口实现了卓越的跨场景通用表现。
AI.keywords: 智能体, 记忆系统, 跨场景通用性, AutoMEM, 主动控制
AI.comments: 该论文指出了当前大模型智能体记忆系统设计过于依赖单一场景的局限性，并提出了“主动控制”优于“被动存储”的核心见解。AutoMEM 通过赋予智能体自我管理存储与检索的能力，显著提升了其在不同任务中的通用性。该研究对于构建更具鲁棒性的智能体系统具有重要参考价值。

title: Toward a Generalized Defense Across Sparse, Continuous, and Structured Parameter Attacks
summary: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous and partially untrusted environments, where models are distributed through cloud storage, CI/CD pipelines, containerized services, and edge execution platforms. This broad deployment landscape exposes model parameters to various integrity risks. Unlike input-space adversarial attacks, parameter attacks directly tamper with the model's internal parameters and persist across all subsequent inferences. Existing defenses either require retraining, incur significant accuracy degradation, or are limited to specific attack classes. However, in real-world deployment scenarios, the forms of parameter attacks are often unpredictable. To address this challenge, we present ParDef, a generalized defense for deep neural networks against diverse types of parameter attacks. ParDef integrates keyed channel reparameterization, which obscures sensitive parameter directions, QC-LDPC quantization, which embeds redundancy and supports error correction, and adaptive robust inference, which stabilizes predictions under uncertainty. Our evaluation on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet using ResNet and VGG models demonstrates that ParDef consistently reduces attack success rates across different parameter attacks while maintaining high model performance and incurring only moderate deployment overhead. These results highlight that ParDef is a practical and generalized defense for DNN deployments.

title: PureLight: Learning Complex Luminaires with Light Tracing
summary: We propose a neural formulation for estimating the appearance of complex luminaires. We focus on challenging luminaires with complex light transport (e.g., small emitters enclosed by multiple specular layers) that are difficult for (bidirectional) path tracing. To this end, we use light tracing to construct paths from emitters to the exit surfaces and formulate appearance estimation as a distribution learning problem. Specifically, we model the probability density function (pdf) of outgoing radiance on the exit surfaces using a large normalizing flow network, and recover the outgoing radiance as the product of the estimated pdf and flux. To enable efficient inference, we distill the learned appearance into a lightweight MLP that directly estimates radiance on the exit surfaces. We additionally train a sampling network for effective direct illumination computation from the luminaire, and a blending network to composite the luminaire into the scene. Our formulation makes it feasible to render challenging luminaires using low sample counts in arbitrary scenes.

AI.title_translation: PureLight：利用光线追踪学习复杂灯具外观
AI.tldr: PureLight 结合光线追踪与神经分布学习，通过模型蒸馏实现了复杂灯具的高效、高质量渲染。
AI.motivation: 传统路径追踪（特别是双向路径追踪）在处理具有复杂光传输（如被多层镜面包裹的小型发射器）的灯具时面临巨大挑战，导致渲染效率低下。
AI.method: 提出一种基于神经分布学习的框架：利用光线追踪构建路径，使用大规模归一化流网络建模出口表面的辐射概率密度函数（pdf），结合通量恢复辐射；通过蒸馏技术将模型压缩为轻量级MLP以加速推理；同时训练采样网络用于直接照明计算，并利用混合网络进行场景合成。
AI.result: 该方法在处理复杂灯具时，能够在极低的采样数下实现高质量的渲染效果，并显著提升了渲染效率。
AI.conclusion: PureLight 通过神经分布学习实现了复杂灯具的高效、高质量渲染，显著降低了传统路径追踪在处理复杂光传输时的采样负担。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于估计复杂灯具外观的神经公式。我们专注于具有复杂光传输（例如，被多层镜面包裹的小型发射器）且对（双向）路径追踪而言极具挑战性的灯具。为此，我们使用光线追踪构建从发射器到出口表面的路径，并将外观估计公式化为分布学习问题。具体而言，我们使用大规模归一化流网络建模出口表面出射辐射的概率密度函数 (pdf)，并将出射辐射恢复为估计的 pdf 与通量的乘积。为了实现高效推理，我们将学习到的外观蒸馏为直接估计出口表面辐射的轻量级 MLP。此外，我们还训练了一个用于计算灯具直接照明的采样网络，以及一个用于将灯具合成到场景中的混合网络。我们的公式使得在任意场景中使用低采样数渲染复杂灯具成为可能。
AI.summary: PureLight 是一种用于估计复杂灯具外观的神经框架。它通过光线追踪构建路径，利用归一化流学习出口表面的辐射分布，并通过蒸馏技术生成轻量级 MLP 以实现高效推理，从而在任意场景中以低采样数实现高质量渲染。
AI.keywords: 神经表征, 光传输, 光线追踪, 归一化流, 灯具渲染
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的神经表征方法来解决复杂灯具渲染中的光传输难题。通过将光线追踪与归一化流模型相结合，并在推理阶段蒸馏为轻量级MLP，有效地平衡了渲染精度与性能。其局限性可能在于对复杂场景的泛化能力以及训练成本。

title: OpenRFM: Dissecting Relational In-Context Learning
summary: Relational Foundation Models (RFMs) promise a single pre-trained predictor that, given any relational database, returns predictions in one forward pass via relational in-context learning (ICL). Yet a substantial gap separates open RFMs from their commercial counterparts, and the origin of this gap has not been systematically understood. We dissect a representative framework, the Relational Transformer (RT), from two perspectives. Model side: we show that RT performs relation-level ICL, and a kernel regression view shows it fails when sparse label-cell coverage yields an underdetermined regression. Data side: we ablate RT's pre-training source and find that existing synthetic-only pre-training and in-distribution pre-training drive the same architecture into different regimes, lazy vs. feature-learning. Probing this gap reveals that the missing ingredient is a support-identifiable relational latent in the label-generation process. These two diagnoses translate into (1) a dual-stage ICL architecture that combines the relational backbone with a batch-level ICL layer lifted from a pre-trained tabular foundation model to overcome relation-level label scarcity, and (2) a homophily-aware synthetic plus continual real-data pre-training mixture, augmented with a prototype-based regularization. These choices define OpenRFM, a simple yet effective RFM that improves average task performance by approximately 30% over the RT backbone and surpasses the commercial model KumoRFMv1 on a large set of evaluation tasks.

title: The Digital Apprentice: A Framework for Human-Directed Agentic AI Development
comments: Submitted to ACM AI Leadership Summit 2026, Visionary Papers Track. 5 pages, 2 figures
summary: Agentic AI deployments face a recurring design tension: heavy human oversight limits scale, while broad autonomy outruns accountability. Neither posture provides the governance infrastructure required for responsible delegation. We present the Digital Apprentice, a framework for scalable, safe AI agency in which autonomy is earned, not assumed. The Digital Apprentice is a developmental learner that internalizes the tacit methodology of a directing human, graduating through per-skill autonomy tiers only when empirical evidence justifies it. The result is an agent that becomes genuinely useful over time while remaining aligned to a specific human's standards. Three architectural components make this possible. (1) Methodology capture, distilling a directing professional's tacit approach into structured assets. (2) Authorization, with autonomy escalation gated by explicit human approval. (3) Continuous alignment, correcting drift at runtime and converting each correction into owned preference data. We instantiate this framework as an inference-time control plane. We mathematically model the quality framework and discuss policies and techniques designed to raise quality. We apply the framework to an open professional corpus, and we show how catching data drift and applying a different technique at runtime recovers degraded quality dimensions under traffic shift. The implication extends beyond any single application. We believe these three pillars, stitched together as a system, form a safer and more viable path to agentic systems that can scale without sacrificing trust.

AI.title_translation: 数字学徒：一种人类主导的代理式AI开发框架
AI.tldr: 提出“数字学徒”框架，通过捕获人类知识、分级授权和持续对齐，实现AI代理在保障安全和问责的前提下稳步提升自主能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决代理式AI在“过度人工干预导致无法扩展”与“过度自主导致缺乏问责”之间的设计矛盾，建立一套负责任的AI代理委派治理基础设施。
AI.method: 提出了“数字学徒”框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)方法论捕获，将人类专业知识转化为结构化资产；(2)授权机制，基于人类明确批准的自主权升级；(3)持续对齐，通过运行时校准和偏好数据转换来纠正行为偏差。该框架被实现为一个推理时控制平面。
AI.result: 通过在开放专业语料库上的实验证明，该框架能在流量变化导致质量下降时，通过捕捉数据偏差并应用不同的运行时技术，成功恢复受损的质量维度，验证了其在保障系统可扩展性与信任度方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 数字学徒框架为代理式AI提供了一种可扩展、安全且可信的治理路径，通过将自主权与人类认可挂钩，实现了AI能力与人类标准的动态对齐。
AI.translation: 代理式AI的部署面临一种反复出现的设计张力：繁重的人工监督限制了规模，而广泛的自主性则超出了问责范围。这两种姿态都无法提供负责任委派所需的治理基础设施。我们提出了“数字学徒”（Digital Apprentice），这是一个用于可扩展、安全AI代理的框架，在这种框架中，自主性是赢得的，而不是预设的。数字学徒是一个发展型学习者，它内化了指导人类的隐性方法论，只有在经验证据证明合理时，才会通过各技能自主权层级进行升级。结果是一个随着时间推移变得真正有用，同时保持与特定人类标准一致的代理。三个架构组件使这一切成为可能：（1）方法论捕获，将指导专业人员的隐性方法提炼为结构化资产；（2）授权，自主权升级由明确的人类批准进行门控；（3）持续对齐，在运行时纠正偏差并将每次纠正转换为拥有的偏好数据。我们将此框架实例化为一个推理时控制平面。我们对质量框架进行了数学建模，并讨论了旨在提高质量的策略和技术。我们将该框架应用于一个开放的专业语料库，并展示了在流量转移下，捕获数据偏差并应用不同的运行时技术如何恢复退化的质量维度。其影响超出了任何单一应用。我们相信这三个支柱作为一个系统缝合在一起，为代理式系统形成了一条更安全、更可行的路径，可以在不牺牲信任的情况下进行扩展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“数字学徒”框架，旨在通过分阶段的自主权授予和持续的对齐机制，平衡AI的自主性与人类的监管需求。该框架通过捕获人类专业方法论、实施分级授权及运行时纠偏，使AI能够随着经验积累变得更加有用且始终符合人类标准，为安全、可扩展的代理式AI开发提供了新路径。
AI.keywords: 代理式AI, 治理框架, 隐性知识捕获, 持续对齐, 自主权分级
AI.comments: 该论文提出的“数字学徒”框架提供了一种平衡自主性与问责制的新颖思路，通过分级授权和持续对齐机制，解决了代理式AI落地中的治理难题。其核心贡献在于将人类的隐性知识显性化并作为AI的行为准则，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Answer Self-Consistency with Margin-Triggered Question Re-Arbitration for the CVPR 2026 VidLLMs Challenge
summary: In this report, we present our solution for Track 2 of the CVPR 2026 VidLLMs Challenge. This track evaluates visual relational reasoning in videos, where models must infer relations that are not always explicitly visible. We propose Answer Self-Consistency with Margin-Triggered Question Re-Arbitration (ASC-MQRA), a training-free test-time reasoning framework built on a multimodal reasoning model. The core ASC component performs multiple stochastic video question-answering runs and aggregates their answer choices through answer-level self-consistency. This substantially improves over single-pass inference and forms our final test submission. We further study MQRA, a conditional re-arbitration module for low-margin examples where the first-stage vote distribution indicates uncertainty. Our vote-margin analysis shows that low-margin examples often retain the ground-truth answer among the top candidates, motivating MQRA to narrow the candidate set and re-watch the video only over the retained candidates. On validation, MQRA further improves over ASC, indicating that low-margin vote distributions can provide a useful uncertainty signal. On test, however, MQRA slightly degrades performance relative to ASC, suggesting that re-arbitration is sensitive to the size and category distribution of the triggered subset. Our final test submission therefore uses ASC without re-arbitration, achieving 72.73 average accuracy and 78.34 category-wise macro average accuracy on validation, and 81.16 average accuracy and 80.91 category-wise macro average accuracy on test. This report details our prompting strategy, implementation setup, ablation studies, and diagnostic analyses. The code is available at https://github.com/data-analytics-labo/ASC-MQRA

AI.title_translation: 面向CVPR 2026 VidLLMs挑战赛的带边际触发问题重裁决的答案自洽性方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的推理框架ASC-MQRA，通过自洽性聚合和基于不确定性的重裁决机制，有效提升了视频大模型在复杂关系推理任务中的准确性。
AI.motivation: 针对视频中视觉关系推理往往无法直接可见的问题，旨在提升多模态模型在视频问答任务中的准确性和推理能力。
AI.method: 提出了ASC-MQRA框架，包含两个核心部分：1. ASC（Answer Self-Consistency）：通过多次随机采样并聚合答案来提高推理稳健性；2. MQRA（Margin-Triggered Question Re-Arbitration）：针对低投票边际的样本，利用不确定性信号缩小候选集并进行二次视频观察以重新裁决。
AI.result: 在验证集上，ASC-MQRA表现优于仅使用ASC的方法；在测试集上，ASC方法达到81.16的平均准确率，而MQRA表现略有下降，最终提交采用ASC。
AI.conclusion: ASC-MQRA框架通过自洽性显著提升了视频问答性能，证明了利用投票边际信号进行动态推理的潜力，最终测试提交采用ASC方法，在CVPR 2026 VidLLMs Challenge中取得了优异成绩。
AI.translation: 在本报告中，我们介绍了针对CVPR 2026 VidLLMs挑战赛第二赛道的解决方案。该赛道评估视频中的视觉关系推理，模型必须推断出并非总是显而易见的视觉关系。我们提出了带边际触发问题重裁决的答案自洽性方法（ASC-MQRA），这是一个构建在多模态推理模型之上的无需训练的测试时推理框架。核心的ASC组件执行多次随机视频问答运行，并通过答案级自洽性聚合它们的答案选择。这大大改进了单次推理，并构成了我们的最终测试提交。我们进一步研究了MQRA，这是一个针对第一阶段投票分布显示不确定性的低边际示例的条件重裁决模块。我们的投票边际分析表明，低边际示例通常在顶级候选者中保留了真实答案，这促使MQRA缩小候选集并仅针对保留的候选者重新观看视频。在验证集上，MQRA进一步优于ASC，表明低边际投票分布可以提供有用的不确定性信号。然而，在测试集上，MQRA相对于ASC性能略有下降，这表明重裁决对触发子集的大小和类别分布很敏感。因此，我们的最终测试提交使用了不带重裁决的ASC，在验证集上达到72.73的平均准确率和78.34的类别宏平均准确率，在测试集上达到81.16的平均准确率和80.91的类别宏平均准确率。本报告详细介绍了我们的提示策略、实现设置、消融研究和诊断分析。代码可在https://github.com/data-analytics-labo/ASC-MQRA获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了针对CVPR 2026 VidLLMs Challenge设计的ASC-MQRA推理框架。该方法通过多轮自洽性验证提升推理性能，并尝试引入基于投票边际的重裁决机制来处理不确定性样本，最终通过仅使用自洽性方法在测试中获得了高准确率。
AI.keywords: 视频大模型, 视觉关系推理, 自洽性, 测试时推理, 投票边际分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的测试时推理框架，通过自洽性（Self-Consistency）和动态重裁决（Re-Arbitration）机制提升视频大模型在复杂视觉关系推理任务中的表现。其创新点在于利用投票边际（vote-margin）作为不确定性信号来优化推理决策，尽管在测试集上重裁决模块的效果未达预期，但该研究为理解多模态模型推理中的不确定性提供了宝贵的实证分析。

title: Neural Galerkin Normalizing Flows for Bayesian Inference of Diffusions with Inaccessible Boundaries
summary:
One of the primary challenges in Bayesian inference on the parameters of a diffusion model from discrete observations is the unavailability of an analytical expression for the transition density function between consecutive observation times, which is needed to derive the likelihood function.
  Extending previous studies that solve Fokker-Planck (FP) type partial differential equations with Normalizing Flows, we propose a new Normalizing Flow architecture to learn the transition density function of the diffusion process between two observation times. We do so by solving in a Neural Galerkin framework the associated FP equation with a Dirac mass as initial condition, over a specified training distribution of the initial datum and the coefficients of the diffusion. We specifically focus on processes whose diffusion matrix vanishes in certain inaccessible boundary regions, such as Stochastic Volatility models that satisfy a Feller condition.
  The product of the obtained transition densities evaluated along the observed trajectory approximates the likelihood function, thereby enabling cheap posterior sampling via Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). After the offline training phase, inference becomes significantly more efficient, as it avoids the need to solve the FP equation in real time for each parameter proposed by the MCMC sampler or to rely on other likelihood-free methods for Bayesian inference that involve repeated simulation of diffusion bridges.

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Learnable Rank
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method that restricts weight updates to low-rank adapters, introducing a fixed low-rank inductive bias by optimizing in a low-dimensional subspace. In this work, we question whether a fixed-rank constraint is the most effective inductive bias for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We introduce *Learnable Rank LoRA (LR-LoRA)*, a PEFT method in which the adapter rank is learned during the training process. Instead of prescribing a uniform rank for all adapter layers, LR-LoRA allows the optimizer to determine the appropriate rank for each layer. Using this approach, we find substantial layer-wise variation in the learned ranks, with the attention and MLP layers in the transformer models exhibiting systematically different rank preferences. Across a range of language understanding and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, LR-LoRA achieves state-of-the-art performance in most settings and consistently outperforms strong PEFT baselines, demonstrating that a learnable rank provides a more flexible and effective inductive bias than fixed-rank adaptations.

title: Measuring What Matters: Synthetic Benchmarks for Concept Bottleneck Models
summary: Concept bottleneck models predict outcomes from high-level concepts detected in inputs. Although concepts provide a simple way to reap benefits from interpretability, very few datasets include concept labels. This limits researchers' ability to determine which problems are suitable for these models, isolate the factors that drive their performance or lead to failures, or uncover which algorithms perform well. In this paper, we develop synthetic benchmarks for concept-bottleneck models, focusing on their two main use cases: decision support, in which models assist humans in making better decisions, and automation, in which models handle routine tasks without supervision. Our benchmarks can generate labeled datasets while controlling for properties that affect performance, including data modality, concept choice, annotation quality, and completeness. We demonstrate how the benchmarks can be used to evaluate representative classes of concept bottleneck models. Our demonstrations show how the benchmarks can diagnose failure modes and guide follow-up testing.

title: A Geometric Characterization of the Stationary Plateau for Two-Layer Neural Networks
summary: We investigate the geometric structure of stationary plateaus that arise in the loss landscape of two-layer neural networks with smooth activation functions. We focus on the phenomenon of "neuron splitting" where duplicating a hidden neuron yields an affine set of stationary points in a wider network. We provide a comprehensive classification of all stationary points on these plateaus, determining under what conditions they constitute local minima or saddle points. Our characterization hinges on a per-neuron curvature object we term the "inner Hessian" matrix. Our analysis reveals that the definiteness of the inner Hessian and the choice of splitting coefficients jointly dictate the local geometry of the plateau. We show that "splitting" a local minimum can yield either a mixture of local minima and saddles or an all-saddle plateau, with a concrete sure-saddle region identified under mild assumptions. In contrast, splitting a saddle point always produces a plateau of saddle points. Our results unify and extend prior landscape analyses, elucidating when and how model expansion preserves or alters the nature of stationary points. These findings offer new geometric insights into the effects of width expansion and reparameterization in neural networks.

title: Generalizable Multi-Task Learning for Wireless Networks Using Prompt Decision Transformers
comments: Accepted paper at IEEE International Mediterranean Conference on Communications and Networking (MeditCom) 2026
summary: Future wireless networks demand rapid adaptation to highly heterogeneous environments and dynamic task configurations, necessitating a shift from conventional rule-based and optimization-driven radio resource management (RRM) toward artificial intelligence (AI)-driven RRM. AI-driven approaches can learn complex nonlinear relationships, generalize across diverse network conditions and enable real-time, scalable and autonomous decision-making. Among RRM techniques, coordinated multipoint (CoMP) transmission is pivotal for mitigating inter-cell interference and enhancing cell-edge performance, thereby improving quality of experience (QoE) in dense deployments. However, optimal multi-cell selection remains a complex combinatorial challenge as it requires jointly optimizing over many possible serving-cell combinations under dynamic traffic and channel conditions. Despite their success, conventional deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods such as proximal policy optimization (PPO) suffer from poor sample efficiency, limited generalization, and costly retraining when state and action spaces change. To address these bottlenecks, we propose a Prompt Decision Transformer (PromptDT) based multi-task learning framework capable of learning across diverse network configurations and reformulating multi-cell selection as a sequence modeling problem. By leveraging offline trajectories and task-specific prompts, PromptDT enables scalable learning across diverse network configurations, including varying base stations and user equipment counts, and scheduler policies. Experimental results demonstrate that PromptDT improves QoE by up to 49% in multi-task settings compared to baselines, with performance scaling positively alongside model capacity. Moreover, PromptDT generalizes effectively to unseen tasks, achieving robust few-shot adaptation to new network configurations without retraining or fine-tuning.
comment: Accepted paper at IEEE International Mediterranean Conference on Communications and Networking (MeditCom) 2026

AI.title_translation: 基于提示决策Transformer的无线网络通用多任务学习
AI.tldr: 提出PromptDT框架，通过序列建模和任务提示，显著提升了无线网络资源管理在异构环境下的泛化能力和QoE表现，无需重训练即可适配新任务。
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则和DRL的无线资源管理方法在面对高度异构和动态的任务配置时，存在样本效率低、泛化能力差以及状态/动作空间变化时需要昂贵重训练的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于提示的决策Transformer（PromptDT）框架，将多小区选择问题重构为序列建模问题，利用离线轨迹和特定任务提示（Prompt）进行训练，以适应不同的基站、用户数量及调度策略。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，PromptDT在多任务设置下将用户体验质量（QoE）提升了高达49%，且在未见过的任务上表现出强大的少样本适应能力，无需重训练或微调。
AI.conclusion: PromptDT框架通过序列建模和提示机制，有效解决了多小区选择中的复杂组合优化问题，实现了在异构无线网络环境下的高效泛化与快速适配。
AI.translation: 未来的无线网络需要能够快速适应高度异构的环境和动态任务配置，这促使无线资源管理（RRM）从传统的基于规则和优化驱动的方法向人工智能（AI）驱动的方法转变。AI驱动的方法可以学习复杂的非线性关系，在不同的网络条件下进行泛化，并实现实时、可扩展和自主的决策。在RRM技术中，协作多点（CoMP）传输对于减轻小区间干扰和增强小区边缘性能至关重要，从而改善密集部署中的用户体验质量（QoE）。然而，最优多小区选择仍然是一个复杂的组合挑战，因为它需要在动态流量和信道条件下共同优化许多可能的服务小区组合。尽管传统深度强化学习（DRL）方法（如PPO）取得了一定成功，但它们存在样本效率低、泛化能力有限以及当状态和动作空间发生变化时重训练成本高等问题。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了一种基于提示决策Transformer（PromptDT）的多任务学习框架，该框架能够跨不同的网络配置进行学习，并将多小区选择重新表述为序列建模问题。通过利用离线轨迹和特定任务提示，PromptDT实现了跨不同网络配置（包括变化的基站和用户设备数量以及调度策略）的可扩展学习。实验结果表明，与基准方法相比，PromptDT在多任务设置中将QoE提高了49%，且性能随模型容量的增加而正向扩展。此外，PromptDT能有效泛化到未见过的任务，实现了对新网络配置的稳健少样本适应，无需重训练或微调。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于无线网络的通用多任务学习框架PromptDT，将多小区选择转化为序列建模问题。通过引入提示机制，该模型能够有效处理异构网络配置，在提升无线资源管理效率的同时，实现了卓越的泛化性能和少样本适应能力。
AI.keywords: 无线网络, 提示决策Transformer, 多任务学习, 无线资源管理, 序列建模
AI.comments: 该研究将序列建模范式（Decision Transformer）引入无线资源管理（RRM）领域，通过提示工程（Prompting）解决了传统DRL在处理多任务和异构网络环境时泛化能力差、样本效率低的问题，是AI赋能无线通信领域的重要探索。

title: From Untrusted Input to Trusted Memory: A Systematic Study of Memory Poisoning Attacks in LLM Agents
summary: Memory is a core component of AI agents, enabling them to accumulate knowledge across interactions and improve performance. However, persistent memory introduces the risk of memory poisoning, where a single adversarial memory write can exert long-term influence over agent behavior. We present a systematic study of memory poisoning in LLM-based agents. We identify four memory write channels and nine structural vulnerabilities in model capabilities, system prompt design, and agent system architecture that make these channels exploitable. Based on these vulnerabilities, we develop a taxonomy of six classes of memory poisoning attacks. Furthermore, we design MPBench -- a benchmark for evaluating memory poisoning attacks, and show that agents designed to write and retrieve memory more aggressively are more exploitable. We also show that existing prompt injection defenses fail to cover memory poisoning attacks. Our findings provide a foundation for understanding and mitigating memory poisoning attacks against AI agents.

AI.title_translation: 从不可信输入到可信内存：LLM智能体中内存投毒攻击的系统性研究
AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了LLM智能体中内存投毒攻击的漏洞与分类，推出了MPBench评估基准，并揭示了现有防御措施对该类攻击的失效性。
AI.motivation: AI智能体的持久化内存机制虽然提升了性能，但也引入了内存投毒风险，即恶意的内存写入可能导致智能体行为产生长期偏差，目前缺乏针对该问题的系统性研究。
AI.method: 系统性分析了四种内存写入渠道和九种结构性漏洞，构建了六类内存投毒攻击分类体系，并开发了评估基准MPBench来量化攻击效果。
AI.result: 研究发现更频繁读写内存的智能体更容易受到攻击，同时证明了现有的提示词注入防御手段无法有效防范内存投毒攻击。
AI.conclusion: 内存投毒是LLM智能体的一个严重安全风险，现有的防御措施无法有效抵御此类攻击，研究提出的分类法和基准测试为未来的防御方案开发奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 内存是AI智能体的核心组件，使其能够在交互中积累知识并提升性能。然而，持久化内存引入了内存投毒的风险，即单次对抗性内存写入可能对智能体行为产生长期影响。我们对基于LLM的智能体中的内存投毒进行了系统性研究。我们确定了四种内存写入渠道以及模型能力、系统提示词设计和智能体系统架构中的九种结构性漏洞，这些漏洞使得上述渠道可被利用。基于这些漏洞，我们开发了六类内存投毒攻击的分类法。此外，我们设计了MPBench——一个用于评估内存投毒攻击的基准，并证明了那些设计上更积极地写入和检索内存的智能体更容易受到攻击。我们还表明，现有的提示词注入防御无法涵盖内存投毒攻击。我们的研究结果为理解和缓解针对AI智能体的内存投毒攻击奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文对基于LLM的智能体中的内存投毒攻击进行了系统性研究。通过分析内存写入渠道和结构性漏洞，作者提出了六类攻击分类法，并开发了评估基准MPBench。研究结果表明，高频内存交互的智能体更易受攻击，且现有防御机制不足。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 内存投毒, 安全漏洞, MPBench, 提示词注入
AI.comments: 该研究首次系统性地探讨了LLM智能体中的内存投毒攻击，填补了该领域的研究空白。其创新之处在于提出了攻击分类法和评估基准MPBench，并揭示了现有防御手段（如提示词注入防御）在应对内存投毒时的局限性，对提升智能体安全性具有重要意义。

title: Policy Gradient for Continuous-Time Robust Markov Decision Processes
summary: The framework of robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) allows the design of reinforcement learning agents that satisfy performance guarantees under worst-case transition dynamics. Traditional RMDPs consider discrete-time dynamics and recently, sample-efficient policy gradient algorithms have been considered in this context. This paper investigates policy gradient algorithms within a continuous-time RMDP framework. Policy gradients and adversarial gradients are derived using pathwise and adjoint-based formulas for stochastic and ordinary differential equations. We propose double-loop optimisers to obtain linear convergence in the oracle-based setting and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{ε^2})$ sample complexity in the sample-based setting in an analysis which also derives novel tools for the framework of undiscounted total cost MDPs. Additionally, we propose mean-field optimisers as distributional optimisers with an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$ oracle-based convergence rate and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{N^2}ε)$ sample complexity under $N$-particle approximation. The effectiveness of continuous-time policy gradient algorithms is confirmed for both optimisers on continuous-time RMDPs with neural ordinary differential equation dynamics.

title: Federated Learning for Multi-Center Sepsis Early Prediction with Privacy-Preserving
summary: Privacy-sensitive and distributed characteristics of multi-center medical data bring severe obstacles to centralized modeling for accurate early prediction of sepsis. Federated learning (FL) has attracted growing attention as a promising framework for collaborative model development, as it allows multiple institutions to jointly train predictive models without directly sharing or centralizing raw data. Nevertheless, its practical performance, robustness, and privacy-preserving benefits remain insufficiently evaluated using real-world clinical datasets. To bridge this gap, this study systematically examines the application of federated learning to multi-center sepsis prediction. The experimental dataset consists of 648 clinically screened samples collected from three tertiary hospitals in China, with rigorous inclusion and exclusion criteria. We establish a centralized training paradigm as the performance baseline, and then implement a horizontal federated learning framework for distributed collaborative modeling. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the federated learning-based model achieves highly comparable prediction accuracy to the centralized counterpart, while fundamentally avoiding privacy leakage. Further privacy security analysis verifies that malicious attackers cannot reconstruct the original patient data from the transmitted model parameters, indicating strong resistance against data reconstruction attacks. This work not only validates the practicality and security of federated learning in clinical sepsis prediction, but also provides a reliable and feasible solution for privacy-preserving multi-center medical collaboration.

AI.title_translation: 面向多中心脓毒症早期预测的隐私保护联邦学习研究
AI.tldr: 本文证明了联邦学习可以在保护医疗数据隐私的同时，实现与集中式训练相当的脓毒症早期预测性能。
AI.motivation: 医疗数据具有隐私敏感性和分布式存储的特点，导致传统的集中式建模在脓毒症早期预测中面临严峻的数据共享和隐私挑战。
AI.method: 采用水平联邦学习框架，利用来自中国三家三甲医院的648个临床筛选样本进行分布式协作建模，并与集中式训练范式进行对比分析。
AI.result: 基于联邦学习的模型在脓毒症预测准确率上与集中式模型相当，且通过隐私安全分析验证了该方法对数据重构攻击具有强大的防御能力。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习能够实现在保护患者隐私的前提下，在多中心医疗环境中达到与集中式学习相当的脓毒症预测性能，是构建隐私保护医疗协作的有效解决方案。
AI.translation: 多中心医疗数据的隐私敏感性和分布式特征，为准确的脓毒症早期预测的集中式建模带来了严重障碍。联邦学习（FL）作为一种有前景的协作模型开发框架，受到了越来越多的关注，因为它允许多个机构联合训练预测模型，而无需直接共享或集中原始数据。然而，其在实际性能、鲁棒性和隐私保护效益方面，使用真实临床数据集评估尚不充分。为了弥补这一差距，本研究系统地考察了联邦学习在多中心脓毒症预测中的应用。实验数据集由来自中国三家三甲医院的648个经过严格纳入和排除标准筛选的临床样本组成。我们建立了集中式训练范式作为性能基准，然后实施了一个水平联邦学习框架进行分布式协作建模。广泛的实验结果表明，基于联邦学习的模型实现了与集中式对应模型高度可比的预测准确率，同时从根本上避免了隐私泄露。进一步的隐私安全分析验证了恶意攻击者无法从传输的模型参数中重构原始患者数据，表明其对数据重构攻击具有很强的抵抗力。这项工作不仅验证了联邦学习在临床脓毒症预测中的实用性和安全性，也为隐私保护的多中心医疗协作提供了一种可靠且可行的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了联邦学习在多中心脓毒症早期预测中的应用，通过三家医院的临床数据集，证明了联邦学习在无需共享原始数据的情况下，能够实现与集中式模型相当的预测精度，并有效保障了患者隐私。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 脓毒症预测, 隐私保护, 多中心医疗, 医疗人工智能
AI.comments: 该研究通过真实临床数据验证了联邦学习在医疗领域的可行性，特别是在隐私保护与模型性能平衡方面取得了重要进展，为多中心医疗协作提供了实证支持，但样本量相对较小可能是其局限性。

title: Literature-Guided Minimax Optimization of Virtual Epilepsy Neurostimulation
comments: 9 pages, 4 figures. Code and interactive essay at https://github.com/liuzhitong330/tvb-llm-robust-neurostim
summary: Computational models of epilepsy promise patient-specific treatment design, but most optimization workflows still search for parameters that perform well on average. In neuromodulation, this is a weak target: a protocol that improves the mean response can still fail in the patient whose network is least tolerant to stimulation. We present a literature-guided minimax pipeline that couples PubMed-scale hypothesis extraction, The Virtual Brain (TVB) Epileptor simulations, and large-language-model-guided black-box optimization. The optimizer proposes either intrinsic model-control parameters or clinically interpretable external-stimulation protocols; TVB evaluates each proposal across sampled virtual patients; and the objective maximizes worst-case reward, defined as the negative variance of simulated seizure activity. In the intrinsic model-control experiment, the best archived parameter set improved worst-case reward from -0.5285 to -0.3182, a 39.8% gain over baseline. The clinical-style external-stimulation search produced a much smaller worst-case improvement (1.7%), and a 20-patient virtual cohort showed no aggregate benefit (p=0.9019), despite a 55% responder rate and a positive temporal-lobe subgroup signal. The study should be read as an in silico proof of concept for robust, literature-aware neurostimulation design, not as clinical evidence.
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Code and interactive essay at https://github.com/liuzhitong330/tvb-llm-robust-neurostim

AI.title_translation: 文献引导的虚拟癫痫神经调控极小极大优化
AI.tldr: 开发了一种利用文献知识和仿真模型进行癫痫神经调控优化的新方法，重点提升了治疗方案在最差情况下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的癫痫治疗优化方法多关注平均响应，忽略了对刺激耐受性较差的个体，导致治疗效果不稳定。因此需要一种能针对最差情况进行鲁棒性优化的方案。
AI.method: 构建了结合PubMed文献挖掘、TVB Epileptor仿真模型以及LLM引导的黑盒优化管道。通过极小极大优化策略，最大化最差情况下的奖励（即癫痫发作活动的负方差）。
AI.result: 在内在模型控制实验中，最差情况奖励提升了39.8%；而在临床风格的外部刺激搜索中，最差情况提升较小（1.7%），且在20名虚拟患者的队列中未观察到显著的整体获益。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了文献引导的极小极大优化在构建鲁棒性癫痫神经调控策略方面的潜力，强调了针对个体差异进行最差情况优化的重要性。
AI.translation: 计算癫痫模型有望实现患者特异性的治疗设计，但大多数优化工作流仍是在寻找在平均水平上表现良好的参数。在神经调控中，这是一个较弱的目标：一个改善平均响应的方案，在对刺激耐受性最差的患者身上可能仍然会失败。我们提出了一个文献引导的极小极大管道，结合了PubMed规模的假设提取、The Virtual Brain (TVB) Epileptor仿真以及大语言模型引导的黑盒优化。优化器提出内在模型控制参数或临床可解释的外部刺激协议；TVB在采样的虚拟患者中评估每个建议；目标是最大化最差情况奖励，定义为模拟癫痫发作活动的负方差。在内在模型控制实验中，归档的最佳参数集将最差情况奖励从-0.5285提高到-0.3182，较基线提升了39.8%。临床风格的外部刺激搜索产生的最差情况改善较小（1.7%），且20名虚拟患者的队列显示没有整体获益（p=0.9019），尽管有55%的响应率和颞叶亚组的阳性信号。本研究应被视为一种鲁棒、文献感知的神经调控设计的计算机模拟概念验证，而非临床证据。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种文献引导的极小极大优化流程，旨在通过TVB模拟和LLM辅助，为癫痫治疗设计更鲁棒的神经调控协议，重点关注提升最差情况下的治疗表现而非平均水平。
AI.keywords: 癫痫, 神经调控, 极小极大优化, 大型语言模型, The Virtual Brain
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地结合了大型语言模型（LLM）的文献挖掘能力与计算神经科学仿真模型（TVB），提出了一种面向“最差情况”鲁棒性的优化范式。其局限在于临床模拟效果仍有待提升，且目前仅为计算机模拟研究，尚未转化为实际临床应用。

title: Noisy memory encoding explains negative polarity illusions
comments: 21 pages, 5 figures, submitted for journal publication
summary: A sentence like "The authors that no critics recommended have ever received acknowledgment for a best-selling novel" is sometimes rated as acceptable even though, strictly speaking, it is ungrammatical because the negative polarity word "ever" is not licensed where it is. This behavioral effect is sometimes called a "negative polarity illusion". Here we propose that the lossy context surprisal theory of Hahn et al. (2022) -- whereby people have an imperfect encoding of complex sentences -- might explain this effect. We hypothesize that people have poor memory representation of the determiners in the main-clause and embedded-clause subjects and could entertain a determiner exchange that licenses ever. We propose that more similar determiners in those positions would trigger stronger illusion effects. Acceptability judgment tasks with six novel determiner pairs (e.g., "few" and "many", "few" and "most") support our proposal, showing, specifically, that a novel sentence, "Many authors that few critics recommended have ever received acknowledgment for a best-selling novel", triggered a much stronger illusion than the canonical one even without time pressure. These results offer further support for the suggestion that human language processing is imperfect and resource-rational: in face of working memory limitations, humans rationally reconstruct what is most likely from noisy linguistic input to facilitate downstream processing.
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, submitted for journal publication

AI.title_translation: 噪声记忆编码解释了负极项错觉
AI.tldr: 人们之所以会误认为错误的句子在语法上可接受，是因为工作记忆限制导致了对句中限定词的模糊记忆与理性重构。
AI.motivation: 旨在解释为何人们有时会认为语法错误的句子（包含未被许可的负极项“ever”）是可以接受的，即“负极项错觉”现象。
AI.method: 基于Hahn等人（2022）的有损上下文惊奇度理论，提出记忆编码噪声假说，并通过六组限定词对的接受度判断实验进行实证验证。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，当主句和从句主语的限定词越相似时，错觉效应越强。例如，“Many authors that few critics recommended have ever...”引发的错觉显著强于经典句式。
AI.conclusion: 人类的语言处理是资源理性的，在面对工作记忆限制时，人们会根据有噪声的语言输入合理地重构句意，这种机制解释了负极项错觉现象。
AI.translation: 像“The authors that no critics recommended have ever received acknowledgment for a best-selling novel”这样的句子，尽管从严格语法角度看，由于负极项“ever”未被许可而显得不合语法，但有时仍会被评为可接受。这种行为效应有时被称为“负极项错觉”。本文提出，Hahn等人（2022）的有损上下文惊奇度理论——即人们对复杂句子的编码是不完美的——可以解释这种效应。我们假设人们对主句和从句主语中的限定词记忆表征较差，可能会在脑中进行限定词置换，从而误以为“ever”是被许可的。我们提出，这些位置上的限定词越相似，触发的错觉效应就越强。通过六对新限定词（如“few”和“many”，“few”和“most”）进行的接受度判断任务支持了我们的提议，具体表现为，即使在没有时间压力的情况下，新句子“Many authors that few critics recommended have ever received acknowledgment for a best-selling novel”触发的错觉也远强于经典句式。这些结果进一步支持了人类语言处理是不完美且资源理性的观点：在面对工作记忆限制时，人类为了促进后续处理，会理性地从有噪声的语言输入中重构最可能的内容。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了负极项错觉的成因，提出这种现象源于人类在处理复杂句子时，由于工作记忆限制导致的对限定词的有损记忆编码。通过实验证实，限定词间的相似性会诱发错觉，支持了人类语言处理是基于有噪声输入进行资源理性重构的观点。
AI.keywords: 负极项错觉, 语言处理, 有损记忆编码, 资源理性, 限定词重构
AI.comments: 该研究通过将心理语言学中的“负极项错觉”与“有损上下文惊奇度理论”相结合，为理解人类语言处理的资源理性提供了有力证据。其创新点在于提出并验证了记忆编码中的噪声会导致对限定词的错误重构，从而解释了语法错误判断的现象。局限性在于该模型主要基于限定词的相似性，未来需探究更广泛的语言结构是否遵循此机制。

title: Expectations vs. Realities: The Cost of MSE-Optimal Forecasting Under Conditional Uncertainty
comments: 12 pages, Accepted for KDD 2026 Research track
summary: Multi-step time series forecasting (MSF) is commonly evaluated using point-wise error metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), implicitly treating the conditional mean as a sufficient target. We show that this can be misleading under conditional uncertainty, where the conditional expectation becomes unrepresentative of typical realized values at longer horizons. We formalize this effect through a conditional uncertainty gap and prove that whenever this gap is nonzero, no deterministic predictor can simultaneously minimize MSE and match the marginal distribution of realized futures. This establishes a fundamental, model-agnostic trade-off between point accuracy and marginal realism in MSF evaluation. Using controlled stochastic dynamical systems and nine real-world forecasting benchmarks, we empirically characterize the resulting accuracy--realism frontier and \textbf{quantify the practical cost of MSE-only model selection}. As conditional uncertainty increases with forecast horizon, the attainable set expands into a pronounced Pareto front, separating MSE-optimal but under-dispersed predictors from methods that trade accuracy for realistic marginal variability. \textbf{Across benchmarks, we find that small relaxations in MSE ($\boldsymbol{\le 5\%}$) frequently unlock disproportionate gains in marginal realism, with median improvements of $\mathbf{17.3\%}$ and gains exceeding $\mathbf{30\%}$ in some datasets.} We further show that common forecasting strategies systematically occupy different regions of this frontier: direct multi-output predictors concentrate near the accuracy-optimal extreme, while recursive strategies and sample-based inference favors marginal realism. Together, these results expose a structural failure mode of MSE-based evaluation in long-horizon forecasting and recast strategy and inference selection as navigation of an unavoidable accuracy--realism trade-off.

title: Robust Multi-view Clustering against Imperfect Information
summary: Real-world multi-view data always suffer from imperfect information problem, where the view-specific observations are absent (i.e., Incomplete Views, IV) and cross-view correspondences are mismatched (i.e., Noisy Correspondences, NC) for certain instances. As a remedy, numerous IV- and NC-oriented multi-view clustering (MvC) methods have been proposed, which however require either reliable correspondences or sufficiently complete instances, thus stopping short of addressing the imperfect information problem. In contrast, we observe that both IV and NC challenges originate from the same issue of imperfect cross-view counterpart information, where the counterpart of an anchor instance in another view might be either unavailable or unreliable. Based on the observation, we propose a novel robust MvC framework, termed Posterior-guided Latent Counterpart Inference (PLCI), which could handle both IV and NC in a unified manner. Specifically, PLCI formulates the desired cross-view counterpart of each anchor instance as a latent variable, and integrates both instance-level reliability and prototype-level semantic transport to infer the posterior distribution of the latent counterpart. Extensive experiments on six widely-used multi-view datasets against 10 state-of-the-art MvC methods demonstrate the effectiveness of PLCI for tackling the imperfect information problem. The code will be released upon acceptance.

title: HYolo: An Intelligent IoT-Based Object Detection System Using Hypergraph Learning
summary: This paper presents HYolo, an intelligent IoT-based object detection framework that integrates hypergraph learning into the YOLO architecture. Traditional YOLO-based object detection models primarily capture pairwise feature interactions and may fail to model complex high-order relationships among objects and contextual features. To address this limitation, HYolo incorporates hypergraph learning to capture richer contextual dependencies and improve object representation. Experimental evaluation on the COCO dataset demonstrates significant performance improvements over baseline YOLO models. The proposed approach achieves approximately 12% improvement in mAP@50 while enhancing overall detection accuracy and robustness. By modeling high-order feature relationships, HYolo provides improved contextual understanding and more reliable object detection performance in IoT-based environments. The results indicate that integrating hypergraph learning into object detection pipelines offers a promising direction for intelligent and context-aware IoT vision systems.

title: Exponential Time Differencing Schemes for a Phase-Field Model of Multicomponent Membranes
summary: In this paper, we develop and analyze exponential time differencing (ETD) schemes for a phase-field model of multicomponent membranes proposed in our previous work \cite{luo2025ohta}, in which membrane deformation is governed by a force-balance phase-field equation and protein segregation is described by a membrane-associated Ohta-Kawasaki (OK) dynamics. For a fixed phase-field membrane, we introduce a geometry-adapted operator splitting method based on the localization function, which reformulates the surface OK dynamics into a form suitable for ETD integration. The resulting first- and second-order ETD schemes, combined with finite-difference spatial discretization, are rigorously proved to satisfy a discrete maximum-bound principle and unconditional energy stability. For the coupled system, we construct stabilized ETD schemes in an FFT-based spectral framework, treating stiff linear terms exactly and nonlinear mechanochemical couplings explicitly. A narrow-band implementation further reduces the computational cost by restricting surface calculations to the diffuse membrane region. Numerical experiments confirm the predicted temporal accuracy, maximum-bound preservation, and energy decay for the fixed-membrane OK problem, and demonstrate stable and efficient three-dimensional simulations of protein-driven pattern formation and membrane deformation.

title: MorphoQuant: Modality-Aware Quantization for Omni-modal Large Language Models
summary: Conventional Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) methods struggle with 4-bit Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) due to the extreme distribution heterogeneity and disparate outlier patterns across modalities. To address this, we propose MorphoQuant, a modality-aware PTQ framework engineered to preserve cross-modal morphology and mitigate outlier loss. Specifically, we introduce Distribution-Aware Bias Compensation (DABC), which selectively absorbs long-tailed outliers into channel-wise biases. This mechanism safeguards outlier magnitudes while maintaining high-precision discretization for dense inliers, thereby preserving accurate discretization across diverse modal distribution. Complementing this, we propose Morphology-Directed Quantization Function Optimization (MDQFO) to co-optimize the quantization grid with the bias mask, ensuring fine-grained alignment across modalities. Extensive evaluations on Qwen2.5-Omni across benchmarks like MMMU and Video-MME demonstrate our approach's superiority. Notably, our W4A4 model achieves 76.63% on ScienceQA, significantly outperforming SOTA W4A4 methods and surprisingly surpassing the W4A16 baseline, which fully demonstrates the exceptional accuracy-efficiency trade-off of our framework.

title: Towards Process Mining Use Case Map Models with PM4Py-UCM
comments: 10 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, submitted to MoDRE 2026
summary: Given the increasing amount of data available in organizational systems, there is an opportunity for early requirements engineering (RE) activities to be better based on evidence than ever before. Process mining (PM) has been used for over two decades to discover and analyze as-is process models from event logs extracted from such data, with outputs often in the form of Petri Nets, directly-follows graphs, or BPMN models. This paper aims to make Use Case Map (UCM) models, from ITU-T's User Requirements Notation (URN), a first-class output of process discovery, so that mined behavior can be used in URN-based modeling, analysis, and management activities. This paper contributes and illustrates PM4Py-UCM, an open-source extension to the existing PM4Py Python library. This new tool contributes 1) a UCM discovery pipeline, 2) hierarchical decomposition strategies producing nested UCM models, 3) configurable performer mappings for UCM and BPMN visualizations, and 4) an exporter to a URN tool (jUCMNav) that preserves the mined model under round-trip. Using public and synthetic event logs, the paper showcases how the same behavior is rendered under different performer abstractions and decomposition strategies, and discusses how PM can become a practical instrument for model-driven RE.

title: Video2LoRA: Parametric Video Internalization for Vision-Language Models
summary: Processing video in vision-language models is expensive: each frame occupies hundreds of tokens, and inference cost scales with every frame and every repeated query. We introduce Video2LoRA, a method for parametric video internalization. A perceiver hypernetwork reads the intermediate representations produced layer-by-layer as a frozen VLM encodes a video, and generates a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter in a single forward pass. Unlike standard LoRA fine-tuning, which requires iterative gradient updates, Video2LoRA predicts these weights directly from the video. Trained for SmolVLM2 500M and 2.2B on video summarization and captioning, Video2LoRA enables the same frozen VLM to answer queries from the adapter alone, with zero visual tokens in its context at query time. Video2LoRA is statistically non-inferior and equivalent to direct video-in-context inference across all five captioning benchmarks at both model scales, and across seven of eight video question answering benchmark-scale pairings. Although trained only on 12 frames at 384px, it remains stable up to 1,024 frames and 1024px, where direct video-in-context inference often degenerates. Across this sweep, it reduces answer-time visual-token load by up to 1,500x and query TTFT by 6-80x, while preserving video-faithful outputs. We also find that independently generated adapters for non-overlapping video segments can compose in rank space, suggesting a path toward chunked long-video internalization.

title: Negative and Fractional Types in the Fidelity Framework
summary: Our Native Type Universe (NTU) has been detailed through five previous papers establishing the substrate our framework's compilation pipeline targets across multiple hardware platforms. We have found in the course of that work a deeper reach this foundation makes available: negative and fractional types as native first-class constructs. James and Sabry established these dualities in 2012; Chen and Sabry later developed their categorical interpretation in compact closed categories. These dualities have practical benefit for compute modalities in our Fidelity Framework where extant general purpose compute framings lack the substrate to host them as native constructs. We see practicality with these type forms in preserving decidability and principal types through the abelian-group algebraic pattern Kennedy's dimensional types establish. The resulting isomorphisms would admit new, concise forms of resolution within our novel lowering strategy, and we sketch a notional Clef language syntax that would admit rational dimensional exponents into our algebra. We trace the implications across several problem spaces these type forms would open to our compilation and verification disciplines: Bayesian inference where fractional types would express conditioning obligations, quantum computation (and simulations) where negative types would provide the type-level adjoint, and finally adiabatic computation where the combined discipline would express Hamiltonian deformation as a reversible constraint-propagation process. The inherent structure of our NTU together with the supporting framework appears well-suited to problem spaces that current software ecosystems do not directly address, while keeping approachable development ergonomics and mature tooling aligned with operational guarantees the framework aspires to provide.

title: Think Fast and Far: Long-Horizon Online POMDP Planning via Rapid State Sampling
comments: @inproceedings{Liang2026Thinking, title = {Think Fast and Far: Long-Horizon Online POMDP Planning via Rapid State Sampling}, author = {Yuanchu Liang and Edward Kim and J.Arden Knoll and Wil Thomason and Zachary Kingston and Lydia E. Kavraki and Hanna Kurniawati}, year = 2026, booktitle = {International Journal of Robotics Research (to appear)} }
summary: Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) are a general and principled framework for motion planning under uncertainty. Despite tremendous improvement in the scalability of POMDP solvers, long-horizon POMDPs remain difficult to solve. To alleviate the difficulty, this paper proposes a new approximate online POMDP solver, called Reference-Based Online POMDP Planning via Rapid State Space Sampling (ROP-RAS3). ROP-RAS3 uses novel extremely fast sampling-based motion planning techniques to sample the state space and generate a diverse set of macro actions online, which are then used to bias belief-space sampling and infer high-quality policies without requiring exhaustive enumeration of the action space -- a fundamental constraint for modern online POMDP solvers. ROP-RAS3 converges to a near-optimal reference-based solution at a rate that depends on the number of sampled actions, rather than the size of the action space. ROP-RAS3 is evaluated on various long-horizon POMDPs with up to 3000 lookahead steps and 35-dimensional state spaces, where the state, action and observation spaces can be continuous, discrete, or a hybrid of discrete and continuous. Although the reference-based optimal solution may not be the same as the optimal POMDP solution, empirical results indicate that in all of these problems, in terms of success rate, ROP-RAS3 outperforms other state-of-the-art methods by up to multiple folds. We also demonstrate the capability of our approach on a physical robot demonstration. This work extends the theory and empirical results of our ISRR24 paper. Code can be found at \texttt{https://github.com/RDLLab/ROPRAS3}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROP-RAS3算法，通过快速状态采样在线生成宏动作来引导信念空间采样，打破了穷举动作空间的限制，在多达3000步的长视界POMDP任务中成功率比现有方法提升数倍。

AI.method: 提出了一种名为ROP-RAS3的近似在线POMDP求解器。该方法利用极快的基于采样的运动规划技术在线对状态空间进行采样并生成多样化的宏动作，进而用这些宏动作来引导信念空间采样，从而推导出高质量的策略，而无需穷举动作空间。

AI.conclusion: ROP-RAS3成功突破了传统在线POMDP求解器受动作空间大小限制的瓶颈，能够以取决于采样动作数量的速率收敛到近优解。在多种极具挑战性的长视界、高维POMDP任务及物理机器人演示中，其成功率均显著超越了现有最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）是不确定性下运动规划的一个通用且原则性的框架。尽管POMDP求解器的可扩展性有了巨大提升，但长视界POMDP仍然难以求解。为了缓解这一困难，本文提出了一种新的近似在线POMDP求解器，称为基于参考的快速状态空间采样在线POMDP规划（ROP-RAS3）。ROP-RAS3使用新型极快的基于采样的运动规划技术来在线采样状态空间并生成多样化的宏动作集，然后利用这些宏动作来引导信念空间采样并推导高质量的策略，而无需穷举动作空间——这是现代在线POMDP求解器的根本约束。ROP-RAS3收敛到近优基于参考的解的速度取决于采样的动作数量，而不是动作空间的大小。ROP-RAS3在多达3000个前瞻步骤和35维状态空间的各种长视界POMDP上进行了评估，其中状态、动作和观测空间可以是连续、离散或离散与连续的混合。尽管基于参考的最优解可能与最优POMDP解不同，但实证结果表明，在所有这些问题中，就成功率而言，ROP-RAS3的效果比其他最先进的方法高出数倍。我们还在物理机器人演示中展示了我们方法的能动性。这项工作扩展了我们ISRR24论文的理论和实证结果。代码可在 \texttt{https://github.com/RDLLab/ROPRAS3} 找到。

title: Gauss Circle Lattices with Geometric Convolutions for Synthesizing High Dimensional Image-Source Room Impulse Responses
comments: Accepted for publication at the 29th International Conference on Digital Audio Effects 2026
summary: The image-source model (ISM) is a widely adopted method for efficiently simulating acoustic room impulse responses (RIRs) under specular reflection assumptions. Acoustic paths between source and receiver are traced to lattice points computed from successive reflections over bounding planes of the room. Rectangular rooms bound the total number of image-sources to be polynomial in the RIR's duration or distance $k$ equivalent, with degree equal the number of room dimensions $N$. Direct ISM simulations are therefore compute upper-bound by $O \left ( k^N \right )$, and consider only cases of $N \leq 3$ for tractability and real-world applications. This work proposes an alternative computational method that lowers the asymptotic compute bound to $O \left ( N k^2 \log k \right )$ for integer coordinates and room dimensions via reducing ISM lattice point counting to the classic Gauss circle problem (GCP). We extend the lattice counting model to frequency-dependent and reflection weighted image-sources in higher dimensions, relating solutions between successive dimensions via the convolution operator. Two constructions for realizing RIRs are presented, along with time-frequency controls, error and run-time analysis, and RIR statistics.
