title: LiSeCo: Linear Semantic Control for Language Generation
comments: TMLR 2026 camera ready; earlier version in NeurIPS MINT Workshop 2024
summary: The prevalence of Large Language Models (LLMs) in critical applications highlights the need for controlled language generation methods that are both computationally efficient and enjoy performance guarantees. To address this need, we use a common model of concept semantics as linearly represented in an LLM's latent space. In particular, we take the view that natural language generation traces a trajectory in this continuous semantic space, realized by the language model's hidden activations. This view permits a control-theoretic treatment of text generation in latent space, in which we propose Linear Semantic Control (LiSeCo), a lightweight, gradient-free intervention that dynamically steers trajectories away from regions corresponding to undesired meanings. In particular, we propose to directly intervene, in an online fashion, the activations of the token that is being generated in embedding space. Crucially, LiSeCo does not simply steer activations towards a desirable region. Instead, it relies on classical techniques from control theory to precisely control activations in a context-dependent way, and guarantees that they are brought into a specific pre-defined region of embedding space that corresponds to allowed semantics. The intervention is computed in closed form according to an optimal controller formulation, minimally impacting generation time. This control of the activations in embedding space allows for fine-grained steering of attributes of the generated sequence. We demonstrate that our approach is effective on different tasks -- toxicity, sentiment, and language (English/Spanish) steering -- while maintaining text quality.

AI.title_translation: LiSeCo：语言生成的线性语义控制
AI.tldr: LiSeCo 是一种高效的无梯度方法，利用控制理论在潜在空间对 LLM 生成进行动态语义干预，确保输出符合预期。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型控制方法往往计算成本高昂或缺乏性能保证，需要一种高效、可控且具备数学保障的机制来引导语言生成。
AI.method: 提出线性语义控制（LiSeCo），在生成过程中通过闭式最优控制器对嵌入空间的激活值进行动态、在线的干预，将轨迹引导至符合预定义的语义区域。
AI.result: 实验证明 LiSeCo 在毒性控制、情感控制以及多语言（英语/西班牙语）转向任务中表现有效，且对生成速度影响极小，同时维持了良好的文本质量。
AI.conclusion: LiSeCo 提供了一种轻量级、无需梯度且具备控制理论保证的文本生成控制方法，在保持文本质量的同时有效实现了对生成内容的语义干预。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在关键应用中的普及凸显了对计算高效且具有性能保证的受控文本生成方法的需求。为了满足这一需求，我们利用了 LLM 潜在空间中线性表示概念语义的通用模型。特别是，我们认为自然语言生成在这一连续语义空间中描绘了一条轨迹，由语言模型的隐藏激活值实现。这一观点允许对潜在空间中的文本生成进行控制理论处理，为此我们提出了线性语义控制（LiSeCo），这是一种轻量级的、无梯度的干预措施，可以动态地将轨迹引导远离对应于不需要含义的区域。具体而言，我们建议在嵌入空间中以在线方式直接干预正在生成的标记的激活值。至关重要的是，LiSeCo 不仅仅是将激活值引导向理想区域，而是依赖经典控制理论技术，以依赖于上下文的方式精确控制激活值，并保证它们被带入嵌入空间中对应于允许语义的特定预定义区域。该干预根据最优控制器公式以闭式计算，对生成时间的影响最小。这种对嵌入空间激活值的控制允许对生成序列的属性进行细粒度的引导。我们证明了我们的方法在不同任务（毒性、情感和语言（英语/西班牙语）引导）上是有效的，同时保持了文本质量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LiSeCo，一种利用线性语义表示和控制理论对大语言模型进行轻量级、无梯度干预的方法，通过在嵌入空间对激活值进行在线动态调整，实现对生成文本语义的精确控制。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 潜在空间, 控制理论, 语义控制, 文本生成
AI.comments: LiSeCo 的创新之处在于将经典控制理论引入大语言模型的潜在空间干预中，通过封闭式解实现高效且可控的文本生成，无需昂贵的梯度计算或微调。其局限性可能在于对“语义空间”线性假设的依赖程度，以及在极度复杂语义任务中的表现。

title: Towards Evaluating the Robustness of Visual State Space Models
comments: Accepted at The 5th Workshop of Adversarial Machine Learning on Computer Vision (CVPRW 2025)
summary: Vision State Space Models (VSSMs), a novel architecture that combines the strengths of recurrent neural networks and latent variable models, have demonstrated remarkable performance in visual perception tasks by efficiently capturing long-range dependencies and modeling complex visual dynamics. However, their robustness under natural and adversarial perturbations remains a critical concern. In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of VSSMs' robustness under various perturbation scenarios, including occlusions, image structure, common corruptions, and adversarial attacks, and compare their performance to well-established architectures such as transformers and Convolutional Neural Networks. Furthermore, we investigate the resilience of VSSMs to object-background compositional changes on sophisticated benchmarks designed to test model performance in complex visual scenes. We also assess their robustness on object detection and segmentation tasks using corrupted datasets that mimic real-world scenarios. To gain a deeper understanding of VSSMs' adversarial robustness, we conduct a frequency-based analysis of adversarial attacks, evaluating their performance against low-frequency and high-frequency perturbations. Our findings highlight the strengths and limitations of VSSMs in handling complex visual corruptions, offering valuable insights for future research. Our code and models will be available at https://github.com/HashmatShadab/MambaRobustness.

title: Kernel Neural Operators (KNOs) for Scalable, Memory-efficient, Geometrically-flexible Operator Learning
summary: This paper introduces the Kernel Neural Operator (KNO), a provably convergent operator-learning architecture that utilizes compositions of deep kernel-based integral operators for function-space approximation of operators (maps from functions to functions). The KNO decouples the choice of kernel from the numerical integration scheme (quadrature), thereby naturally allowing for operator learning with explicitly-chosen trainable kernels on irregular geometries. On irregular domains, this allows the KNO to utilize domain-specific quadrature rules. To help ameliorate the curse of dimensionality, we also leverage an efficient dimension-wise factorization algorithm on regular domains. More importantly, the ability to explicitly specify kernels also allows the use of highly expressive, non-stationary, neural anisotropic kernels whose parameters are computed by training neural networks. We present universal approximation theorems showing that both the continuous and fully discretized KNO are universal approximators on operator learning problems. Numerical results demonstrate that on existing benchmarks the training and test accuracy of KNOs is closely comparable to or higher than that of popular neural operators while typically using an order of magnitude fewer trainable parameters, with the more expressive kernels proving important to attaining high accuracy. KNOs thus facilitate low-memory, geometrically-flexible, deep operator learning, while retaining the implementation simplicity and transparency of traditional kernel methods from both scientific computing and machine learning.

title: ChatSOP: An SOP-Guided MCTS Planning Framework for Controllable LLM Dialogue Agents
summary: Dialogue agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show superior performance in various tasks. Despite the better user understanding and human-like responses, their **lack of controllability** remains a key challenge, often leading to unfocused conversations or task failure. To address this, we introduce Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) to regulate dialogue flow. Specifically, we propose **ChatSOP**, a novel SOP-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) planning framework designed to enhance the controllability of LLM-driven dialogue agents. To enable this, we curate a dataset comprising SOP-annotated multi-scenario dialogues, generated using a semi-automated role-playing system with GPT-4o and validated through strict manual quality control. Additionally, we propose a novel method that integrates Chain of Thought reasoning with supervised fine-tuning for SOP prediction and utilizes SOP-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search for optimal action planning during dialogues. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, such as achieving a 27.95% improvement in action accuracy compared to baseline models based on GPT-3.5 and also showing notable gains for open-source models. Dataset and codes are publicly available.

title: Solving Zebra Puzzles Using Constraint-Guided Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Prior research has enhanced the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve logic puzzles using techniques such as chain-of-thought prompting or introducing a symbolic representation. These frameworks are still usually insufficient to solve complicated logical problems, such as Zebra puzzles, due to the inherent complexity of translating natural language clues into logical statements. We introduce a multi-agent system, ZPS, that integrates LLMs with an off the shelf theorem prover. This system tackles the complex puzzle-solving task by breaking down the problem into smaller, manageable parts, generating SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories) code to solve them with a theorem prover, and using feedback between the agents to repeatedly improve their answers. We also introduce an automated grid puzzle grader to assess the correctness of our puzzle solutions and show that the automated grader is reliable by evaluating it in a user-study. Our approach shows improvement in all three LLMs we tested, with GPT-4 showing 166% improvement in the number of fully correct solutions.

AI.title_translation: 利用约束引导的多智能体系统解决Zebra谜题
AI.tldr: 通过结合LLM与SMT定理证明器，并利用多智能体反馈机制，ZPS系统显著提升了处理复杂逻辑谜题的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的思维链或符号表示方法在处理像Zebra谜题这样复杂的逻辑问题时，往往难以准确地将自然语言线索转化为逻辑语句，导致求解效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出了名为ZPS的多智能体系统。该系统将问题拆解为多个子任务，利用LLM生成SMT（可满足性模理论）代码，交由现成的定理证明器求解，并引入智能体间的反馈循环机制不断优化结果；同时开发了自动网格谜题评分器进行验证。
AI.result: 在测试的三种LLM上均取得了性能提升，其中GPT-4的完全正确解数量提升了166%。此外，通过用户研究验证了自动网格谜题评分器的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: ZPS系统证明了将LLM与符号化推理工具结合，并通过多智能体反馈机制，能显著提升处理复杂逻辑谜题的准确性。
AI.translation: 先前的研究通过思维链提示或引入符号表示等技术，增强了大语言模型（LLM）解决逻辑谜题的能力。然而，由于将自然语言线索转化为逻辑陈述的固有复杂性，这些框架通常不足以解决像Zebra谜题这类复杂的逻辑问题。我们引入了一个名为ZPS的多智能体系统，它将LLM与现成的定理证明器集成在一起。该系统通过将问题分解为更小、更易于管理的部分，生成用于定理证明器求解的SMT（可满足性模理论）代码，并利用智能体之间的反馈来反复改进答案，从而攻克这一复杂的谜题求解任务。我们还引入了一个自动网格谜题评分器来评估我们谜题解决方案的正确性，并通过用户研究证明了该自动评分器的可靠性。我们的方法在所测试的所有三种LLM上都显示出改进，其中GPT-4在完全正确解决方案的数量上提高了166%。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为ZPS的多智能体系统，旨在解决LLM在处理复杂Zebra逻辑谜题时的局限性。通过将问题分解、利用LLM生成SMT代码并结合定理证明器进行求解，配合智能体间的反馈优化机制，该系统显著提高了逻辑推理的准确性。
AI.keywords: Zebra谜题, 大语言模型, 多智能体系统, SMT定理证明器, 逻辑推理
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地结合了LLM的自然语言处理能力与传统定理证明器（SMT）的严谨逻辑推理能力，通过多智能体协作和反馈机制解决了LLM在处理复杂逻辑谜题时的短板。其局限性在于对特定格式（如Zebra谜题）的依赖，以及对外部定理证明器的依赖。

title: CounterFace: A Synthetic Face Dataset for Fine-Grained Counterfactual Evaluation of Face Recognition Systems
comments: Code available at https://github.com/Guruprasad68/counterface_facct2026. Dataset available for non-commercial research upon request
summary:
Face recognition (FR) systems are widely deployed in critical applications, making their reliability and robustness across diverse populations and conditions essential. Standard evaluation of FR systems typically relies on datasets such as LFW to estimate average recognition accuracy. Some benchmarks also capture coarse-grained intra-identity variations such as aging, pose, and lighting. However, human faces undergo more fine-grained changes, including appearance changes such as hairstyles and makeup, that are underrepresented in existing benchmarks. Counterfactual evaluation provides a method to assess FR robustness under such fine-grained variations. Existing counterfactual face datasets synthesized with image generators, however, are limited in attribute coverage due to the use of humans for verification in the pipeline.
  We propose CounterFace, a new counterfactual evaluation dataset comprising 20 facial attributes and 8 demographic factors, exceeding prior synthetic face datasets by 14 attributes and 2 demographics. The dataset is generated using a fully automated pipeline based on off-the-shelf image generators with custom verifiers, removing human need for verification. CounterFace contains 11,821 counterfactual face pairs, and a post-hoc user study confirms the faithfulness of the generated counterfactuals. We evaluate two commercial and four open-source FR systems (AWS Rekognition, Face++, AdaFace, MagFace, ArcFace, FaceNet) across 160 attribute-demographic combinations. Our dataset helps in the isolation of precise failure modes for individual systems unlike standard evaluation benchmarks. Results indicate that the performance degradation varies across attributes and demographics for all six systems and occluding attributes (e.g., facemask and facial hair) universally degrade performance.
comment: Code available at https://github.com/Guruprasad68/counterface_facct2026. Dataset available for non-commercial research upon request

title: Explaining a probabilistic prediction on the simplex with Shapley compositions
summary: Originating in game theory, Shapley values are widely used for explaining a machine learning model's prediction by quantifying the contribution of each feature's value to the prediction. This requires a scalar prediction as in binary classification, whereas a multiclass probabilistic prediction is a discrete probability distribution, living on a multidimensional simplex. In such a multiclass setting the Shapley values are typically computed separately on each class in a one-vs-rest manner, ignoring the compositional nature of the output distribution. In this paper, we introduce Shapley compositions as a well-founded way to properly explain a multiclass probabilistic prediction, using the Aitchison geometry from compositional data analysis. We prove that the Shapley composition is the unique quantity satisfying linearity, symmetry and efficiency on the Aitchison simplex, extending the corresponding axiomatic properties of the standard Shapley value. We demonstrate this proper multiclass treatment in a range of scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 利用Shapley组合解释单纯形上的概率预测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Aitchison几何的Shapley组合方法，为多分类概率预测提供了更严谨、符合组合特性的解释框架。
AI.motivation: 传统的Shapley值主要针对标量预测，在处理多分类概率预测时，通常采用“一对多”方式，忽略了概率分布在单纯形上的组合约束特性。
AI.method: 利用组合数据分析中的Aitchison几何，引入Shapley组合（Shapley compositions），并证明其在Aitchison单纯形上满足线性性、对称性和有效性。
AI.result: 证明了Shapley组合是Aitchison单纯形上满足特定公理化性质的唯一量，并在多个场景下验证了其处理多分类预测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Shapley组合为解释多分类概率预测提供了一种基于Aitchison几何的、具有公理化基础的严谨方法，能够有效处理概率分布的约束特性。
AI.translation: Shapley值起源于博弈论，被广泛用于通过量化每个特征值对预测的贡献来解释机器学习模型的预测。这通常要求预测结果为标量（如二分类），而多分类概率预测是一个离散的概率分布，存在于多维单纯形上。在这种多分类设置中，Shapley值通常以“一对多”的方式在每个类别上分别计算，忽略了输出分布的组合性质。在本文中，我们引入了Shapley组合，作为一种利用组合数据分析中Aitchison几何来正确解释多分类概率预测的合理方法。我们证明了Shapley组合是Aitchison单纯形上唯一满足线性性、对称性和有效性的量，扩展了标准Shapley值的相应公理化属性。我们在一系列场景中展示了这种恰当的多分类处理方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“Shapley组合”的新方法，专门用于解释多分类概率预测。该方法利用Aitchison几何原理，克服了传统方法忽略概率输出组合性质的局限性，并证明了其在数学公理上的完备性。
AI.keywords: Shapley值, 多分类预测, 组合数据分析, Aitchison几何, 模型可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文将博弈论中的Shapley值与组合数据分析中的Aitchison几何相结合，提出了一种处理多分类概率预测的新方法。其创新之处在于能够捕捉输出分布的组合性质，而非简单地进行多次二分类处理，为解释复杂模型提供了更严谨的数学框架。

title: LLMs + Persona-Plug = Personalized LLMs
summary: Personalization plays a critical role in numerous language tasks and applications, since users with the same requirements may prefer diverse outputs based on their individual interests. This has led to the development of various personalized approaches aimed at adapting large language models (LLMs) to generate customized outputs aligned with user preferences. Some of them involve fine-tuning a unique personalized LLM for each user, which is too expensive for widespread application. Alternative approaches introduce personalization information in a plug-and-play manner by retrieving the user's relevant historical texts as demonstrations. However, this retrieval-based strategy may break the continuity of the user history and fail to capture the user's overall styles and patterns, hence leading to sub-optimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose a novel personalized LLM model, PPlug. It constructs a user-specific embedding for each individual by modeling all her historical contexts through a lightweight plug-in user embedder module. By attaching this embedding to the task input, LLMs can better understand and capture user habits and preferences, thereby producing more personalized outputs without tuning their own parameters. Extensive experiments on various tasks in the language model personalization (LaMP) benchmark demonstrate that the proposed model significantly outperforms existing personalized LLM approaches.

title: SSSD: Simply-Scalable Speculative Decoding
comments: Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026, Main Conference)
summary:
Speculative Decoding has emerged as a popular technique for accelerating inference in Large Language Models. However, most existing approaches yield only modest improvements in production serving systems. Methods that achieve substantial speedups typically rely on an additional trained draft model or auxiliary model components, increasing deployment and maintenance complexity. This added complexity reduces flexibility, particularly when serving workloads shift to tasks, domains, or languages that are not well represented in the draft model's training data.
  We introduce Simply-Scalable Speculative Decoding (SSSD), a training-free method that combines lightweight n-gram matching with hardware-aware speculation. Relative to standard autoregressive decoding, SSSD reduces latency by up to 2.9x. It achieves performance on par with leading training-based approaches across a broad range of benchmarks, while requiring substantially lower adoption effort--no data preparation, training or tuning are needed--and exhibiting superior robustness under language and domain shift, as well as in long-context settings.

title: SpecPCM: A Low-power PCM-based In-Memory Computing Accelerator for Full-stack Mass Spectrometry Analysis
summary: Mass spectrometry (MS) is essential for proteomics and metabolomics but faces impending challenges in efficiently processing the vast volumes of data. This paper introduces SpecPCM, an in-memory computing (IMC) accelerator designed to achieve substantial improvements in energy and delay efficiency for both MS spectral clustering and database (DB) search. SpecPCM employs analog processing with low-voltage swing and utilizes recently introduced phase change memory (PCM) devices based on superlattice materials, optimized for low-voltage and low-power programming. Our approach integrates contributions across multiple levels: application, algorithm, circuit, device, and instruction sets. We leverage a robust hyperdimensional computing (HD) algorithm with a novel dimension-packing method and develop specialized hardware for the end-to-end MS pipeline to overcome the non-ideal behavior of PCM devices. We further optimize multi-level PCM devices for different tasks by using different materials. We also perform a comprehensive design exploration to improve energy and delay efficiency while maintaining accuracy, exploring various combinations of hardware and software parameters controlled by the instruction set architecture (ISA). SpecPCM, with up to three bits per cell, achieves speedups of up to 82x and 143x for MS clustering and DB search tasks, respectively, along with a four-orders-of-magnitude improvement in energy efficiency compared with state-of-the-art CPU/GPU tools.

AI.title_translation: SpecPCM：一种用于全栈质谱分析的低功耗PCM存内计算加速器
AI.tldr: SpecPCM通过利用新型PCM器件和超大规模计算算法，在质谱分析任务中实现了高达百倍级的性能提升和万倍级的能效优化。
AI.motivation: 质谱分析在大规模蛋白质组学和代谢组学研究中面临严峻的数据处理效率挑战，传统CPU/GPU方案在能耗和处理延迟上难以满足需求。
AI.method: 采用基于超晶格材料的PCM器件进行模拟存内计算；结合超大规模计算（HD）算法及创新的维度打包方法；设计专用硬件流水线和指令集架构（ISA）进行端到端优化，并针对不同任务对PCM器件进行多级材料优化。
AI.result: SpecPCM支持每个单元存储高达3位数据，在质谱聚类和数据库搜索任务中分别实现了最高82倍和143倍的加速，能效比提升了四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: SpecPCM通过跨层级优化，在质谱分析任务中实现了显著的性能提升和能效跨越，证明了基于PCM的存内计算技术在处理大规模生物数据方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 质谱（MS）对于蛋白质组学和代谢组学至关重要，但目前在高效处理海量数据方面面临严峻挑战。本文介绍了SpecPCM，这是一款存内计算（IMC）加速器，旨在显著提高MS谱聚类和数据库（DB）搜索的能量效率和处理延迟。SpecPCM采用低电压摆幅的模拟处理，并利用近期推出的基于超晶格材料的相变存储器（PCM）器件，这些器件针对低电压和低功耗编程进行了优化。我们的方法整合了应用、算法、电路、器件和指令集等多个层面的贡献。我们利用一种稳健的超大规模计算（HD）算法，配合创新的维度打包方法，并开发了针对端到端MS流水线的专用硬件，以克服PCM器件的非理想行为。我们还通过使用不同材料针对不同任务优化了多级PCM器件。此外，我们进行了全面的设计探索，在保持准确性的同时提高能量和延迟效率，并通过指令集架构（ISA）控制各种硬件和软件参数的组合。SpecPCM每个单元支持高达3位存储，在MS聚类和数据库搜索任务中分别实现了最高82倍和143倍的加速，与最先进的CPU/GPU工具相比，能效提升了四个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SpecPCM，一种专为质谱分析设计的低功耗存内计算加速器。该方案结合了新型超晶格PCM器件与超大规模计算算法，通过跨应用、算法、电路及指令集的协同设计，显著改善了质谱数据处理的能效与延迟。
AI.keywords: 质谱分析, 存内计算, 相变存储器, 超大规模计算, 硬件加速器
AI.comments: 该论文通过跨层级（从器件到应用）的协同设计，成功解决了质谱分析中大数据处理的能效瓶颈。其创新点在于将超大规模计算（HD）与新型超晶格PCM器件结合，在硬件层面实现了高效的存内计算。该研究展示了专用硬件加速器在特定生物信息学任务中的巨大潜力。

title: LaVIDE: Language-Prompted Satellite Change Detection via Map-Image Alignment
summary: Remote sensing change detection based on a map reference and an up-to-date image boosts timely observation of the Earth's surface when earlier images are lacking for comparison. However, the semantic gap between high-level map categories and low-level image details hinders the extraction of homogeneous features for robust temporal association in change detection. Unlike conventional approaches that either compare pixel-level visual similarity or propagate segmentation errors, \textcolor{black}{we propose a novel framework, \underline{La}nguage-\underline{VI}sion \underline{D}iscriminator for d\underline{E}tecting changes, LaVIDE}, which bridges the semantic gap between high-level map categories and low-level image details using language as an intermediary. Specifically, we introduce {\it restricted prompt learning} to generate context-aware textual prompts that align map semantics with image content, and an {\it object-aware embedding enhancement} strategy to integrate object-level attributes (e.g., shape, boundary) into map representations. These components enable robust cross-modal alignment within a unified language-vision feature space. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks, DynamicEarthNet, HRSCD, BANDON, and SECOND, demonstrate that LaVIDE outperforms state-of-the-art methods by significant margins, achieving $18.4\%$ and $5.2\%$ improvements in IoU on multi-class and single-class change detection tasks, respectively. Our framework not only advances the accuracy of map-image change detection but also provides a practical solution for rapid map updating with minimal human intervention, promising broad impacts in urban planning, disaster assessment, and ecological conservation. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/ShuGuoJ/LAVIDE.git.

AI.title_translation: LaVIDE：基于地图-影像对齐的语言提示卫星变化检测
AI.tldr: LaVIDE 通过语言提示技术弥合了地图语义与影像细节之间的鸿沟，实现了更精准的卫星遥感变化检测。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏早期遥感影像进行对比时，利用地图与最新影像进行变化检测具有重要意义。然而，高层地图类别与底层影像细节之间存在显著的“语义鸿沟”，导致传统方法在特征提取和跨模态关联上表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出了 LaVIDE 框架，核心包含：1. 受限提示学习（restricted prompt learning），用于生成上下文感知的文本提示以对齐地图语义与影像内容；2. 对象感知嵌入增强（object-aware embedding enhancement），将形状和边界等对象级属性整合到地图表示中，从而在统一的视觉-语言特征空间内实现鲁棒的跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在 DynamicEarthNet、HRSCD、BANDON 和 SECOND 四个基准测试中，LaVIDE 表现优于当前最先进的方法，多类变化检测任务的 IoU 提升了 18.4%，单类变化检测任务的 IoU 提升了 5.2%。
AI.conclusion: LaVIDE 框架通过语言引导实现了地图与遥感影像的有效语义对齐，显著提升了多类和单类变化检测的精度，为快速地图更新提供了一种高效、鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.translation: 基于地图参考和最新影像的遥感变化检测，在缺乏早期影像进行对比时，能够有效提升对地球表面的实时观测能力。然而，高层地图类别与底层影像细节之间的语义鸿沟，阻碍了变化检测中鲁棒时间关联所需同质特征的提取。与传统方法（要么比较像素级视觉相似度，要么传播分割误差）不同，我们提出了一个新的框架——LaVIDE（用于检测变化的语言-视觉判别器），利用语言作为中介来弥合高层地图类别与底层影像细节之间的语义鸿沟。具体而言，我们引入了“受限提示学习”来生成上下文感知的文本提示，以对齐地图语义与影像内容；并引入了“对象感知嵌入增强”策略，将对象级属性（如形状、边界）整合到地图表示中。这些组件在统一的语言-视觉特征空间内实现了鲁棒的跨模态对齐。在 DynamicEarthNet、HRSCD、BANDON 和 SECOND 四个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，LaVIDE 的表现显著优于最先进的方法，在多类和单类变化检测任务上分别实现了 18.4% 和 5.2% 的 IoU 提升。我们的框架不仅提高了地图-影像变化检测的准确性，还为以最少的人工干预进行快速地图更新提供了实用的解决方案，在城市规划、灾害评估和生态保护方面具有广泛的影响。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LaVIDE 框架，旨在解决基于地图与影像进行遥感变化检测时存在的语义鸿沟问题。通过引入受限提示学习和对象感知嵌入增强，该方法利用语言作为中介，有效对齐了高层地图语义与底层影像细节，实现了更鲁棒的跨模态特征提取，并在多项任务中显著提升了检测精度。
AI.keywords: 变化检测, 语言提示, 地图影像对齐, 遥感, 语义鸿沟
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入语言作为桥梁，巧妙地解决了地图语义与遥感影像特征之间的语义鸿沟问题。创新之处在于利用受限提示学习和对象感知嵌入增强，实现了多模态特征的有效对齐，在多个基准测试中表现出色，具有很高的实用价值和应用前景。

title: Local Clustering on Complex Graphs and Complex Hypergraphs
summary: Local/seeded clustering aims to find a compact cluster near the given starting instances. While most existing studies on graph clustering assume a discrete graph setting (i.e., unweighted, undirected graphs without self-loops), real-world graphs can be more complex. In this paper, we extend the classic non-approximating Andersen-Chung-Lang (ACL) clustering algorithm beyond discrete graphs and generalize its quadratic optimality to a wider range of complex graphs, including weighted, directed, and self-looped graphs and hypergraphs with edge-dependent vertex weights. Specifically, by leveraging PageRank, we propose two algorithms: GeneralACL for graphs and HyperACL for hypergraphs. We prove that, under two mild conditions, both algorithms can identify a quadratically optimal cluster in terms of conductance. Additionally, we provide experiments to validate our theoretical findings. Our code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/HyperACL.

title: Learning Randomized Reductions
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026 (Spotlight). 9 pages main text + appendix
summary: Randomized self-reductions (RSRs) express $f(x)$ using $f$ evaluated at random correlated points, enabling self-correcting programs, instance-hiding protocols, and applications in complexity theory and cryptography. Yet discovering RSRs has required manual expert derivation for over 40 years, limiting their practical use. We present Bitween for automated RSR learning. First, we formalize RSR learning with sample complexity analysis under correlated sampling. Second, we develop Vanilla Bitween, which integrates multiple backends (linear regression, genetic programming, symbolic regression, and mixed-integer programming). The linear regression backend outperforms the others, discovering RSRs for 43 of 80 functions (54%) in RSR-Bench, our benchmark suite, including the first known reduction for sigmoid. Third, we introduce Agentic Bitween, a neuro-symbolic approach where LLM agents propose novel query functions beyond the fixed set ($x+r$, $x-r$, $x \cdot r$, $x$, $r$) in prior work. Agentic Bitween discovers RSRs for 64 of 80 functions (80%), outperforming pure neural baselines in both RSR discovery and verification accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 学习随机归约
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Bitween的自动化框架，通过结合符号回归和LLM智能体，成功实现了随机自归约（RSR）的自动发现，显著提升了该领域的研究效率。
AI.motivation: 随机自归约（RSR）在复杂性理论和密码学中至关重要，但过去40年来一直依赖人工手动推导，极大地限制了其应用范围和效率，需要一种自动化的发现方法。
AI.method: 1. 形式化RSR学习并进行样本复杂性分析；2. 开发Vanilla Bitween框架，集成线性回归、遗传编程等后端；3. 提出Agentic Bitween，利用LLM智能体探索更广泛的查询函数空间。
AI.result: Vanilla Bitween在80个函数中成功为43个发现了RSR；Agentic Bitween进一步提升性能，成功为64个函数（80%）发现了RSR，并超越了纯神经网络基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Bitween框架成功实现了RSR的自动化学习，通过结合多种回归后端和智能体方法，在RSR-Bench基准测试中取得了显著成果，证明了自动化发现复杂数学归约的可行性。
AI.translation: 随机自归约（RSR）利用在随机相关点上评估的函数值来表达f(x)，这使得自校正程序、实例隐藏协议以及在复杂性理论和密码学中的应用成为可能。然而，40多年来发现RSR一直需要专家手动推导，限制了其实际应用。我们提出了用于自动化RSR学习的Bitween。首先，我们在相关采样下形式化了RSR学习并进行了样本复杂性分析。其次，我们开发了Vanilla Bitween，它集成了多个后端（线性回归、遗传编程、符号回归和混合整数规划）。线性回归后端优于其他方法，在我们的基准套件RSR-Bench中的80个函数中为43个（54%）发现了RSR，包括首次发现的sigmoid归约。第三，我们引入了Agentic Bitween，这是一种神经符号方法，其中LLM智能体提出了超越先前工作中固定集合（x+r, x-r, x*r, x, r）的新颖查询函数。Agentic Bitween为80个函数中的64个（80%）发现了RSR，在RSR发现和验证准确性方面均优于纯神经基线。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Bitween框架，旨在实现随机自归约（RSR）的自动化发现。通过形式化定义和结合多种符号回归后端，该方法不仅能自动化生成RSR，还通过引入LLM智能体扩展了搜索空间，显著提升了在基准测试中的发现成功率。
AI.keywords: 随机自归约, 自动化学习, 神经符号方法, 智能体, 复杂性理论
AI.comments: 该研究填补了随机自归约（RSR）长期依赖人工推导的空白，通过自动化方法显著提高了RSR的发现效率。其创新点在于将传统符号回归方法与大模型智能体（Agentic）相结合，不仅验证了自动化发现的可行性，还成功发现了如sigmoid函数等此前未知的归约方式，具有重要的理论与实际应用价值。

title: Scalable Event Cloud Network for Event-based Classification
summary: Event cameras are biologically inspired sensors garnering significant attention from both industry and academia. Mainstream methods favor frame and voxel representations, which reach a satisfactory performance while introducing time-consuming transformations, bulky models, and sacrificing fine-grained temporal information. Alternatively, Point Cloud representation demonstrates promise in addressing the mentioned weaknesses, but it has limited scalability in abstracting features of higher spatial resolution and longer temporal sequence events. In this paper, we propose a Scalable Network named SECNet to leverage Event Cloud representation. SECNet integrates polarity at the structural level by innovating the Event-based Group and Sampling module rather than only at the input level. To accommodate the surge in the number of events, SECNet embraces feature extraction in the frequency domain via the Fourier transform.This approach not only substantially extinguishes the explosion of Multiply Accumulate Operations but also effectively abstracts spatio-temporal features. We conducted extensive experiments on \textbf{ten} event-based datasets, and substantiate the scalability, effectiveness, and efficiency of SECNet. Our code will be available at: https://github.com/rhwxmx/SECNet_ICML.

title: Fides: Secure and Scalable Asynchronous DAG Consensus via Trusted Components
summary:
DAG-based BFT consensus has attracted growing interest in distributed data management systems for consistent replication in untrusted settings due to its high throughput and resilience to asynchrony. However, existing protocols still suffer from high communication overhead and long commit latency. In parallel, introducing minimal hardware trust has proven effective in reducing the complexity of BFT consensus.
  Inspired by these works, we present Fides, an asynchronous DAG-based BFT consensus protocol that, to our knowledge, is among the first to leverage TEEs to enhance both scalability and efficiency. Fides tolerates a minority of Byzantine replicas and achieves $O(κn^2 + n^3)$ metadata communication complexity through a customized TEE-assisted Reliable Broadcast (T-RBC) primitive with linear communication complexity in one-step broadcast. Building on T-RBC, Fides redefines the DAG construction rules by reducing the reference requirement from $2f+1$ to $f+1$ between consecutive vertices. This new structure weakens DAG connectivity and invalidates traditional commit rules, so we formally abstract the problem and derive new theoretical bounds of liveness. We further propose a four-round commit rule that achieves the theoretically minimal commit latency. Besides, we design two additional primitives, T-RoundCert and T-Coin, to efficiently certify DAG references and replace the costly cryptographic common coin used in prior protocols. Comprehensive evaluations on geo-distributed and local testbeds show that Fides substantially outperforms state-of-the-art protocols, including Tusk, Bullshark, Mysticeti, RCC, Damysus, Achilles and HybridSet, achieving lower latency and higher throughput while preserving strong safety and liveness guarantees.

title: Geometry-Preserving Encoder/Decoder in Latent Generative Models
summary: Generative modeling aims to generate new data samples that resemble a given dataset. When using diffusion models for this task, one of the main challenges is solving the problem in the input space, which tends to be very high-dimensional. To address this, recent approaches solve diffusion models in the latent space through an encoder that maps from the data space to a lower-dimensional latent space, improving training efficiency and achieving state-of-the-art results. The variational autoencoder (VAE) is the most commonly used encoder/decoder framework in this domain, known for its ability to learn latent representations and generate data samples. In this paper, we introduce a novel encoder/decoder framework with theoretical properties distinct from those of the VAE, specifically designed to preserve the geometric structure of the data distribution. We demonstrate the significant advantages of this geometry-preserving encoder in the training process of both the encoder and decoder. Additionally, we provide theoretical results proving convergence of the training process, including convergence guarantees for encoder training, and results showing faster convergence of decoder training when using the geometry-preserving encoder.

title: UEFI Memory Forensics: A Framework for UEFI Threat Analysis
summary: Modern computing systems rely on the Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI), which has replaced the legacy Basic Input/Output System (BIOS) as the firmware standard for the modern boot process. Although the UEFI represents a significant advancement in system firmware, it is increasingly targeted by threat actors seeking to exploit its execution environment and take advantage of its persistence mechanisms. While some security-related analysis of UEFI components has been performed--primarily via debugging and runtime behavior testing--to the best of our knowledge, no prior study has specifically addressed the capturing and analysis of volatile UEFI runtime memory to detect malicious exploitation during the pre-OS phase. This gap in UEFI forensic tools limits the ability to conduct in-depth security analysis in pre-OS environments. Such a gap is particularly surprising, given that memory forensics is widely regarded as foundational to modern incident response, as reflected by the popularity of above-OS memory analysis frameworks, such as Rekall, Volatility, and MemProcFS. To address the lack of below-OS memory forensics, we introduce a framework for UEFI memory forensics. The proposed framework consists of two components: UEFIMemDump, a memory acquisition tool, and UEFIDumpAnalysis, an extendable collection of analysis modules capable of detecting malicious activities such as function pointer hooking, inline hooking, malicious image loading, and gadget-based control-flow manipulation. Our proof-of-concept implementation demonstrates the framework's ability to detect modern UEFI threats, such as Thunderstrike, CosmicStrand, and Glupteba bootkits. By providing an open-source solution, our work enables researchers and practitioners to investigate firmware-level threats, develop additional analysis modules, and advance overall below-OS security through UEFI memory analysis.

title: Robust-LLaVA: On the Effectiveness of Large-Scale Robust Image Encoders for Multi-modal Large Language Models
comments: Accepted at Trustworthy FMs Workshop Trust Before Use: Building Foundation Models that You Can Trust (ICCVW) 2025
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in vision-language tasks but remain vulnerable to visual adversarial perturbations that can induce hallucinations, manipulate responses, or bypass safety mechanisms. Existing methods seek to mitigate these risks by applying constrained adversarial fine-tuning to CLIP vision encoders on ImageNet-scale data, ensuring their generalization ability is preserved. However, this limited adversarial training restricts robustness and broader generalization. In this work, we explore an alternative approach of leveraging existing vision classification models that have been adversarially pre-trained on large-scale data. Our analysis reveals two principal contributions: (1) the extensive scale and diversity of adversarial pre-training enables these models to demonstrate superior robustness against diverse adversarial threats, ranging from imperceptible perturbations to advanced jailbreaking attempts, without requiring additional adversarial training, and (2) end-to-end MLLM integration with these robust models facilitates enhanced adaptation of language components to robust visual features, outperforming existing plug-and-play methodologies on complex reasoning tasks. Through systematic evaluation across visual question-answering, image captioning, and jail-break attacks, we demonstrate that MLLMs trained with these robust models achieve superior adversarial robustness while maintaining favorable clean performance. Our framework achieves 2x and 1.5x average robustness gains in captioning and VQA tasks, respectively, and delivers over 10% improvement against jailbreak attacks. Code and pretrained models will be available at https://github.com/HashmatShadab/Robust-LLaVA.

title: Expected Return Symmetries
summary: Symmetry is an important inductive bias that can improve model robustness and generalization across many deep learning domains. In multi-agent settings, a priori known symmetries have been shown to address a fundamental coordination failure mode known as mutually incompatible symmetry breaking; e.g. in a game where two independent agents can choose to move "left'' or "right'', and where a reward of +1 or -1 is received when the agents choose the same action or different actions, respectively. However, the efficient and automatic discovery of environment symmetries, in particular for decentralized partially observable Markov decision processes, remains an open problem. Furthermore, environmental symmetry breaking constitutes only one type of coordination failure, which motivates the search for a more accessible and broader symmetry class. In this paper, we introduce such a broader group of previously unexplored symmetries, which we call expected return symmetries, which contains environment symmetries as a subgroup. We show that agents trained to be compatible under the group of expected return symmetries achieve better zero-shot coordination results than those using environment symmetries. As an additional benefit, our method makes minimal a priori assumptions about the structure of their environment and does not require access to ground truth symmetries.

title: Parametric Reduced Order Models for the Generalized Kuramoto--Sivashinsky Equations
summary: The paper studies parametric Reduced Order Models (ROMs) for the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) and generalized Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (gKS) equations. We consider several POD and POD-DEIM projection ROMs with various strategies for parameter sampling and snapshot collection. The aim is to identify an approach for constructing a ROM that is efficient across a range of parameters, encompassing several regimes exhibited by the KS and gKS solutions: weakly chaotic, transitional, and quasi-periodic dynamics. We describe such an approach and demonstrate that it is essential to develop ROMs that adequately represent the short-time transient behavior of the gKS model.

title: Enhancing Hallucination Detection through Noise Injection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to generating plausible yet incorrect responses, known as hallucinations. Effectively detecting hallucinations is therefore crucial for the safe deployment of LLMs. Recent research has linked hallucinations to model uncertainty, suggesting that hallucinations can be detected by measuring dispersion over answer distributions obtained from multiple samples drawn from a model. While drawing from the distribution over tokens defined by the model is a natural way to obtain samples, in this work, we argue that it is suboptimal for the purpose of detecting hallucinations. We show that detection can be improved significantly by taking into account model uncertainty in the Bayesian sense. To this end, we propose a very simple, training-free approach based on perturbing an appropriate subset of model parameters, or equivalently hidden unit activations, during sampling. We demonstrate that our approach significantly improves inference-time hallucination detection over standard sampling across diverse datasets, model architectures, and uncertainty metrics.

AI.title_translation: 通过注入噪声增强幻觉检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单、无需训练的噪声注入方法，通过在采样时扰动模型参数或激活值，从贝叶斯不确定性的角度显著提升了大语言模型的推理期幻觉检测效果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型容易产生看似合理但实际上错误的“幻觉”内容，检测并消除幻觉对于安全部署LLM至关重要。虽然现有方法利用多次采样的答案分布离散度（模型不确定性）来检测幻觉，但直接从模型定义的Token分布中进行标准采样在幻觉检测上是次优的，需要从贝叶斯不确定性的角度进行改进。
AI.method: 提出了一种简单且无需训练（training-free）的方法：在采样过程中，通过对模型参数的一个适当子集进行扰动，或者等效地对隐藏单元激活（hidden unit activations）进行扰动（即注入噪声），从而在贝叶斯意义上引入并衡量模型的不确定性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与标准采样方法相比，该方法在多种不同的数据集、模型架构和不确定性度量指标下，均能显著提升推理阶段的幻觉检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过在贝叶斯视角下引入参数或激活值扰动，能够比传统的标准Token采样更有效地捕捉模型的不确定性，从而显著提升大语言模型在推理阶段的幻觉检测能力。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）容易生成看似合理但实际上不正确的回答，即幻觉。因此，有效检测幻觉对于安全部署LLM至关重要。最近的研究将幻觉与模型不确定性联系起来，表明可以通过测量从模型中抽取的多个样本的答案分布离散度来检测幻觉。虽然从模型定义的Token分布中抽取样本是一种自然的采样方式，但在本研究中，我们认为这种方法在检测幻觉方面是次优的。我们表明，通过在贝叶斯意义上考虑模型不确定性，可以显著提高检测效果。为此，我们提出了一种非常简单、无需训练的方法，该方法基于在采样过程中扰动模型参数的适当子集，或等效地扰动隐藏单元的激活。我们证明，在不同的数据集、模型架构和不确定性指标上，我们的方法比标准采样显著改善了推理阶段的幻觉检测。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）的幻觉检测问题，指出传统的基于标准Token分布采样的幻觉检测方法存在局限性。为此，作者提出了一种基于贝叶斯不确定性的噪声注入方法。该方法无需训练，通过在采样期间扰动模型的部分参数或隐藏层激活值，能够更准确地量化模型不确定性。多项实验表明，该方法在多种架构和数据集上均能显著提高幻觉检测的准确率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 幻觉检测, 噪声注入, 贝叶斯不确定性, 无需训练
AI.comments: 本论文的创新点在于将贝叶斯不确定性引入到大语言模型的采样过程中，通过极其简单的噪声注入（扰动参数或激活值）来替代传统的直接Token采样，且无需任何模型训练。其重要性在于为LLM的安全部署提供了一种低成本、易于插拔的幻觉检测方案。局限性在于，摘要中未明确如何选择“适当的参数子集”以及扰动幅度，这在实际应用中可能需要额外的超参数微调；同时，多次采样和扰动依然会带来一定的推理延迟和计算开销。

title: The memory of $ω$-regular and BC($Σ_2^0$) objectives
summary: In the context of 2-player zero-sum infinite-duration games played on (potentially infinite) graphs, the memory of an objective is the smallest integer k such that in any game won by Eve, she has a strategy with <= k states of memory. For omega-regular objectives, checking whether the memory equals a given number k was not known to be decidable. In this work, we focus on objectives in BC(Sigma0^2), i.e. recognised by a potentially infinite deterministic parity automaton. We provide a class of automata that recognise objectives with memory <= k, leading to the following results: (1) For omega-regular objectives, the memory over finite and infinite games coincides and can be computed in NP. (2) Given two objectives W1 and W2 in BC(Sigma0^2) and assuming W1 is prefix-independent, the memory of W1 U W2 is at most the product of the memories of W1 and W2. Our results also apply to chromatic memory, the variant where strategies can update their memory state only depending on which colour is seen.

AI.title_translation: $\omega$-正则与 BC($\Sigma_2^0$) 目标的记忆复杂度
AI.tldr: 本文证明了 $\omega$-正则目标的记忆复杂度计算属于 NP 类，并给出了博弈目标并集的记忆复杂度乘积上界。
AI.motivation: 在双人零和无限博弈中，检查一个 $\omega$-正则目标的记忆复杂度是否等于给定常数 $k$ 此前是否可判定尚属未知。本文旨在解决这一计算难题，并探索更广泛的 BC($\Sigma_2^0$) 目标的记忆性质。
AI.method: 作者针对由（可能无限的）确定性奇偶自动机识别的 BC($\Sigma_2^0$) 目标，设计并提供了一类能够识别“记忆复杂度 $\le k$”之目标的特殊自动机模型。
AI.result: 1. 证明了对于 $\omega$-正则目标，有限博弈与无限博弈的记忆复杂度相同，且可在 NP 内计算；\n2. 证明了若 $W_1$ 前缀无关，则 $W_1 \cup W_2$ 的记忆复杂度不大于两者记忆复杂度的乘积；\n3. 结果同样适用于着色记忆（chromatic memory）变体。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了 $\omega$-正则目标记忆复杂度的可判定性与计算复杂度问题，并为 BC($\Sigma_2^0$) 目标的并集操作提供了记忆复杂度的理论上界。
AI.translation: 在（可能无限的）图上进行的双人零和无限持续时间博弈的背景下，一个目标的记忆复杂度是最小的整数 $k$，使得在 Eve 获胜的任何博弈中，她都拥有一个记忆状态数 $\le k$ 的策略。对于 $\omega$-正则目标，检查其记忆复杂度是否等于给定数字 $k$ 之前并不知道是否是可判定的。在这项工作中，我们专注于 BC($\Sigma_2^0$) 中的目标，即由可能无限的确定性奇偶自动机识别的目标。我们提供了一类识别记忆复杂度 $\le k$ 的目标的自动机，从而得出以下结果：（1）对于 $\omega$-正则目标，有限和无限博弈上的记忆复杂度是一致的，并且可以在 NP 中计算。（2）给定 BC($\Sigma_2^0$) 中的两个目标 $W_1$ 和 $W_2$，并假设 $W_1$ 是前缀无关的，则 $W_1 \cup W_2$ 的记忆复杂度至多是 $W_1$ 和 $W_2$ 记忆复杂度的乘积。我们的结果也适用于着色记忆，即策略只能根据看到的颜色来更新其记忆状态的变体。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了双人零和无限博弈中 $\omega$-正则及 BC($\Sigma_2^0$) 目标的记忆复杂度。作者提出了一类特殊的自动机来识别记忆复杂度不超过 $k$ 的目标。基于此，文章证明了 $\omega$-正则目标的记忆复杂度在有限和无限博弈中是等价的，且其判定问题属于 NP 类。此外，还给出了在前缀无关条件下，两个目标并集的记忆复杂度上界为其各自记忆复杂度的乘积，该结论同样适用于着色记忆。
AI.keywords: 记忆复杂度, $\omega$-正则目标, 零和博弈, 奇偶自动机, 可判定性
AI.comments: 该论文解决了博弈论与自动机领域中关于 $\omega$-正则目标记忆复杂度可判定性的一个长期开放问题，将其复杂度限制在 NP 级别，具有极高的理论价值。提出的自动机构造方法和关于目标并集的记忆复杂度乘积界限也为合成复杂策略提供了实用的理论指导。

title: When and why randomised exploration works (in linear bandits)
comments: Minor corrections to formulas and text; results unchanged
summary: We provide an approach for the analysis of randomised exploration algorithms like Thompson sampling that does not rely on forced optimism or posterior inflation. With this, we demonstrate that in the $d$-dimensional linear bandit setting, when the action space is smooth and strongly convex, randomised exploration algorithms enjoy an $n$-step regret bound of the order $O(d\sqrt{n} \log(n))$. Notably, this shows for the first time that there exist non-trivial linear bandit settings where Thompson sampling can achieve optimal dimension dependence in the regret.

AI.title_translation: 随机探索何时以及为何有效（在线性多臂老虎机中）
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的分析方法，首次证明了在平滑且强凸的动作空间下，汤普森采样等随机探索算法在线性多臂老虎机中可以达到最优的维度依赖遗憾界 $O(d\sqrt{n} \log(n))$。
AI.motivation: 传统的随机探索算法（如汤普森采样）的理论分析通常需要依赖强制乐观或后验膨胀等非自然的技术手段。本文旨在提供一种不依赖这些设定的全新分析方法，以解释随机探索在线性多臂老虎机中何时以及为何有效。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需依赖强制乐观（forced optimism）或后验膨胀（posterior inflation）的随机探索算法分析新方法。并在 $d$ 维线性多臂老虎机设置中，针对平滑且强凸的动作空间，利用该方法对算法的 $n$ 步遗憾界进行了推导和分析。
AI.result: 证明了在平滑且强凸的动作空间中，随机探索算法具有 $O(d\sqrt{n} \log(n))$ 的 $n$ 步遗憾界。这是首次证明在非平凡的线性多臂老虎机设置中，汤普森采样可以实现对维度 $d$ 的最优依赖。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的分析框架成功证明了在平滑且强凸的动作空间下，随机探索算法（如汤普森采样）在线性多臂老虎机中可以实现 $O(d\sqrt{n} \log(n))$ 的最优维度依赖遗憾界。
AI.translation: 我们提供了一种分析汤普森采样（Thompson sampling）等随机探索算法的方法，该方法不依赖于强制乐观或后验膨胀。借此，我们证明了在 $d$ 维线性多臂老虎机设置中，当动作空间是平滑且强凸的时，随机探索算法享有 $O(d\sqrt{n} \log(n))$ 的 $n$ 步遗憾界。值得注意的是，这首次表明存在非平凡的线性多臂老虎机设置，在这些设置中，汤普森采样可以在遗憾中实现最优的维度依赖。
AI.summary: 本文研究了线性多臂老虎机中的随机探索算法（如汤普森采样）。作者提出了一种无需强制乐观或后验膨胀的新型分析方法。研究表明，在平滑且强凸的动作空间下，随机探索算法可以达到 $O(d\sqrt{n} \log(n))$ 的 $n$ 步遗憾界，首次证明了汤普森采样在此类非平凡设置下能实现最优的维度依赖。
AI.keywords: 随机探索, 线性多臂老虎机, 汤普森采样, 遗憾界, 强凸动作空间
AI.comments: 本论文的创新之处在于摆脱了以往分析随机探索算法（如汤普森采样）时对“强制乐观”或“后验膨胀”的依赖，提出了一种更具普适性和启发性的新分析方法。其重要性在于首次证明了在平滑且强凸的动作空间下，汤普森采样能在线性多臂老虎机中达到最优的维度依赖遗憾界。局限性在于该结论依赖于动作空间平滑且强凸的特定几何假设，在更一般的动作空间下的推广性仍有待研究。

title: From Motion Signals to Insights: A Unified Framework for Student Behavior Analysis and Feedback in Physical Education Classes
summary: Analyzing student behavior in educational scenarios is crucial for enhancing teaching quality and student engagement. Existing AI-based models often rely on classroom video footage to identify and analyze student behavior. While these video-based methods can partially capture and analyze student actions, they struggle to accurately track each student's actions in physical education classes, which take place in outdoor, open spaces with diverse activities, and are challenging to generalize to the specialized technical movements involved in these settings. Furthermore, current methods typically lack the ability to integrate specialized pedagogical knowledge, limiting their ability to provide in-depth insights into student behavior and offer feedback for optimizing instructional design. To address these limitations, we propose a unified end-to-end framework that leverages human activity recognition technologies based on motion signals, combined with advanced large language models, to conduct more detailed analyses and feedback of student behavior in physical education classes. Our framework begins with the teacher's instructional designs and the motion signals from students during physical education sessions, ultimately generating automated reports with teaching insights and suggestions for improving both learning and class instructions. This solution provides a motion signal-based approach for analyzing student behavior and optimizing instructional design tailored to physical education classes. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework can accurately identify student behaviors and produce meaningful pedagogical insights.

AI.title_translation: 从运动信号到洞察：体育课学生行为分析与反馈的统一框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个结合运动信号人体活动识别与大语言模型的端到端框架，用于准确识别体育课中的学生行为并自动生成教学改进反馈。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于视频的AI行为分析方法在户外、开放且活动多样的体育课场景中难以准确追踪每个学生的动作，且难以推广到专业的技术动作，同时缺乏整合专业教学法知识的能力，无法提供深入的行为洞察和教学优化反馈。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的端到端框架，该框架结合了基于运动信号的人体活动识别技术与先进的大语言模型。它输入教师的教学设计和学生在体育课期间的运动信号，最终自动生成包含教学洞察和改进建议的报告。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架能够准确识别学生行为，并产生具有实际教学意义的洞察与改进建议。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为体育课提供了一种基于运动信号的学生行为分析与教学设计优化解决方案，能够有效提升体育教学质量并提供有价值的教学反馈。
AI.translation: 在教育场景中分析学生行为对于提高教学质量和学生参与度至关重要。现有的基于人工智能的模型通常依赖课堂视频画面来识别和分析学生行为。虽然这些基于视频的方法可以部分捕捉和分析学生动作，但它们在体育课中难以准确追踪每个学生的动作，因为体育课在户外、开放空间进行且活动多样，而且这些方法难以推广到体育课中涉及的专业技术动作。此外，当前方法通常缺乏整合专业教学法知识的能力，从而限制了它们提供深入学生行为洞察以及为优化教学设计提供反馈的能力。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个统一的端到端框架，该框架利用基于运动信号的人体活动识别技术，结合先进的大语言模型，对体育课中的学生行为进行更详细的分析和反馈。我们的框架以教师的教学设计和学生在体育课期间的运动信号为起点，最终自动生成包含教学洞察以及改进学习和课堂教学建议的报告。该解决方案提供了一种基于运动信号的方法，用于分析学生行为并优化量身定制的体育课教学设计。实验结果表明，我们的框架能够准确识别学生行为并产生有意义的教学洞察。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统视频AI方法在户外体育课中难以精准追踪学生动作且缺乏教学反馈能力的问题，提出了一种结合运动信号人体行为识别与大语言模型的统一端到端框架。该框架通过分析学生的运动信号和教师的教学设计，能够自动生成包含教学洞察和改进建议的分析报告，从而优化体育课的教学设计。
AI.keywords: 体育教学, 行为分析, 运动信号, 人体活动识别, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将基于运动信号的人体活动识别（HAR）技术与大语言模型（LLM）相结合，克服了传统视频分析在户外体育课中易受遮挡、多目标追踪困难以及难以泛化到专业动作的局限性。通过引入大语言模型，框架能够整合专业教学法知识，将底层的运动信号转化为高层的教学洞察和改进建议。其局限性可能在于需要学生佩戴传感器设备获取运动信号，这在实际大规模教学应用中会增加设备成本和管理复杂度。

title: Hierarchical Self-Supervised Adversarial Training for Robust Vision Models in Histopathology
comments: Accepted at 28th International Conference On Medical Image Computing And Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2025)
summary: Adversarial attacks pose significant challenges for vision models in critical fields like healthcare, where reliability is essential. Although adversarial training has been well studied in natural images, its application to biomedical and microscopy data remains limited. Existing self-supervised adversarial training methods overlook the hierarchical structure of histopathology images, where patient-slide-patch relationships provide valuable discriminative signals. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Self-Supervised Adversarial Training (HSAT), which exploits these properties to craft adversarial examples using multi-level contrastive learning and integrate it into adversarial training for enhanced robustness. We evaluate HSAT on multiclass histopathology dataset OpenSRH and the results show that HSAT outperforms existing methods from both biomedical and natural image domains. HSAT enhances robustness, achieving an average gain of 54.31% in the white-box setting and reducing performance drops to 3-4% in the black-box setting, compared to 25-30% for the baseline. These results set a new benchmark for adversarial training in this domain, paving the way for more robust models. Our Code for training and evaluation is available at https://github.com/HashmatShadab/HSAT.

AI.title_translation: 组织病理学中鲁棒视觉模型的分层自监督对抗训练
AI.tldr: 本文提出 HSAT 框架，通过引入组织病理学图像的“患者-切片-图像块”分层结构进行多级对比对抗训练，显著提升了模型在白盒和黑盒攻击下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 对抗攻击对医疗等安全关键领域的视觉模型构成了严重威胁。虽然对抗训练在自然图像中已得到广泛研究，但在生物医学和显微图像中的应用仍很有限。现有的自监督对抗训练方法忽视了组织病理学图像中蕴含的“患者-切片-图像块”的分层结构关系，而这些关系能提供重要的判别信号。
AI.method: 提出分层自监督对抗训练（HSAT）。该方法利用组织病理学图像特有的“患者-切片-图像块”分层结构，通过多级对比学习（multi-level contrastive learning）来构建对抗样本，并将其整合到自监督对抗训练中，以增强模型的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多分类组织病理学数据集 OpenSRH 上的评估表明，HSAT 优于现有的生物医学和自然图像防御方法。在白盒攻击下，HSAT 实现了平均 54.31% 的鲁棒性提升；在黑盒攻击下，其性能下降仅为 3-4%（而基线方法的性能下降高达 25-30%）。
AI.conclusion: HSAT 为组织病理学领域的对抗训练树立了新的基准，为构建更具鲁棒性的医疗视觉模型铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 对抗攻击给医疗保健等关键领域的视觉模型带来了重大挑战，在这些领域中，可靠性至关重要。尽管对抗训练在自然图像中得到了深入研究，但其在生物医学和显微镜数据中的应用仍然有限。现有的自监督对抗训练方法忽略了组织病理学图像的分层结构，其中患者-切片-图像块（patient-slide-patch）的关系提供了宝贵的判别信号。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了分层自监督对抗训练（HSAT），它利用这些属性，通过多级对比学习来构建对抗样本，并将其整合到对抗训练中以增强鲁棒性。我们在多分类组织病理学数据集 OpenSRH 上评估了 HSAT，结果表明 HSAT 优于生物医学和自然图像领域的现有方法。HSAT 增强了鲁棒性，在白盒设置下实现了平均 54.31% 的提升，并将黑盒设置下的性能下降减少到 3-4%（相比之下，基线方法的下降为 25-30%）。这些结果为该领域的对抗训练树立了新的基准，为更鲁棒的模型奠定了基础。我们的训练和评估代码可在 https://github.com/HashmatShadab/HSAT 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种专门针对组织病理学图像的分层自监督对抗训练（HSAT）方法。通过利用病理图像特有的“患者-切片-图像块”分层关联进行多级对比学习，该方法能够生成高质量的对抗样本并显著提升模型的防守能力。实验表明，HSAT 在 OpenSRH 数据集上取得了突破性表现，大幅提高了模型在黑盒和白盒攻击下的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 组织病理学, 对抗训练, 自监督学习, 对比学习, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将组织病理学图像特有的“患者-切片-图像块”分层结构融入到自监督对抗训练中，解决了通用对抗训练在特定医疗领域效果受限的问题。实验结果非常亮眼，尤其是在黑盒攻击下将性能下降控制在极低水平（3-4%），具有很强的实用价值。局限性在于目前仅在 OpenSRH 数据集上进行了验证，其在其他医学图像模态（如放射学图像）上的推广性还有待观察。

title: Speculative Thinking: Enhancing Small-Model Reasoning with Large Model Guidance at Inference Time
summary: Recent advances leverage post-training to enhance model reasoning performance, which typically requires costly training pipelines and still suffers from inefficient, overly lengthy outputs. We introduce Speculative Thinking, a training-free framework that enables large reasoning models to guide smaller ones during inference at the reasoning level, distinct from speculative decoding, which operates at the token level. Our approach is based on two observations: (1) reasoning-supportive tokens such as "wait" frequently appear after structural delimiters like "\n\n", serving as signals for reflection or continuation; and (2) larger models exhibit stronger control over reflective behavior, reducing unnecessary backtracking while improving reasoning quality. By strategically delegating reflective steps to a more capable model, our method significantly boosts the reasoning accuracy of reasoning models while shortening their output. With the assistance of the 32B reasoning model, the 1.5B model's accuracy on MATH500 increases from 83.2% to 89.4%, marking a substantial improvement of 6.2%. Simultaneously, the average output length is reduced from 5439 tokens to 4583 tokens, representing a 15.7% decrease. Moreover, when applied to a non-reasoning model (Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct), our framework boosts its accuracy from 74.0% to 81.8% on the same benchmark, achieving a relative improvement of 7.8%.

AI.title_translation: 投机思维：在推理阶段利用大模型引导增强小模型的推理能力
AI.tldr: 一种无需训练的推理优化框架，利用大模型引导小模型进行高效反射，在提升推理精度的同时缩短了输出长度。
AI.motivation: 现有通过后训练提升模型推理的方法成本高昂且输出往往过于冗长，缺乏效率。
AI.method: 提出一种名为 Speculative Thinking 的训练无关框架，在推理阶段将小模型的反射步骤（如遇到结构化分隔符后的思考过程）委托给大模型处理，从而优化推理质量并减少无效输出。
AI.result: 1.5B 模型在 MATH500 上的准确率从 83.2% 提升至 89.4%，平均输出长度减少 15.7%；Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 的准确率也从 74.0% 提升至 81.8%。
AI.conclusion: Speculative Thinking 提供了一种高效的训练无关框架，通过大模型引导提升小模型的推理准确率并缩短输出长度。
AI.translation: 最近在后训练方面取得的进展增强了模型的推理性能，但这通常需要昂贵的训练流水线，且仍存在输出效率低下、过于冗长的问题。我们引入了 Speculative Thinking，这是一个无需训练的框架，它使大型推理模型能够在推理阶段在推理层面引导较小的模型，这与在标记层面操作的投机解码不同。我们的方法基于两个观察：(1) 像“wait”这样的推理支持标记经常出现在像“\n\n”这样的结构分隔符之后，作为反思或继续的信号；(2) 更大的模型对反思行为表现出更强的控制力，减少了不必要的回溯，同时提高了推理质量。通过策略性地将反思步骤委托给能力更强的模型，我们的方法显著提高了推理模型的推理准确性，同时缩短了它们的输出。在 32B 推理模型的辅助下，1.5B 模型在 MATH500 上的准确率从 83.2% 提高到 89.4%，实现了 6.2% 的大幅提升。同时，平均输出长度从 5439 个标记减少到 4583 个标记，减少了 15.7%。此外，当应用于非推理模型（Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct）时，我们的框架使其在同一基准测试上的准确率从 74.0% 提高到 81.8%，实现了 7.8% 的相对提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种名为 Speculative Thinking 的推理时训练无关框架，通过让大模型指导小模型进行反射式思考，在显著提升小模型推理准确性的同时，有效缩短了推理输出长度。
AI.keywords: Speculative Thinking, 推理优化, 大模型引导, 训练无关, 模型压缩
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的推理时引导框架，通过将反射任务委托给大模型，巧妙地解决了小模型推理能力不足和输出冗长的问题，且无需训练，具有很高的实用价值和灵活性。

title: A Linear Time Algorithm for the Maximum Overlap of Two Convex Polygons Under Translation
summary: Given two convex polygons $P$ and $Q$ with $n$ and $m$ edges, the maximum overlap problem is to find a translation of $P$ that maximizes the area of its intersection with $Q$. We give the first randomized algorithm for this problem with linear running time. Our result improves the previous two-and-a-half-decades-old algorithm by de Berg, Cheong, Devillers, van Kreveld, and Teillaud (1998), which ran in $O((n+m)\log(n+m))$ time, as well as multiple recent algorithms given for special cases of the problem.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于两个凸多边形平移最大重叠的线性时间算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个在平移下求解两个凸多边形最大重叠面积的线性时间随机算法，改进了长期以来的最优复杂度。
AI.motivation: 旨在优化并改进已有二十五年历史的 $O((n+m)\log(n+m))$ 算法，以更高效地解决两个凸多边形在平移下的最大重叠面积问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种全新的随机算法，该算法在处理两个凸多边形的平移重叠问题时，通过随机化技术实现了线性运行时间。
AI.result: 成功实现了首个针对该问题的线性时间随机算法，超越了以往所有相关算法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种针对两个凸多边形平移最大重叠问题的首个线性时间随机算法，显著提升了计算效率。
AI.translation: 给定两个分别具有 $n$ 和 $m$ 条边的凸多边形 $P$ 和 $Q$，最大重叠问题旨在找到 $P$ 的一个平移，使其与 $Q$ 的交集面积最大化。我们给出了该问题的首个具有线性运行时间的随机算法。我们的结果改进了 de Berg, Cheong, Devillers, van Kreveld 和 Teillaud (1998) 提出的已有二十五年历史的 $O((n+m)\log(n+m))$ 时间算法，以及近期针对该问题特殊情况提出的多种算法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了两个凸多边形平移下的最大重叠面积问题，提出了一种全新的随机算法，能够在线性时间内求解，打破了该领域维持了25年的最优时间复杂度记录。
AI.keywords: 凸多边形, 最大重叠, 线性时间算法, 随机算法, 计算几何
AI.comments: 该研究在计算几何领域具有重要意义，因为它打破了长期以来在该问题上 $O((n+m)\log(n+m))$ 的时间复杂度壁垒，实现了线性的时间复杂度，证明了随机化算法在处理几何优化问题上的高效性。

title: The Great Data Standoff: Researchers vs. Platforms Under the Digital Services Act
comments: Published at the 20th International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM 2026). Please cite accordingly. This research has been supported by funding from the ERC Starting Grant HUMANads (ERC-2021-StG No 101041824)
summary: To facilitate accountability and transparency, the Digital Services Act (DSA) sets up a process through which Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs) need to grant vetted researchers access to their internal data (Article 40(4)). Operationalising such access is challenging for at least two reasons. First, data access is only available for research on systemic risks affecting European citizens, a concept with high levels of legal uncertainty. Second, data access suffers from an inherent standoff problem. Researchers need to request specific data but are not in a position to know all internal data processed by VLOPs, who, in turn, expect data specificity for potential access. In light of these limitations, data access under the DSA remains a mystery. To contribute to the discussion of how Article 40 can be interpreted and applied, we provide a concrete illustration of what data access can look like in a real-world systemic risk case study. We focus on the 2024 Romanian presidential election interference incident, the first event of its kind to trigger systemic risk investigations by the European Commission. During the elections, one candidate is said to have benefited from TikTok algorithmic amplification through a complex dis- and misinformation campaign. By analysing this incident, we can comprehend election-related systemic risk to explore practical research tasks and compare necessary data with available TikTok data. In particular, we make two contributions: (i) we combine insights from law, computer science and platform governance to shed light on the complexities of studying systemic risks in the context of election interference, focusing on two relevant factors: platform manipulation and hidden advertising; and (ii) we provide practical insights into various categories of available data for the study of TikTok, based on platform documentation, data donations and the Research API.

AI.title_translation: 数字服务法案下，研究人员与平台的重大对峙
AI.tldr: 数字服务法案（DSA）旨在通过允许经过审查的研究人员访问超大规模在线平台（VLOPs）的内部数据来促进问责和透明度。然而，数据访问存在两大挑战：一是数据访问仅限于研究欧洲公民面临的系统性风险，而“系统性风险”这一概念的法律定义尚不明确；二是数据访问存在固有的对峙问题——研究人员需要具体数据但无法完全了解VLOPs处理的所有内部数据，而VLOPs则要求提供具体的数据请求。本研究通过分析2024年罗马尼亚总统选举干预事件这一具体的系统性风险案例，探讨了Article 40的实际应用和解释，重点关注平台操纵和隐藏广告，并基于平台文档、数据捐赠和研究API，提供了关于TikTok可用数据类别的实践见解，结合了法律、计算机科学和平台治理的洞见。
AI.motivation: 数字服务法案（DSA）要求超大规模在线平台（VLOPs）向经过审查的研究人员提供内部数据访问权限，以促进问责和透明度。然而，实际操作面临法律不确定性和数据访问固有的对峙问题。本研究旨在探讨DSA Article 40的解释和应用，并为应对系统性风险提供实际解决方案。
AI.method: 本研究结合了法律、计算机科学和平台治理的见解，通过分析2024年罗马尼亚总统选举干预事件这一具体的系统性风险案例，来研究系统性风险，特别是平台操纵和隐藏广告。研究人员分析了实际研究任务，并比较了所需数据与TikTok平台提供的可用数据（基于平台文档、数据捐赠和研究API）。
AI.result: 通过对罗马尼亚总统选举干预事件的案例研究，本研究揭示了在选举干预背景下研究系统性风险的复杂性，重点关注了平台操纵和隐藏广告。研究还提供了关于TikTok可用数据类别的实践见解，为理解和应用DSA Article 40提供了实际依据。
AI.conclusion: 数字服务法案（DSA）旨在通过数据访问促进研究和问责，但实际执行面临法律模糊性和数据访问对峙等挑战。通过对罗马尼亚总统选举干预事件的案例研究，本研究强调了结合多学科方法和利用现有数据资源来应对系统性风险的重要性，并为DSA Article 40的实际应用提供了指导。
AI.translation: 为了促进问责和透明度，《数字服务法案》（DSA）设立了一个流程，要求超大规模在线平台（VLOPs）向经过审查的研究人员提供其内部数据访问权限（第40条第4款）。然而，这种数据访问的实际操作面临至少两个挑战。首先，数据访问仅限于研究影响欧洲公民的系统性风险，而“系统性风险”这一概念具有高度的法律不确定性。其次，数据访问存在固有的对峙问题。研究人员需要请求特定的数据，但他们无法了解VLOPs所处理的所有内部数据，而VLOPs反过来又期望获得具体的数据请求才能允许访问。鉴于这些限制，《数字服务法案》下的数据访问仍然是一个谜。为了促进对第40条如何被解释和应用的讨论，我们通过一个真实的系统性风险案例研究，具体说明了数据访问可能是什么样子。我们关注2024年罗马尼亚总统选举干预事件，这是首个触发欧盟委员会系统性风险调查的此类事件。在选举期间，据称有一位候选人通过复杂的虚假信息宣传活动，受益于TikTok的算法放大。通过分析这一事件，我们可以理解与选举相关的系统性风险，以探索实际的研究任务，并将所需数据与TikTok可用的数据进行比较。特别是，我们做出了两项贡献：（一）我们结合了法律、计算机科学和平台治理的见解，阐明了在选举干预背景下研究系统性风险的复杂性，重点关注两个相关因素：平台操纵和隐藏广告；（二）我们基于平台文档、数据捐赠和研究API，提供了关于研究TikTok可用数据的各种类别的实践见解。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了《数字服务法案》（DSA）下研究人员访问超大规模在线平台（VLOPs）数据所面临的挑战，特别是法律不确定性和数据访问的对峙问题。通过对2024年罗马尼亚总统选举干预事件的案例研究，结合法律、计算机科学和平台治理的视角，研究人员分析了选举相关的系统性风险，重点关注平台操纵和隐藏广告。此外，研究还评估了TikTok平台可用的数据，为DSA Article 40的实际应用提供了具体的见解和实践指导。
AI.keywords: 数字服务法案, 系统性风险, 数据访问, 平台治理, 选举干预
AI.comments: 该研究通过一个具体的案例，巧妙地阐释了《数字服务法案》在实践中可能遇到的复杂性。研究方法结合了法律、计算机科学和平台治理，具有跨学科的优势。然而，研究的结论在多大程度上可以推广到其他类型的系统性风险和平台仍有待观察。此外，对“系统性风险”法律概念的深入探讨可以进一步增强研究的说服力。

title: Closing the Loop in Affect-Driven Game Adaptation: A Systematic Review
summary: Recognizing player state is only one component of affective game adaptation; inferred experience must also be translated into adaptive interventions that modify gameplay or game content. Although player experience modeling and content adaptation are established research areas, fewer studies examine how sensing, modeling, and adaptation are integrated into complete, empirically evaluated gameplay systems. This PRISMA-guided systematic review analyzes 23 empirical studies published from January 1, 2015, to December 31, 2025, that implement a complete experience-driven loop defined here as the combination of player data acquisition, player experience modeling, and adaptive game content. Complete-loop systems were relatively uncommon in the retrieved corpus, and the selected systems were predominantly oriented toward dynamic difficulty adjustment, engagement, rehabilitation, or performance-related goals. Game telemetry was the dominant input modality, while non-invasive sources with affective relevance, such as facial expression analysis and peripheral interaction data, were less common. Knowledge-based methods, including rule-based systems and heuristics, dominated both modeling and adaptation because of their interpretability and low deployment requirements, whereas machine learning approaches were less frequent and remained constrained by data availability, transparency, and runtime integration challenges. Most importantly, affective information was often used to support challenge calibration or related adaptation objectives, while stress, anxiety, horror, and related affective states were rarely addressed as explicit adaptation targets. These findings identify a gap within this review scope: affective information may enter an adaptive loop without making affective state the objective of adaptation.

AI.title_translation: 情感驱动游戏适应中的闭环实现：一项系统综述
AI.tldr: 本文综述了情感驱动游戏自适应系统，指出目前实现“感知-建模-适应”闭环的系统较少，且大多仅用于难度调整，缺乏针对特定情感状态的直接干预研究。
AI.motivation: 尽管玩家体验建模和内容适应是独立的研究热点，但缺乏关于如何将感知、建模和适应整合为完整、经实证评估的游戏系统的研究。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA指南对2015年至2025年间发表的23项实证研究进行系统性回顾，分析了包含数据采集、体验建模及内容适应的完整闭环系统。
AI.result: 研究发现闭环系统较少见，多聚焦于难度调整和参与度；主流方法为基于规则的启发式算法而非机器学习；情感信息多用于校准难度而非直接针对情感状态进行干预。
AI.conclusion: 目前情感驱动游戏适应系统的研究仍处于起步阶段，闭环系统较少。领域内主要采用基于规则的方法进行动态难度调整，而针对特定情感状态（如压力、焦虑）的系统化适应研究仍存在显著缺口。
AI.translation: 识别玩家状态仅仅是情感驱动游戏适应的一个组成部分；推断出的体验还必须转化为能够修改游戏玩法或游戏内容的适应性干预。尽管玩家体验建模和内容适应是已确立的研究领域，但很少有研究探讨如何将感知、建模和适应整合为完整的、经过实证评估的游戏系统。这篇基于PRISMA指南的系统综述分析了2015年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间发表的23项实证研究，这些研究实现了本文定义的完整体验驱动循环，即玩家数据获取、玩家体验建模和自适应游戏内容的组合。在检索到的文献中，完整循环的系统相对罕见，所选系统主要面向动态难度调整、参与度、康复或与表现相关的目标。游戏遥测是主要的输入模态，而具有情感相关性的非侵入性来源（如面部表情分析和外围交互数据）则较少见。基于知识的方法（包括基于规则的系统和启发式方法）在建模和适应中占据主导地位，因为它们具有可解释性和较低的部署要求，而机器学习方法则较少见，并受到数据可用性、透明度和运行时集成挑战的限制。最重要的是，情感信息通常用于支持挑战校准或相关的适应目标，而压力、焦虑、恐惧和相关情感状态很少被作为明确的适应目标。这些发现指出了该综述范围内的一个空白：情感信息可能进入了一个适应循环，但并没有将情感状态作为适应的目标。
AI.summary: 本文通过对23项实证研究的系统综述，探讨了情感驱动游戏适应系统的现状。研究发现，将情感感知与游戏内容自适应结合的完整闭环系统较为稀缺，且目前系统多采用规则驱动而非机器学习，且极少直接将特定情感状态作为适应目标，揭示了该领域在系统集成与情感干预深度上的发展潜力。
AI.keywords: 情感计算, 游戏自适应, 闭环系统, 玩家体验模型, 系统综述
AI.comments: 该综述揭示了情感驱动游戏适应领域的一个关键痛点：尽管“情感感知”与“内容适应”研究已趋成熟，但实现二者闭环的完整系统仍然稀缺。研究指出，目前领域内过分依赖基于规则的方法，且对复杂情感（如焦虑、恐怖）的针对性适应研究不足，为未来系统集成与情感计算的应用提供了明确的研究方向。

title: $\mathcal{H}_2$-optimal model reduction of linear quadratic-output systems by multivariate rational interpolation
summary: This paper addresses the $\mathcal{H}_2$-optimal approximation of linear dynamical systems with quadratic-output functions, also known as linear quadratic-output systems. Our major contributions are threefold. First, we derive interpolatory first-order optimality conditions for the linear quadratic-output $\mathcal{H}_2$ minimization problem. These conditions correspond to the mixed-multipoint tangential interpolation of the full-order linear- and quadratic-output transfer functions, and generalize the Meier-Luenberger optimality framework for the $\mathcal{H}_2$-optimal model reduction of linear time-invariant systems. Second, given the optimal interpolation data, we show how to enforce the interpolatory optimality conditions explicitly by Petrov-Galerkin projection of the full-order model. Third, to find the optimal interpolation data, we build on this projection framework and propose a generalization of the iterative rational Krylov algorithm for the $\mathcal{H}_2$-optimal model reduction of linear quadratic-output systems, called LQO-IRKA. Upon convergence, LQO-IRKA produces reduced linear quadratic-output systems that satisfy the interpolatory optimality conditions. The method only requires solving shifted linear systems and matrix-vector products, thus making it suitable for large-scale problems. Numerical examples are included to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: 线性二次输出系统的H2最优模型降阶与多元有理插值
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于线性二次输出系统H2最优模型降阶的新方法，通过推广迭代有理Krylov算法（IRKA）来实现，称为LQO-IRKA。该方法通过满足插值最优性条件来获得降阶模型，并适用于大规模问题。
AI.motivation: 解决线性动力系统与二次输出函数（即线性二次输出系统）的H2最优逼近问题，并推广现有的H2最优模型降阶方法。
AI.method: 推导了线性二次输出H2最小化问题的插值一阶最优性条件，该条件对应于全阶线性-和二次输出传递函数的混合多点切向插值。然后，利用Petrov-Galerkin投影显式地强制执行这些插值最优性条件。最后，提出了一种名为LQO-IRKA的算法，作为迭代有理Krylov算法（IRKA）的推广，用于求解最优插值数据，以实现H2最优模型降阶。
AI.result: 提出了满足插值最优性条件的降阶线性二次输出系统，并通过数值算例证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功地将H2最优模型降阶问题扩展到线性二次输出系统，并提出了一种新的迭代算法LQO-IRKA，该算法能够有效地获得满足最优性条件的降阶模型，并且适用于大规模问题。
AI.translation: 本文研究了具有二次输出函数的线性动力系统的$\	ext{H}_2$最优逼近，也称为线性二次输出系统。我们的主要贡献有三方面。首先，我们推导了线性二次输出$\	ext{H}_2$最小化问题的插值一阶最优性条件。这些条件对应于全阶线性和二次输出传递函数的混合多点切向插值，并且推广了用于线性时不变系统$\	ext{H}_2$最优模型降阶的Meier-Luenberger最优性框架。其次，给定最优插值数据，我们展示了如何通过全阶模型的Petrov-Galerkin投影显式地强制执行插值最优性条件。第三，为了找到最优插值数据，我们在此投影框架的基础上，提出了一种名为LQO-IRKA的算法，它是用于线性二次输出系统$\	ext{H}_2$最优模型降阶的迭代有理Krylov算法的推广。一旦收敛，LQO-IRKA就能产生满足插值最优性条件的降阶线性二次输出系统。该方法仅需要求解移位线性系统和矩阵向量乘积，因此适用于大规模问题。包含了数值算例来说明所提出方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对线性二次输出系统的H2最优模型降阶问题，提出了一种基于多元有理插值的新方法。研究推导了最优性条件，并提出了一种名为LQO-IRKA的迭代算法来寻找最优插值数据，通过Petrov-Galerkin投影获得满足最优条件的降阶模型。该方法适用于大规模问题，并通过数值算例验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: H2最优模型降阶, 线性二次输出系统, 有理插值, Krylov算法, Petrov-Galerkin投影
AI.comments: 该研究将H2最优模型降阶技术成功扩展到更广泛的线性二次输出系统，提出的LQO-IRKA算法在理论和实践上都具有重要意义。算法的迭代性质和对大规模问题的适用性是其亮点，但对于算法的收敛性和精度保证仍需进一步的理论分析。

title: TikTok Search Recommendations: Governance and Research Challenges
comments: Published at The 1st International Workshop on Computational Approaches to Content Moderation and Platform Governance (COMPASS), held at ICWSM 2025. Please cite accordingly. This research has been supported by funding from the ERC Starting Grant HUMANads (ERC-2021-StG No 101041824)
summary: Like other social media, TikTok is embracing its use as a search engine, developing search products to steer users to produce searchable content and engage in content discovery. Their recently developed product search recommendations are preformulated search queries recommended to users on videos. However, TikTok provides limited transparency about how search recommendations are generated and moderated, despite requirements under regulatory frameworks like the European Union's Digital Services Act. By suggesting that the platform simply aggregates comments and common searches linked to videos, it sidesteps responsibility and issues that arise from contextually problematic recommendations, reigniting long-standing concerns about platform liability and moderation. This position paper addresses the novelty of search recommendations on TikTok by highlighting the challenges that this feature poses for platform governance and offering a computational research agenda, drawing on preliminary qualitative analysis. It sets out the need for transparency in platform documentation, data access and research to study search recommendations.
