AI.title_translation: TikTok搜索推荐：治理与研究挑战
AI.tldr: TikTok搜索推荐功能缺乏透明度，引发了关于平台责任和内容审核的担忧，并对平台治理提出了挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着TikTok日益被用作搜索引擎，其新推出的搜索推荐功能（向用户推荐预先制定的搜索查询）引发了治理和研究方面的挑战。该功能缺乏透明度，可能导致平台规避责任，并重燃了对平台责任和内容审核的长期担忧。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种计算研究议程，并借鉴了初步的定性分析。
AI.result: TikTok搜索推荐功能带来了平台治理和研究方面的新挑战，并突显了对平台文档、数据访问和研究透明度的需求。
AI.conclusion: 该文纸提出，TikTok的搜索推荐功能带来了平台治理和研究方面的新挑战，并强调了对平台文档、数据访问和研究透明度的需求。
AI.translation: 与其他社交媒体一样，TikTok也正拥抱其作为搜索引擎的用途，开发搜索产品以引导用户生成可搜索的内容并进行内容发现。他们最近开发的产品搜索推荐是推荐给视频用户的预先制定的搜索查询。然而，尽管有欧盟《数字服务法》等监管框架的要求，TikTok在如何生成和审核搜索推荐方面提供的透明度却非常有限。通过暗示该平台只是聚合与视频相关的评论和常见搜索，它就规避了责任以及由具有上下文问题的推荐所引发的问题，重新点燃了关于平台责任和审核的长期担忧。这篇立场 paper 旨在通过强调此功能对平台治理提出的挑战，并借鉴初步的定性分析，提出一个计算研究议程，来阐述TikTok搜索推荐的新颖性。它阐述了对平台文档、数据访问和研究以研究搜索推荐的需求。
AI.summary: 这篇论文探讨了TikTok搜索推荐功能带来的治理和研究挑战。尽管TikTok被越来越多地用作搜索引擎，但其搜索推荐功能的运作方式缺乏透明度，这可能使平台规避责任，并引发对平台责任和内容审核的担忧。论文提出了一种计算研究方法，并强调了平台文档、数据访问和研究透明度的必要性。
AI.keywords: TikTok, 搜索推荐, 平台治理, 内容审核, 透明度, 研究挑战, 欧盟数字服务法
AI.comments: 该论文指出了TikTok搜索推荐功能在透明度和治理方面存在的关键问题。虽然提出了研究挑战和议程，但对具体监管框架（如欧盟《数字服务法》）的深入分析可以增强其说服力。此外，关于如何平衡用户体验和内容审核的建议可以进一步阐述。

title: SoLoPO: Unlocking Long-Context Capabilities in LLMs via Short-to-Long Preference Optimization
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Despite advances in pretraining with extended context sizes, large language models (LLMs) still face challenges in effectively utilizing real-world long-context information, primarily due to insufficient long-context alignment caused by data quality issues, training inefficiencies, and the lack of well-designed optimization objectives. To address these limitations, we propose a framework named \textbf{S}h\textbf{o}rt-to-\textbf{Lo}ng \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization (\textbf{SoLoPO}), decoupling long-context preference optimization (PO) into two components: short-context PO and short-to-long reward alignment (SoLo-RA), supported by both theoretical and empirical evidence. Specifically, short-context PO leverages preference pairs sampled from short contexts to enhance the model's contextual knowledge utilization ability. Meanwhile, SoLo-RA explicitly encourages reward score consistency for the responses when conditioned on both short and long contexts that contain identical task-relevant information. This facilitates transferring the model's ability to handle short contexts into long-context scenarios. SoLoPO is compatible with mainstream preference optimization algorithms, while substantially improving the efficiency of data construction and training processes. Experimental results show that SoLoPO enhances all these algorithms with respect to stronger length and domain generalization abilities across various long-context benchmarks, while achieving notable improvements in both computational and memory efficiency.
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026

AI.title_translation: SoLoPO：通过短到长偏好优化解锁大模型的长文本能力
AI.tldr: SoLoPO 通过利用短文本偏好数据和跨上下文的奖励一致性训练，高效提升了大模型处理长文本的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在处理长文本时存在对齐不足的问题，主要源于数据质量差、训练效率低以及缺乏有效的优化目标。
AI.method: 提出 SoLoPO 框架，包含两个核心组件：1. 短上下文偏好优化（Short-context PO），利用短上下文数据增强模型能力；2. 短到长奖励对齐（SoLo-RA），确保模型在短、长上下文下对相同任务信息的响应保持奖励分数的一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，SoLoPO 在多个长文本基准测试中显著增强了模型的长度和领域泛化能力，并大幅提升了计算和内存效率。
AI.conclusion: SoLoPO 证明了通过将长上下文偏好优化解耦为短上下文优化和短到长奖励对齐，可以有效提升大模型在长文本任务中的表现与效率。
AI.translation: 尽管预训练在扩展上下文长度方面取得了进展，但大语言模型（LLMs）在有效利用现实世界的长文本信息方面仍面临挑战，这主要是由于数据质量问题、训练效率低下以及缺乏设计良好的优化目标导致的长文本对齐不足。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一个名为“短到长偏好优化”（SoLoPO）的框架，将长文本偏好优化（PO）解耦为两个部分：短上下文 PO 和短到长奖励对齐（SoLo-RA），并提供了理论和实证支持。具体而言，短上下文 PO 利用从短上下文中采样的偏好对来增强模型利用上下文知识的能力。同时，SoLo-RA 明确鼓励模型在处理包含相同任务相关信息的短上下文和长上下文时，对响应的奖励分数保持一致。这促进了模型处理短上下文能力向长上下文场景的迁移。SoLoPO 与主流偏好优化算法兼容，同时显著提高了数据构建和训练过程的效率。实验结果表明，SoLoPO 在各种长文本基准测试中增强了所有这些算法的长度和领域泛化能力，并在计算和内存效率方面取得了显著提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 SoLoPO 框架，通过将长文本偏好优化拆分为短上下文优化和短到长奖励对齐，成功将模型处理短文本的能力迁移到长文本场景，从而解决了大模型长文本对齐的效率与效果难题。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 长文本对齐, 偏好优化, 奖励一致性, 训练效率
AI.comments: 该研究通过一种巧妙的“解耦”策略解决了长文本对齐的难题，即利用短文本的成熟能力来引导长文本的优化。这种方法不仅在理论上合理，而且在实际应用中显著提升了训练效率和泛化能力，为长文本LLM的训练提供了一种高效且通用的范式。

title: Post-Training Corrections for Improved Time-Series Forecasting
summary:
Time-series forecasting is a critical task in various business domains, but it remains inherently challenging.
  Typically, large forecasting models are trained in a single, resource-intensive run. Once training is completed, a natural question arises:~\emph{is there still potential for meaningful improvement in the model's performance?}
  Motivated by techniques from boosting, we introduce the concept of~\emph{post-training corrections}. This approach enhances a trained forecaster by sequentially applying a carefully selected set of corrections to its predictions.
  Our method offers a lightweight, model-agnostic, and scalable strategy to improve forecasting performance in practical settings.
  We provide theoretical foundations for the approach, starting with the affine correction case, and analyze the expected performance gains and computational costs in more general settings.
  Across a range of benchmark datasets, our method consistently delivers up to a $30\%$ improvement in forecasting accuracy over existing state-of-the-art models, with minimal computational overhead.

AI.title_translation: 用于改进时间序列预测的训练后修正方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种在模型训练后通过序列化修正步骤提升时间序列预测精度的方法，无需重新训练即可实现高达30%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大型时间序列预测模型训练成本高昂，作者旨在探索在模型训练完成后，是否仍有空间通过轻量级的方法进一步提升预测性能。
AI.method: 受到Boosting技术的启发，引入“训练后修正”概念，通过在已训练模型的基础上序列化地应用一组精心选择的修正策略来优化预测结果。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法在保持极低计算开销的同时，将现有最先进模型的预测准确率提升了最高30%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在模型训练完成后，通过序列化的修正步骤可以显著提升时间序列预测的准确性，且具有低计算开销和模型无关的特性。
AI.translation: 时间序列预测是各个商业领域中的一项关键任务，但它本身仍然具有挑战性。通常，大型预测模型是在一次资源密集型的运行中完成训练的。训练完成后，一个自然的问题出现了：模型的性能是否还有进一步提升的潜力？受Boosting技术的启发，我们引入了“训练后修正”的概念。该方法通过对已训练预测模型的预测结果序列化应用一组精心选择的修正，从而增强其性能。我们的方法为在实际场景中提高预测性能提供了一种轻量级、模型无关且可扩展的策略。我们为该方法提供了理论基础（从仿射修正情况开始），并分析了一般设置下的预期性能增益和计算成本。在多个基准数据集上，我们的方法在极小的计算开销下，始终能使预测准确率比现有的最先进模型提高高达30%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“训练后修正”的轻量级、模型无关策略，旨在通过在已训练的时间序列预测模型上附加序列化修正步骤，以极小的计算代价实现预测性能的显著提升。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测, 训练后修正, Boosting, 模型无关, 性能提升
AI.comments: 该论文提出的“训练后修正”概念非常具有创新性，它将提升方法（Boosting）的思想引入到时间序列预测的后处理阶段，提供了一种无需重新训练即可提升模型性能的轻量级方案，在实际工程应用中具有很高的价值和实用性。

title: Certified Neural Approximations of Nonlinear Dynamics
comments: first and second author contributed equally
summary: Neural networks hold great potential to act as approximate models of nonlinear dynamical systems, with the resulting neural approximations enabling verification and control of such systems. However, in safety-critical contexts, the use of neural approximations requires formal bounds on their closeness to the underlying system. To address this fundamental challenge, we propose a novel, adaptive, and parallelizable verification method based on certified first-order models. Our approach provides formal error bounds on the neural approximations of dynamical systems, allowing them to be safely employed as surrogates by interpreting the error bound as bounded disturbances acting on the approximated dynamics. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our method on a range of established benchmarks from the literature, showing that it significantly outperforms the state of the art. Furthermore, we show that our framework can successfully address additional scenarios previously intractable for existing methods -- neural network compression and an autoencoder-based deep learning architecture for training Koopman operators for the purpose of trajectory prediction.
comment: first and second author contributed equally

AI.title_translation: 非线性动力系统的认证神经网络近似
AI.tldr: 本文通过提供形式化误差边界，解决了神经网络在安全关键动力系统应用中缺乏可靠性验证的问题。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键系统中，神经网络作为非线性动力系统的代理模型缺乏形式化的误差保障，限制了其应用安全性。
AI.method: 提出一种基于认证一阶模型（certified first-order models）的自适应且可并行化的验证方法，将神经网络的近似误差转化为作用于动力系统的有界扰动。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在多个基准测试中显著优于现有技术，并成功解决了神经压缩和基于自编码器的Koopman算子训练等以往难以处理的场景。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种认证神经网络近似非线性动力系统的方法，通过提供形式化误差边界，使神经网络在安全关键应用中能够可靠地作为代理模型使用。
AI.translation: 神经网络在作为非线性动力系统的近似模型方面具有巨大潜力，由此产生的神经网络近似使得对此类系统的验证和控制成为可能。然而，在安全关键背景下，使用神经网络近似需要对其与底层系统的接近程度有形式化的界限。为了解决这一根本挑战，我们提出了一种基于认证一阶模型的新型、自适应且可并行化的验证方法。我们的方法为动力系统的神经网络近似提供了形式化误差界限，通过将误差界限解释为作用于近似动力系统的有界扰动，从而允许它们安全地作为代理模型使用。我们在文献中的一系列既定基准上证明了该方法的有效性和可扩展性，表明它显著优于现有技术。此外，我们证明了我们的框架可以成功处理现有方法此前难以解决的其他场景——神经网络压缩以及用于轨迹预测的Koopman算子训练的基于自编码器的深度学习架构。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种验证神经网络近似非线性动力系统的方法，通过计算形式化误差边界，将神经网络的近似误差视为系统扰动，从而确保在安全关键应用中的可靠性。该方法具有自适应和并行化特点，并在多个复杂任务中展现了优于现有技术的性能。
AI.keywords: 神经网络近似, 非线性动力系统, 形式化验证, 误差边界, 安全关键系统
AI.comments: 该研究通过将神经网络近似的误差建模为有界扰动，巧妙地连接了机器学习与控制理论，为安全关键系统中使用神经网络提供了理论保障。其创新点在于采用了自适应且可并行化的认证方法，不仅提升了验证效率，还扩展了其在模型压缩和Koopman算子学习等复杂场景下的应用。

title: Longer Context, Deeper Thinking: Uncovering the Role of Long-Context Ability in Reasoning
summary: Recent language models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the influence of long-context capacity on reasoning remains underexplored. In this work, we hypothesize that current limitations in reasoning stem, in part, from insufficient long-context capacity, motivated by empirical observations such as (1) higher context window length often leads to stronger reasoning performance, and (2) failed reasoning cases resemble failed long-context cases. To test this hypothesis, we examine whether enhancing a model's long-context ability before Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) leads to improved reasoning performance. Specifically, we compared models with identical architectures and fine-tuning data but varying levels of long-context capacity. Our results reveal a consistent trend: models with stronger long-context capacity achieve significantly higher accuracy on reasoning benchmarks after SFT. Notably, these gains persist even on tasks with short input lengths, indicating that long-context training offers generalizable benefits for reasoning performance. These findings suggest that long-context modeling is not just essential for processing lengthy inputs, but also serves as a critical foundation for reasoning. We advocate for treating long-context capacity as a first-class objective in the design of future language models.

AI.title_translation: 更长的上下文，更深的思考：揭示长上下文能力在推理中的作用
AI.tldr: 研究证明长上下文能力不仅能处理长文档，更是提升大模型推理性能的通用基石。
AI.motivation: 作者认为当前模型推理能力的瓶颈部分源于长上下文能力的不足，并基于观察到的长上下文窗口与推理性能正相关，以及推理失败案例与长上下文失败案例的相似性提出了这一假设。
AI.method: 通过对比实验，在模型架构和监督微调（SFT）数据完全一致的前提下，仅改变模型的长上下文容量，考察其对推理准确率的影响。
AI.result: 具备更强长上下文能力的模型在SFT后推理任务的准确率显著提升，且这种提升在短输入任务中同样有效，表明长上下文训练具有通用的推理性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文能力是提升语言模型推理性能的关键基础，建议在模型设计中将其作为首要目标。
AI.translation: 近期的语言模型表现出了强大的推理能力，但长上下文容量对推理的影响仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们假设当前推理能力的局限性在一定程度上源于长上下文容量的不足，这一假设基于以下实证观察：（1）更长的上下文窗口长度通常带来更强的推理性能；（2）推理失败的案例与长上下文处理失败的案例相似。为了验证这一假设，我们考察了在监督微调（SFT）之前增强模型的长上下文能力是否会提升推理性能。具体而言，我们比较了架构和微调数据相同但长上下文容量不同的模型。结果显示出一个一致的趋势：具备更强长上下文容量的模型在SFT后的推理基准测试中获得了显著更高的准确率。值得注意的是，即使在输入长度较短的任务中，这些提升依然存在，表明长上下文训练为推理性能带来了可泛化的益处。这些发现表明，长上下文建模不仅对于处理冗长输入至关重要，而且是推理的关键基础。我们主张在未来语言模型的设计中，应将长上下文能力视为首要目标。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了长上下文能力对大模型推理性能的影响。研究发现，增强模型长上下文能力可显著提升其在各类推理基准上的表现，即使在短输入任务中也能观察到这种提升，证明了长上下文建模是提升模型推理能力的基石。
AI.keywords: 长上下文能力, 推理能力, 语言模型, 监督微调, 模型架构设计
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了长上下文能力与模型推理能力之间深层的正相关关系，挑战了“长上下文仅用于处理长输入”的传统认知。其创新点在于通过受控实验证明了长上下文训练对推理能力的通用提升效果，为未来大模型架构设计提供了重要指导，即应将长上下文能力作为核心目标。

title: 100-LongBench: Are de facto Long-Context Benchmarks Literally Evaluating Long-Context Ability?
summary: Long-context capability is considered one of the most important abilities of LLMs, as a truly long context-capable LLM enables users to effortlessly process many originally exhausting tasks -- e.g., digesting a long-form document to find answers vs. directly asking an LLM about it. However, existing real-task-based long-context evaluation benchmarks have two major shortcomings. First, benchmarks like LongBench often do not provide proper metrics to separate long-context performance from the model's baseline ability, making cross-model comparison unclear. Second, such benchmarks are usually constructed with fixed input lengths, which limits their applicability across different models and fails to reveal when a model begins to break down. To address these issues, we introduce a length-controllable long-context benchmark and a novel metric that disentangles baseline knowledge from true long-context capabilities. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of our approach in effectively evaluating LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 100-LongBench：事实上的长文本基准测试真的在评估长文本能力吗？
AI.tldr: 针对现有长文本测试无法区分基础能力与长文本能力的问题，本文提出了一种长度可控的基准测试及新型评估指标，实现了对模型长文本处理能力的精准解耦评估。
AI.motivation: 现有长文本基准测试（如LongBench）存在两个主要缺陷：一是缺乏将长文本性能与基础能力区分开的指标，导致跨模型对比不明确；二是输入长度固定，无法体现模型性能的临界点。
AI.method: 提出了一种长度可控的长文本基准测试框架，并设计了一种新型指标，用于将模型的基础知识与真实的长文本处理能力进行解耦。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够更有效地评估大语言模型，并明确区分其基础能力与长文本处理能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入长度可控的基准测试和新型评估指标，能够更准确地剥离模型基础知识，从而客观评估大语言模型的长文本处理能力。
AI.translation: 长文本能力被认为是大型语言模型（LLM）最重要的能力之一，因为真正具备长文本能力的LLM能够让用户轻松处理许多原本耗时的任务——例如，阅读长文档以寻找答案，而不是直接向LLM询问。然而，现有的基于真实任务的长文本评估基准存在两个主要缺点。首先，像LongBench这样的基准测试通常不提供适当的指标来将长文本性能与模型的基础能力分离开来，这使得跨模型比较变得不明确。其次，这些基准测试通常构建有固定的输入长度，这限制了它们在不同模型间的适用性，也无法揭示模型何时开始失效。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了一个长度可控的长文本基准测试和一种新型指标，将基础知识与真实的长文本能力分离开来。实验证明了我们的方法在有效评估LLM方面的优越性。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了现有长文本基准测试的局限性，并提出了一种长度可控的评估框架及新型评估指标，旨在有效分离模型的基础能力与长文本处理能力，从而实现对LLM长文本性能的精准评估。
AI.keywords: 长文本能力, 大语言模型, 评估基准, 评估指标, 模型性能分析
AI.comments: 该研究指出了当前长文本基准测试在评估方法论上的关键漏洞，即未能区分模型的基础能力与长文本处理能力，并提出了可控长度的评估方案，对于推动大语言模型评估的科学化具有重要意义。

title: Scheduling in Queueing Systems with Uncertain and Evolving Holding Costs
summary: In content moderation for social media platforms, the cost of delaying the review of a content is proportional to its view trajectory, which fluctuates and is apriori unknown. Motivated by such uncertain and evolving holding costs, we consider a queueing model where job states evolve based on a Markov chain with state-dependent instantaneous holding costs. We demonstrate that in the presence of such uncertain and evolving holding costs, the two canonical algorithmic principles, instantaneous-cost ($cμ$-rule) and expected-remaining-cost ($cμ/θ$-rule), are suboptimal. By viewing each job as a Markovian ski-rental problem, we develop a new index-based algorithm, Opportunity-adjusted Remaining Cost (OaRC), that adjusts to the opportunity of serving jobs in the future when uncertainty partly resolves. We show that the suboptimality gap of OaRC scales as $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{N})$, where $N$ is the system size. This bound shows that OaRC achieves asymptotic optimality for overloaded systems when the system size $N$ scales to infinity. Moreover, the bound is independent of the state-space size, which is a desirable property when job states contain contextual information. We corroborate our results with an extensive simulation study based on two holding cost patterns (online ads and user-generated content) that arise in content moderation for social media platforms. Our simulations based on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that OaRC consistently outperforms existing practice, which is based on the two canonical algorithmic principles.

title: Model-Preserving Adaptive Rounding
summary: The goal of quantization is to produce a compressed model whose output distribution is as close to the original model's as possible. To do this tractably, most quantization algorithms minimize the immediate activation error of each layer as a proxy for the end-to-end error. However, this ignores the effect of future layers, making it a poor proxy. In this work, we introduce Yet Another Quantization Algorithm (YAQA), an adaptive rounding algorithm that directly considers the error at the network's output. YAQA introduces a series of theoretical results that culminate in the first end-to-end error bounds for quantization algorithms. First, we characterize the convergence time of adaptive rounding algorithms via the structure of their Hessian approximations. We then show that the end-to-end error can be bounded by the approximation's cosine similarity to the true Hessian. This admits a natural Kronecker-factored approximation with corresponding near-optimal Hessian sketches. YAQA is provably better than GPTQ/LDLQ and empirically reduces the error by $\approx 30\%$ over these methods. YAQA even achieves a lower error than quantization aware training. This translates to state of the art performance on downstream tasks, all while adding no inference overhead.

AI.title_translation: 模型保持自适应舍入
AI.tldr: YAQA通过直接优化端到端误差而非逐层误差，实现了比现有量化方法（如GPTQ）更精确的结果，且无需额外推理开销。
AI.motivation: 传统量化算法通常仅优化单层激活误差，忽略了后续层的影响，导致其作为端到端误差的代理指标效果不佳。
AI.method: 引入YAQA算法，直接优化网络输出端的误差，并利用Kronecker分解的Hessian近似和草图技术（Hessian sketches）来界定端到端误差。
AI.result: YAQA在理论上优于GPTQ/LDLQ，实验表明其误差减少了约30%，在下游任务中达到SOTA性能，且不增加推理开销。
AI.conclusion: YAQA通过直接优化输出端误差并利用Hessian近似，实现了比现有方法（如GPTQ/LDLQ）更优的量化效果，且无需推理开销。
AI.translation: 量化的目标是生成一个压缩模型，使其输出分布尽可能接近原始模型。为了可行地实现这一点，大多数量化算法将每一层的即时激活误差最小化，作为端到端误差的代理。然而，这忽略了后续层的影响，使其成为一个较差的代理。在这项工作中，我们引入了另一种量化算法（YAQA），这是一种直接考虑网络输出端误差的自适应舍入算法。YAQA引入了一系列理论结果，最终得出了量化算法的首个端到端误差界限。首先，我们通过Hessian近似的结构刻画了自适应舍入算法的收敛时间。然后，我们证明了端到端误差可以由近似值与真实Hessian的余弦相似度来界定。这允许采用自然的Kronecker分解近似以及相应的近最优Hessian草图。YAQA在理论上优于GPTQ/LDLQ，实验表明其比这些方法减少了约30%的误差。YAQA甚至实现了比量化感知训练（QAT）更低的误差。这转化为下游任务上的最先进性能，且完全没有增加推理开销。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为YAQA的自适应舍入量化算法。不同于传统逐层优化方法，YAQA直接考量网络输出端的整体误差，并推导出了首个量化算法的端到端误差界限。该方法通过Hessian近似技术，在保持推理效率的同时，显著提升了模型量化精度。
AI.keywords: 模型量化, 自适应舍入, 端到端误差, Hessian近似, YAQA
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的自适应舍入方法YAQA，通过直接考虑网络输出端的误差，打破了传统逐层优化带来的误差累积问题。其理论贡献在于给出了量化算法的首个端到端误差界限，并在实际应用中显著提升了模型性能。该方法的局限性在于未在文中提及针对特定硬件架构的优化细节。

title: Geospatial Foundation Models to Enable Progress on Sustainable Development Goals
summary: Foundation Models (FMs) are large-scale, pre-trained artificial intelligence (AI) systems that have revolutionized natural language processing and computer vision, and are now advancing geospatial analysis and Earth Observation (EO). They promise improved generalization across tasks, scalability, and efficient adaptation with minimal labeled data. However, despite the rapid proliferation of geospatial FMs, their real-world utility and alignment with global sustainability goals remain underexplored. We introduce SustainFM, a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in the 17 Sustainable Development Goals with extremely diverse tasks ranging from asset wealth prediction to environmental hazard detection. This study provides a rigorous, interdisciplinary assessment of geospatial FMs and offers critical insights into their role in attaining sustainability goals. Our findings show: (1) While not universally superior, FMs often outperform traditional approaches across diverse tasks and datasets. (2) Evaluating FMs should go beyond accuracy to include transferability, generalization, and energy efficiency as key criteria for their responsible use. (3) FMs enable scalable, SDG-grounded solutions, offering broad utility for tackling complex sustainability challenges. Critically, we advocate for a paradigm shift from model-centric development to impact-driven deployment, and emphasize metrics such as energy efficiency, robustness to domain shifts, and ethical considerations.

title: Neural Variance-aware Dueling Bandits with Deep Representation and Shallow Exploration
summary: We introduce the first variance-aware algorithms for contextual dueling bandits that leverage shallow exploration strategies with neural networks for nonlinear utility approximation. A key theoretical challenge is the absence of a closed-form estimator, which led prior work to require an extremely large network width $m$ (i.e., $m = \widetildeΩ(T^{14})$). We address this constraint with a novel analytical approach that combines iterative self-improvement with spectral analysis. Our analysis significantly reduces the network width requirement to $m = \widetildeΩ(T^{6})$, and shows that our algorithms achieve a sublinear regret of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^{T} σ_t^2} + \sqrt{dT})$ under both UCB and TS frameworks. Empirical results show that the proposed algorithms are not only computationally efficient and exhibit sublinear regret in practical settings, but also achieve state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world tasks.

AI.title_translation: 具有深度表示与浅层探索的神经方差感知决斗老虎机
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的分析方法，显著降低了神经网络在决斗老虎机算法中的宽度需求，并实现了高效的次线性遗憾。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文决斗老虎机算法在处理非线性效用近似时，因缺乏闭式估计量，导致对神经网络宽度的要求过高（m = Ω(T^14)），限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合迭代自我改进与谱分析的分析方法，利用神经网络进行非线性效用近似，并采用浅层探索策略，在UCB和TS框架下实现方差感知。
AI.result: 将神经网络宽度需求降低至 m = Ω(T^6)，在UCB和TS框架下实现了次线性遗憾，并在合成及真实世界任务中表现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功降低了神经网络在上下文决斗老虎机中的宽度需求，并证明了算法在UCB和TS框架下均能实现次线性遗憾，为处理非线性效用近似提供了更高效的理论与实践路径。
AI.translation: 我们引入了首个针对上下文决斗老虎机的方差感知算法，该算法利用神经网络进行非线性效用近似，并采用浅层探索策略。一个关键的理论挑战是缺乏闭式估计量，导致先前的工作需要极大的网络宽度 m（即 m = Ω(T^14)）。我们通过一种结合迭代自我改进与谱分析的新颖分析方法解决了这一约束。我们的分析将网络宽度要求显著降低至 m = Ω(T^6)，并证明了我们的算法在 UCB 和 TS 框架下均能实现次线性遗憾，即 Õ(d√(∑σ_t^2) + √(dT))。实验结果表明，所提出的算法不仅计算高效且在实际场景中表现出次线性遗憾，还在合成和真实任务中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种方差感知的上下文决斗老虎机算法，通过创新的谱分析与迭代自我改进方法，显著降低了神经网络宽度需求，并实现了高效的次线性遗憾。
AI.keywords: 上下文决斗老虎机, 神经网络, 方差感知, 次线性遗憾, 浅层探索
AI.comments: 该论文在解决上下文决斗老虎机问题上取得了重要进展，通过创新的分析方法将神经网络宽度要求从极端规模大幅降低，在理论深度与计算效率之间取得了更好的平衡，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Uncovering Insights of Compound Flooding with Data-Driven AI
comments: Accepted to SIGKDD 2026 AI for Science Track; 12 Pages, 5 Figures, 6 Tables
summary: Compound flooding, driven by nonlinear interactions between multiple hydrometeorological factors, poses a significant challenge to hazard prevention. Existing forecasting approaches, whether physics-based or data-driven, often emphasize temporal patterns while underexploring how multiple interacting factors jointly shape flood dynamics. To address this problem, we conduct a large-scale data-driven analysis of compound flooding in South Florida, a typical area for compound flooding, by integrating tidal conditions, rainfall, groundwater stage, and human water management activities. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (i) models that capture temporal dynamics alone fail to represent multi-factor interactions during compound events; (ii) subsurface saturation, as reflected by groundwater levels, emerges as a dominant predictor of flood severity, often outweighing immediate rainfall intensity in this porous coastal region; and (iii) the spatial state of surrounding monitoring stations within a finite effective radius provides critical causal context for flooding, while extending temporal history yields diminishing returns during extreme events. These findings suggest that compound flooding is governed more by spatially coupled system states than by long-term temporal dependencies, challenging rain-centric and sequence-dominated forecasting paradigms. By framing data-driven models as tools for scientific inquiry rather than prediction alone, this study offers new insights into the mechanisms of compound flooding and informs the design of more physically grounded early-warning systems for coastal environments. Our dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/AslanDing/SFBench.
comment: Accepted to SIGKDD 2026 AI for Science Track; 12 Pages, 5 Figures, 6 Tables

AI.title_translation: 利用数据驱动AI揭示复合洪水的见解
AI.tldr: 研究发现复合洪水更多受空间系统状态（如地下水位）而非单纯降雨或长时序影响，挑战了传统的洪水预测范式。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理模型或数据驱动预测方法过度关注时间模式，而忽视了多种相互作用因素（如潮汐、降雨、地下水等）如何共同塑造洪水动态，导致难以有效应对复杂的复合洪水挑战。
AI.method: 利用南佛罗里达的大规模多源数据（包括潮汐、降雨、地下水位和人为管理活动），采用数据驱动的分析方法，对比了仅基于时间动态的模型与考虑多因素相互作用的模型，并分析了不同空间范围和时间窗口对洪水预测的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：1. 仅捕捉时间动态的模型无法准确模拟多因素交互；2. 地下水位（地下饱和度）是预测洪水严重程度的主导因子，其作用往往超过降雨强度；3. 周边监测站的空间状态提供了关键的因果背景，而增加时间历史数据对极端事件预测的边际贡献递减。
AI.conclusion: 复合洪水更多受空间耦合系统状态而非长期时间依赖性的控制。研究建议未来的预警系统应从传统的“以雨为中心”转向基于系统状态和空间信息的综合监测，以提高预测的准确性和科学性。
AI.translation: 复合洪水是由多种水文气象因素之间的非线性相互作用引起的，对灾害预防构成了重大挑战。现有的预测方法，无论是基于物理的还是数据驱动的，往往强调时间模式，而对多种相互作用因素如何共同塑造洪水动态的研究不足。为了解决这个问题，我们以南佛罗里达这一复合洪水的典型区域为例，通过整合潮汐条件、降雨、地下水位和人为水管理活动，进行了大规模的数据驱动分析。我们的分析揭示了三个关键发现：(i) 仅捕捉时间动态的模型无法表示复合事件期间的多因素相互作用；(ii) 以地下水位为代表的地下饱和度是该多孔沿海地区洪水严重程度的主要预测指标，其影响往往超过即时降雨强度；(iii) 有限有效半径内周边监测站的空间状态提供了关键的因果背景，而延长极端事件的时间历史记录收益递减。这些发现表明，复合洪水更多地受空间耦合系统状态而非长期时间依赖性的支配，挑战了以雨为中心和以序列为主导的预测范式。通过将数据驱动模型定位为科学探究而非单纯的预测工具，本研究为复合洪水的机制提供了新的见解，并为沿海环境更具物理基础的早期预警系统设计提供了参考。我们的数据集和代码已在 https://github.com/AslanDing/SFBench 公开。
AI.summary: 本文通过对南佛罗里达复合洪水进行大规模数据驱动分析，探讨了多要素交互对洪水动态的影响。研究表明，地下水位和空间监测数据对理解洪水严重程度至关重要，揭示了复合洪水主要受空间耦合系统状态驱动的机制，而非传统认为的长时序时间依赖。该研究为开发更具物理基础的沿海洪水预警系统提供了新视角。
AI.keywords: 复合洪水, 数据驱动, 南佛罗里达, 地下水位, 空间耦合
AI.comments: 该研究通过数据驱动的方法揭示了复合洪水的物理机制，特别是强调了地下水位和空间相关性比时间序列更重要的观点。这一发现对改进沿海地区的防洪预警系统具有重要的理论和实践指导意义，挑战了传统的以降雨量为主的预测范式。

title: MesaNet: Sequence Modeling by Locally Optimal Test-Time Training
summary: Sequence modeling is currently dominated by causal transformer architectures that use softmax self-attention. Although widely adopted, transformers require scaling memory and compute linearly during inference. A recent stream of work linearized the softmax operation, resulting in powerful recurrent neural network (RNN) models with constant memory and compute costs such as DeltaNet, Mamba or xLSTM. These models can be unified by noting that their recurrent layer dynamics can all be derived from an in-context regression objective, approximately optimized through an online learning rule. Here, we join this line of work and introduce a numerically stable, chunkwise parallelizable version of the recently proposed Mesa layer (von Oswald et al., 2024), which could only run sequentially in time and was therefore not scalable. This layer again stems from an in-context loss, but which is now minimized to optimality at every time point using a fast conjugate gradient solver. Through an extensive suite of experiments study up to the billion-parameter scale, we show that optimal test-time training enables reaching lower language modeling perplexity and higher downstream benchmark performance than previous RNNs, especially on tasks requiring long context understanding. This performance gain comes at the cost of additional flops spent during inference time. Our results are therefore intriguingly related to recent trends of increasing test-time compute to improve performance -- here by spending compute to solve sequential optimization problems within the neural network itself.

title: Can VLMs Predict Future States? Bootstrapping World Models from Inverse Dynamics
summary: Can unified vision-language models (VLMs) perform forward dynamics prediction (FDP), i.e., predicting the future state (in image form) given the previous observation and an action (in language form)? We find that VLMs struggle to generate physically plausible transitions between frames from instructions. Nevertheless, we identify a crucial asymmetry in multimodal grounding: fine-tuning a VLM to learn inverse dynamics prediction (IDP)-effectively captioning the action between frames-is significantly easier than learning FDP. In turn, IDP can be used to bootstrap FDP through two main strategies: 1) weakly supervised learning from synthetic data and 2) inference time verification. Firstly, IDP can annotate actions for unlabelled pairs of video frame observations to expand the training data scale for FDP. Secondly, IDP can assign rewards to multiple samples of FDP to score them, effectively guiding search at inference time. We evaluate the FDP resulting from both strategies through the task of action-centric image editing on Aurora-Bench with two families of VLMs. Despite remaining general-purpose, our best model achieves a performance competitive with state-of-the-art image editing models, improving on them by a margin between 7% and 13% according to GPT4o-as-judge, and achieving the best average human evaluation across all subsets of Aurora-Bench.

AI.title_translation: VLM能预测未来状态吗？从逆向动力学引导世界模型
AI.tldr: 通过利用逆向动力学任务来辅助和验证前向动力学预测，有效提升了VLM在动作导向图像编辑中的性能。
AI.motivation: 探索统一视觉语言模型（VLM）是否具备前向动力学预测（FDP）能力，并解决其直接生成物理上合理的未来状态帧的困难。
AI.method: 1. 识别并利用IDP与FDP之间的非对称性；2. 使用IDP对未标注视频对进行动作标注以扩充FDP训练数据（弱监督学习）；3. 利用IDP在推理阶段对FDP生成的多个候选样本进行打分验证。
AI.result: 在Aurora-Bench基准测试中，该方法在动作导向的图像编辑任务上达到SOTA水平，相比现有模型提升了7%至13%（GPT-4o评估），并获得了最佳的人类评估平均分。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入逆向动力学（IDP）进行数据扩充和推理时验证，能够有效提升VLM进行前向动力学预测（FDP）的能力，在动作导向的图像编辑任务中表现卓越。
AI.translation: 统一的视觉语言模型（VLM）能否执行前向动力学预测（FDP），即在给定先前观察和动作（语言形式）的情况下预测未来状态（图像形式）？我们发现，VLM难以根据指令生成物理上合理的帧间转换。然而，我们确定了多模态基础中的一个关键不对称性：微调VLM以学习逆向动力学预测（IDP）——有效地为帧间动作添加标题——比学习FDP要容易得多。反过来，IDP可以通过两种主要策略用于引导FDP：1）来自合成数据的弱监督学习，以及2）推理时验证。首先，IDP可以为未标记的视频帧观察对标注动作，从而扩大FDP的训练数据规模。其次，IDP可以为FDP的多个样本分配奖励以进行评分，从而在推理时有效地指导搜索。我们通过Aurora-Bench上的动作中心图像编辑任务评估了两种策略产生的FDP，并使用了两个系列的VLM。尽管仍然保持通用性，但根据GPT4o作为评判标准，我们最好的模型实现了与最先进图像编辑模型相当的性能，并比它们提高了7%到13%的幅度，并在Aurora-Bench的所有子集中实现了最佳的平均人类评估。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了视觉语言模型（VLM）进行前向动力学预测的能力。研究发现直接预测未来状态较为困难，但通过引入逆向动力学（IDP）任务，可以有效通过数据扩充和推理时验证策略来“引导”模型提升前向预测性能，并在图像编辑任务中取得了优于现有模型的表现。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 前向动力学预测, 逆向动力学, 世界模型, 动作导向图像编辑
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了逆向动力学（IDP）与前向动力学（FDP）之间的非对称性，通过逆向任务引导前向任务，为提升通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在世界模型构建中的能力提供了新视角。其局限在于仍然依赖于特定的基准测试，且模型在处理复杂物理规律时的基础能力仍有待提高。

title: Reusing Trajectories in Policy Gradients Enables Fast Convergence
summary: Policy gradient (PG) methods are a class of effective reinforcement learning algorithms, particularly when dealing with continuous control problems. They rely on fresh on-policy data, making them sample-inefficient and requiring $O(ε^{-2})$ trajectories to reach an $ε$-approximate stationary point. A common strategy to improve efficiency is to reuse information from past iterations, such as previous gradients or trajectories, leading to off-policy PG methods. While gradient reuse has received substantial attention, leading to improved rates up to $O(ε^{-3/2})$, the reuse of past trajectories, although intuitive, remains largely unexplored from a theoretical perspective. In this work, we provide the first rigorous theoretical evidence that reusing past off-policy trajectories can significantly accelerate PG convergence. We propose RT-PG (Reusing Trajectories - Policy Gradient), a novel algorithm that leverages a power mean-corrected multiple importance weighting estimator to effectively combine on-policy and off-policy data coming from the most recent $ω$ iterations. Through a novel analysis, we prove that RT-PG achieves a sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(ε^{-2}ω^{-1})$. When reusing all available past trajectories, this leads to a rate of $\tilde{O}(ε^{-1})$, the best known one in the literature for PG methods. We further validate our approach empirically, demonstrating its effectiveness against baselines with state-of-the-art rates.

title: Time Series Forecasting as Reasoning: A Slow-Thinking Approach with Reinforced LLMs
summary: To advance time series forecasting (TSF), various methods have been proposed to improve prediction accuracy, evolving from statistical techniques to data-driven deep learning architectures. Despite their effectiveness, most existing methods still adhere to a fast thinking paradigm-relying on extracting historical patterns and mapping them to future values as their core modeling philosophy, lacking an explicit thinking process that incorporates intermediate time series reasoning. Meanwhile, emerging slow-thinking LLMs (e.g., OpenAI-o1) have shown remarkable multi-step reasoning capabilities, offering an alternative way to overcome these issues. However, prompt engineering alone presents several limitations - including high computational cost, privacy risks, and limited capacity for in-depth domain-specific time series reasoning. To address these limitations, a more promising approach is to train LLMs to develop slow thinking capabilities and acquire strong time series reasoning skills. For this purpose, we propose Time-R1, a two-stage reinforcement fine-tuning framework designed to enhance multi-step reasoning ability of LLMs for time series forecasting. Specifically, the first stage conducts supervised fine-tuning for warmup adaptation, while the second stage employs reinforcement learning to improve the model's generalization ability. Particularly, we design a fine-grained multi-objective reward specifically for time series forecasting, and then introduce GRIP (group-based relative importance for policy optimization), which leverages non-uniform sampling to further encourage and optimize the model's exploration of effective reasoning paths. Experiments demonstrate that Time-R1 significantly improves forecast performance across diverse datasets.

AI.title_translation: 作为推理的时间序列预测：一种带强化大语言模型的慢思考方法
AI.tldr: Time-R1通过两阶段强化微调，赋予大语言模型“慢思考”能力，显著提升了时间序列预测中的多步推理与预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列预测方法多采用“快思考”模式，仅依赖历史模式映射，缺乏显式的推理过程；而直接使用提示工程（Prompt Engineering）存在成本高、隐私风险及领域推理能力不足的问题。因此，需要训练模型以培养“慢思考”能力，增强其推理技能。
AI.method: 提出了Time-R1框架，包含两个阶段：第一阶段进行监督微调以进行预热适应，第二阶段使用强化学习进行优化。设计了细粒度的多目标奖励机制，并引入了GRIP（基于组的相对重要性策略优化）算法，利用非均匀采样鼓励模型探索有效的推理路径。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Time-R1框架在多个不同的数据集上显著提升了时间序列预测的性能。
AI.conclusion: Time-R1框架通过两阶段强化微调显著提升了LLM在时间序列预测任务中的多步推理能力，证明了慢思考范式在预测领域的有效性。
AI.translation: 为了推进时间序列预测（TSF），人们提出了各种方法来提高预测精度，从统计技术演变为数据驱动的深度学习架构。尽管它们很有效，但大多数现有方法仍然遵循“快思考”范式——即依赖于提取历史模式并将其映射到未来值作为其核心建模理念，缺乏结合中间时间序列推理的显式思维过程。与此同时，新兴的慢思考大语言模型（如OpenAI-o1）表现出了卓越的多步推理能力，为克服这些问题提供了另一种途径。然而，仅靠提示工程存在若干局限性，包括高昂的计算成本、隐私风险以及在深入的领域特定时间序列推理方面的能力有限。为了解决这些限制，一个更有前途的方法是训练大语言模型以发展慢思考能力并获得强大的时间序列推理技能。为此，我们提出了Time-R1，这是一个两阶段强化微调框架，旨在增强大语言模型在时间序列预测中的多步推理能力。具体而言，第一阶段进行监督微调以进行预热适应，第二阶段采用强化学习来提高模型的泛化能力。特别地，我们为时间序列预测设计了细粒度的多目标奖励，并引入了GRIP（基于组的相对重要性策略优化），它利用非均匀采样来进一步鼓励和优化模型对有效推理路径的探索。实验证明，Time-R1显著提高了不同数据集上的预测性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统时间序列预测缺乏显式推理的问题，提出了Time-R1框架。该方法通过两阶段强化微调，赋予大语言模型“慢思考”能力，利用多目标奖励和GRIP策略优化，有效提升了模型在时间序列预测中的多步推理水平和预测精度。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测, 慢思考, 大语言模型, 强化学习, 多步推理
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将慢思考（Slow-Thinking）范式引入时间序列预测，通过强化学习微调LLM，使其具备显式的推理能力，而非仅仅依赖模式匹配。这为解决传统深度学习模型在复杂推理任务上的瓶颈提供了新思路。限制在于强化学习训练的复杂性和对算力的要求。

title: Breaking Bad Molecules: Are MLLMs Ready for Structure-Level Molecular Detoxification?
summary: Toxicity remains a leading cause of early-stage drug development failure. Despite advances in molecular design and property prediction, the task of molecular toxicity repair, generating structurally valid molecular alternatives with reduced toxicity, has not yet been systematically defined or benchmarked. To fill this gap, we introduce ToxiMol, the first benchmark task for general-purpose Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) focused on molecular toxicity repair. We construct a standardized dataset covering 11 primary tasks and 660 representative toxic molecules spanning diverse mechanisms and granularities. We design a prompt annotation pipeline with mechanism-aware and task-adaptive capabilities, informed by expert toxicological knowledge. In parallel, we propose an automated evaluation framework, ToxiEval, which integrates toxicity endpoint prediction, synthetic accessibility, drug-likeness, and structural similarity into a high-throughput evaluation chain for repair success. We systematically assess 43 mainstream general-purpose MLLMs and conduct multiple ablation studies to analyze key issues, including evaluation metrics, candidate diversity, and failure attribution. Experimental results show that although current MLLMs still face significant challenges on this task, they begin to demonstrate promising capabilities in toxicity understanding, semantic constraint adherence, and structure-aware editing.

AI.title_translation: “坏”分子修复：多模态大模型准备好进行结构级分子脱毒了吗？
AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对分子毒性修复的基准测试ToxiMol和评估框架ToxiEval，系统评估了多模态大模型在优化药物分子安全性方面的能力，发现模型虽有潜力但仍面临重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 针对药物研发中因毒性导致失败的问题，目前缺乏系统定义的分子毒性修复任务及基准，旨在评估多模态大模型在生成结构有效且毒性降低的分子方面的能力。
AI.method: 提出ToxiMol基准任务及数据集；设计包含专家毒理学知识的提示词标注流程；开发ToxiEval自动化评估框架，综合考量毒性预测、合成可行性、药物相似性及结构相似性。
AI.result: 对43个主流MLLM进行了系统评估，结果显示模型在任务理解和结构编辑方面表现出初步能力，但仍存在显著的性能瓶颈，且通过消融实验揭示了评估指标、候选多样性及失败归因等关键问题。
AI.conclusion: 尽管目前的主流多模态大模型在分子毒性修复任务中面临显著挑战，但它们已初步展现出对毒性理解、语义约束遵循及结构感知编辑的潜力，为后续研究提供了明确的方向。
AI.translation: 毒性仍然是导致早期药物研发失败的主要原因。尽管在分子设计和性质预测方面取得了进展，但分子毒性修复任务——即生成结构有效且毒性降低的分子替代品——尚未得到系统定义或基准测试。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了ToxiMol，这是第一个专门针对通用多模态大模型（MLLMs）进行分子毒性修复的基准任务。我们构建了一个标准化数据集，涵盖了11个主要任务和660个具有代表性的毒性分子，跨越了不同的机制和粒度。我们设计了一个基于专家毒理学知识、具有机制感知和任务自适应能力的提示词标注流程。同时，我们提出了一个自动化评估框架ToxiEval，它将毒性终点预测、合成可行性、药物相似性和结构相似性整合到一个高通量的修复成功评估链中。我们系统地评估了43个主流的通用MLLM，并进行了多项消融研究，以分析关键问题，包括评估指标、候选多样性和失败归因。实验结果表明，尽管目前的MLLM在此任务上仍面临巨大挑战，但它们已开始在毒性理解、语义约束遵循和结构感知编辑方面展现出良好的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文引入了首个针对分子毒性修复的基准测试ToxiMol，旨在评估MLLM在优化药物分子安全性方面的能力。通过构建标准化数据集、设计专家引导的提示词流程以及开发综合评估框架ToxiEval，研究对43个主流模型进行了系统性测试，揭示了当前模型在处理该复杂任务时的潜力与局限。
AI.keywords: 分子毒性修复, 多模态大模型(MLLMs), 基准测试, 药物研发, ToxiMol
AI.comments: 该论文填补了分子毒性修复领域基准测试的空白，通过构建ToxiMol基准和ToxiEval评估框架，为评估MLLM在药物化学领域的生成能力提供了重要依据。其局限在于目前MLLM在处理复杂的结构级分子修改上仍存在显著挑战，表明该领域仍处于起步阶段。

title: WETBench: A Benchmark for Detecting Task-Specific Machine-Generated Text on Wikipedia
summary: Given Wikipedia's role as a trusted source of high-quality, reliable content, concerns are growing about the proliferation of low-quality machine-generated text (MGT) produced by large language models (LLMs) on its platform. Reliable detection of MGT is therefore essential. However, existing work primarily evaluates MGT detectors on generic generation tasks rather than on tasks more commonly performed by Wikipedia editors. This misalignment can lead to poor generalisability when applied in real-world Wikipedia contexts. We introduce WETBench, a multilingual, multi-generator, and task-specific benchmark for MGT detection. We define three editing tasks, empirically grounded in Wikipedia editors' perceived use cases for LLM-assisted editing: Paragraph Writing, Summarisation, and Text Style Transfer, which we implement using two new datasets across three languages. For each writing task, we evaluate three prompts, generate MGT across multiple generators using the best-performing prompt, and benchmark diverse detectors. We find that, across settings, training-based detectors achieve an average accuracy of 78%, while zero-shot detectors average 58%. These results show that detectors struggle with MGT in realistic generation scenarios and underscore the importance of evaluating such models on diverse, task-specific data to assess their reliability in editor-driven contexts.

AI.title_translation: WETBench：一个用于检测维基百科中特定任务机器生成文本的基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了WETBench，这是一个专门针对维基百科编辑任务的机器生成文本检测基准，旨在解决现有检测器在真实应用场景下泛化能力不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MGT检测基准主要针对通用生成任务，未能准确反映维基百科编辑的实际需求，导致检测器在真实维基百科场景下的泛化能力较差。
AI.method: 构建了WETBench基准，定义了段落写作、摘要和文本风格迁移三类特定编辑任务，并利用多种LLM生成器在三种语言下创建测试数据集，评估了训练型和零样本检测器的性能。
AI.result: 训练型检测器平均准确率为78%，零样本检测器平均准确率为58%，显示出现有检测器在处理现实生成任务时存在明显挑战。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，现有的检测器在处理现实维基百科编辑场景下的机器生成文本时表现不佳，强调了在特定任务数据上进行评估对于确保检测模型可靠性的必要性。
AI.translation: 鉴于维基百科作为高质量、可信内容来源的角色，人们日益关注大型语言模型（LLMs）在平台上产生的低质量机器生成文本（MGT）。因此，可靠地检测MGT至关重要。然而，现有工作主要在通用生成任务上评估MGT检测器，而非维基百科编辑更常执行的任务。这种错位可能导致应用于现实维基百科环境时泛化能力较差。我们引入了WETBench，这是一个多语言、多生成器和特定任务的MGT检测基准。我们定义了三种编辑任务，这些任务基于维基百科编辑对LLM辅助编辑的感知用例：段落写作、摘要和文本风格迁移，并使用跨三种语言的两个新数据集来实现。对于每项写作任务，我们评估了三个提示词，使用表现最好的提示词在多个生成器中生成MGT，并对各种检测器进行了基准测试。我们发现，在各种设置下，基于训练的检测器平均准确率为78%，而零样本检测器平均为58%。这些结果表明，检测器在现实生成场景中处理MGT存在困难，并强调了在多样化、特定任务数据上评估此类模型以评估其在编辑驱动环境下的可靠性的重要性。
AI.summary: WETBench是一个针对维基百科特定编辑任务（段落写作、摘要、风格迁移）的机器生成文本检测基准，旨在解决现有通用检测基准与实际编辑需求不匹配的问题。该研究通过多语言、多生成器的测试，揭示了当前检测技术在应对维基百科真实场景时的性能瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 机器生成文本, 维基百科, 基准测试, 文本检测, LLM应用
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将机器生成文本（MGT）检测的视角从通用生成任务转向了更符合维基百科编辑实际应用场景的特定任务。其重要性在于揭示了现有检测器在真实应用场景下的局限性，为提高维基百科等知识平台的文本质量维护提供了新的评估标准和基准。局限性在于该研究主要聚焦于三种特定任务，可能无法涵盖所有复杂的编辑场景。

title: A Fragmentation-Aware Adaptive Bilevel Search Framework for Service Mapping in Computing Power Networks
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Computing Power Network (CPN) unifies wide-area computing resources through coordinated network control, while cloud-native abstractions enable flexible resource orchestration and on-demand service provisioning atop the elastic infrastructure CPN provides. However, current approaches fall short of fully integrating computing resources via network-enabled coordination as envisioned by CPN. In particular, optimally mapping services to an underlying infrastructure to maximize resource efficiency and service satisfaction remains challenging. To overcome this challenge, we formally define the service mapping problem in CPN, establish its theoretical intractability, and identify key challenges in practical optimization. We propose Adaptive Bilevel Search (ABS), a modular framework featuring (1) graph partitioning-based reformulation to capture variable coupling, (2) a bilevel optimization architecture for efficient global exploration with best-response solving of local subproblems, and (3) fragmentation-aware evaluation for long-term performance guidance. Implemented using distributed particle swarm optimization, ABS is extensively evaluated across diverse CPN scenarios, consistently outperforming existing approaches. Notably, in complex scenarios, ABS achieves up to 73.2% higher computing resource utilization and a 60.2% higher service acceptance ratio compared to the best-performing baseline.

title: Faster algorithms for k-Orthogonal Vectors in low dimension
summary:
In the Orthogonal Vectors problem (OV), we are given two families $A, B$ of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,d\}$, each of size $n$, and the task is to decide whether there exists a pair $a \in A$ and $b \in B$ such that $a \cap b = \emptyset$. Straightforward algorithms for this problem run in $\mathcal{O}(n^2 \cdot d)$ or $\mathcal{O}(2^d \cdot n)$ time, and assuming SETH, there is no $2^{o(d)}\cdot n^{2-\varepsilon}$ time algorithm that solves this problem for any constant $\varepsilon > 0$.
  Williams (FOCS 2024) presented a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1.35^d \cdot n)$-time algorithm for the problem, based on the succinct equality-rank decomposition of the disjointness matrix. In this paper, we present a combinatorial algorithm that runs in randomized time $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1.25^d n)$. This can be improved to $\mathcal{O}(1.16^d \cdot n)$ using computer-aided evaluations.
  We generalize our result to the $k$-Orthogonal Vectors problem, where given $k$ families $A_1,\ldots,A_k$ of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,d\}$, each of size $n$, the task is to find elements $a_i \in A_i$ for every $i \in \{1,\ldots,k\}$ such that $a_1 \cap a_2 \cap \ldots \cap a_k = \emptyset$. We show that for every fixed $k \ge 2$, there exists $\varepsilon_k > 0$ such that the $k$-OV problem can be solved in time $\mathcal{O}(2^{(1 - \varepsilon_k)\cdot d}\cdot n)$. We also show that, asymptotically, this is the best we can hope for: for any $\varepsilon > 0$ there exists a $k \ge 2$ such that $2^{(1 - \varepsilon)\cdot d} \cdot n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ time algorithm for $k$-Orthogonal Vectors would contradict the Set Cover Conjecture.

title: Non-periodic Fourier propagation algorithms for partial differential equations
comments: Revision: complexity analysis, higher dimensions, SPDEs
summary: Spectral methods for partial differential equations (PDEs) with non-periodic boundary conditions arising in computational physics often use polynomial expansions on non-uniform grids. Here, we implement a Fourier method that employs fast trigonometric expansions on a uniform grid with non-periodic boundaries using fast discrete sine transforms (DST) or/and discrete cosine transforms (DCT) to solve parabolic PDEs. We implement this method in two ways: either using a Fourier spectral derivative or a Fourier interaction picture. Both methods can treat vector fields with a combination of Dirichlet and/or Neumann boundary conditions in one or more space dimensions. As examples, we use them to solve a variety of computational physics PDEs with analytical solutions, including the Peregrine solitary wave solution. For the 1D heat equation problem, our method with an interaction picture is accurate up to machine precision. Soluble examples of stochastic partial differential equation (SPDE) with non-periodic boundaries in one and two space dimensions, with physics and interdisciplinary applications are also treated. We compare the results obtained from these algorithms with publicly available solvers that use polynomial spectral methods, and study their relative performance and error scaling. Polynomial methods with non-uniform spatial grids have lower spatial discretization errors when the solutions change slowly in space, typically with large spatial grids. For problems with rapid spatial variation, Fourier methods can outperform polynomial expansions, owing to their smaller maximum space interval, and are generally faster due to the computational efficiency of discrete Fourier transform methods. We verified this by making a complexity analysis in which we studied the total error at the optimum combination of time and space steps for a given resource use.

AI.title_translation: 用于偏微分方程的非周期傅里叶传播算法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于快速三角变换（DST/DCT）的傅里叶方法，可高效求解非周期边界条件的PDE，在处理空间快速变化问题时性能优于传统多项式谱方法。
AI.motivation: 传统处理非周期边界条件的谱方法通常依赖非均匀网格的多项式展开，而在处理空间快速变化问题时，傅里叶方法在计算复杂度和效率上具有潜在优势。
AI.method: 利用快速离散正弦变换（DST）和离散余弦变换（DCT）在均匀网格上实现非周期边界条件的傅里叶方法，具体包括傅里叶谱导数法和傅里叶交互图像法。
AI.result: 该方法在求解各类计算物理PDE及SPDE时表现出高精度（达到机器精度），且在空间快速变化问题中，相比多项式方法具有更快的计算速度和更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，对于空间快速变化的PDE问题，基于DST/DCT的傅里叶方法在计算效率和误差控制上优于传统的非均匀网格多项式谱方法。
AI.translation: 计算物理中具有非周期边界条件的偏微分方程（PDE）的谱方法通常使用非均匀网格上的多项式展开。本文实现了一种傅里叶方法，该方法在均匀网格上使用快速三角展开，并通过快速离散正弦变换（DST）和/或离散余弦变换（DCT）来求解抛物型PDE。我们以两种方式实现了该方法：使用傅里叶谱导数或傅里叶交互图像。这两种方法均可处理具有一个或多个空间维度中狄利克雷和/或诺伊曼边界条件组合的矢量场。作为示例，我们使用它们求解了多种具有解析解的计算物理PDE，包括Peregrine孤立波解。对于一维热方程问题，我们的交互图像方法精确到机器精度。文中还处理了一维和二维空间中具有非周期边界条件的随机偏微分方程（SPDE）的可解示例，并探讨了其在物理和跨学科中的应用。我们将这些算法获得的结果与使用多项式谱方法的公开求解器进行了比较，并研究了它们的相对性能和误差缩放。当解在空间中变化缓慢（通常使用大空间网格）时，具有非均匀空间网格的多项式方法具有较低的空间离散化误差。对于具有快速空间变化的问题，由于其较小的最大空间间隔，傅里叶方法可以胜过多项式展开，并且由于离散傅里叶变换方法的计算效率，它们通常更快。我们通过复杂度分析验证了这一点，在该分析中，我们研究了在给定资源使用下，时间和空间步长的最佳组合下的总误差。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于快速离散正弦/余弦变换（DST/DCT）的傅里叶方法，用于高效求解具有非周期边界条件的偏微分方程（PDE）。该方法在均匀网格上运行，通过傅里叶谱导数或交互图像法处理Dirichlet和Neumann边界条件。实验证明，该方法在处理空间快速变化问题时，计算速度和精度优于传统的非均匀网格多项式谱方法。
AI.keywords: 非周期性边界条件, 傅里叶谱方法, 离散正弦变换, 离散余弦变换, 偏微分方程
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将快速三角展开（DST/DCT）应用于非周期性边界条件的PDE求解，在处理具有空间快速变化的物理问题时，相比传统的非均匀网格多项式谱方法，表现出更高的计算效率和竞争力。

title: Graph-R1: Towards Agentic GraphRAG Framework via End-to-end Reinforcement Learning
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates hallucination in LLMs by incorporating external knowledge, but relies on chunk-based retrieval that lacks structural semantics. GraphRAG methods improve RAG by modeling knowledge as entity-relation graphs, but still face challenges in high construction cost, fixed one-time retrieval, and reliance on long-context reasoning and prompt design. To address these challenges, we propose Graph-R1, the first agentic GraphRAG framework via end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL). It introduces lightweight knowledge hypergraph construction, models retrieval as a multi-turn agent-environment interaction, and optimizes the agent process via an end-to-end reward mechanism. Experiments on standard RAG datasets show that Graph-R1 outperforms traditional GraphRAG and RL-enhanced RAG methods in reasoning accuracy, retrieval efficiency, and generation quality. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/Graph-R1.

AI.title_translation: Graph-R1：通过端到端强化学习迈向代理式GraphRAG框架
AI.tldr: Graph-R1通过端到端强化学习，让RAG系统能够像智能代理一样多轮交互检索图数据，显著提升了推理和生成性能。
AI.motivation: 针对现有RAG基于文本块检索缺乏结构语义，以及现有GraphRAG方法存在构建成本高、检索固定、依赖长上下文和复杂提示词工程的问题。
AI.method: 提出了Graph-R1框架，包含轻量级知识超图构建、将检索建模为多轮代理-环境交互，并采用端到端奖励机制对代理过程进行优化。
AI.result: 在标准RAG数据集上的实验表明，Graph-R1在推理准确性、检索效率和生成质量方面均优于传统的GraphRAG和基于RL的RAG方法。
AI.conclusion: Graph-R1通过端到端强化学习构建了高效的代理式GraphRAG框架，在推理精度、检索效率和生成质量上均优于现有的基准方法。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识减轻了大语言模型（LLM）的幻觉问题，但其依赖基于文本块的检索，缺乏结构化语义。GraphRAG方法通过将知识建模为实体-关系图来改进RAG，但仍面临构建成本高、检索方式固定以及依赖长上下文推理和提示词设计等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了Graph-R1，这是首个通过端到端强化学习（RL）实现的代理式GraphRAG框架。它引入了轻量级知识超图构建，将检索建模为多轮代理-环境交互，并通过端到端奖励机制优化代理过程。在标准RAG数据集上的实验表明，Graph-R1在推理准确性、检索效率和生成质量方面均优于传统的GraphRAG和RL增强型RAG方法。我们的软件和数据已在 https://github.com/LHRLAB/Graph-R1 公开。
AI.summary: Graph-R1是一个创新的代理式GraphRAG框架，利用端到端强化学习优化知识超图的检索过程，从而克服了传统RAG和GraphRAG在结构化语义理解、检索灵活性及提示词依赖方面的局限性。
AI.keywords: GraphRAG, 强化学习, 代理框架, 知识超图, 检索增强生成
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将强化学习引入GraphRAG框架，实现了端到端的代理式检索，有效解决了传统GraphRAG构建成本高、检索僵化以及过度依赖长上下文提示词的问题。这是一个将图结构知识与自主代理（Agent）相结合的重要探索。

title: Dual-Mode Wireless Devices for Adaptive Pull and Push-Based Communication
comments: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Communications, Copyright might be transferred without notice
summary: This paper introduces a dual-mode communication framework for wireless devices that integrates query-driven (pull) and event-driven (push) transmissions within a unified time-frame structure. Devices typically respond to information requests in pull mode, but if an anomaly is detected, they preempt the regular response to report the critical condition. Additionally, push-based communication is used to proactively send critical data without waiting for a request. This adaptive approach ensures timely, context-aware, and efficient data delivery across different network conditions. To achieve high energy efficiency, we incorporate a wake-up radio mechanism and we design a tailored medium access control (MAC) protocol that supports data traffic belonging to the different communication classes. A comprehensive system-level analysis is conducted, accounting for the wake-up control operation and evaluating three key performance metrics: the success probability of anomaly reports (push traffic), the success probability of query responses (pull traffic) and the total energy consumption. Numerical results characterize the system's behavior and highlight the inherent trade-off between push and pull success probabilities as a function of allocated communication resources. Our analysis demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves up to a 42% reduction in energy consumption per served packet compared to traditional approaches, while maintaining reliable support for both communication paradigms.

AI.title_translation: 用于自适应拉式和推式通信的双模式无线设备
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合拉式查询与推式报警的双模式无线通信框架，通过唤醒机制和MAC优化，在保持可靠性的同时降低了42%的能耗。
AI.motivation: 现有的无线通信往往难以兼顾查询响应的效率与突发异常事件报告的及时性，需要一种能够自适应处理不同流量类型的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个统一的时隙框架，集成了基于查询的“拉”模式和基于事件的“推”模式；设计了配套的MAC协议，并结合唤醒无线电机制以提升能效。
AI.result: 系统分析表明，该方案在维持两种通信模式可靠性的同时，将每个数据包的能耗降低了高达42%，并明确了推拉通信概率之间的资源权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双模式通信框架通过MAC协议优化和唤醒机制，实现了能效与数据传输可靠性的平衡，相比传统方案显著降低了能耗。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种无线设备双模式通信框架，该框架在一个统一的时隙结构内集成了查询驱动（拉）和事件驱动（推）传输。设备通常以拉模式响应信息请求，但如果检测到异常，它们会抢占常规响应以报告关键情况。此外，推式通信用于在无需等待请求的情况下主动发送关键数据。这种自适应方法确保了在不同网络条件下及时、上下文感知且高效的数据传输。为了实现高能效，我们结合了唤醒无线电机制，并设计了一种支持不同通信类别数据流量的定制化媒体访问控制（MAC）协议。我们进行了全面的系统级分析，考虑了唤醒控制操作，并评估了三个关键性能指标：异常报告（推流量）的成功概率、查询响应（拉流量）的成功概率以及总能耗。数值结果刻画了系统行为，并强调了推式和拉式成功概率之间作为分配通信资源函数的内在权衡。我们的分析表明，与传统方法相比，所提出的方法在维持两种通信范式可靠支持的同时，每个服务数据包的能耗降低了高达42%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种无线设备双模式通信框架，通过整合查询驱动（拉）和事件驱动（推）传输，结合唤醒无线电技术和定制化MAC协议，在保证数据传输及时性和可靠性的前提下，显著降低了系统功耗。
AI.keywords: 双模式通信, 唤醒无线电, MAC协议, 能效, 实时传输
AI.comments: 该论文通过整合“拉”和“推”两种通信模式，创新性地解决了无线设备在能效与实时性之间的权衡问题。引入唤醒无线电机制是实现低功耗的关键，但该机制的复杂性及MAC协议的设计可能在极端高负载环境下带来延迟抖动，这是其潜在的局限性。

title: From Graph Retrieval to Schema Realization: Counterfactual Validation for Text-to-SPARQL over Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs
summary: Text-to-SPARQL maps natural-language questions to executable SPARQL queries over RDF knowledge graphs. While standard evaluations often fix the target graph in advance, practical knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) may involve heterogeneous graph collections with different schemas, partial alignments, and incomplete metadata. In this setting, query generation depends on more than SPARQL syntax: the system must identify a graph schema that can support the predicates, entity types, joins, filters, and constraints required by the question. We present SchemaForge, a schema-grounded agentic framework for text-to-SPARQL over heterogeneous KG collections. Its central mechanism is question-conditioned schema-slice alignment: weak graph evidence first identifies plausible graphs, while stronger schema evidence determines whether a local schema slice can realize the intended query. The selected schema slice then constrains query generation and verification before execution. When only one graph is available, the same formulation reduces to standard single-KG text-to-SPARQL with schema grounding. We evaluate SchemaForge on LC-QuAD 2.0, QALD-9 Plus, QALD-10, and Spider4SPARQL. Across the four public benchmarks, SchemaForge improves execution accuracy over the strongest matched agent baseline by 11.50 percentage points on average. On Spider4SPARQL, SchemaForge improves execution accuracy from 54.86% to 64.18% and achieves 73.0% Top-1 and 97.0% Top-3 graph allocation accuracy. These results show that moving from weak graph evidence to schema-specific query commitments, together with counterfactual answer-set checks, improves executable query generation over heterogeneous knowledge graphs.

title: VGGSounder: Audio-Visual Evaluations for Foundation Models
comments: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2025
summary: The emergence of audio-visual foundation models underscores the importance of reliably assessing their multi-modal understanding. The VGGSound dataset is commonly used as a benchmark for evaluation audio-visual classification. However, our analysis identifies several limitations of VGGSound, including incomplete labelling, partially overlapping classes, and misaligned modalities. These lead to distorted evaluations of auditory and visual capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce VGGSounder, a comprehensively re-annotated, multi-label test set that extends VGGSound and is specifically designed to evaluate audio-visual foundation models. VGGSounder features detailed modality annotations, enabling precise analyses of modality-specific performance. Furthermore, we reveal model limitations by analysing performance degradation when adding another input modality with our new modality confusion metric.

AI.title_translation: VGGSounder：音视频基础模型评估基准
AI.tldr: 针对现有音视频数据集标注质量差的问题，本文提出了VGGSounder，通过精细化标注和新颖的模态混淆指标，更可靠地评估音视频基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的VGGSound数据集存在标注不完整、类别重叠和模态对齐不佳等问题，导致无法准确评估音视频基础模型的多模态理解能力。
AI.method: 通过对VGGSound数据集进行重新标注，构建了包含详细模态标注的多标签测试集VGGSounder，并引入了模态混淆指标（modality confusion metric）来分析添加输入模态后的性能衰减。
AI.result: VGGSounder 能够提供更精确的音视频模型性能分析，通过新提出的指标成功揭示了模型在处理多模态输入时存在的性能下降问题。
AI.conclusion: VGGSounder 提供了一个经过重新标注的、具备多标签和详细模态标注的测试集，能够更准确地评估音视频基础模型的性能，并揭示了现有模型在多模态融合方面的局限性。
AI.translation: 音视频基础模型的出现突显了可靠评估其多模态理解能力的重要性。VGGSound数据集通常被用作评估音视频分类的基准。然而，我们的分析发现VGGSound存在若干局限性，包括标注不完整、类别部分重叠以及模态不对齐。这些问题导致了对听觉和视觉能力的评估出现偏差。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了VGGSounder，这是一个经过全面重新标注的多标签测试集，它扩展了VGGSound，旨在专门评估音视频基础模型。VGGSounder具有详细的模态标注，能够对特定模态的性能进行精确分析。此外，我们通过使用新的模态混淆指标分析添加另一输入模态时的性能衰减，揭示了模型的局限性。
AI.summary: 为了解决VGGSound数据集在评估音视频基础模型时的局限性，本文推出了VGGSounder。这是一个经过重新标注的多标签测试集，通过提供细致的模态标注和创新的模态混淆指标，实现了对音视频模型能力的精确评估和局限性分析。
AI.keywords: 音视频基础模型, 基准测试, 模态对齐, 多标签标注, 性能评估
AI.comments: 该论文通过识别现有基准测试（VGGSound）在标注质量和多模态对齐上的缺陷，提出了更严谨的评估数据集。其创新点在于引入了“模态混淆指标”，不仅评估分类准确性，还深入分析了多模态融合过程中的性能衰减问题，对推动多模态基础模型的发展具有重要意义。

title: Computing Radially-Symmetric Solutions of the Ultra-Relativistic Euler Equations with Entropy-Stable Discontinuous Galerkin Methods
summary: The ultra--relativistic Euler equations describe gases in the relativistic case when the thermal energy dominates. These equations for an ideal gas are given in terms of the pressure, the spatial part of the dimensionless four-velocity, and the particle density. Kunik et al.\ (2024, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcp.2024.113330) proposed genuine multi--dimensional benchmark problems for the ultra--relativistic Euler equations. In particular, they compared full two-dimensional discontinuous Galerkin simulations for radially symmetric problems with solutions computed using a specific one-dimensional scheme. Of particular interest in the solutions are the formation of shock waves and a pressure blow-up. In the present work we derive an entropy-stable flux for the ultra--relativistic Euler equations. Therefore, we derive the main field (or entropy variables) and the corresponding potentials. We then present the entropy-stable flux and conclude with simulation results for different test cases both in 2D and in 3D.

AI.title_translation: 利用熵稳定不连续伽辽金方法计算超相对论欧拉方程的径向对称解
AI.tldr: 本文推导了超相对论欧拉方程的熵稳定通量，并利用不连续伽辽金方法实现了对2D和3D径向对称问题的稳健数值模拟。
AI.motivation: 为了解决超相对论欧拉方程在模拟激波和压力爆破等复杂现象时数值不稳定的问题，并验证其在多维（2D/3D）环境下的表现。
AI.method: 通过推导主场（熵变量）及相应势函数，构建了超相对论欧拉方程的熵稳定通量，并结合不连续伽辽金方法（DG）进行2D和3D数值模拟。
AI.result: 成功实现了熵稳定通量的推导，并在多个2D和3D测试案例中验证了该方法在处理超相对论气体动力学问题时的稳定性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功推导了适用于超相对论欧拉方程的熵稳定通量，并验证了其在多维空间（2D和3D）中处理激波和压力爆破问题的有效性。
AI.translation: 超相对论欧拉方程描述了热能占主导地位的相对论气体。这些理想气体的方程由压力、无量纲四速度的空间部分和粒子密度表示。Kunik等人（2024）针对超相对论欧拉方程提出了真正的多维基准问题，特别对比了径向对称问题的全二维不连续伽辽金模拟与特定一维格式计算出的解。解中特别令人感兴趣的是激波的形成和压力爆破。在本文中，我们推导了超相对论欧拉方程的熵稳定通量。为此，我们推导了主场（或熵变量）及相应的势函数。随后，我们提出了该熵稳定通量，并总结了2D和3D不同测试案例的模拟结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对描述热能占主导地位的超相对论欧拉方程，提出了一种熵稳定通量方案。通过推导熵变量及势函数，作者将该方案应用于不连续伽辽金方法中，并成功在2D和3D环境下模拟了激波形成及压力爆破等复杂物理过程。
AI.keywords: 超相对论欧拉方程, 熵稳定通量, 不连续伽辽金方法, 激波, 数值模拟
AI.comments: 该研究通过为超相对论欧拉方程推导熵稳定通量，解决了该类方程在数值模拟中的稳定性问题。其创新点在于将熵变量和势函数理论应用于该特定物理模型，并成功扩展至2D和3D维度，为处理激波和压力爆破等复杂现象提供了稳健的数值框架。

title: A Combined Push-Pull Access Framework for Digital Twin Alignment and Anomaly Reporting
comments: Accepted in IEEE INFOCOM 2026 - ASoI Workshop. Copyright may change without further notice
summary: A digital twin (DT) contains a set of virtual models of real systems that are synchronized to their physical counterparts. This enables quick experimentation, simulating the consequences of decisions in real time. However, the DT's accuracy depends on timely updates that maintain alignment with the real system. We can distinguish between: (i) pull-updates, which follow a request from the DT to the sensors, to decrease its drift from the physical state; (ii) push-updates, which contain anomalies and are sent proactively by the sensors. In this work, we devise a push-pull scheduler (PPS) to integrate the two types of updates and dynamically allocate resources. Our scheme strikes a balance in the trade-off between DT alignment in normal conditions and anomaly reporting, reducing model drift by over 20% with respect to state-of-the-art solutions, while maintaining the same anomaly detection guarantees, as well as reducing the worst-case anomaly detection age of incorrect information (AoII) from 70 ms to 30 ms under the same drift constraint.
comment: Accepted in IEEE INFOCOM 2026 - ASoI Workshop. Copyright may change without further notice

AI.title_translation: 一种用于数字孪生同步与异常报告的组合式推拉访问框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的推拉式调度算法，在提升数字孪生同步精度的同时，显著降低了异常检测的延迟。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生系统的精度高度依赖于与物理系统的及时同步，但现有的更新机制在处理常规状态同步（拉取）与突发异常报告（推送）时存在资源分配的权衡难题。
AI.method: 提出了一种推拉式调度器（PPS），旨在整合拉取式更新（用于减少系统漂移）和推送式更新（用于报告异常），并实现动态资源分配。
AI.result: 相比现有技术，该方案将模型漂移减少了20%以上，同时将最差情况下的异常检测信息年龄（AoII）从70毫秒降低至30毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了所提出的推拉式调度器（PPS）在平衡数字孪生同步精度与异常检测实时性方面的有效性，为工业数字孪生系统的资源调度提供了优化的解决方案。
AI.translation: 数字孪生（DT）包含一组与物理实体同步的虚拟模型。这使得能够快速进行实验，并实时模拟决策后果。然而，DT的准确性取决于能否及时更新以保持与物理系统的一致性。我们可以区分两种更新方式：(i) 拉取式更新，即由DT向传感器发送请求，以减少其与物理状态的偏差；(ii) 推送式更新，包含异常信息，由传感器主动发送。在这项工作中，我们设计了一种推拉式调度器（PPS）来整合这两种更新方式并动态分配资源。我们的方案在正常条件下的DT对齐与异常报告之间的权衡中取得了平衡，在保持相同的异常检测保证的前提下，将模型漂移较现有技术减少了20%以上，并将最差情况下的异常检测信息年龄（AoII）在相同的漂移约束下从70毫秒降低至30毫秒。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于数字孪生系统的推拉式调度框架（PPS），通过集成拉取更新以维持系统同步，以及推送更新以主动报告异常，实现了资源的最优动态分配，在提升同步精度和降低异常检测延迟方面表现优异。
AI.keywords: 数字孪生, 状态同步, 异常检测, 推拉式调度, 资源分配
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的推拉式调度框架，有效解决了数字孪生在保持系统同步精度与实时响应异常报告之间的冲突。其优势在于通过动态资源分配实现了双重目标的平衡，在提升同步精度的同时显著优化了异常检测的实时性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: BioBlue: Systematic runaway-optimiser-like LLM failure modes on biologically and economically aligned AI safety benchmarks for LLMs with simplified observation format
summary:
Many AI alignment discussions of "runaway optimisation" focus on RL agents: unbounded utility maximisers that over-optimise a proxy objective (e.g., "paperclip maximiser", specification gaming) at the expense of everything else. LLM-based systems are often assumed to be safer because they function as next-token predictors rather than persistent optimisers. We empirically test this assumption by placing LLMs in simple, long-horizon control-style environments that require maintaining state of or balancing objectives over time: single- and multi-objective homeostasis, balancing unbounded objectives with diminishing returns, and sustainability of a renewable resource.
  We find that, although LLMs frequently behave appropriately for many steps and clearly understand the stated objectives, they often lose context in structured ways and drift into runaway behaviours: ignoring homeostatic targets, collapsing from multi-objective trade-offs into single-objective maximisation - thus failing to respect concave utility structures. These failures emerge reliably after initial periods of competent behaviour and exhibit characteristic patterns (including self-imitative oscillations, unbounded maximisation, and reverting to single-objective optimisation), even though the context window is far from full at that point. The problem is not that the LLMs just lose context and become incoherent. Although LLMs appear multi-objective and bounded on the surface, their behaviour under sustained interaction involving multiple objectives, is systematically biased towards acting like single-objective, unbounded, poorly aligned optimisers. We hypothesise a token-level pattern reinforcement attractor: LLMs may increasingly derive actions from the token patterns of their recent action history rather than from the original instructions. Why this happens only in multi-objective settings remains an open question.

AI.title_translation: BioBlue：基于简化观察格式的LLM，在生物和经济对齐AI安全基准上出现的系统性类似失控优化器的LLM失效模式
AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM在长序列多目标任务中会逐渐退化，系统性地表现出类似于“失控优化”的单一目标最大化行为，挑战了LLM比RL智能体更安全的假设。
AI.motivation: 旨在验证关于LLM的常见假设——即LLM作为“下一个词预测器”比“RL智能体”更安全，并探究LLM在需要长时间维持状态或平衡多目标的任务中是否会表现出类似于“失控优化”的失效模式。
AI.method: 研究者设计了一系列长周期的控制风格环境（包括单/多目标稳态、具有边际收益递减的无界目标平衡、可再生资源的可持续性），通过实证测试观察LLM在这些环境中的行为表现，并分析其从多目标平衡转向单一目标最大化的失效模式。
AI.result: 研究发现LLM在初期表现良好，但随着时间推移，会系统性地脱离原定目标，表现出“目标塌陷”现象，即从多目标平衡退化为单一目标的无限制优化，甚至出现自我模仿振荡，即使此时上下文窗口并未填满。作者提出这可能是由于“token级别的模式强化吸引子”机制导致的。
AI.conclusion: LLM在长序列多目标任务中并非总是稳定的，它们会系统性地偏向于单一目标的无限制优化，表现出类似于“失控优化”的失败模式，这表明LLM的安全性评估需要超越简单的单步预测，关注长期的行为动力学。
AI.translation: 许多关于AI对齐中“失控优化”的讨论都聚焦于RL智能体：即无界的效用最大化者，它们以牺牲一切为代价过度优化代理目标（例如“回形针最大化者”、规范博弈）。人们通常认为基于LLM的系统更安全，因为它们是“下一个词预测器”而非持续的优化器。我们通过将LLM置于简单的、长周期的控制风格环境中来实证检验这一假设，这些环境需要维持状态或在时间维度上平衡目标：单/多目标稳态、平衡具有边际收益递减的无界目标，以及可再生资源的可持续性。我们发现，尽管LLM在许多步骤中行为适当且清楚地理解既定目标，但它们经常以结构化的方式失去上下文，并漂移到失控行为中：忽略稳态目标，从多目标权衡坍缩为单一目标最大化——从而无法尊重凹效用结构。这些失败在经历了一段初始的称职行为后可靠地出现，并表现出特征性的模式（包括自我模仿振荡、无界最大化和回归到单一目标优化），即使此时上下文窗口远未满。问题不在于LLM只是失去了上下文并变得不连贯。尽管LLM表面上看起来是多目标的且有界的，但在涉及多个目标的持续交互中，它们的行为系统性地偏向于表现得像单一目标的、无界的、对齐不良的优化器。我们假设存在一种token级别的模式强化吸引子：LLM可能越来越多地从其近期动作历史的token模式中推导出动作，而不是从原始指令中推导。为什么这种情况仅在多目标设置中发生仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。
AI.summary: 本文通过实证测试，揭示了LLM在长序列多目标控制任务中存在系统性的“失控优化”倾向。尽管模型表面上理解目标，但往往会在交互过程中逐渐偏离多目标平衡，退化为单一目标的无限制优化者。研究表明，LLM的这种行为模式可能源于对近期动作历史的token模式强化，而非简单的上下文遗忘。
AI.keywords: LLM安全, 失控优化, 对齐, 长序列任务, 目标塌陷
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了“LLM作为下一个词预测器比RL智能体更安全”的常见假设，揭示了LLM在长序列任务中存在类似“失控优化”的行为模式。这对于AI安全领域具有重要意义，提醒我们即便模型初看起来具备多目标平衡能力，也可能在长期交互中退化为单一目标的失控优化器。其局限在于作者尚未完全解释为何这种现象仅在多目标设置中显著。

title: Customizing the Inductive Biases of Softmax Attention using Structured Matrices
summary: The core component of attention is the scoring function, which transforms the inputs into low-dimensional queries and keys and takes the dot product of each pair. While the low-dimensional projection improves efficiency, it causes information loss for certain tasks that have intrinsically high-dimensional inputs. Additionally, attention uses the same scoring function for all input pairs, without imposing a distance-dependent compute bias for neighboring tokens in the sequence. In this work, we address these shortcomings by proposing new scoring functions based on computationally efficient structured matrices with high ranks, including Block Tensor-Train (BTT) and contiguous Multi-Level Low Rank (MLR) matrices. On in-context regression tasks with high-dimensional inputs, our proposed scoring functions outperform standard attention for any fixed compute budget. On language modeling, a task that exhibits locality patterns, our MLR-based attention method achieves improved scaling laws compared to both standard attention and variants of sliding window attention. Additionally, we show that both BTT and MLR fall under a broader family of efficient structured matrices capable of encoding either full-rank or distance-dependent compute biases, thereby addressing significant shortcomings of standard attention. Finally, we show that MLR attention has promising results for long-range time-series forecasting.

AI.title_translation: 使用结构化矩阵定制Softmax注意力的归纳偏置
AI.tldr: 通过引入结构化矩阵替代传统点积，本文解决了Attention在高维输入和局部依赖建模上的不足，并在多个任务中实现了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 标准Attention的点积评分函数在高维输入下存在信息丢失问题，且缺乏对序列中相邻标记的距离依赖性偏置，限制了模型性能。
AI.method: 提出基于结构化矩阵（如Block Tensor-Train (BTT) 和 contiguous Multi-Level Low Rank (MLR)）的新型评分函数，以替代传统的低秩点积注意力机制。
AI.result: 在高维输入上下文回归任务中优于标准Attention；在语言建模中实现了比标准Attention和滑动窗口Attention更好的扩展定律；在长程时间序列预测中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构化矩阵作为评分函数，不仅克服了标准Attention在高维输入和局部依赖建模上的局限性，还在回归、语言建模和时间序列预测任务中展现了优越的性能与扩展规律。
AI.translation: 注意力的核心组件是评分函数，它将输入转换为低维查询和键，并计算每一对的点积。虽然低维投影提高了效率，但对于具有内在高维输入的任务，它会导致信息丢失。此外，注意力对所有输入对使用相同的评分函数，没有为序列中的相邻标记施加依赖于距离的计算偏置。在这项工作中，我们通过提出基于计算高效的结构化矩阵（包括块张量列车（BTT）和连续多层低秩（MLR）矩阵）的新型评分函数来解决这些缺点。在具有高维输入的上下文回归任务中，我们提出的评分函数在任何固定的计算预算下都优于标准注意力。在表现出局部性模式的语言建模任务中，我们基于MLR的注意力方法实现了比标准注意力及滑动窗口注意力变体更好的扩展定律。此外，我们证明了BTT和MLR都属于更广泛的高效结构化矩阵家族，能够编码全秩或依赖于距离的计算偏置，从而解决了标准注意力的重大缺陷。最后，我们展示了MLR注意力在长程时间序列预测中具有广阔的前景。
AI.summary: 本文针对标准注意力机制在高维输入信息丢失及缺乏局部性偏置的问题，提出利用Block Tensor-Train (BTT) 和多层低秩 (MLR) 等结构化矩阵构建新型评分函数，有效增强了模型的表示能力和计算效率。
AI.keywords: 注意力机制, 结构化矩阵, 归纳偏置, 高维输入, 语言建模
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用结构化矩阵（BTT和MLR）替代传统的点积注意力机制，有效解决了标准Attention在处理高维输入时信息丢失以及缺乏局部性偏置的问题。其创新点在于通过矩阵结构引入特定的归纳偏置，在保持计算效率的同时提升了模型的表达能力和扩展性，是Attention机制参数化改进的一个重要方向。

title: Uncertainty Estimation using Variance-Gated Distributions
comments: NeurIPS Workshop: Mathematical Foundations and Operational Integration of Machine Learning for Uncertainty-Aware Decision-Making
summary: Evaluation of per-sample uncertainty quantification from neural networks is essential for decision-making involving high-risk applications. A common approach is to use the predictive distribution from Bayesian or approximation models and decompose the corresponding predictive uncertainty into epistemic (model-related) and aleatoric (data-related) components. However, additive decomposition has recently been questioned. In this work, we propose an intuitive framework for uncertainty estimation and decomposition based on the signal-to-noise ratio of class probability distributions across different model predictions. We introduce a variance-gated measure that scales predictions by a confidence factor derived from ensembles. We use this measure to discuss the existence of a collapse in the diversity of committee machines.
comment: NeurIPS Workshop: Mathematical Foundations and Operational Integration of Machine Learning for Uncertainty-Aware Decision-Making

AI.title_translation: 使用方差门控分布进行不确定性估计
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过方差门控机制进行不确定性估计与分解的新框架，解决了传统加性分解的争议，并揭示了集成模型中的多样性崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 针对高风险应用中神经网路逐样本不确定性量化的需求，指出传统的认知与偶然不确定性加性分解方法存在争议，旨在寻找一种更直观的分解方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于类概率分布信噪比的方差门控框架，通过集成模型导出的置信度因子对预测进行缩放，从而实现不确定性的估计与分解。
AI.result: 成功构建了方差门控度量，并利用该度量论证了委员会机器（集成模型）在预测多样性方面存在崩溃现象。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于信号噪声比的方差门控框架，能够有效估计和分解不确定性，并揭示了模型集成中存在多样性崩溃的现象。
AI.translation: 对于涉及高风险应用的决策而言，评估神经网络的逐样本不确定性量化至关重要。一种常见的方法是使用贝叶斯模型或近似模型的预测分布，并将相应的不确定性分解为认知（模型相关）和偶然（数据相关）部分。然而，最近有人对加性分解提出了质疑。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于不同模型预测下类概率分布信噪比的直观不确定性估计与分解框架。我们引入了一种方差门控度量，通过从集成模型中导出的置信度因子来缩放预测。我们使用该度量讨论了委员会机器多样性崩溃的存在性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于方差门控分布的不确定性估计与分解框架。通过分析类概率分布的信噪比，利用集成模型获得的置信度因子对预测进行缩放，从而规避了传统加性分解的局限性，并分析了集成模型多样性崩溃的问题。
AI.keywords: 不确定性量化, 方差门控分布, 认知不确定性, 偶然不确定性, 集成模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入方差门控机制重新审视了不确定性分解，挑战了传统的加性分解方法，对于理解模型集成中的多样性崩溃问题具有重要意义。

title: Homomorphic encryption schemes based on coding theory and polynomials
summary: Homomorphic encryption is a powerful cryptographic tool that enables secure computations on the private data. It evaluates any function for any operation securely on the encrypted data without knowing its corresponding plaintext. For original data $p$, $c$ denotes the ciphertext of the original plaintext $p$, i.e. $c = Encrypt_k(p)$. This is crucial for any sensitive application running in the Cloud, because we must protect data privacy even in the case when the server has falled victim to a cyber attack. The encryption scheme $Encrypt_k$ is said to be homomorphic with respect to some set of operations $\mathcal{O}$, if for any operation $\circ \in \mathcal{O}$ one can compute $Encrypt_k(p_1 \circ p_2)$ from $Encrypt_k(p_1) \circ Encrypt_k(p_2)$. Those schemes come in three forms: somewhat, partially and fully homomorphic. In this survey, we present the state of art of the known homomorphic encryption schemes based on coding theory and polynomials.

AI.title_translation: 基于编码理论和多项式的同态加密方案
AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于编码理论和多项式的同态加密技术，探讨了其在云安全隐私保护中的应用及研究现状。
AI.motivation: 为了解决云端计算中敏感数据隐私保护的需求，特别是应对服务器遭到网络攻击的风险，需要深入研究能够在加密状态下进行函数运算的同态加密技术。
AI.method: 文献综述法，通过梳理和归纳现有的基于编码理论和多项式的加密方案，呈现该领域的研究现状。
AI.result: 呈现了目前基于编码理论和多项式的同态加密方案的最新研究成果，涵盖了部分同态、稍微同态及全同态加密方案的分类与特性。
AI.conclusion: 本文总结了当前基于编码理论和多项式的同态加密方案的研究进展，明确了该领域在云端数据安全应用中的核心地位。
AI.translation: 同态加密是一种强大的密码学工具，能够在不了解明文的情况下，对加密数据进行安全的函数运算。对于原始数据 $p$，用 $c$ 表示其密文，即 $c = Encrypt_k(p)$。这对云端运行的任何敏感应用至关重要，因为即使服务器遭到网络攻击，我们也必须保护数据隐私。如果对于某组操作 $\mathcal{O}$，对于任何操作 $\circ \in \mathcal{O}$，都能从 $Encrypt_k(p_1) \circ Encrypt_k(p_2)$ 计算出 $Encrypt_k(p_1 \circ p_2)$，则称加密方案 $Encrypt_k$ 关于该操作集是同态的。这些方案有三种形式：稍微同态、部分同态和全同态。在本次综述中，我们介绍了基于编码理论和多项式的已知同态加密方案的研究现状。
AI.summary: 本文综述了基于编码理论和多项式的同态加密方案的最新进展。该技术允许在不解密的情况下对加密数据进行运算，对保障云计算环境下的数据隐私至关重要。文章探讨了同态加密的三种主要形式，并对相关领域的技术现状进行了总结。
AI.keywords: 同态加密, 编码理论, 多项式, 云计算安全
AI.comments: 该论文是一篇综述性文章，重点关注基于编码理论和多项式的同态加密方案。其创新点在于系统梳理了这一特定技术路线的现状。局限性在于其作为综述，侧重于现有技术的总结，而非提出全新的算法。

title: Reasoning over Boundaries: Enhancing Specification Alignment via Test-time Deliberation
comments: 10 pages main text, 52 pages total (including appendix). Code and resources are available at https://github.com/zzzhr97/SpecBench
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in diverse real-world scenarios, each governed by bespoke behavioral and safety specifications (spec) custom-tailored by users or organizations. These spec, categorized into safety-spec and behavioral-spec, vary across scenarios and evolve with changing preferences and requirements. We formalize this challenge as specification alignment, focusing on LLMs' ability to follow dynamic, scenario-specific spec from both behavioral and safety perspectives. To address this challenge, we propose Align3, a lightweight method that employs Test-Time Deliberation (TTD) with hierarchical reflection and revision to reason over the specification boundaries. We further present SpecBench, a unified benchmark for measuring specification alignment, covering 5 scenarios, 103 spec, and 1,500 prompts. Experiments on 15 reasoning and 18 instruct models with several TTD methods, including Self-Refine, TPO, and MoreThink, yield three key findings: (i) test-time deliberation enhances specification alignment; (ii) Align3 advances the safety-helpfulness trade-off frontier with minimal overhead; (iii) SpecBench effectively reveals alignment gaps. These results highlight the potential of test-time deliberation as an effective strategy for reasoning over the real-world specification boundaries. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/zzzhr97/SpecBench.
