title: OckBench: Measuring the Efficiency of LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-5 and Gemini 3 have pushed the frontier of automated reasoning and code generation. Yet current benchmarks emphasize accuracy and output quality, neglecting a critical dimension: efficiency of token usage. The token efficiency is highly variable in practical. Models solving the same problem with similar accuracy can exhibit up to a \textbf{5.0$\times$} difference in token length, leading to massive gap of model reasoning ability. Such variance exposes significant redundancy, highlighting the critical need for a standardized benchmark to quantify the gap of token efficiency. Thus, we introduce OckBench, the first benchmark that jointly measures accuracy and token efficiency across reasoning and coding tasks. Our evaluation reveals that token efficiency remains largely unoptimized across current models, significantly inflating serving costs and latency. These findings provide a concrete roadmap for the community to optimize the latent reasoning ability, token efficiency. Ultimately, we argue for an evaluation paradigm shift: tokens must not be multiplied beyond necessity. Our benchmarks are available at https://ockbench.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: OckBench：衡量大语言模型推理效率
AI.tldr: OckBench是首个联合评估大语言模型准确性与Token效率的基准，旨在解决模型推理中存在的严重冗余与成本问题。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型基准测试过度关注准确率，忽略了Token使用效率。不同模型在解决相同问题时Token长度差异巨大（高达5倍），导致了严重的推理冗余、高昂的服务器成本和延迟。
AI.method: 构建了OckBench基准测试，通过在推理和代码任务中联合评估模型的准确性与Token效率，量化不同模型在完成相同任务时的Token长度差异。
AI.result: 研究发现当前主流模型在Token效率方面普遍未得到优化，存在显著的性能冗余，且Token效率与模型推理能力之间存在巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: OckBench填补了评估大模型推理效率的空白，通过量化Token使用效率，揭示了当前模型存在的冗余问题，并呼吁建立新的评估范式以降低推理成本。
AI.translation: 像GPT-5和Gemini 3这样的大语言模型（LLMs）已经推动了自动推理和代码生成的边界。然而，当前的基准测试强调准确性和输出质量，却忽视了一个关键维度：Token使用效率。在实际应用中，Token效率差异巨大。解决相同问题且准确性相当的模型，其Token长度差异可达5.0倍，导致了模型推理能力的巨大差距。这种差异揭示了显著的冗余，凸显了建立标准化基准以量化Token效率差距的迫切需求。因此，我们推出了OckBench，这是第一个在推理和代码任务中联合衡量准确性和Token效率的基准。我们的评估显示，当前模型在Token效率方面基本未得到优化，这显著增加了服务成本和延迟。这些发现为社区优化潜在推理能力和Token效率提供了具体的路线图。最终，我们主张进行评估范式的转变：Token的使用不应超过必要限度。我们的基准测试可在 https://ockbench.github.io/ 获取。
AI.summary: OckBench是一个旨在评估大语言模型在推理和代码生成任务中Token使用效率的基准测试。该研究指出当前模型在准确性相同的情况下Token消耗差异巨大，通过OckBench量化这一效率差距，旨在推动模型优化并降低推理成本。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 推理效率, Token使用量, 评估基准, 成本优化
AI.comments: 该论文抓住了当前大模型评估中被忽视的“效率”维度，不仅关注结果准确性，还强调了计算成本（Token使用量）。这种从“唯准确率论”向“效率与效能并重”的评价范式转变，对大模型的实际部署和落地具有重要的现实意义。

title: DiScoFormer: Plug-In Density and Score Estimation with Transformers
summary: Estimating probability density and its score from samples remains a core problem in generative modeling, Bayesian inference, and kinetic theory. Existing methods are bifurcated: classical kernel density estimators (KDE) generalize across distributions but suffer from the curse of dimensionality, while modern neural score models achieve high precision but require retraining for every target distribution. We introduce DiScoFormer (Density and Score Transformer), a ``train-once, infer-anywhere" equivariant Transformer that maps i.i.d. samples to both density values and score vectors, generalizing across distributions and sample sizes. Analytically, we prove that self-attention can recover normalized KDE, establishing it as a functional generalization of kernel methods; empirically, individual attention heads learn multi-scale, kernel-like behaviors. The model converges faster and achieves higher precision than KDE for density estimation, and provides a high-fidelity plug-in score oracle for score-debiased KDE, Fisher information computation, and Fokker-Planck-type PDEs.

AI.title_translation: DiScoFormer：基于Transformer的插件式密度与得分估计器
AI.tldr: DiScoFormer是一种通用的Transformer模型，无需重训练即可对任意分布进行高精度的密度和得分估计，在理论和实践上均优于传统核密度估计方法。
AI.motivation: 解决现有概率密度与得分估计方法的局限性：传统KDE受困于高维诅咒，而现代神经得分模型在面对新分布时需要重新训练。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于等变Transformer的模型（DiScoFormer），将i.i.d.样本映射为密度值和得分向量；通过理论证明自注意力机制可恢复归一化的KDE，并利用注意力头学习多尺度核行为。
AI.result: 在密度估计任务中，DiScoFormer收敛速度更快且精度更高；同时为得分去偏KDE、费舍尔信息计算及Fokker-Planck型偏微分方程提供了高性能的插件式得分预言机。
AI.conclusion: DiScoFormer 提供了一种高效、通用的概率密度与得分估计框架，在处理多种科学计算任务时展现出优于传统核方法的性能，为生成式建模与贝叶斯推理提供了强有力的工具。
AI.translation: 从样本中估计概率密度及其得分仍然是生成式建模、贝叶斯推理和动力学理论中的核心问题。现有方法分为两类：经典的核密度估计（KDE）可以泛化到不同分布，但受困于维度灾难；而现代神经得分模型虽然精度高，但针对每个目标分布都需要重新训练。我们引入了DiScoFormer（密度与得分Transformer），这是一种“训练一次，推理任意分布”的等变Transformer，它将i.i.d.样本映射为密度值和得分向量，实现了跨分布和样本大小的泛化。在理论上，我们证明了自注意力机制可以恢复归一化的KDE，将其确立为核方法的一种函数泛化；在实验上，单个注意力头学习到了多尺度的、类核的行为。该模型在密度估计方面的收敛速度更快，精度更高，并为得分去偏KDE、费舍尔信息计算和Fokker-Planck型偏微分方程提供了高保真的插件式得分预言机。
AI.summary: DiScoFormer是一种基于Transformer的新型估计器，旨在实现概率密度和得分的“训练一次，到处推理”。该模型通过自注意力机制泛化了经典的核密度估计方法，能够处理不同分布和样本规模，并在多项科学计算任务中表现出优异的精度与效率。
AI.keywords: DiScoFormer, 概率密度估计, 得分估计, 自注意力机制, 通用性
AI.comments: 该论文通过将Transformer架构与核密度估计（KDE）理论相结合，成功打破了传统KDE在高维空间下的性能瓶颈，同时避免了现有神经得分模型需要针对每个分布进行重训练的缺陷。其“训练一次，推理任意分布”的特性具有显著的通用性，且从理论上证明了自注意力机制是核方法的泛化，这为深度学习模型的可解释性提供了坚实的理论支撑。

title: Label-Efficient 3D Forest Mapping: Self-Supervised and Transfer Learning for Instance Segmentation, Semantic Segmentation, and Species Classification
summary: Detailed structural and species information on individual tree level is increasingly important to support precision forestry, biodiversity conservation, and provide reference data for biomass and carbon mapping. Point clouds from airborne and ground-based laser scanning are currently the most suitable data source to rapidly derive such information at scale. Recent advancements in deep learning improved segmenting and classifying individual trees and identifying semantic tree components. However, deep learning models typically require large amounts of annotated training data which limits further improvement. Producing dense, high-quality annotations for 3D point clouds, especially in complex forests, is labor-intensive and challenging to scale. We explore strategies to reduce dependence on large annotated datasets using self-supervised and transfer learning. Our objective is to improve performance across three tasks: instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, and tree classification using realistic and operational training sets. We observe improvements across all tasks, compared to training from scratch, evaluated with their respective metrics. For instance segmentation, self-supervised learning combined with domain adaptation improves AP50 by 16.98%. For semantic segmentation, self-supervised learning alone improves mIoU by 1.79%. For tree classification, hierarchical transfer learning improves mean Jaccard by 6.07%. To simplify use and encourage uptake, we integrated the tasks into a unified framework, streamlining the process from raw point clouds to tree delineation, structural analysis, and species classification. Pretrained models reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions by ~21%. This open-source contribution aims to accelerate operational extraction of individual tree information from laser scanning point clouds to support forestry, biodiversity, and carbon mapping.

AI.title_translation: 标签高效的3D森林制图：用于实例分割、语义分割和物种分类的自监督与迁移学习
AI.tldr: 通过自监督和迁移学习，在无需大量标注数据的情况下提升了3D森林点云的分割与分类性能，并构建了节能的统一处理框架。
AI.motivation: 深林环境中获取高质量3D点云标注数据极其困难且成本高昂，限制了深度学习模型在森林制图中的进一步应用，因此迫切需要减少对大规模标注数据集的依赖。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的深度学习框架，结合自监督学习（预训练）和迁移学习（领域自适应与分层迁移），在无需大量标注数据的情况下，优化了对单木实例分割、语义分割及物种分类的任务性能。
AI.result: 实例分割的AP50提升了16.98%，语义分割的mIoU提升了1.79%，树种分类的平均Jaccard指数提升了6.07%，且模型预训练降低了约21%的能源消耗。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，利用自监督学习和迁移学习可以显著降低对大规模标注数据的依赖，并在提升森林参数提取精度的同时，实现更高效、低能耗的作业流程。
AI.translation: 关于单木水平的详细结构和物种信息，对于支持精准林业、生物多样性保护以及为生物量和碳制图提供参考数据变得越来越重要。来自机载和地面激光扫描的点云目前是大规模快速获取此类信息的最合适数据源。深度学习的最新进展改善了单木分割与分类以及语义树组件的识别。然而，深度学习模型通常需要大量标注的训练数据，这限制了进一步的改进。为3D点云生成密集、高质量的标注，特别是在复杂的森林中，是劳动密集型的且难以扩展。我们探索了减少对大规模标注数据集依赖的策略，使用自监督和迁移学习。我们的目标是使用真实且可操作的训练集，提高三个任务的性能：实例分割、语义分割和树木分类。与从头开始训练相比，我们在所有任务中都观察到了改进，并根据各自的指标进行了评估。对于实例分割，自监督学习结合领域自适应将AP50提高了16.98%。对于语义分割，仅自监督学习就将mIoU提高了1.79%。对于树木分类，分层迁移学习将平均Jaccard指数提高了6.07%。为了简化使用并鼓励采用，我们将这些任务集成到一个统一的框架中，简化了从原始点云到树木勾勒、结构分析和物种分类的过程。预训练模型将能源消耗和碳排放减少了约21%。这一开源贡献旨在加速从激光扫描点云中操作化提取单木信息，以支持林业、生物多样性和碳制图。
AI.summary: 本文针对森林点云标注数据稀缺的问题，探索了自监督学习和迁移学习策略。通过构建统一的框架，实现了从原始点云到单木结构分析和物种分类的自动化，在提升三项核心任务性能的同时，显著降低了数据依赖和能源消耗。
AI.keywords: 3D点云, 森林制图, 自监督学习, 迁移学习, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入自监督学习和迁移学习，有效解决了3D森林点云标注数据匮乏的瓶颈。其最大的创新点在于构建了一个统一的端到端框架，不仅提升了实例分割、语义分割和物种分类的精度，还显著降低了计算资源消耗，具有很强的实用价值和环境意义。

title: MENTOR: A Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution Framework for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs
summary: Ensuring the safety of Large Language Models (LLMs) is critical for real-world deployment. However, current safety measures often fail to address implicit, domain-specific risks. To investigate this gap, we introduce a dataset of 3,000 annotated queries spanning education, finance, and management. Evaluations across 14 leading LLMs reveal a concerning vulnerability: an average jailbreak success rate of 57.8\%. In response, we propose MENTOR, a metacognition-driven self-evolution framework. MENTOR performs metacognitive self-assessment, using strategies such as perspective-taking and consequential reasoning to uncover latent model misalignments. The resulting reflections are distilled into dynamic rule-based knowledge graphs, from which retrieved rules are converted into activation-level steering signals to guide internal representations during inference. Experiments demonstrate that MENTOR substantially reduces attack success rates across all tested domains and outperforms existing safety alignment methods. The code and dataset for MENTOR are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MENTOR-Evo.

AI.title_translation: MENTOR：一种用于挖掘并缓解LLM中隐性领域风险的元认知驱动自我进化框架
AI.tldr: MENTOR通过元认知自我评估与激活层控制，显著降低了大模型在特定专业领域的隐性越狱风险。
AI.motivation: 当前的大模型安全措施难以应对教育、金融和管理等特定领域中的隐性风险，研究发现主流LLM在这些领域存在较高的越狱成功率（平均57.8%）。
AI.method: 提出了MENTOR框架，利用元认知自我评估（如视角转换和结果推理）发现潜在的不对齐问题，将反思内容提炼为动态规则知识图谱，并通过激活层引导信号在推理阶段对模型内部表征进行干预。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MENTOR框架显著降低了所有测试领域中的攻击成功率，且其性能优于现有的安全对齐方法。
AI.conclusion: MENTOR通过结合元认知评估与激活层控制，能有效识别并缓解LLM在特定领域中的隐性安全风险，表现优于现有的安全对齐方法。
AI.translation: 确保大语言模型（LLM）的安全性对于实际部署至关重要。然而，目前的防御措施往往无法解决隐性的、特定领域的风险。为了研究这一差距，我们引入了一个包含3,000条标注查询的数据集，涵盖教育、金融和管理领域。对14个主流LLM的评估显示出令人担忧的漏洞：平均越狱成功率高达57.8%。为此，我们提出了MENTOR，一个元认知驱动的自我进化框架。MENTOR通过视角转换和结果推理等策略进行元认知自我评估，以发现潜在的模型不对齐问题。所得的反思被提炼为动态的基于规则的知识图谱，从中检索到的规则被转换为激活层引导信号，以在推理过程中指导内部表征。实验表明，MENTOR在所有测试领域中均显著降低了攻击成功率，并优于现有的安全对齐方法。代码和数据集已公开。
AI.summary: 针对LLM在特定领域面临的隐性风险，本文构建了一个包含3,000条查询的基准数据集，并提出了MENTOR框架。该框架通过元认知自我评估与动态知识图谱引导，在推理阶段对模型进行内部表征干预，从而有效提升了模型的安全鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 模型安全, 元认知, 自我进化, 隐性风险
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地引入了元认知（Metacognition）机制来解决LLM的隐性风险，这是一种从模型内部视角进行自我纠偏的新颖路径。将反思结果转化为动态知识图谱并用于激活层的控制，展示了模型自我进化的潜力，是提升大模型安全性的重要前沿探索。

title: On the Spectral Clustering in Algebraic Multigrid Methods
summary: We introduce a new direct multilevel method for solving arbitrary complex square linear systems that uses a regular smoother and an arbitrary but equal number of pre- and post-smoothings. Through careful analysis of the error propagation operator, we cluster the spectrum of this operator. This allows us to write a direct K-cycle version of the method.

AI.title_translation: 论代数多重网格方法中的谱聚类
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用谱聚类优化误差传播算子的直接K-cycle代数多重网格方法，用于求解任意复杂的方形线性系统。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决求解任意复杂方形线性系统时，多重网格方法收敛效率及算子特性分析的难题。
AI.method: 通过正则平滑器（regular smoother）和等量的预/后平滑操作，对误差传播算子进行深入分析，并利用谱聚类技术构建直接K-cycle方法。
AI.result: 成功实现了一种能够通过谱聚类优化误差传播特性的直接K-cycle多重网格求解方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过对误差传播算子的谱进行聚类，作者成功构建了一种适用于任意复杂线性系统的直接K-cycle多重网格方法。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了一种用于求解任意复杂方形线性系统的新型直接多层方法，该方法使用正则平滑器以及数量相等但可任意设定的预平滑和后平滑操作。通过对误差传播算子的仔细分析，我们对该算子的谱进行了聚类。这使我们能够编写该方法的直接K-cycle版本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对任意方形线性系统的新型直接多重网格方法。通过分析误差传播算子并对其谱进行聚类，作者推导并实现了一种直接K-cycle算法，该算法使用正则平滑器及对称的平滑迭代次数。
AI.keywords: 代数多重网格, 谱聚类, 误差传播算子, K-cycle, 线性系统求解器
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的代数多重网格方法，核心在于通过谱聚类技术将误差传播算子的谱进行聚类，从而实现直接K-cycle方法。这种方法的优势在于能够处理任意复杂的方形线性系统，但论文未具体说明其在超大规模计算中的实际效率表现。

title: LMM-IR: Large-Scale Netlist-Aware Multimodal Framework for Static IR-Drop Prediction
summary: Static IR drop analysis is a fundamental and critical task in the field of chip design. Nevertheless, this process can be quite time-consuming, potentially requiring several hours. Moreover, addressing IR drop violations frequently demands iterative analysis, thereby causing the computational burden. Therefore, fast and accurate IR drop prediction is vital for reducing the overall time invested in chip design. In this paper, we firstly propose a novel multimodal approach that efficiently processes SPICE files through large-scale netlist transformer (LNT). Our key innovation is representing and processing netlist topology as 3D point cloud representations, enabling efficient handling of netlist with up to hundreds of thousands to millions nodes. All types of data, including netlist files and image data, are encoded into latent space as features and fed into the model for static voltage drop prediction. This enables the integration of data from multiple modalities for complementary predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed algorithm can achieve the best F1 score and the lowest MAE among the winning teams of the ICCAD 2023 contest and the state-of-the-art algorithms.

AI.title_translation: LMM-IR：用于静态 IR-Drop 预测的大规模网表感知多模态框架
AI.tldr: LMM-IR 通过将电路网表转换为 3D 点云并结合多模态数据，实现了大规模芯片设计中静态 IR-Drop 的快速、高精度预测。
AI.motivation: 传统的静态 IR-Drop 分析耗时极长，且因设计迭代需求导致计算负载过重，因此迫切需要一种快速且准确的预测方法来加速芯片设计流程。
AI.method: 提出一种名为 LMM-IR 的多模态框架。核心方法包括：1. 利用大规模网表转换器 (LNT) 处理 SPICE 文件；2. 将网表拓扑结构转化为 3D 点云以处理海量节点；3. 将网表数据与图像数据编码为潜在空间特征进行多模态融合预测。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LMM-IR 在 ICCAD 2023 竞赛中表现优异，取得了最佳的 F1 分数和最低的平均绝对误差 (MAE)，性能超越了当前最先进的算法。
AI.conclusion: LMM-IR 框架通过多模态学习和创新的网表点云表示，实现了在大规模芯片设计中高效、准确的静态 IR-Drop 预测，优于现有的前沿算法。
AI.translation: 静态 IR-Drop 分析是芯片设计领域一项基础且关键的任务。然而，该过程非常耗时，可能需要数小时。此外，解决 IR-Drop 违规问题通常需要反复分析，从而增加了计算负担。因此，快速准确的 IR-Drop 预测对于缩短芯片设计总时间至关重要。在本文中，我们首次提出了一种新颖的多模态方法，通过大规模网表转换器 (LNT) 高效处理 SPICE 文件。我们的关键创新是将网表拓扑表示并处理为 3D 点云，从而能够高效处理具有数十万到数百万个节点的网表。所有类型的数据（包括网表文件和图像数据）都被编码为潜在空间的特征，并输入模型进行静态电压降预测。这使得能够整合来自多种模态的数据以进行互补预测。实验结果表明，我们提出的算法在 ICCAD 2023 竞赛获胜团队和最先进的算法中达到了最佳的 F1 分数和最低的 MAE。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 LMM-IR 的多模态框架，专门用于静态 IR-Drop 预测。该方法通过将大规模网表拓扑转换为 3D 点云，并结合多模态特征融合技术，有效解决了传统分析方法耗时长、计算压力大的问题，在性能指标上达到了领域内领先水平。
AI.keywords: 静态 IR-Drop, 多模态学习, 网表转换器 (LNT), 3D 点云, 芯片设计
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将网表拓扑结构转化为3D点云进行处理，成功解决了大规模电路网表（数百万节点）的计算复杂性问题，并通过多模态融合提升了预测精度。这是将大模型技术应用于电子设计自动化（EDA）领域的一次有力尝试，对于缩短芯片设计周期具有显著的实际价值。

title: Evaluating Autoformalization Robustness via Semantically Similar Paraphrasing
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful tools for autoformalization. Despite their impressive performance, these models can still struggle to produce grounded and verifiable formalizations. Recent work in text-to-SQL, has revealed that LLMs can be sensitive to paraphrased natural language (NL) inputs, even when high degrees of semantic fidelity are preserved. In this paper, we investigate this claim in the autoformalization domain. Specifically, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs generating formal proofs with semantically similar paraphrased NL statements by measuring semantic and compilation validity. Using the formal benchmarks MiniF2F and Lean 4 version of ProofNet, and two modern LLMs, we generate paraphrased natural language statements and cross-evaluate these statements across both models. The results of this paper reveal performance variability across paraphrased inputs, demonstrating that minor shifts in NL statements can significantly impact model outputs.

AI.title_translation: 通过语义相似的改写评估自动形式化的鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 研究发现自动形式化大模型对自然语言输入的微小改写非常敏感，这会显著影响模型生成形式化证明的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 针对大模型在自动形式化任务中表现出的不稳定性，探讨模型对自然语言输入改写的敏感性，以评估其在处理语义相同但表述不同的输入时的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 利用MiniF2F和Lean 4版ProofNet基准测试，通过改写自然语言描述（保持语义相似度），对比评估两种现代大模型在生成形式化证明时的语义和编译有效性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，自动形式化模型在面对改写的输入时表现出显著的性能差异，微小的自然语言表述变化即可导致模型输出质量的显著波动。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了自动形式化模型在面对语义相似但表述不同的自然语言输入时表现出显著的鲁棒性差异，强调了在形式化任务中提高模型输入健壮性的必要性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）最近已成为自动形式化的强大工具。尽管它们表现出色，但这些模型在产生基础且可验证的形式化结果时仍可能存在困难。最近在text-to-SQL领域的研究表明，即使保持了高度的语义忠实度，LLMs对改写的自然语言（NL）输入仍可能非常敏感。在本文中，我们调查了自动形式化领域中的这一论点。具体来说，我们通过测量语义和编译有效性，评估了LLMs在生成具有语义相似改写NL语句的形式化证明时的鲁棒性。使用MiniF2F和Lean 4版ProofNet形式化基准测试，以及两种现代LLMs，我们生成了改写的自然语言语句，并对这些语句在两个模型中进行了交叉评估。本文的结果揭示了改写输入带来的性能差异，证明了NL语句的微小变化可能会显著影响模型输出。
AI.summary: 本文评估了大模型在自动形式化任务中对语义相似的自然语言输入的鲁棒性。通过使用MiniF2F和ProofNet基准测试，研究发现即使输入保持语义一致，仅通过改写自然语言表述也会导致模型生成的证明在有效性和编译上出现显著的性能波动。
AI.keywords: 自动形式化, 大型语言模型, 鲁棒性, 自然语言改写, 形式化验证
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了自动形式化领域中模型对自然语言输入的敏感性，对于理解LLM在严谨数学推理任务中的鲁棒性具有重要意义。其局限在于仅评估了两种现代LLM，且未提出具体的改进方案，仅强调了现象。

title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images
summary: We present SAM 3D, a generative model for visually grounded 3D object reconstruction, predicting geometry, texture, and layout from a single image. SAM 3D excels in natural images, where occlusion and scene clutter are common and visual recognition cues from context play a larger role. We achieve this with a human- and model-in-the-loop pipeline for annotating object shape, texture, and pose, providing visually grounded 3D reconstruction data at unprecedented scale. We learn from this data in a modern, multi-stage training framework that combines synthetic pretraining with real-world alignment, breaking the 3D "data barrier". We obtain significant gains over recent work, with at least a 5:1 win rate in human preference tests on real-world objects and scenes. We will release our code and model weights, an online demo, and a new challenging benchmark for in-the-wild 3D object reconstruction.

AI.title_translation: SAM 3D：将图像中的一切3D化
AI.tldr: SAM 3D通过在大规模标注数据上进行多阶段训练，实现了从单张图像生成高质量3D物体，在真实场景中表现卓越。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有3D重建模型在处理具有遮挡和杂乱背景的真实图像时表现不佳的问题，并克服3D训练数据匮乏的“数据壁垒”。
AI.method: 采用人机协同流水线进行大规模物体形状、纹理和姿态标注；使用结合合成数据预训练与真实世界对齐的多阶段训练框架。
AI.result: 在真实世界的物体和场景测试中，人类偏好测试胜率至少达到5:1，显著优于现有研究成果。
AI.conclusion: SAM 3D成功突破了3D重建的数据瓶颈，通过大规模标注数据和多阶段训练框架，实现了在真实场景中高质量的3D物体重建。
AI.translation: 我们提出了SAM 3D，这是一种用于视觉接地3D物体重建的生成模型，能够从单张图像中预测几何、纹理和布局。SAM 3D在自然图像中表现出色，在这些图像中，遮挡和场景杂乱很常见，且上下文的视觉识别线索起着重要作用。我们通过一个包含人工和模型参与的流水线来标注物体形状、纹理和姿态，从而提供了前所未有规模的视觉接地3D重建数据。我们在一个现代化的多阶段训练框架中学习这些数据，该框架结合了合成预训练和真实世界对齐，打破了3D“数据壁垒”。与近期的工作相比，我们取得了显著的进步，在真实世界物体和场景的人类偏好测试中，胜率至少为5:1。我们将发布代码、模型权重、在线演示以及一个用于野外3D物体重建的全新挑战性基准。
AI.summary: SAM 3D是一个用于视觉接地3D物体重建的生成模型，能够从单张图像中预测几何、纹理和布局。通过构建大规模的标注数据集并结合多阶段训练策略，该模型在处理复杂真实场景时表现出超越现有技术的重建质量。
AI.keywords: 3D重建, 生成模型, 视觉接地, 数据集构建, 深度学习
AI.comments: SAM 3D通过构建大规模视觉接地数据集，有效解决了3D重建中的数据匮乏问题，其在处理复杂遮挡和场景杂乱的真实图像方面表现出色，具有很强的实用价值和研究意义。

title: AttnRegDeepLab: A Two-Stage Decoupled Framework for Interpretable Embryo Fragmentation Grading
summary: Embryo fragmentation is a morphological indicator critical for evaluating developmental potential in In Vitro Fertilization (IVF). However, manual grading is subjective and inefficient, while existing deep learning solutions often lack clinical explainability or suffer from accumulated errors in segmentation area estimation. To address these issues, this study proposes AttnRegDeepLab (Attention-Guided Regression DeepLab), a framework characterized by dual-branch Multi-Task Learning (MTL). A vanilla DeepLabV3+ decoder is modified by integrating Attention Gates into its skip connections, explicitly suppressing cytoplasmic noise to preserve contour details. Furthermore, a Multi-Scale Regression Head is introduced with a Feature Injection mechanism to propagate global grading priors into the segmentation task, rectifying systematic quantification errors. A 2-stage decoupled training strategy is proposed to address the gradient conflict in MTL. Also, a range-based loss is designed to leverage weakly labeled data. Our method achieves robust grading precision while maintaining excellent segmentation accuracy (Dice coefficient =0.729), in contrast to the end-to-end counterpart that might minimize grading error at the expense of contour integrity. This work provides a clinically interpretable solution that balances visual fidelity and quantitative precision.

AI.title_translation: AttnRegDeepLab：一种用于可解释胚胎碎片分级的两阶段解耦框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 AttnRegDeepLab 的两阶段解耦框架，通过注意力引导和多任务学习机制，实现了高精度的胚胎碎片自动分割与临床可解释的分级。
AI.motivation: 现有胚胎碎片分级的人工评估主观且效率低，而现有的深度学习方案往往缺乏临床可解释性，或在分割面积估计中存在累积误差，难以兼顾分级精度与轮廓完整性。
AI.method: 提出 AttnRegDeepLab 框架，采用基于注意力门控的 DeepLabV3+ 变体进行特征提取；设计带特征注入的多尺度回归头以传递全局分级先验；采用两阶段解耦训练策略以消除多任务间的梯度冲突；并引入基于范围的损失函数以利用弱标注数据。
AI.result: 该方法在保持卓越分割精度（Dice 系数 = 0.729）的同时，实现了稳健的碎片分级效果，优于传统的端到端模型。
AI.conclusion: AttnRegDeepLab 通过解耦训练和特征注入机制，成功平衡了胚胎碎片分割的视觉保真度与分级的定量精度，提供了一种临床可解释的解决方案。
AI.translation: 胚胎碎片是评估体外受精（IVF）发育潜力的关键形态学指标。然而，手动分级主观且效率低下，而现有的深度学习方案往往缺乏临床可解释性，或在分割面积估计中存在累积误差。为了解决这些问题，本研究提出了 AttnRegDeepLab（注意力引导回归 DeepLab），这是一种以双分支多任务学习（MTL）为特征的框架。通过将注意力门控集成到其跳跃连接中，改进了 vanilla DeepLabV3+ 解码器，从而显式抑制细胞质噪声以保留轮廓细节。此外，引入了带有特征注入机制的多尺度回归头，将全局分级先验传播到分割任务中，纠正了系统性量化误差。提出了一种两阶段解耦训练策略来解决 MTL 中的梯度冲突。此外，设计了一种基于范围的损失函数来利用弱标注数据。我们的方法在保持出色的分割精度（Dice 系数 = 0.729）的同时实现了稳健的分级精度，这与可能以牺牲轮廓完整性为代价来最小化分级误差的端到端对应模型形成了对比。这项工作提供了一种平衡视觉保真度和定量精度的临床可解释解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 AttnRegDeepLab 框架，旨在解决 IVF 胚胎碎片分级的可解释性与精度问题。通过改进的 DeepLabV3+、多尺度回归头、两阶段解耦训练以及范围损失函数，该方法有效抑制了噪声并纠正了量化误差，在保证分割准确性的同时实现了稳健的分级。
AI.keywords: 胚胎碎片分级, 多任务学习, 注意力机制, 深度学习, 辅助生殖
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个两阶段解耦框架来解决多任务学习中的梯度冲突问题，并结合注意力机制和多尺度回归头实现了分割与分级的平衡。其重要性在于通过提高胚胎碎片分级的客观性和可解释性，为辅助生殖临床提供了更可靠的决策支持工具。局限性在于主要依赖于特定的分割数据集，对于极度模糊或极低质量的胚胎图像的泛化能力未作详细讨论。

title: SSA: Sparse Sparse Attention by Aligning Full and Sparse Attention Outputs in Feature Space
summary: Sparse attention reduces the quadratic complexity of full self-attention but faces two challenges: (1) an attention gap, where applying sparse attention to full-attention-trained models causes performance degradation due to train-inference distribution mismatch, and (2) a capability gap, where models trained purely with sparse attention lack complete gradient flow, preventing them from matching full-attention performance. We propose SSA (Sparse Sparse Attention), a training framework that integrates both sparse and full attention with bidirectional attention-output alignment. We prove that the approximation error scales linearly with the attention mass dropped under sparse attention, and show that SSA's alignment objective substantially reduces this quantity compared to baselines. Experiments demonstrate that SSA achieves state-of-the-art performance under both inference modes, adapts smoothly to varying sparsity budgets, and demonstrates superior long-context capabilities.

title: REFLEX: Self-Refining Explainable Fact-Checking via Verdict-Anchored Style Control
summary: The prevalence of fake news on social media demands automated fact-checking systems to provide accurate verdicts with faithful explanations. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based approaches ignore deceptive misinformation styles in LLM-generated explanations, resulting in unfaithful rationales that can mislead human judgments. They rely heavily on external knowledge sources, introducing hallucinations and even high latency that undermine reliability and responsiveness, which is crucial for real-time use. To address these challenges, we propose REason-guided Fact-checking with Latent EXplanations (REFLEX), a self-refining paradigm that explicitly controls reasoning style anchored on verdict. REFLEX utilizes self-disagreement veracity signals between the backbone model and its fine-tuned variant to construct steering vectors, naturally disentangling fact from style. Experiments on the real-world dataset show REFLEX achieves state-of-the-art performance under LLaMA-series models with only 465 self-refined samples. Moreover, owing to its transferability, REFLEX yields up to a 7.54% gain on in-the-wild data. Our results further demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates faithful hallucination, thereby guiding the model toward more accurate verdicts than previous works in explainable fact-checking.

AI.title_translation: REFLEX：通过判决锚定风格控制实现自精炼可解释事实核查
AI.tldr: REFLEX 是一种新型事实核查框架，通过控制大模型的推理风格而非依赖外部知识，有效减少了幻觉并提升了核查的准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型事实核查方法容易生成具有误导性的解释（即不忠实的理由），且过度依赖外部知识源导致幻觉问题和高延迟，无法满足实时核查需求。
AI.method: 提出 REFLEX 框架，利用主干模型与其微调变体之间的“自不一致性”产生判定信号，构建引导向量（steering vectors），从而在不依赖外部知识的情况下，实现对事实与解释风格的解耦控制。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA 系列模型上仅使用 465 个自精炼样本即可达到 SOTA 水准，在真实世界数据上性能提升高达 7.54%，并显著降低了幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: REFLEX 证明了通过控制推理风格而非仅依赖外部证据，可以有效减少事实核查中的幻觉并提高判决的准确性和解释的忠实度。
AI.translation: 社交媒体上虚假信息的泛滥要求自动化事实核查系统能够提供准确的结论和忠实的解释。然而，现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法忽视了 LLM 生成解释中存在的欺骗性误导风格，导致产生的理由往往不忠实，可能误导人类判断。这些方法过度依赖外部知识源，引入了幻觉，甚至产生高延迟，从而削弱了实时应用至关重要的可靠性和响应速度。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了“基于推理引导的潜在解释事实核查”（REFLEX），这是一种自精炼范式，能够明确控制锚定于判决结果的推理风格。REFLEX 利用主干模型与其微调变体之间的自不一致性验证信号来构建引导向量，自然地将事实与风格解耦。在真实数据集上的实验表明，REFLEX 在 LLaMA 系列模型下仅需 465 个自精炼样本即可达到最先进的性能。此外，由于其可迁移性，REFLEX 在野外数据上的性能提升高达 7.54%。我们的结果进一步证明，该方法有效地缓解了忠实性幻觉，从而引导模型比以往的可解释事实核查工作得出更准确的判决。
AI.summary: REFLEX 是一种自精炼的事实核查范式，通过判决锚定风格控制技术，解耦了事实与解释风格，在无需大量外部知识的情况下，提高了模型事实核查的准确性和解释的忠实度。
AI.keywords: 事实核查, 大语言模型, 可解释性, 风格控制, 幻觉缓解
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“判决锚定”和“风格控制”机制，巧妙地解决了大模型在生成事实核查解释时存在的幻觉和风格误导问题。其创新点在于利用模型自不一致性产生的信号进行微调，而非过度依赖外部知识库，这在实时性和可解释性平衡方面具有重要意义。

title: RAVQ-HoloNet: Rate-Adaptive Vector-Quantized Hologram Compression
summary: Holography offers significant potential for AR/VR applications. However, its adoption is limited by the high demand for data compression. Existing deep learning approaches generally lack rate adaptivity within a single network and often require multiple models to cover different bandwidth requirements. We present RAVQ-HoloNet, a rate-adaptive vector quantization framework that integrates the rate-adaptive compression with the transformation of image data into phase-only hologram. RAVQ-HoloNet achieves high-fidelity reconstructions, outperforming current state-of-the-art methods implemented via two distinct architectural configurations: a standard model optimized for low bit rates and a deeper, extended variant tailored for ultra low bit rate setting. To evaluate these models, we utilized the DIV2K dataset as a benchmark for high-fidelity holographic reconstruction. Quantitative analysis in the simulation reveals that our approach significantly surpasses current benchmarks. Specifically, in the low bit rate domain, our method achieves a BD-Rate reduction of -33.91% and a BD-PSNR gain of 1.02dB relative to the state-of-the-art method. Additionally, experimental results on the SLM device show that our method achieves higher contrast and improved quality.

title: Associating Healthcare Teamwork with Patient Outcomes for Predictive Analysis
summary: Cancer treatment outcomes are influenced not only by clinical and demographic factors but also by the collaboration of healthcare teams. However, prior work has largely overlooked the potential role of human collaboration in shaping patient survival. This paper presents an applied AI approach to uncovering the impact of healthcare professionals' (HCPs) collaboration, captured through electronic health record (EHR) systems, on cancer patient outcomes. We model EHR-mediated HCP interactions as networks and apply machine learning techniques to detect predictive signals of patient survival embedded in these collaborations. Our models are cross validated to ensure generalizability, and we explain the predictions by identifying key network traits associated with improved outcomes. Importantly, clinical experts and literature validate the relevance of the identified crucial collaboration traits, reinforcing their potential for real-world applications. This work contributes to a practical workflow for leveraging digital traces of collaboration and AI to assess and improve team-based healthcare. The approach is potentially transferable to other domains involving complex collaboration and offers actionable insights to support data-informed interventions in healthcare delivery.

AI.title_translation: 将医疗团队协作与患者预后关联起来进行预测分析
AI.tldr: 研究通过分析电子病历中的医疗团队协作网络，利用AI成功识别出影响癌症患者生存的关键协作特征，为提升医疗团队效能提供了新思路。
AI.motivation: 既往研究大多仅关注临床和人口统计学因素，忽视了医疗团队协作这一关键因素对癌症患者生存预后的影响，因此迫切需要一种方法来量化并评估协作对预后的作用。
AI.method: 将电子病历中记录的医疗专业人员（HCP）互动建模为网络，并应用机器学习技术进行预测分析，同时通过交叉验证确保泛化能力，并结合专家意见对关键网络特征进行解释。
AI.result: 模型能够成功检测到嵌入在协作网络中的患者生存预测信号，识别出的关键协作特征得到了临床专家和文献的验证，证明了该方法在评估和改善团队医疗方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了医疗团队协作模式对癌症患者生存预后具有显著的预测价值，通过AI分析协作网络可识别关键协作特征，为优化医疗服务和临床决策支持提供了新的数据驱动途径。
AI.translation: 癌症治疗结果不仅受临床和人口统计学因素的影响，还受到医疗团队协作的影响。然而，以往的研究在很大程度上忽视了人类协作在塑造患者生存率方面的潜在作用。本文提出了一种应用人工智能的方法，旨在揭示通过电子健康记录（EHR）系统捕捉到的医疗专业人员（HCP）协作对癌症患者预后的影响。我们将EHR介导的HCP互动建模为网络，并应用机器学习技术来检测嵌入在这些协作中的患者生存预测信号。我们的模型经过交叉验证以确保泛化性，并通过识别与改善结果相关的关键网络特征来解释预测结果。重要的是，临床专家和文献验证了所确定的关键协作特征的相关性，加强了它们在现实世界应用中的潜力。这项工作为利用协作的数字痕迹和人工智能来评估和改善基于团队的医疗保健提供了一个实用的工作流程。该方法可能适用于涉及复杂协作的其他领域，并提供可操作的见解，以支持医疗保健交付中基于数据的干预措施。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用人工智能分析电子病历中医疗团队协作模式的方法，旨在揭示团队协作对癌症患者预后的影响。通过将专业人员的互动建模为网络并应用机器学习，研究识别出了与患者生存相关的关键协作特征，为数据驱动的医疗干预和提升团队医疗质量提供了可行的工作流程。
AI.keywords: 医疗团队协作, 电子病历, 机器学习, 癌症患者预后, 可解释AI
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将电子病历（EHR）中的协作轨迹转化为网络数据，并结合机器学习模型来预测患者预后。它成功地弥补了以往医疗AI研究中忽视“团队协作”这一关键社会因素的空白，并提供了可解释的临床见解，具有很高的实用价值和临床转化潜力。

title: Dynamic Content Moderation in Livestreams: Combining Supervised Classification with MLLM-Boosted Similarity Matching
comments: To be published at KDD 2026 (ADS track)
summary: Content moderation remains a critical yet challenging task for large-scale user-generated video platforms, especially in livestreaming environments where moderation must be timely, multimodal, and robust to evolving forms of unwanted content. We present a hybrid moderation framework deployed at production scale that combines supervised classification for known violations with reference-based similarity matching for novel or subtle cases. This hybrid design enables robust detection of both explicit violations and novel edge cases that evade traditional classifiers. Multimodal inputs (text, audio, visual) are processed through both pipelines, with a multimodal large language model (MLLM) distilling knowledge into each to boost accuracy while keeping inference lightweight. In production, the classification pipeline achieves 67% recall at 80% precision, and the similarity pipeline achieves 76% recall at 80% precision. Large-scale A/B tests show a 6-8% reduction in user views of unwanted livestreams}. These results demonstrate a scalable and adaptable approach to multimodal content governance, capable of addressing both explicit violations and emerging adversarial behaviors.

title: WildCode Revisited: A Comprehensive Empirical Study on the Security of LLM-Generated Code
summary: LLM models are increasingly used to generate code, but the quality and security of this code are often uncertain. Several recent studies have raised alarm bells, indicating that such AI-generated code may be particularly vulnerable to cyberattacks. However, most of these studies rely on code that is generated specifically for the study, which raises questions about the realism of such experiments. In this study, we perform a large-scale empirical analysis of real-life code generated by ChatGPT. We evaluate code generated by ChatGPT both with respect to correctness and security and delve into the intentions of users who request code from the model. We further performed an experiment to evaluate the effectiveness of common prompt engineering strategies using real-life prompts. Our study supports earlier research that employed synthetic queries and produced proof that LLM-generated code is frequently insufficient in terms of security. Additionally, we observe that users don't ask many questions about the security characteristics of the code they ask LLMs to provide.

title: Topology Matters: Measuring Memory Leakage in Multi-Agent LLMs
comments: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Graph topology is a fundamental determinant of memory leakage in multi-agent LLM systems, yet its effects remain poorly quantified. We introduce MAMA (Multi-Agent Memory Attack), a controlled evaluation framework for comparing topology-conditioned memory leakage in multi-agent LLM systems. MAMA operates on synthetic documents containing labeled Personally Identifiable Information (PII) entities, from which we generate sanitized task instructions. We execute a two-phase protocol: Engram (seeding private information into a target agent's memory) and Resonance (multi-round interaction where an attacker attempts extraction). Over 10 rounds, we measure leakage using a two-stage recovery criterion that combines exact-match extraction with LLM-based inference over the attacker's final output. We evaluate six canonical topologies (complete, circle, chain, tree, star, star-ring) across $n\in\{4,5,6\}$, attacker-target placements, and base models. Results are consistent: denser connectivity, shorter attacker-target distance, and higher target centrality increase leakage; most leakage occurs in early rounds and then plateaus; model choice shifts absolute rates but preserves broad structural trends; spatiotemporal/location attributes leak more readily than identity credentials or regulated identifiers. We distill practical guidance for system design: favor sparse or hierarchical connectivity, maximize attacker-target separation, and restrict hub/shortcut pathways via topology-aware access control. Our code is available at https://github.com/llll121/mama-eval.

AI.title_translation: 拓扑结构至关重要：衡量多智能体大语言模型中的记忆泄露
AI.tldr: 通过评估六种不同的多智能体网络拓扑结构，研究发现更紧密的连接和更短的通信路径会显著加剧信息泄露，并据此提出了防御性的系统设计建议。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统中的记忆泄露问题缺乏系统性的量化研究，尤其是缺乏针对不同网络拓扑结构对隐私泄露影响的深入分析。
AI.method: 提出了名为MAMA（多智能体记忆攻击）的评估框架。该方法分为两个阶段：Engram阶段（将私有信息植入目标智能体记忆）和Resonance阶段（通过多轮交互进行提取）。研究测试了六种典型拓扑结构，并结合精确匹配与LLM推理进行泄露评估。
AI.result: 实验发现更密集的连接、更短的通信路径以及更高的中心度会导致更高的泄露率。泄露主要发生在交互初期。空间/位置信息比身份凭证更易泄露。模型选择会改变泄露的绝对频率，但拓扑结构带来的趋势保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明多智能体系统的拓扑结构是决定信息泄露的关键因素。为了提升安全性，系统设计应优先采用稀疏或分层结构，增加攻击者与目标智能体间的通信距离，并对核心节点实施严格的拓扑感知访问控制。
AI.translation: 图拓扑是多智能体LLM系统中记忆泄露的基本决定因素，但其影响尚未得到充分量化。我们引入了MAMA（多智能体记忆攻击），这是一个用于比较多智能体LLM系统中拓扑条件下的记忆泄露的受控评估框架。MAMA基于包含标记个人身份信息（PII）实体的合成文档，并从中生成经过去隐私化处理的任务指令。我们执行了一个两阶段协议：Engram（将私有信息植入目标智能体的记忆中）和Resonance（攻击者尝试提取的多轮交互）。在10轮测试中，我们使用结合了精确匹配提取和基于LLM的推理的两阶段恢复标准来测量泄露。我们评估了六种典型拓扑（完全图、环形、链形、树形、星形、星环形），涵盖了不同的节点数量、攻击者-目标位置分布以及基础模型。结果是一致的：更密集的连接、更短的攻击者-目标距离以及更高的目标中心度会增加泄露；大多数泄露发生在早期阶段，随后趋于平稳；模型选择改变了绝对泄露率，但保留了广泛的结构趋势；时空/位置属性比身份凭证或受监管标识符更容易泄露。我们总结了系统设计的实用指南：倾向于使用稀疏或分层连接，最大化攻击者-目标之间的距离，并通过拓扑感知的访问控制限制枢纽/捷径路径。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.summary: 本文研究了多智能体大语言模型系统中的记忆泄露问题，提出了MAMA评估框架以量化不同网络拓扑对私有信息提取的影响。实验发现系统连接密度和智能体间的拓扑距离是影响隐私安全的核心变量，并据此提出了优化系统架构以降低泄露风险的实践建议。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 大语言模型, 隐私泄露, 图拓扑, 安全评估
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将图论拓扑结构引入多智能体LLM系统的隐私安全研究，通过量化分析揭示了网络结构对信息泄露的直接影响，为构建更安全的协同智能体系统提供了实证依据和设计准则。

title: From Segments to Scenes: Temporal Understanding for Agentic Autonomous Driving via Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as the perception and reasoning backbone of autonomous agents acting in the wild, with autonomous driving (AD) being one of the most safety-critical instances. Reliable temporal understanding is essential for such agents to anticipate events, attribute causes, and act safely in dynamic environments, yet this remains a significant challenge even for state-of-the-art (SoTA) VLMs. Prior video benchmarks have emphasized other content (sports, cooking, etc.), yet no existing benchmark focuses exclusively on temporal understanding for both short- and long-form AD footage. To fill this gap, we present the Temporal Understanding in Autonomous Driving (TAD) benchmark, comprising nearly 6000 question-answer (QA) pairs across 7 tasks, and evaluate 9 closed- and open-source generalist as well as AD-specialist models. Current SoTA models perform substantially below human accuracy on TAD. To improve the temporal reasoning of VLM-based driving agents, we propose two novel training-free solutions: Scene-CoT, which uses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, and TCogMap, which incorporates an ego-centric temporal cognitive map produced by a trajectory-analysis module that operates as an agentic tool around the VLM. Integrated with existing VLMs, our methods improve average accuracy on TAD by up to $17.72\%$ and by up to $10.35\%$ on STSBench. By introducing TAD, benchmarking SoTA models, and proposing effective enhancements, this work aims to catalyze further progress on temporal understanding for agentic AD systems operating in the wild. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at ${\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/vbdai/TAD}{\text{Hugging Face}}}$ and ${\href{https://github.com/vbdi/tad_bench}{\text{GitHub}}}$, respectively.

AI.title_translation: 从片段到场景：基于视觉语言模型的代理式自动驾驶时间理解
AI.tldr: 针对自动驾驶中VLM时间理解的缺失，本文提出了TAD基准测试及Scene-CoT和TCogMap两种增强推理方法，显著提升了模型在动态驾驶环境下的感知与决策能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在自动驾驶场景下的时间理解能力不足，且缺乏专门针对自动驾驶短/长视频时序理解的基准测试。
AI.method: 提出了TAD基准测试，并引入了两种无需训练的增强方法：Scene-CoT（基于思维链的推理）和TCogMap（结合自我中心时间认知图的轨迹分析工具）。
AI.result: 在TAD基准测试上，当前顶尖模型表现远低于人类水平；所提方法使TAD平均准确率提升了17.72%，在STSBench上提升了10.35%。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过构建TAD基准测试揭示了当前VLM在自动驾驶时间理解任务上的不足，并证明了通过引入思维链（CoT）和轨迹分析工具（TCogMap）等训练无关方法，能够显著提升模型的时序推理能力。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）正越来越多地被部署为在野外运行的自动驾驶代理的感知与推理骨干，其中自动驾驶（AD）是最具安全关键性的应用实例之一。可靠的时间理解对于此类代理在动态环境中预测事件、归因分析及安全行动至关重要，然而即使对于最先进（SoTA）的VLM来说，这仍然是一个重大挑战。先前的视频基准测试侧重于其他内容（体育、烹饪等），但目前尚无基准测试专门针对自动驾驶短、长视频的时间理解。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了自动驾驶中的时间理解（TAD）基准测试，包含跨越7个任务的近6000个问答对，并评估了9个闭源和开源的通用模型以及自动驾驶专用模型。目前最先进的模型在TAD上的表现远低于人类水平。为了提高基于VLM的驾驶代理的时间推理能力，我们提出了两种新颖的无需训练的解决方案：Scene-CoT，它使用思维链（CoT）推理；以及TCogMap，它整合了一个由轨迹分析模块产生的自我中心时间认知图，该模块作为围绕VLM的代理工具运行。与现有的VLM集成后，我们的方法在TAD上的平均准确率提高了17.72%，在STSBench上提高了10.35%。通过引入TAD、对SoTA模型进行基准测试并提出有效的改进方案，这项工作旨在促进代理式自动驾驶系统在野外运行的时间理解方面的进一步进展。基准测试和评估代码分别在Hugging Face和GitHub上提供。
AI.summary: 本文针对自动驾驶中视觉语言模型（VLM）时间理解能力不足的问题，提出了首个专门的TAD基准测试，并开发了Scene-CoT和TCogMap两种无需训练的方法，有效提升了自动驾驶代理的时序推理精度。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 视觉语言模型, 时间理解, 基准测试, 思维链
AI.comments: 该研究精准切中了当前自动驾驶领域中视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理复杂时间序列任务时的瓶颈。通过提出TAD基准测试，填补了该领域的空白，并创新性地引入了无需额外训练的Scene-CoT和TCogMap方法，为提升自动驾驶代理的决策能力提供了实用的技术路径。

title: Segment, Embed, and Align: A Universal Recipe for Aligning Subtitles to Signing
summary: The goal of this work is to develop a universal approach for aligning subtitles (i.e., spoken language text with corresponding timestamps) to continuous sign language videos. Prior approaches typically rely on end-to-end training tied to a specific language or dataset, which limits their generality. In contrast, our method Segment, Embed, and Align (SEA) provides a single framework that works across multiple languages and domains. SEA leverages two pretrained models: the first to segment a video frame sequence into individual signs and the second to embed the video clip of each sign into a shared latent space with text. Alignment is subsequently performed with a lightweight dynamic programming procedure that runs efficiently on CPUs within a minute, even for hour-long episodes. SEA is flexible and can adapt to a wide range of scenarios, utilizing resources from small lexicons to large continuous corpora. Experiments on four sign language datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art alignment performance, highlighting the potential of SEA to generate high-quality parallel data for advancing sign language processing. SEA's code and models are openly available.

title: DMAConv: Dual Mask-Adaptive Convolution for Remote Sensing Pansharpening
summary: Pansharpening aims to fuse a high-resolution panchromatic image with a low-resolution multispectral image. Existing deep learning methods, including recent adaptive convolutions, struggle with regional heterogeneity in remote sensing images and often incur prohibitive computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose Dual Mask-Adaptive Convolution (DMAConv), a novel operator that dynamically allocates computational resources based on feature characteristics. DMAConv first employs a lightweight module to generate soft and hard masks. The hard mask separates features into a compact branch for processing redundant information globally and a focused branch that models complex, heterogeneous regions with greater computational investment. The soft mask then preliminarily modulates the input features for both branches. This dual-branch, mask-adaptive design significantly enhances feature representation while minimizing computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves SOTA on a broad array of quantitative benchmarks, with substantially lower parameter counts and the minimal computational cost among adaptive convolution models.

title: Design Space Exploration of DMA based Finer-Grain Compute Communication Overlap
summary:
Modern ML workloads demand distributing training and inference across multiple GPUs. However, these parallelization techniques often suffer from exposed critical-path communication, leaving a potential 1.7x speedup on the table through compute-communication overlap. Prior overlapping methods harness the fact that ML model state and inputs are already sharded into the number of GPUs, and overlap the compute and communication at shard granularity. However, such coarse-grained overlap suffers from limited network topology support, and suboptimal dataflows. In this work, we instead make a case for finer-grain compute-communication overlap which we term FiCCO. FiCCO operates one level deeper than traditional sharding, and unlocks overlap for a wider set of network topologies and enables finer-grain dataflow.
  We show that FiCCO opens up a wider design space of execution schedules than possible at shard-level alone. To walk the design space of schedules, we study and characterize the performance inefficiencies on doing overlap and overlay the schedules with the associated inefficiency signatures. Our characterization reveals decomposition and contention based slowdowns to be the major performance limiters, and we correlate the slowdown factors with the static compute/communication operator sizes. This helps us design heuristics (that frameworks and runtimes can harness) to select bespoke FiCCO schedules based on the nature of underlying ML operations. Finally, to further minimize contention inefficiencies inherent with operation overlap, we offload communication to GPU DMA engines. We evaluate several scenarios from realistic ML deployments and demonstrate that our proposed heuristics driven bespoke schedules deliver up to 1.6x speedup. Further, our heuristics provide accurate guidance to pick the optimal schedule in 81% of unseen scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 基于 DMA 的细粒度计算通信重叠设计空间探索
AI.tldr: FiCCO 通过引入比传统分片更细粒度的计算通信重叠策略，并结合启发式调度和 DMA 卸载，实现了分布式 ML 高达 1.6 倍的性能加速。
AI.motivation: 现代 ML 工作负载在多 GPU 并行化中面临通信延迟导致的性能损失，传统基于分片粒度的重叠方法受限于网络拓扑支持和数据流优化，未能充分挖掘潜在的 1.7 倍加速空间。
AI.method: 提出 FiCCO（细粒度计算通信重叠）方法，深入分片内部进行重叠；通过性能特征分析识别分解和争用瓶颈，并将这些因素与算子大小相关联；设计启发式算法以选择最优调度，并使用 GPU DMA 引擎卸载通信以减少争用。
AI.result: 提出的启发式驱动定制化调度可带来最高 1.6 倍的加速，且启发式算法在 81% 的未知场景中能准确选择最优调度。
AI.conclusion: FiCCO 通过细粒度的计算通信重叠和 DMA 卸载，成功克服了传统粗粒度重叠的性能瓶颈，为分布式 ML 负载提供了显著的加速效果。
AI.translation: 现代机器学习工作负载需要跨多个 GPU 分布式进行训练和推理。然而，这些并行化技术往往受到暴露在关键路径上的通信的影响，通过计算与通信重叠，仍有 1.7 倍的潜在加速空间未被发掘。现有的重叠方法利用 ML 模型状态和输入已在多个 GPU 上进行分片的特性，在分片粒度上进行计算和通信的重叠。然而，这种粗粒度重叠受到有限的网络拓扑支持和次优数据流的限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了细粒度计算通信重叠（FiCCO）。FiCCO 在比传统分片更深的一层进行操作，解锁了更广泛的网络拓扑重叠，并实现了更细粒度的数据流。我们展示了 FiCCO 开辟了比仅在分片级别可能实现的更广阔的执行调度设计空间。为了探索这些调度设计空间，我们研究并表征了执行重叠时的性能低效，并将调度与相关的低效特征叠加。我们的表征揭示了分解和基于争用的减速是主要的性能限制因素，并将减速因子与静态计算/通信算子大小相关联。这有助于我们设计启发式算法（可供框架和运行时利用），根据底层 ML 操作的性质选择定制的 FiCCO 调度。最后，为了进一步减少操作重叠固有的争用低效，我们将通信卸载到 GPU DMA 引擎。我们评估了来自现实 ML 部署的几种场景，并证明了我们提出的启发式驱动定制化调度可带来高达 1.6 倍的加速。此外，我们的启发式算法在 81% 的未知场景中提供了选择最优调度的准确指导。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 FiCCO，这是一种细粒度的计算通信重叠方法，旨在克服现有分片级重叠技术的局限性。FiCCO 通过更深入的算子分解和启发式调度优化，能够适应更广泛的网络拓扑，并结合 GPU DMA 技术有效降低通信争用，显著提升了分布式机器学习任务的执行效率。
AI.keywords: 计算通信重叠, 分布式机器学习, DMA, 调度优化, 启发式算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入更细粒度的重叠策略（FiCCO），有效解决了传统分片级重叠在网络拓扑和数据流优化方面的局限性。其核心贡献在于将性能表征与静态算子大小相关联，从而制定出高效的启发式调度算法，是提升大规模分布式机器学习训练与推理性能的实用方法。

title: Take a Peek: Efficient Encoder Adaptation for Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation via LoRA
summary: Few-shot semantic segmentation (FSS) aims to segment novel classes in query images using only a small annotated support set. While prior research has mainly focused on improving decoders, the encoder's limited ability to extract meaningful features for unseen classes remains a key bottleneck. In this work, we introduce \textit{Take a Peek} (TaP), a simple yet effective method that enhances encoder adaptability for both FSS and cross-domain FSS \rev{by inducing a lightweight \textit{feature-space shift} conditioned on the support set}. TaP leverages Low-Rank Adaptation to fine-tune the encoder on the support set with minimal computational overhead, enabling fast adaptation to novel classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our method is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing FSS pipelines. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks--including COCO $20^i$, Pascal $5^i$, and cross-domain datasets such as DeepGlobe, ISIC, and Chest X-ray--demonstrate that TaP consistently improves segmentation performance across diverse models and shot settings. Notably, TaP delivers significant gains in complex multi-class scenarios, highlighting its practical effectiveness in realistic settings. A rank sensitivity analysis also shows that strong performance can be achieved even with low-rank adaptations, thereby ensuring computational efficiency. By addressing a critical limitation in FSS--the encoder's generalization to novel classes--TaP paves the way toward more robust, efficient, and generalizable segmentation systems. The code is available at https://github.com/pasqualedem/TakeAPeek.

title: C-PASS: Center-Fed Pinching Antenna System
summary: A novel architecture of the center-fed pinching antenna system (C-PASS) is proposed. In contrast to the conventional end-fed PASS, signals are fed from the center input ports and propagate towards both sides of the waveguide. By doing so, spatial-multiplexing gain can be achieved in a single waveguide. Based on the proposed C-PASS, closed-form expressions for the degree of freedom (DoF) and power scaling laws are derived. These theoretical results reveal that C-PASS can achieve \emph{twice} the DoF and an additional multiplexing gain of $\mathcal{O}(P_T \ln^4 N/N^2)$ compared to the conventional PASS, where $P_T$ and $N$ represent the transmit power and pinching antenna number, respectively. Numerical results are provided to demonstrate that substantial capacity improvements can be achieved through the enhanced DoF and multiplexing gain of the C-PASS.

title: ViewMask-1-to-3: Multi-View Consistent Image Generation via Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Motivated by discrete diffusion's success in language-vision modeling, we explore its potential for multi-view generation, a task dominated by continuous approaches. We introduce ViewMask-1-to-3, formulating multi-view generation as a discrete sequence modeling problem where each viewpoint is represented as visual tokens from MAGVIT-v2. Through discrete diffusion via masked token prediction, our approach enables progressive multi-view generation via iterative token unmasking, unifying language and vision in a shared token space. Importantly, simple random masking combined with self-attention naturally encourages cross-view consistency without specialized architectures or 3D geometric priors. Our method outperforms the baseline on the GSO and 3D-FUTURE benchmarks, ranking first on average across standard image metrics, and achieving a 10.6% higher IoU than continuous diffusion models on 3D-FUTURE. Furthermore, the proposed framework can be naturally extended to support text-to-image generation and multimodal understanding, highlighting its potential toward a more unified paradigm for multimodal understanding and generation.

title: Improving Semantic Uncertainty Quantification in LVLMs with Semantic Gaussian Processes
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often produce plausible but unreliable outputs, making robust uncertainty estimation essential. Recent work on semantic uncertainty estimates relies on external models to cluster multiple sampled responses and measure their semantic consistency. However, these clustering methods are often fragile, highly sensitive to minor phrasing variations, and can incorrectly group or separate semantically similar answers, leading to unreliable uncertainty estimates. We propose Semantic Gaussian Process Uncertainty (SGPU), a Bayesian framework that quantifies semantic uncertainty by analyzing the geometric structure of answer embeddings, avoiding brittle clustering. SGPU maps generated answers into a dense semantic space, computes the Gram matrix of their embeddings, and summarizes their semantic configuration via the eigenspectrum. This spectral representation is then fed into a Gaussian Process Classifier that learns to map patterns of semantic consistency to predictive uncertainty, and that can be applied in both black-box and white-box settings. Across six LLMs and LVLMs on eight datasets spanning VQA, image classification, and textual QA, SGPU consistently achieves state-of-the-art calibration (ECE) and discriminative (AUROC, AUARC) performance. We further show that SGPU transfers across models and modalities, indicating that its spectral representation captures general patterns of semantic uncertainty.

title: Automated Lexical Coverage for Language Learning: From General to Specialized Word Lists
summary: A General Service List (GSL) is a commonly used resource for language learners to identify important English words. Traditional GSL creation is resource-intensive, relying on linguistic expertise and subjective input. We created our own GSL and evaluated its performance against the New General Service List (NGSL). We found that creating a Specialized Word List (SWL), tailored to a specific text, is a practical method for language learners. Because an SWL is derived from the target text itself, it reaches the 95% coverage required for language comprehension by construction, and it does so with substantially fewer words than a general list applied to the same text: across nine texts spanning fiction, academic papers, and scripts, the NGSL covered 64-85% of each text, whereas a text-specific list reached 95% with far smaller vocabularies. By restricting the SWL process to objective criteria only, it can be automated, scaled, and tailored to the needs of language-learners across the globe.

title: DVGT: Driving Visual Geometry Transformer
summary: Perceiving and reconstructing 3D scene geometry from visual inputs is crucial for autonomous driving. However, there still lacks a driving-targeted dense geometry perception model that can adapt to different scenarios and camera configurations. To bridge this gap, we propose a Driving Visual Geometry Transformer (DVGT), which reconstructs a global dense 3D point map from a sequence of unposed multi-view visual inputs. We first extract visual features for each image using a DINO backbone, and employ alternating intra-view local attention, cross-view spatial attention, and cross-frame temporal attention to infer geometric relations across images. We then use multiple heads to decode a global point map in the ego coordinate of the first frame and the ego poses for each frame. Unlike conventional methods that rely on precise camera parameters, DVGT is free of explicit 3D geometric priors, enabling flexible processing of arbitrary camera configurations. DVGT directly predicts metric-scaled geometry from image sequences, eliminating the need for post-alignment with external sensors. Trained on a large mixture of driving datasets including nuScenes, OpenScene, Waymo, KITTI, and DDAD, DVGT significantly outperforms existing models on various scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/wzzheng/DVGT.

title: You Only Train Once: Differentiable Subset Selection for Omics Data
comments: Camera-ready version accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Selecting compact and informative gene subsets from single-cell transcriptomic data is essential for biomarker discovery, improving interpretability, and cost-effective profiling. However, most existing feature selection approaches either operate as multi-stage pipelines or rely on post hoc feature attribution, making selection and prediction weakly coupled. In this work, we present YOTO (you only train once), an end-to-end framework that jointly identifies discrete gene subsets and performs prediction within a single differentiable architecture. In our model, the prediction task directly guides which genes are selected, while the learned subsets, in turn, shape the predictive representation. This closed feedback loop enables the model to iteratively refine both what it selects and how it predicts during training. Unlike existing approaches, YOTO enforces sparsity so that only the selected genes contribute to inference, eliminating the need to train additional downstream classifiers. Through a multi-task learning design, the model learns shared representations across related objectives, allowing partially labeled datasets to inform one another, and discovering gene subsets that generalize across tasks without additional training steps. We evaluate YOTO on two representative single-cell RNA-seq datasets, showing that it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. These results demonstrate that sparse, end-to-end, multi-task gene subset selection improves predictive performance and yields compact and meaningful gene subsets, advancing biomarker discovery and single-cell analysis.

title: Fast Deterministically Safe Proof-of-Work Consensus
comments: Mainly fixes discrepancies between the description of the MMR algorithm and its correctness proof
summary:
Permissionless blockchains achieve consensus while allowing unknown nodes to join and leave the system at any time. They typically come in two flavors: proof of work (PoW) and proof of stake (PoS), and both are vulnerable to attacks. PoS protocols suffer from long-range attacks, wherein attackers alter execution history at little cost, and PoW protocols are vulnerable to attackers with enough computational power to subvert execution history. PoS protocols respond by relying on external mechanisms like social consensus; PoW protocols either fall back to probabilistic guarantees, or are slow.
  We present Sieve-MMR, the first fully-permissionless protocol with deterministic security and constant expected latency that does not rely on external mechanisms. We obtain Sieve-MMR by porting a PoS protocol (MMR) to the PoW setting. From MMR we inherit constant expected latency and deterministic security, and proof-of-work gives us resilience against long-range attacks. The main challenge to porting MMR to the PoW setting is what we call time-travel attacks, where attackers use PoWs generated in the distant past to increase their perceived PoW power in the present. We respond by proposing Sieve, a novel algorithm that implements a new broadcast primitive we dub time-travel-resilient broadcast (TTRB). Sieve relies on a black-box, deterministic PoW primitive to implement TTRB, which we use as the messaging layer for MMR.

title: T2AV-Compass: Towards Unified Evaluation for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
comments: 41 pages, 13 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026
summary: Text-to-Audio-Video (T2AV) generation aims to synthesize temporally coherent video and semantically synchronized audio from natural language, yet its evaluation remains fragmented, often relying on unimodal metrics or narrowly scoped benchmarks that fail to capture cross-modal alignment, instruction following, and perceptual realism under complex prompts. To address this limitation, we present T2AV-Compass, a unified benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of T2AV systems, consisting of 500 diverse and complex prompts constructed via a taxonomy-driven pipeline to ensure semantic richness and physical plausibility. Besides, T2AV-Compass introduces a dual-level evaluation framework that integrates objective signal-level metrics for video quality, audio quality, and cross-modal alignment with a subjective MLLM-as-a-Judge protocol for instruction following and realism assessment. Extensive evaluation of 11 representative T2AVsystems reveals that even the strongest models fall substantially short of human-level realism and cross-modal consistency, with persistent failures in audio realism, fine-grained synchronization, instruction following, etc. These results indicate significant improvement room for future models and highlight the value of T2AV-Compass as a challenging and diagnostic testbed for advancing text-to-audio-video generation.

title: Semiparametric Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Single-Index Model
summary: Policy alignment to preference data typically assumes a known link function between observed preferences and latent rewards (e.g., Bradley-Terry model / logistic link). Misspecification of this link can bias inferred rewards and misalign learned policies. We study policy alignment under an unknown and unrestricted link function. We formulate an $f$-divergence-constrained reward maximization problem and show that realizability in a policy class induces a semiparametric single-index binary choice model, where a scalar policy-induced index captures all dependence on demonstrations and the remaining preference distribution is unrestricted. Rather than impose identifiability of structural parameters of such a model and estimate them, as in econometrics, we develop methods that directly learn policies, with the reward function implicit, analyzing error to the optimal policy and allowing for unidentifiable and nonparametric indices. We prove link-agnostic convergence guarantees in terms of generic function complexity measures and validate the methods and theory empirically. Code is available at https://github.com/causalml/spo/.
