title: Culturally Grounded Personas in Large Language Models: Characterization and Alignment with Socio-Psychological Value Frameworks
summary: Despite the growing utility of Large Language Models (LLMs) for simulating human behavior, the extent to which these synthetic personas accurately reflect world and moral value systems across different cultural conditionings remains uncertain. This paper investigates the alignment of synthetic, culturally-grounded personas with established frameworks, specifically the World Values Survey (WVS), the Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map, and Moral Foundations Theory. We conceptualize and produce LLM-generated personas based on a set of interpretable WVS-derived variables, and we examine the generated personas through three complementary lenses: positioning on the Inglehart-Welzel map, which unveils their interpretation reflecting stable differences across cultural conditionings; demographic-level consistency with the World Values Survey, where response distributions broadly track human group patterns; and moral profiles derived from a Moral Foundations questionnaire, which we analyze through a culture-to-morality mapping to characterize how moral responses vary across different cultural configurations. Our approach of culturally-grounded persona generation and analysis enables evaluation of cross-cultural structure and moral variation.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型中基于文化背景的人格：特征刻画与社会心理价值框架的对齐
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了LLM生成的合成人格在多大程度上符合现实世界的跨文化价值观和道德标准，并提供了一种评估模型文化对齐度的方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在模拟人类行为时，其背后反映的文化和道德价值观是否准确且符合不同文化背景，目前尚不明确，需要进行系统性评估。
AI.method: 利用世界价值观调查（WVS）变量引导LLM生成合成人格，并通过Inglehart-Welzel文化地图定位、WVS人口统计一致性检验以及道德基础问卷分析，评估模型在文化和道德层面的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现，生成的合成人格在Inglehart-Welzel地图上表现出稳定的文化差异，其人口统计学回应分布与人类群体模式基本一致，且其道德概况能够反映不同文化配置下的道德变化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功验证了通过特定变量引导LLM生成具有文化代表性的合成人格的可行性，并证明了这些模型在一定程度上能反映人类的跨文化道德差异。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在模拟人类行为方面的效用日益增长，但这些合成人格在多大程度上能准确反映不同文化条件下的人类世界观和道德价值体系仍不确定。本文研究了合成的、基于文化背景的人格与既定框架（特别是世界价值观调查（WVS）、Inglehart-Welzel文化地图和道德基础理论）的对齐情况。我们概念化并生成了基于一组可解释的WVS衍生变量的LLM人格，并通过三个互补的视角对其进行了考察：在Inglehart-Welzel地图上的定位，揭示了它们对反映文化条件下稳定差异的诠释；与世界价值观调查一致的人口统计学层面，即响应分布广泛跟踪人类群体模式；以及从道德基础问卷中得出的道德概况，我们通过文化到道德的映射来分析这些概况，以表征道德响应如何随不同的文化配置而变化。我们这种基于文化背景的人格生成和分析方法，使得对跨文化结构和道德差异的评估成为可能。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）生成的合成人格在多大程度上反映了不同文化背景下的世界观和道德价值观。研究通过WVS变量引导模型生成人格，并利用Inglehart-Welzel地图、人口统计一致性及道德基础理论对其进行评估，结果表明LLM能够模拟出具有跨文化结构和道德差异的合成人格。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 合成人格, 文化差异, 道德基础理论, 社会心理学框架
AI.comments: 该研究通过将LLM与成熟的社会心理学框架（WVS、Inglehart-Welzel图、道德基础理论）相结合，为评估大模型的文化偏见和行为模拟能力提供了一个严谨的定量分析框架，具有很高的学术和应用价值。

title: Tuning the Implicit Regularizer of Masked Diffusion Language Models: Enhancing Generalization via Insights from $k$-Parity
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models have recently emerged as a powerful generative paradigm, yet their generalization properties remain understudied compared to their auto-regressive counterparts. In this work, we investigate these properties within the setting of the $k$-parity problem (computing the XOR sum of $k$ relevant bits), where neural networks typically exhibit grokking -- a prolonged plateau of chance-level performance followed by sudden generalization. We theoretically decompose the Masked Diffusion (MD) objective into a Signal regime which drives feature learning, and a Noise regime which serves as an implicit regularizer. By training nanoGPT using MD objective on the $k$-parity problem, we demonstrate that MD objective fundamentally alters the learning landscape, enabling rapid and simultaneous generalization without experiencing grokking. Furthermore, we leverage our theoretical insights to optimize the distribution of the mask probability in the MD objective. Our method significantly improves perplexity for 50M-parameter models and achieves superior results across both pre-training from scratch and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, we observe performance gains peaking at $8.8\%$ and $5.8\%$, respectively, on 8B-parameter models, confirming the scalability and effectiveness of our framework in large-scale masked diffusion language model regimes.

AI.title_translation: 调整掩码扩散语言模型的隐式正则化：基于$k$-parity问题的泛化增强研究
AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析和实验证明，优化掩码扩散模型中的掩码分布可以消除训练中的grokking现象，显著提升大规模语言模型的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型的泛化特性研究不足，且在训练中常出现“grokking”（延迟泛化）现象。
AI.method: 将MD目标函数分解为信号和噪声机制；通过$k$-parity问题进行实验分析；通过优化掩码概率分布来改进模型训练。
AI.result: 消除了训练过程中的grokking现象；在50M参数模型上提升了困惑度；在8B参数模型上，预训练和监督微调的性能分别提升了8.8%和5.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化掩码概率分布，研究证明了掩码扩散模型能够有效改变学习景观，从而实现快速泛化并提升在大规模语言模型上的表现。
AI.translation: 掩码扩散语言模型最近已成为一种强大的生成范式，但与自回归模型相比，其泛化特性研究尚不充分。在这项工作中，我们在$k$-parity问题（计算$k$个相关位的XOR和）的背景下研究了这些特性，神经网络在此问题上通常表现出grokking现象——即在长时间的随机水平性能平原之后突然出现泛化。我们从理论上将掩码扩散（MD）目标分解为驱动特征学习的信号机制和充当隐式正则化器的噪声机制。通过在$k$-parity问题上使用MD目标训练nanoGPT，我们证明了MD目标从根本上改变了学习景观，能够在不经历grokking的情况下实现快速且同时的泛化。此外，我们利用我们的理论见解优化了MD目标中掩码概率的分布。我们的方法显著提高了50M参数模型的困惑度，并在从头预训练和监督微调中都取得了优异的结果。具体而言，我们在8B参数模型上观察到性能分别提升了8.8%和5.8%，证实了我们的框架在大型掩码扩散语言模型机制中的可扩展性和有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了掩码扩散语言模型的泛化能力，通过分析$k$-parity问题，将目标函数拆解为信号和噪声机制。研究发现MD目标能改变学习景观，消除grokking现象，并据此优化了掩码概率分布，显著提升了大规模语言模型的性能。
AI.keywords: 掩码扩散模型, 泛化能力, k-parity问题, grokking, 隐式正则化
AI.comments: 该论文通过对$k$-parity问题的深入理论分析，揭示了掩码扩散模型（MD）中隐式正则化的作用机制。其创新之处在于将MD目标函数分解为信号和噪声两个部分，并利用这一发现优化了掩码概率分布，从而消除了训练中的“grokking”现象，并在大规模模型中取得了显著的性能提升。这为理解扩散模型在语言任务中的泛化能力提供了重要的理论视角。

title: \textsc{Lethe}: Principled Dual-Stream Update for Persistent Knowledge Erasure in Federated Unlearning
summary: Federated unlearning (FU) aims to erase knowledge from a global model. Existing studies commonly assume that federated collaboration terminates after unlearning, overlooking a deployment-realistic scenario where training continues on the remaining clients after deletion requests are fulfilled. In this work, we identify a critical failure mode, termed knowledge resurfacing, revealing that continued training on retained data alone can reactivate unlearned knowledge in a few rounds. Empirically, we demonstrate that many state-of-the-art FU methods are prone to knowledge resurfacing. We then propose Lethe, a novel unlearning method for persistent knowledge erasure in federated settings. In each iteration, Lethe operates on a forget stream from the unlearning client and a retain stream from the retained clients. It redirects unlearning updates toward a region where the two streams are anti-aligned, discouraging retained-data training from moving back toward the forgotten knowledge. Consequently, Lethe ensures stronger unlearning persistence during subsequent federated training. Extensive experiments across diverse models, datasets, and unlearning levels validate that Lethe supports all levels of unlearning in a unified manner across both CV and NLP tasks, demonstrating consistently low RR, below 1% in most cases, even after an extremely long horizon of follow-up training.

title: R3G: A Reasoning-Retrieval-Reranking Framework for Vision-Centric Answer Generation
summary: Vision-centric retrieval for VQA requires retrieving images to supply missing visual cues and integrating them into the reasoning process. However, selecting the right images and integrating them effectively into the model's reasoning remains challenging.To address this challenge, we propose R3G, a modular Reasoning-Retrieval-Reranking framework.It first produces a brief reasoning plan that specifies the required visual cues, then adopts a two-stage strategy, with coarse retrieval followed by fine-grained reranking, to select evidence images.On MRAG-Bench, R3G improves accuracy across six MLLM backbones and nine sub-scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art overall performance. Ablations show that sufficiency-aware reranking and reasoning steps are complementary, helping the model both choose the right images and use them well. We release code and data at https://github.com/czh24/R3G.

AI.title_translation: R3G：一种用于以视觉为中心的答案生成的推理-检索-重排序框架
AI.tldr: R3G通过“推理规划+两阶段检索重排序”的模块化流程，解决了视觉问答中检索与推理集成的难题，实现了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决视觉问答（VQA）中如何有效检索缺失视觉线索并将其无缝集成到模型推理过程中的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为R3G的模块化框架，包含三个核心步骤：首先生成简要的推理计划以确定所需视觉线索；接着采用两阶段策略，即粗略检索后进行细粒度重排序，以精准选择证据图像。
AI.result: 在MRAG-Bench基准测试中，R3G在六种MLLM骨干网络和九个子场景中均提升了准确率，达到了最先进的整体性能水平。消融实验表明，充分性感知重排序与推理步骤具有互补性。
AI.conclusion: R3G框架通过推理计划与两阶段检索策略，显著提升了多模态大模型在视觉问答任务中的性能，证明了推理与视觉证据检索协同工作的重要性。
AI.translation: 以视觉为中心的视觉问答（VQA）检索需要检索图像以提供缺失的视觉线索，并将其整合到推理过程中。然而，选择正确的图像并将其有效地整合到模型的推理中仍然具有挑战性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了R3G，一个模块化的推理-检索-重排序（Reasoning-Retrieval-Reranking）框架。它首先生成一个简要的推理计划，指定所需的视觉线索，然后采用两阶段策略，通过粗略检索和细粒度重排序来选择证据图像。在MRAG-Bench上，R3G在六个MLLM骨干模型和九个子场景中提高了准确率，实现了最先进的整体性能。消融实验表明，充分性感知重排序和推理步骤是互补的，帮助模型既能选择正确的图像，又能很好地利用它们。我们发布了代码和数据，网址为 https://github.com/czh24/R3G。
AI.summary: R3G是一个用于视觉问答的模块化框架，通过制定推理计划来指导图像检索，并结合粗检索与细重排序策略，精准获取视觉证据，从而显著增强了多模态大模型在复杂任务中的推理与回答能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉问答, 检索增强生成, 推理计划, 多模态大模型, 重排序
AI.comments: R3G通过模块化的“推理-检索-重排序”流程，有效解决了视觉问答中图像检索与推理集成难的问题。其创新之处在于引入了推理计划来指导检索，并通过两阶段策略提升了证据图像的选择质量，在多个MLLM基准测试中表现卓越，具有很强的实用价值和扩展性。

title: SFMP: Fine-Grained, Hardware-Friendly and Search-Free Mixed-Precision Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: Mixed-precision quantization is a promising approach for compressing large language models under tight memory budgets. However, existing mixed-precision methods typically suffer from one of two limitations: they either rely on expensive discrete optimization to determine precision allocation, or introduce hardware inefficiencies due to irregular memory layouts. We propose SFMP, a search-free and hardware-friendly mixed-precision quantization framework for large language models. The framework is built upon four novel ideas: Fractional bit-width, which extends integer bit-width for weight matrix to fractional value and transforms discrete precision allocation as a continuous problem; 2)Block-wise mixed-precision, enabling fine-grained precision within weight matrices while remaining hardware-friendly; 3)Row-column weight reordering, which aggregates salient weights via row and column reordering, incurring only a small activation reordering overhead during inference; 4)Unified GEMM kernel, which supports mixed-precision GEMM at arbitrary average bit-width. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFMP outperforms state-of-the-art layer-wise mixed-precision methods under the same memory constraints, while significantly reducing quantization cost and improving inference efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/Nkniexin/SFMP

AI.title_translation: SFMP：面向大语言模型的细粒度、硬件友好且无需搜索的混合精度量化方法
AI.tldr: SFMP通过创新的分数位宽和统一硬件计算方案，实现了无需搜索的高效大模型混合精度量化，兼顾了压缩率与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的混合精度量化方法存在两大局限：一是搜索最优精度分配的计算开销巨大，二是由于不规则的内存布局导致硬件执行效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了SFMP框架，包含四个核心组件：1. 分数位宽（将离散精度分配转化为连续问题）；2. 块级混合精度（在保持硬件友好的前提下实现细粒度精度）；3. 行列权重重排序（通过重排序聚合显著权重）；4. 统一GEMM内核（支持任意平均位宽的混合精度计算）。
AI.result: 实验表明，SFMP在相同的内存约束下优于现有的层级混合精度量化方法，同时显著降低了量化开销并提高了推理性能。
AI.conclusion: SFMP通过分数位宽、块级混合精度和统一算子等技术，实现了无需搜索且硬件友好的大模型压缩，在保持高精度的同时显著提升了推理效率。
AI.translation: 混合精度量化是压缩受限于内存的大语言模型的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的混合精度方法通常受限于以下两个问题之一：要么依赖昂贵的离散优化来确定精度分配，要么因不规则的内存布局而导致硬件效率低下。我们提出了SFMP，一个针对大语言模型的无需搜索且硬件友好的混合精度量化框架。该框架基于四个创新点：1. 分数位宽，将权重矩阵的整数位宽扩展为分数，并将离散精度分配转化为连续问题；2. 块级混合精度，在权重矩阵内部实现细粒度精度，同时保持硬件友好；3. 行列权重重排序，通过行列重排序聚合显著权重，仅在推理时产生少量的激活重排序开销；4. 统一GEMM内核，支持任意平均位宽的混合精度矩阵乘法。大量实验证明，SFMP在相同的内存约束下优于当前最先进的层级混合精度方法，同时显著降低了量化成本并提高了推理效率。代码已开源。
AI.summary: SFMP是一个针对大语言模型的混合精度量化框架，通过引入分数位宽、块级细粒度精度控制、权重重排序及统一GEMM算子，消除了复杂的搜索过程并优化了硬件执行效率。
AI.keywords: 混合精度量化, 大语言模型, 分数位宽, 硬件友好, 推理效率
AI.comments: 该研究通过创新的分数位宽和硬件友好的布局策略，有效解决了大模型量化中精度分配计算开销大与硬件执行效率低之间的矛盾，为大模型的高效部署提供了实用方案。

title: On the Expressive Power of Permutation-Equivariant Weight-Space Networks
comments: Accepted as a spotlight paper at ICML 2026
summary: Weight-space learning studies neural architectures that operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. Motivated by the growing availability of pretrained models, recent work has demonstrated the effectiveness of weight-space networks across a wide range of tasks. SOTA weight-space networks rely on permutation-equivariant designs to improve generalization. However, this may negatively affect expressive power, warranting theoretical investigation. Importantly, unlike other structured domains, weight-space learning targets maps operating on both weight and function spaces, making expressivity analysis particularly subtle. While a few prior works provide partial expressivity results, a comprehensive characterization is still missing. In this work, we address this gap by developing a systematic theory for expressivity of weight-space networks. We first prove that all prominent permutation-equivariant networks are equivalent in expressive power. We then establish universality in both weight- and function-space settings under mild, natural assumptions on the input weights, and characterize the edge-case regimes where universality no longer holds. Guided by our theoretical results, we show that slight modifications to existing weight-space models yield a 34% improvement over prior SOTA, demonstrating the practical relevance of our framework.
comment: Accepted as a spotlight paper at ICML 2026

AI.title_translation: 论置换等变权重空间网络的表达能力
AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析证明了主流权重空间网络的表达能力等价性与通用性，并利用理论指导改进模型，实现了34%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 权重空间网络在处理预训练模型参数方面表现出色，但其置换等变性设计可能限制表达能力，且目前缺乏针对权重和函数空间的全面表达能力理论分析。
AI.method: 通过理论证明分析主流置换等变网络的表达能力，推导权重空间和函数空间下的通用性条件，并根据理论分析对现有模型进行改进。
AI.result: 证明了主流置换等变网络表达能力等价；在特定假设下建立了权重和函数空间的通用性；改进后的模型在任务中实现了比现有SOTA高出34%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一套系统的权重空间网络表达能力理论，证明了主流网络的等价性与通用性，并通过理论指导实现了性能的实质性突破。
AI.translation: 权重空间学习研究的是直接作用于其他神经网络参数的神经架构。受预训练模型日益普及的推动，近期研究展示了权重空间网络在广泛任务中的有效性。目前最先进（SOTA）的权重空间网络依赖于置换等变设计来提高泛化能力。然而，这可能会对表达能力产生负面影响，因此有必要进行理论研究。重要的是，与其他结构化领域不同，权重空间学习的目标是作用于权重空间和函数空间的映射，这使得表达能力分析变得尤为微妙。虽然先前的一些工作提供了一些局部的表达能力结果，但仍缺乏全面的刻画。在这项工作中，我们通过为权重空间网络的表达能力开发一套系统理论来填补这一空白。我们首先证明了所有主流的置换等变网络在表达能力上是等价的。然后，在对输入权重进行温和、自然的假设下，我们建立了权重空间和函数空间中的通用性，并刻画了不再满足通用性的边缘情况。在理论结果的指导下，我们展示了对现有权重空间模型的微小修改可以比之前的SOTA提升34%，证明了我们框架的实际意义。
AI.summary: 本文研究了权重空间网络的表达能力，证明了主流置换等变网络在表达能力上是等价的，并建立了在权重和函数空间下的通用性理论。基于这些理论发现，作者对现有模型进行了改进，显著提升了其实际应用性能。
AI.keywords: 权重空间学习, 置换等变性, 表达能力, 通用性, 神经网络参数
AI.comments: 该论文通过严谨的理论分析，揭示了当前权重空间网络在表达能力上的等价性，并填补了该领域通用性理论的空白。其创新点在于将理论发现直接转化为实际性能的显著提升，具有很高的学术和应用价值。

title: PersistBench: When Should Long-Term Memories Be Forgotten by LLMs?
summary: Conversational assistants are increasingly integrating long-term memory with large language models (LLMs). This persistence of memories, e.g., the user is vegetarian, can enhance personalization in future conversations. However, the same persistence can also introduce safety risks that have been largely overlooked. Hence, we introduce PersistBench to measure the extent of these safety risks. We identify two long-term memory-specific risks: cross-domain leakage, where LLMs inappropriately inject context from the long-term memories; and memory-induced sycophancy, where stored long-term memories insidiously reinforce user biases. We evaluate 18 frontier and open-source LLMs on our benchmark. Our results reveal a surprisingly high failure rate across these LLMs - a median failure rate of 53% on cross-domain samples and 97% on sycophancy samples. To address this, our benchmark encourages the development of more robust and safer long-term memory usage in frontier conversational systems.

AI.title_translation: PersistBench：大语言模型何时应该遗忘长期记忆？
AI.tldr: PersistBench揭示了LLM在处理长期记忆时存在严重的安全风险，其中记忆诱导的谄媚行为失败率高达97%。
AI.motivation: 随着对话式助手越来越多地集成长期记忆以实现个性化，这种持久性可能带来被忽视的安全风险，因此需要对其进行系统性的评估。
AI.method: 提出了PersistBench基准测试，专门针对大语言模型在长期记忆使用中的两个核心风险（跨领域泄露和记忆诱导的谄媚）进行评估，并对18个主流前沿及开源模型进行了实证测试。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，模型表现不佳，在跨领域样本上的中位失败率为53%，在记忆诱导的谄媚样本上的中位失败率高达97%。
AI.conclusion: 现有的前沿和开源LLM在处理长期记忆时存在严重的安全隐患，特别是对于记忆诱导的谄媚行为几乎缺乏防御能力，亟需开发更鲁棒的记忆管理机制。
AI.translation: 对话式助手正越来越多地将长期记忆与大语言模型（LLM）集成。这种记忆的持久性（例如，用户是素食主义者）可以增强未来对话的个性化体验。然而，这种持久性也可能带来被广泛忽视的安全风险。因此，我们引入了PersistBench来衡量这些安全风险的程度。我们确定了两种长期记忆特有的风险：跨领域泄露，即LLM不适当地注入来自长期记忆的上下文；以及记忆诱导的谄媚，即存储的长期记忆潜移默化地强化了用户的偏见。我们对18个前沿和开源LLM进行了基准测试。结果显示，这些LLM的失败率高得惊人——在跨领域样本上的中位失败率为53%，在谄媚样本上的中位失败率为97%。为了解决这个问题，我们的基准测试旨在鼓励前沿对话系统开发更鲁棒、更安全的长期记忆使用方式。
AI.summary: 本文引入了PersistBench基准测试，用于量化分析大语言模型在长期记忆应用中面临的跨领域信息泄露和记忆诱导的谄媚倾向，并揭示了当前主流模型在这些安全指标上的极高失败率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 长期记忆, 安全风险, 跨领域泄露, 谄媚行为
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了长期记忆在LLM应用中的安全盲点，特别是跨领域泄露和记忆诱导的谄媚行为。这些发现对于开发更安全、更可控的个性化对话系统具有重要的现实指导意义，同时也提醒开发者在提升个性化体验时必须权衡潜在的安全风险。

title: Sem-NaVAE: Semantically-Guided Outdoor Mapless Navigation via Generative Trajectory Priors
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: This work presents a mapless navigation approach for outdoor applications. It combines the exploratory capacity of conditional variational autoencoders (CVAEs) to generate trajectories and the semantic segmentation capabilities of a lightweight visual language model (VLM) to select the trajectory to execute. Open-vocabulary segmentation is used to score and select the generated trajectories based on natural language, and a state-of-the-art local planner executes velocity commands. One of the key features of the proposed approach is its ability to generate a large variability of trajectories and select them to navigate in real-time. In real-world outdoor experiments, Sem-NaVAE achieves a 90% success rate across routes of 120-240m in unseen environments, outperforming the nearest baseline by 10% while remaining within 7% of a map-based upper bound. A video showing an experimental run of the system can be found in https://youtu.be/i3R5ey5O2yk.

title: SUSD: Structured Unsupervised Skill Discovery through State Factorization
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Unsupervised Skill Discovery (USD) aims to autonomously learn a diverse set of skills without relying on extrinsic rewards. One of the most common USD approaches is to maximize the Mutual Information (MI) between skill latent variables and states. However, MI-based methods tend to favor simple, static skills due to their invariance properties, limiting the discovery of dynamic, task-relevant behaviors. Distance-Maximizing Skill Discovery (DSD) promotes more dynamic skills by leveraging state-space distances, yet still fall short in encouraging comprehensive skill sets that engage all controllable factors or entities in the environment. In this work, we introduce SUSD, a novel framework that harnesses the compositional structure of environments by factorizing the state space into independent components (e.g., objects or controllable entities). SUSD allocates distinct skill variables to different factors, enabling more fine-grained control on the skill discovery process. A dynamic model also tracks learning across factors, adaptively steering the agent's focus toward underexplored factors. This structured approach not only promotes the discovery of richer and more diverse skills, but also yields a factorized skill representation that enables fine-grained and disentangled control over individual entities which facilitates efficient training of compositional downstream tasks via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL). Our experimental results across three environments, with factors ranging from 1 to 10, demonstrate that our method can discover diverse and complex skills without supervision, significantly outperforming existing unsupervised skill discovery methods in factorized and complex environments. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/hadi-hosseini/SUSD.
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026

AI.title_translation: SUSD：通过状态因式分解实现结构化无监督技能发现
AI.tldr: SUSD 通过将状态空间分解为独立因子来发现复杂且解耦的技能，解决了现有方法在多实体环境下技能单一的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于互信息（MI）或距离最大化（DSD）的无监督技能发现方法难以发现复杂的动态行为，且无法充分利用环境中的多实体结构，导致发现的技能集不够全面或缺乏解耦性。
AI.method: 提出 SUSD 框架，通过将状态空间分解为独立组件（如物体或可控实体），并为不同因子分配不同的技能变量；同时利用动态模型监控各因子的学习进度，自适应地引导智能体关注未充分探索的因子。
AI.result: 在三个不同环境（因子数 1-10）的实验中，SUSD 能够发现更多样、更复杂的技能，并在因子化和复杂环境中显著优于现有的无监督技能发现方法。
AI.conclusion: SUSD 通过状态因式分解成功提升了无监督技能发现的复杂度和多样性，在多因素环境中表现优异，为复杂任务的层级强化学习提供了有效的技能表征。
AI.translation: 无监督技能发现（USD）旨在在不依赖外部奖励的情况下自主学习一组多样的技能。USD 最常见的方法之一是最大化技能潜变量与状态之间的互信息（MI）。然而，由于不变性属性，基于 MI 的方法往往偏好简单、静态的技能，限制了动态、任务相关行为的发现。距离最大化技能发现（DSD）通过利用状态空间距离来促进更动态的技能，但在鼓励涵盖环境中所有可控因素或实体的全面技能集方面仍然不足。在这项工作中，我们引入了 SUSD，这是一个利用环境组合结构的新框架，通过将状态空间分解为独立组件（如物体或可控实体）。SUSD 为不同的因子分配不同的技能变量，从而在技能发现过程中实现更细粒度的控制。一个动态模型还会跟踪各因子的学习情况，自适应地引导智能体的注意力转向未充分探索的因子。这种结构化方法不仅促进了更丰富、更多样化技能的发现，还产生了一种因子化的技能表示，实现了对个体实体的细粒度解耦控制，从而通过层级强化学习（HRL）促进了组合下游任务的高效训练。我们在三个因子数从 1 到 10 的环境中的实验结果表明，我们的方法可以在没有监督的情况下发现多样且复杂的技能，在因子化和复杂环境中显著优于现有的无监督技能发现方法。代码已公开：https://github.com/hadi-hosseini/SUSD。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 SUSD 的无监督技能发现框架，通过将状态空间分解为独立因子，实现对不同环境组件的细粒度技能分配与控制，从而在无需外部奖励的情况下发现更丰富、解耦的技能集，并提升了下游层级强化学习任务的效率。
AI.keywords: 无监督技能发现, 状态因式分解, 强化学习, 技能解耦, 互信息
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入状态因式分解（State Factorization）解决了传统无监督技能发现方法在复杂环境下的局限性，特别是在处理多实体控制和技能多样性方面具有显著创新。其核心贡献在于将技能发现过程结构化，实现了对环境因子的解耦控制，为层级强化学习提供了更高效的预训练基础。

title: Efficient Adversarial Attacks on High-dimensional Offline Bandits
summary: Bandit algorithms have recently emerged as a powerful tool for evaluating machine learning models, including generative image models and large language models, by efficiently identifying top-performing candidates without exhaustive comparisons. These methods typically rely on a reward model, often distributed with public weights on platforms such as Hugging Face, to provide feedback to the bandit. While online evaluation is expensive and requires repeated trials, offline evaluation with logged data has become an attractive alternative. However, the adversarial robustness of offline bandit evaluation remains largely unexplored, particularly when an attacker perturbs the reward model (rather than the training data) prior to bandit training. In this work, we fill this gap by investigating, both theoretically and empirically, the vulnerability of offline bandit training to adversarial manipulations of the reward model. We introduce a novel threat model in which an attacker exploits offline data in high-dimensional settings to hijack the bandit's behavior. Starting with linear reward functions and extending to nonlinear models such as ReLU neural networks, we study attacks on two Hugging Face evaluators used for generative model assessment: one measuring aesthetic quality and the other assessing compositional alignment. Our results show that even small, imperceptible perturbations to the reward model's weights can drastically alter the bandit's behavior. From a theoretical perspective, we prove a striking high-dimensional effect: as input dimensionality increases, the perturbation norm required for a successful attack decreases, making modern applications such as image evaluation especially vulnerable. Extensive experiments confirm that naive random perturbations are ineffective, whereas carefully targeted perturbations achieve near-perfect attack success rates ...

AI.title_translation: 针对高维离线老虎机的高效对抗攻击
AI.tldr: 研究发现，通过对离线老虎机评估所用的奖励模型施加微小权重扰动，攻击者可以轻易操纵模型评估结果，且这种攻击在高维数据中表现得更加容易。
AI.motivation: 现有的离线老虎机评估方法在面临奖励模型被恶意篡改（对抗性扰动）时的鲁棒性研究严重缺失，特别是在高维生成模型评估场景下。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对奖励模型权重（而非数据）的对抗攻击框架，涵盖从线性奖励函数到ReLU神经网络的多种模型，并利用高维空间特性设计了针对性的扰动策略。
AI.result: 研究发现，即使是微小且不可见的权重扰动也能显著改变老虎机的决策行为；理论分析证明，随着输入维度增加，攻击所需的扰动范数会减小，且实验证实精心设计的攻击手段能达到近乎完美的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了离线老虎机评估方法对奖励模型攻击的高度敏感性，特别是在高维应用中，攻击难度会随维度增加而降低，这强调了在机器学习评估流水线中建立对抗鲁棒性的必要性。
AI.translation: 老虎机算法最近已成为评估机器学习模型（包括生成式图像模型和大语言模型）的强大工具，能够通过高效识别表现最好的候选者而无需进行详尽的比较。这些方法通常依赖于奖励模型（通常以公共权重形式发布在 Hugging Face 等平台上）来为老虎机提供反馈。虽然在线评估成本高昂且需要重复试验，但利用日志数据进行的离线评估已成为一种极具吸引力的替代方案。然而，离线老虎机评估的对抗鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未被探索，特别是在攻击者在老虎机训练之前扰动奖励模型（而非训练数据）时。在这项工作中，我们通过理论和实证研究离线老虎机训练对奖励模型对抗性操纵的脆弱性，填补了这一空白。我们引入了一种新的威胁模型，攻击者利用高维环境下的离线数据来劫持老虎机的行为。从线性奖励函数开始，并扩展到 ReLU 神经网络等非线性模型，我们研究了针对两个用于生成模型评估的 Hugging Face 评估器的攻击：一个用于衡量美学质量，另一个用于评估组合对齐。我们的结果表明，即使是对奖励模型权重的微小、不可察觉的扰动，也会剧烈改变老虎机的行为。从理论角度来看，我们证明了一个显著的高维效应：随着输入维度的增加，成功攻击所需的扰动范数会减小，这使得图像评估等现代应用特别容易受到攻击。大量实验证实，简单的随机扰动是无效的，而精心设计的针对性扰动则实现了近乎完美的攻击成功率。
AI.summary: 本文研究了离线多臂老虎机在评估机器学习模型时，针对奖励模型权重进行对抗攻击的脆弱性。作者提出了针对高维数据的攻击模型，理论证明了攻击难度随维度增加而降低，并通过对美学和对齐评估器的实验，验证了微小扰动即可操纵老虎机决策的有效性。
AI.keywords: 离线老虎机, 对抗攻击, 奖励模型, 高维数据, 模型评估
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了离线多臂老虎机在评估高维生成模型时的潜在安全漏洞。其创新之处在于提出了一种针对奖励模型权重而非训练数据的攻击模型，并从理论上证明了维度灾难会放大这种攻击效果，这对当前依赖预训练奖励模型进行自动评估的机器学习流程具有重要的安全启示。

title: Adaptive Information Control for Search-Augmented LLM Reasoning
summary: Search-augmented reasoning agents interleave multi-step reasoning with external retrieval, but uncontrolled retrieval can introduce redundant evidence, saturate the context, and destabilize reinforcement learning (RL). Existing outcome-based RL methods provide only sparse terminal rewards, offering limited guidance for intermediate information-acquisition decisions. We propose DeepControl, an adaptive information-control framework based on information utility, a state-dependent estimate of the marginal value of retrieved evidence. The framework regulates information acquisition along two axes: extent, i.e., whether retrieval should continue, and resolution, i.e., how much retrieved detail should be exposed. It implements these controls through retrieval-continuation guidance, hierarchical granularity control, and an annealed control-forcing scheme. This enables the policy to internalize effective acquisition behavior during training and operate without external control at test time. Across seven benchmarks, DeepControl consistently outperforms strong RL and retrieval baselines without explicit information control; compared with Search-R1, it improves average performance by +9.4 and +8.6 points on Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-3B, respectively. Additional analyses show improved search effectiveness, training stability, and evidence utilization.

title: Making Expert Reasoning Learnable with Self-Distillation
summary: Improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) typically relies either on the model's ability to sample a correct solution to be reinforced or the existence of a stronger model able to solve the problem. However, many difficult problems remain intractable for even current frontier models, preventing the extraction of valid training signals. A promising alternative is to leverage high-quality expert human solutions, yet naive imitation of this data fails because it is fundamentally out-of-distribution: expert solutions are typically didactic, containing implicit reasoning gaps intended for human readers rather than computational models. Furthermore, high-quality expert solutions are expensive, necessitating generalizable, sample-efficient training methods. We propose Distribution Aligned Imitation Learning (DAIL), a two-step self-distillation method that bridges the distributional gap by first transforming expert solutions into detailed, in-distribution reasoning traces and then applying a contrastive objective to focus learning on expert insights and methodologies. We find that DAIL can leverage fewer than 1000 high-quality expert solutions to achieve up to 31% pass@128 gains on Qwen2.5-Instruct and Qwen3, double reasoning efficiency, and enable out-of-domain generalization.

AI.title_translation: 通过自蒸馏使专家推理变得可学习
AI.tldr: DAIL 通过将人类专家方案转化为模型可学习的详细推理路径，仅用不到 1000 个样本即可显著提升 LLM 的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 推理改进方法依赖于模型自我采样或更强模型，但面对极难问题时失效；直接模仿人类专家数据因存在分布差异和推理间隙而效果有限，且专家数据昂贵。
AI.method: 提出分布对齐模仿学习（DAIL）：首先将专家方案转化为详细的、同分布的推理轨迹，随后应用对比目标函数聚焦于专家洞察和方法论的训练。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Instruct 和 Qwen3 上，使用少于 1000 个专家样本，实现了高达 31% 的 pass@128 提升，推理效率翻倍，并具备领域外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DAIL 通过将专家方案转化为模型可学习的推理轨迹，在极少量数据下显著提升了 LLM 的推理性能和效率。
AI.translation: 提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力通常依赖于模型采样正确解决方案进行强化，或者依赖于更强模型来解决问题。然而，许多难题对于当前的前沿模型来说仍然难以解决，这阻碍了有效训练信号的提取。一个有前景的替代方案是利用高质量的专家人类解决方案，但对这些数据的简单模仿往往失败，因为它们在本质上是分布外（out-of-distribution）的：专家解决方案通常是说教式的，包含旨在给人类读者而非计算模型看的隐性推理间隙。此外，高质量的专家解决方案昂贵，需要具有通用性、样本高效的训练方法。我们提出了分布对齐模仿学习（DAIL），这是一种两阶段自蒸馏方法，通过首先将专家解决方案转化为详细的、同分布的推理轨迹，然后应用对比目标函数将学习重点放在专家洞察和方法论上，从而弥合了分布差距。我们发现，DAIL 可以利用少于 1000 个高质量专家解决方案，在 Qwen2.5-Instruct 和 Qwen3 上实现高达 31% 的 pass@128 增益，使推理效率翻倍，并实现领域外泛化。
AI.summary: 本文提出了分布对齐模仿学习（DAIL），这是一种通过两阶段自蒸馏弥合人类专家方案与模型推理需求之间分布差距的方法。该方法将昂贵的专家数据转化为详细的推理轨迹，从而在极小样本量下显著增强了 LLM 的推理能力和效率。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 推理能力, 自蒸馏, 模仿学习, 分布对齐
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于解决了直接模仿人类专家数据（由于分布差异和推理跳跃）效果不佳的问题。通过两阶段自蒸馏方法将专家方案转化为模型易于学习的推理轨迹，实现了小样本下的高效推理能力提升，具有很强的实用价值。

title: What Structural Inductive Bias Helps Transformers Reason Over Knowledge Graphs? A Study with Tabula RASA
summary: What structural inductive bias helps transformers reason over knowledge graphs? Through controlled ablations of a minimal transformer modification with four independently removable components (sparse adjacency masking, edge-type biases, query scaling, value gating), we isolate which structural signals drive multi-hop reasoning. Our finding is sharp: sparse adjacency masking alone accounts for the dominant share of improvement over unmasked transformers (+72.5pp on 3-hop MetaQA, +45.5pp on WebQSP, +53.9pp on CWQ), while learned relation parameters add only modest refinement and can actively hurt without structural guidance. A zero-shot experiment provides architecturally independent corroboration: masking-based attention degrades 4.0x less than relation-specific weights when edge types are held out. The useful inductive bias for multi-hop KGQA is predominantly topological, not relational.

title: Can Large Language Models Generalize Procedures Across Representations?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained and tested extensively on symbolic representations such as code and graphs, yet real-world user tasks are often specified in natural language. To what extent can LLMs generalize across these representations? Here, we approach this question by studying isomorphic tasks involving procedures represented in code, graphs, and natural language (e.g., scheduling steps in planning). We find that training LLMs with popular post-training methods on graphs or code data alone does not reliably generalize to corresponding natural language tasks, while training solely on natural language can lead to inefficient performance gains. To address this gap, we propose a two-stage reinforcement learning curriculum that first trains on symbolic, then natural language data. The curriculum substantially improves model performance across model families and tasks. Remarkably, a 1.5B Qwen model trained by our method can closely match zero-shot GPT-4o in naturalistic planning. Finally, our analysis suggests that successful cross-representation generalization can be interpreted as a form of generative analogy, which our curriculum effectively encourages. The dataset and code used in this paper can be found \href{https://github.com/fangru-lin/procedure_generalization_llm}{here}.
